Source: [HTML Standard commit snapshot](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/). Source revision `877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a` (9 October 2026); retrieved 11 October 2026 UTC. This immutable snapshot is the selected language baseline, independently of the html5ever implementation ingestion revision.

The exact [WHATWG LICENSE](../licenses/whatwg/LICENSE), also present in the HTML repository at this revision, has SHA-256 `85dc6f5ccb57a6fe8c33d158f9fc8fc7ee5655a5d3db2cdd131c6a3d0f48a864`. Specification prose is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International; the BSD 3-Clause scope applies when portions are incorporated into code, not as an alternative license for this Markdown.

Complete original HTML: 14,930,614 bytes, SHA-256 `877d6cc00dae6c18c16d952fdcbf944acc58919579621b4257fa0ed1888a871f`. Complete-section extraction input: 1,514,032 bytes, SHA-256 `48a1a13e5cfe178e9d3d167bbda308584e3f36e981b8685b69805d69dcc4047c`.

Retained complete heading sections, including all descendant clauses and bounded by the next equal-or-higher-level heading: `embedded-content`. Original snapshot header is retained. The [edition map](SOURCE-EDITIONS.md#pinned-html-language-baseline) records the ten companion captures and bounded ownership. Every §4 element definition is retained across the collection. Omitted browser runtime chapters remain linked to this immutable snapshot; retaining JavaScript interfaces, networking, media, script execution or custom-element algorithms as source evidence does not assign their implementation to the native HTML crate. HTML syntax, author conformance and required parsing recovery remain distinct; malformed input is not rejected solely for an author-conformance error.

Conversion uses the repository preparation/filter, approved Pandoc 3.1.11.1 and parsed-GFM comparison. Source scripts/styles are omitted without execution. Source headings, IDs, links, prose, inline code, variables, literal blocks, images and table cells/spans are checked. Selected complex tables and inline SVG diagrams remain literal semantic HTML/SVG, preserving source structure without flattening. Cross-capture links retain the same pinned edition.

Where <a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;embedded&#45;content&#45;category&#45;2"></a>[embedded content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#embedded-content-category) is expected&#46;

Zero or more <a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> elements&#44; followed by one <a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#44; optionally intermixed with <a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;script&#45;supporting&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[script&#45;supporting elements](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#script-supporting-elements-2)&#46;

Neither tag is omissible&#46;

<a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;sanitizer&#45;uncategorized"></a>[Uncategorized](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sanitizer-uncategorized)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmlpictureelement"></a><a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLPictureElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code> element is a container which provides multiple sources to its contained <a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element to allow authors to declaratively control or give hints to the user agent about which image resource to use&#44; based on the screen pixel density&#44; <a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;viewport"></a>[viewport](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#viewport) size&#44; image format&#44; and other factors&#46; It <a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) its children&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code> element is somewhat different from the similar&#45;looking <a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> and <a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> elements&#46; While all of them contain <a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> elements&#44; the <a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-source-src)</code> attribute has no meaning when the element is nested within a <a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code> element&#44; and the resource selection algorithm is different&#46; Also&#44; the <a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code> element itself does not display anything&#59; it merely provides a context for its contained <a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element that enables it to choose from multiple <a id="the&#45;picture&#45;element&#58;url"></a>[URLs](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url)&#46;

No <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag"></a>[end tag](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-end-tag)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes"></a>[Content attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-attributes)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;global&#45;attributes"></a>[Global attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#global-attributes)

<a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-source-type)</code> — Type of embedded resource

<a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;media"></a><code>[media](#attr-source-media)</code> — Applicable media

<a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-source-src)</code> &#40;in <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> or <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code>&#41; — Address of the resource

<a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;srcset"></a><code>[srcset](#attr-source-srcset)</code> &#40;in <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code>&#41; — Images to use in different situations&#44; e&#46;g&#46;&#44; high&#45;resolution displays&#44; small monitors&#44; etc&#46;

<a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;sizes"></a><code>[sizes](#attr-source-sizes)</code> &#40;in <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code>&#41; — Image sizes for different page layouts

<a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;width"></a><code>[width](#attr-dim-width)</code> &#40;in <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code>&#41; — Horizontal dimension

<a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;height"></a><code>[height](#attr-dim-height)</code> &#40;in <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code>&#41; — Vertical dimension

<strong><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;accessibility&#45;considerations"></a>[Accessibility considerations](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-accessibility-considerations)&#58;</strong>

[For authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-source)&#46;

[For implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-source)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;sanitization"></a>[Sanitization](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-sanitization)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;sanitizer&#45;uncategorized"></a>[Uncategorized](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sanitizer-uncategorized)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmlsourceelement"></a><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflecturl"></a><a id="dom&#45;source&#45;src"></a><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect"></a><a id="dom&#45;source&#45;type"></a><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;3"></a><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;2"></a><a id="dom&#45;source&#45;srcset"></a><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;4"></a><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;3"></a><a id="dom&#45;source&#45;sizes"></a><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;5"></a><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;4"></a><a id="dom&#45;source&#45;media"></a><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;6"></a><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;5"></a><a id="dom&#45;source&#45;width"></a><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;7"></a><a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;6"></a><a id="dom&#45;source&#45;height"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLSourceElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, ReflectURL] attribute USVString src;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString type;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute USVString srcset;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString sizes;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString media;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute unsigned long width;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute unsigned long height;
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element allows authors to specify multiple alternative <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;source&#45;set"></a>[source sets](#source-set) for <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> elements or multiple alternative <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[media resources](#media-resource) for <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[media elements](#media-element)&#46; It does not <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represent](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) anything on its own&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;source&#45;type"></a><strong><code>type</code></strong> attribute may be present&#46; If present&#44; the value must be a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;mime&#45;type&#45;string"></a>[valid MIME type string](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-mime-type)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;source&#45;media"></a><strong><code>media</code></strong> attribute may also be present&#46; If present&#44; the value must contain a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;media&#45;query&#45;list"></a>[valid media query list](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-media-query-list)&#46; The user agent will skip to the next <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element if the value does not <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;matches&#45;the&#45;environment"></a>[match the environment](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#matches-the-environment)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;media&#45;2"></a><code>[media](#attr-source-media)</code> attribute is only evaluated once during the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm) for <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[media elements](#media-element)&#46; In contrast&#44; when using the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code> element&#44; the user agent will <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;img&#45;environment&#45;changes"></a>[react to changes in the environment](#img-environment-changes)&#46;

The remainder of the requirements depend on whether the parent is a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code> element or a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#58;

<strong>The <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element&#39;s parent is a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code> element</strong>

The <a id="attr&#45;source&#45;srcset"></a><strong><code>srcset</code></strong> attribute must be present&#44; and is a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;srcset&#45;attribute"></a>[srcset attribute](#srcset-attribute)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;srcset&#45;2"></a><code>[srcset](#attr-source-srcset)</code> attribute contributes the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;image&#45;source"></a>[image sources](#image-source) to the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;source&#45;set&#45;2"></a>[source set](#source-set)&#44; if the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element is selected&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;srcset&#45;3"></a><code>[srcset](#attr-source-srcset)</code> attribute has any <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;image&#45;candidate&#45;string"></a>[image candidate strings](#image-candidate-string) using a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;width&#45;descriptor"></a>[width descriptor](#width-descriptor)&#44; the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;sizes&#45;2"></a><code>[sizes](#attr-source-sizes)</code> attribute may also be present&#46; If&#44; additionally&#44; the following sibling <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element does not <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;allows&#45;auto&#45;sizes"></a>[allow auto&#45;sizes](#allows-auto-sizes)&#44; the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;sizes&#45;3"></a><code>[sizes](#attr-source-sizes)</code> attribute must be present&#46; The <a id="attr&#45;source&#45;sizes"></a><strong><code>sizes</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;sizes&#45;attribute"></a>[sizes attribute](#sizes-attribute)&#44; which contributes the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;source&#45;size&#45;2"></a>[source size](#source-size-2) to the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;source&#45;set&#45;3"></a>[source set](#source-set)&#44; if the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element is selected&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

If the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;allows&#45;auto&#45;sizes&#45;2"></a>[allows auto&#45;sizes](#allows-auto-sizes)&#44; then the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;sizes&#45;4"></a><code>[sizes](#attr-source-sizes)</code> attribute can be omitted on previous sibling <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> elements&#46; In such cases&#44; it is equivalent to specifying <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;valdef&#45;sizes&#45;auto"></a><code>[auto](#valdef-sizes-auto)</code>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element supports <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;dimension&#45;attributes"></a>[dimension attributes](#dimension-attributes)&#46; The <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element can use the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;width&#45;2"></a><code>[width](#attr-dim-width)</code> and <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;height&#45;2"></a><code>[height](#attr-dim-height)</code> attributes of a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element&#44; instead of those on the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element itself&#44; to determine its rendered dimensions and aspect&#45;ratio&#44; [as defined in the Rendering section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dimRendering)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](#attr-source-type)</code> attribute gives the type of the images in the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;source&#45;set&#45;4"></a>[source set](#source-set)&#44; to allow the user agent to skip to the next <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element if it does not support the given type&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

If the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;type&#45;3"></a><code>[type](#attr-source-type)</code> attribute is <em>not</em> specified&#44; the user agent will not select a different <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element if it finds that it does not support the image format after fetching it&#46;

When a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element has a following sibling <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element or <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element with a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;srcset"></a><code>[srcset](#attr-img-srcset)</code> attribute specified&#44; it must have at least one of the following&#58;

- A <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;media&#45;3"></a><code>[media](#attr-source-media)</code> attribute specified with a value that&#44; after <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;strip&#45;leading&#45;and&#45;trailing&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace"></a>[stripping leading and trailing ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-leading-and-trailing-ascii-whitespace)&#44; is not the empty string and is not an <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for the string &#34;<code>all</code>&#34;&#46;

- A <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;type&#45;4"></a><code>[type](#attr-source-type)</code> attribute specified&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;src&#45;2"></a><code>[src](#attr-source-src)</code> attribute must not be present&#46;

<strong>The <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element&#39;s parent is a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[media element](#media-element)</strong>

The <a id="attr&#45;source&#45;src"></a><strong><code>src</code></strong> attribute gives the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) of the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#46; The value must be a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;empty&#45;url&#45;potentially&#45;surrounded&#45;by&#45;spaces"></a>[valid non&#45;empty URL potentially surrounded by spaces](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-empty-url-potentially-surrounded-by-spaces)&#46; This attribute must be present&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;type&#45;5"></a><code>[type](#attr-source-type)</code> attribute gives the type of the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;3"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; to help the user agent determine if it can play this <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;4"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) before fetching it&#46; The <code>codecs</code> parameter&#44; which certain MIME types define&#44; might be necessary to specify exactly how the resource is encoded&#46; [&#91;RFC6381&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsRFC6381)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Dynamically modifying a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;src&#45;3"></a><code>[src](#attr-source-src)</code> or <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;type&#45;6"></a><code>[type](#attr-source-type)</code> attribute when the element is already inserted in a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> or <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> element will have no effect&#46; To change what is playing&#44; just use the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> attribute on the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[media element](#media-element) directly&#44; possibly making use of the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;navigator&#45;canplaytype"></a><code>[canPlayType&#40;&#41;](#dom-navigator-canplaytype)</code> method to pick from amongst available resources&#46; Generally&#44; manipulating <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> elements manually after the document has been parsed is an unnecessarily complicated approach&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The following list shows some examples of how to use the <code>codecs&#61;</code> MIME parameter in the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;type&#45;7"></a><code>[type](#attr-source-type)</code> attribute&#46;

<strong>H&#46;264 Constrained baseline profile video &#40;main and extended video compatible&#41; level 3 and Low&#45;Complexity AAC audio in MP4 container</strong>

``` text
<source src='video.mp4' type='video/mp4; codecs="avc1.42E01E, mp4a.40.2"'>
```

<strong>H&#46;264 Extended profile video &#40;baseline&#45;compatible&#41; level 3 and Low&#45;Complexity AAC audio in MP4 container</strong>

``` text
<source src='video.mp4' type='video/mp4; codecs="avc1.58A01E, mp4a.40.2"'>
```

<strong>H&#46;264 Main profile video level 3 and Low&#45;Complexity AAC audio in MP4 container</strong>

``` text
<source src='video.mp4' type='video/mp4; codecs="avc1.4D401E, mp4a.40.2"'>
```

<strong>H&#46;264 &#39;High&#39; profile video &#40;incompatible with main&#44; baseline&#44; or extended profiles&#41; level 3 and Low&#45;Complexity AAC audio in MP4 container</strong>

``` text
<source src='video.mp4' type='video/mp4; codecs="avc1.64001E, mp4a.40.2"'>
```

<strong>MPEG&#45;4 Visual Simple Profile Level 0 video and Low&#45;Complexity AAC audio in MP4 container</strong>

``` text
<source src='video.mp4' type='video/mp4; codecs="mp4v.20.8, mp4a.40.2"'>
```

<strong>MPEG&#45;4 Advanced Simple Profile Level 0 video and Low&#45;Complexity AAC audio in MP4 container</strong>

``` text
<source src='video.mp4' type='video/mp4; codecs="mp4v.20.240, mp4a.40.2"'>
```

<strong>MPEG&#45;4 Visual Simple Profile Level 0 video and AMR audio in 3GPP container</strong>

``` text
<source src='video.3gp' type='video/3gpp; codecs="mp4v.20.8, samr"'>
```

<strong>Theora video and Vorbis audio in Ogg container</strong>

``` text
<source src='video.ogv' type='video/ogg; codecs="theora, vorbis"'>
```

<strong>Theora video and Speex audio in Ogg container</strong>

``` text
<source src='video.ogv' type='video/ogg; codecs="theora, speex"'>
```

<strong>Vorbis audio alone in Ogg container</strong>

``` text
<source src='audio.ogg' type='audio/ogg; codecs=vorbis'>
```

<strong>Speex audio alone in Ogg container</strong>

``` text
<source src='audio.spx' type='audio/ogg; codecs=speex'>
```

<strong>FLAC audio alone in Ogg container</strong>

``` text
<source src='audio.oga' type='audio/ogg; codecs=flac'>
```

<strong>Dirac video and Vorbis audio in Ogg container</strong>

``` text
<source src='video.ogv' type='video/ogg; codecs="dirac, vorbis"'>
```

The <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;srcset&#45;4"></a><code>[srcset](#attr-source-srcset)</code> and <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;sizes&#45;5"></a><code>[sizes](#attr-source-sizes)</code> attributes must not be present&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;html&#45;element&#45;insertion&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element insertion steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-insertion-steps)&#44; given <var>insertedNode</var>&#44; are&#58;

1.  Let <var>parent</var> be <var>insertedNode</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;parent"></a>[parent](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-parent)&#46;

2.  If <var>parent</var> is a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[media element](#media-element) that has no <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src&#45;2"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> attribute and whose <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> has the value <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;empty"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;EMPTY](#dom-media-network_empty)</code>&#44; then invoke that <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;8"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm)&#46;

3.  If <var>parent</var> is a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code> element&#44; then <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;list&#45;iterate"></a>[for each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) <var>child</var> of <var>parent</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;tree&#45;child"></a>[children](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-child)&#44; if <var>child</var> is an <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#44; then count this as a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;relevant&#45;mutations"></a>[relevant mutation](#relevant-mutations) for <var>child</var>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;html&#45;element&#45;moving&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element moving steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-moving-steps)&#44; given <var>movedNode</var>&#44; <var>isSubtreeRoot</var>&#44; and <var>oldAncestor</var> are&#58;

1.  If <var>movedNode</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;parent&#45;2"></a>[parent](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-parent) is a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;9"></a>[media element](#media-element) that has no <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src&#45;3"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> attribute and whose <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;2"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> has the value <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;empty&#45;2"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;EMPTY](#dom-media-network_empty)</code>&#44; then invoke that <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;10"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm&#45;3"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm)&#46;

2.  If <var>isSubtreeRoot</var> is true and <var>oldAncestor</var> is a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code> element&#44; then <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;list&#45;iterate&#45;2"></a>[for each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) <var>child</var> of <var>oldAncestor</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;tree&#45;child&#45;2"></a>[children](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-child)&#58; if <var>child</var> is an <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#44; then count this as a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;relevant&#45;mutations&#45;2"></a>[relevant mutation](#relevant-mutations) for <var>child</var>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;html&#45;element&#45;removing&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element removing steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-removing-steps)&#44; given <var>removedNode</var>&#44; <var>isSubtreeRoot</var>&#44; and <var>oldAncestor</var> are&#58;

1.  If <var>isSubtreeRoot</var> is true and <var>oldAncestor</var> is a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code> element&#44; then <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;list&#45;iterate&#45;3"></a>[for each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) <var>child</var> of <var>oldAncestor</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;tree&#45;child&#45;3"></a>[children](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-child)&#58; if <var>child</var> is an <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#44; then count this as a <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;relevant&#45;mutations&#45;3"></a>[relevant mutation](#relevant-mutations) for <var>child</var>&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

If the author isn&#39;t sure if user agents will all be able to render the media resources provided&#44; the author can listen to the <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;event&#45;error"></a><code>[error](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-error)</code> event on the last <a id="the&#45;source&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element and trigger fallback behavior&#58;

``` text
<script>
 function fallback(video) {
   // replace <video> with its contents
   while (video.hasChildNodes()) {
     if (video.firstChild instanceof HTMLSourceElement)
       video.removeChild(video.firstChild);
     else
       video.parentNode.insertBefore(video.firstChild, video);
   }
   video.parentNode.removeChild(video);
 }
</script>
<video controls autoplay>
 <source src='video.mp4' type='video/mp4; codecs="avc1.42E01E, mp4a.40.2"'>
 <source src='video.ogv' type='video/ogg; codecs="theora, vorbis"'
         onerror="fallback(parentNode)">
 ...
</video>
```

#### <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element"></a>4&#46;8&#46;3 The <strong><code>img</code></strong> element[](#the-img-element)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;img](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/img)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari1&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

 LegacyFactoryFunction=Image(optional unsigned long width, optional unsigned long height)]
interface HTMLImageElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString alt;
  [CEReactions, ReflectURL] attribute USVString src;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute USVString srcset;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString sizes;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString? crossOrigin;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString useMap;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean isMap;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean controls;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute unsigned long width;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute unsigned long height;
  readonly attribute unsigned long naturalWidth;
  readonly attribute unsigned long naturalHeight;
  readonly attribute boolean complete;
  readonly attribute USVString currentSrc;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString referrerPolicy;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString decoding;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString loading;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString fetchPriority;

  Promise<undefined> decode();

  // also has obsolete members
};

An <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element represents an image&#46;

An <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element has a <a id="concept&#45;img&#45;dimension&#45;attribute&#45;source"></a><strong>dimension attribute source</strong>&#44; initially set to the element itself&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLImageElement&#47;src](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLImageElement/src)

[Element&#47;img&#35;attr&#45;srcset](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/img#attr-srcset)

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

The image given by the <a id="attr&#45;img&#45;src"></a><strong><code>src</code></strong> and <a id="attr&#45;img&#45;srcset"></a><strong><code>srcset</code></strong> attributes&#44; and any previous sibling <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> elements&#39; <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;srcset"></a><code>[srcset](#attr-source-srcset)</code> attributes if the parent is a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code> element&#44; is the embedded content&#59; the value of the <a id="attr&#45;img&#45;alt"></a><strong><code>alt</code></strong> attribute provides equivalent content for those who cannot process images or who have image loading disabled &#40;i&#46;e&#46;&#44; it is the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;fallback&#45;content"></a>[fallback content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#fallback-content)&#41;&#46;

The requirements on the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;3"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute&#39;s value are described [in a separate section](#alt)&#46;

At least one of the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src&#45;2"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code> and <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;srcset&#45;2"></a><code>[srcset](#attr-img-srcset)</code> attributes must be present&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src&#45;3"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code> attribute is present&#44; it must contain a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;empty&#45;url&#45;potentially&#45;surrounded&#45;by&#45;spaces"></a>[valid non&#45;empty URL potentially surrounded by spaces](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-empty-url-potentially-surrounded-by-spaces) referencing a non&#45;interactive&#44; optionally animated&#44; image resource that is neither paged nor scripted&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The requirements above imply that images can be static bitmaps &#40;e&#46;g&#46; PNGs&#44; GIFs&#44; JPEGs&#41;&#44; single&#45;page vector documents &#40;single&#45;page PDFs&#44; XML files with an SVG document element&#41;&#44; animated bitmaps &#40;APNGs&#44; animated GIFs&#41;&#44; animated vector graphics &#40;XML files with an SVG <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;document&#45;element"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element) that use declarative SMIL animation&#41;&#44; and so forth&#46; However&#44; these definitions preclude SVG files with script&#44; multipage PDF files&#44; interactive MNG files&#44; HTML documents&#44; plain text documents&#44; and the like&#46; [&#91;PNG&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsPNG) [&#91;GIF&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsGIF) [&#91;JPEG&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsJPEG) [&#91;PDF&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsPDF) [&#91;XML&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsXML) [&#91;APNG&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsAPNG) [&#91;SVG&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsSVG) [&#91;MNG&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsMNG)

The <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;srcset&#45;3"></a><code>[srcset](#attr-img-srcset)</code> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;srcset&#45;attribute"></a>[srcset attribute](#srcset-attribute)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;srcset&#45;4"></a><code>[srcset](#attr-img-srcset)</code> attribute and the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src&#45;4"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code> attribute &#40;if <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;width&#45;descriptor"></a>[width descriptors](#width-descriptor) are not used&#41; contribute the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;image&#45;source"></a>[image sources](#image-source) to the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;source&#45;set"></a>[source set](#source-set) &#40;if no <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element was selected&#41;&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;srcset&#45;5"></a><code>[srcset](#attr-img-srcset)</code> attribute is present and has any <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;image&#45;candidate&#45;string"></a>[image candidate strings](#image-candidate-string) using a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;width&#45;descriptor&#45;2"></a>[width descriptor](#width-descriptor)&#44; the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;sizes&#45;2"></a><code>[sizes](#attr-img-sizes)</code> attribute must also be present&#46; If the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;srcset&#45;6"></a><code>[srcset](#attr-img-srcset)</code> attribute is <em>not</em> specified&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;loading&#45;2"></a><code>[loading](#attr-img-loading)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;loading&#45;lazy&#45;state"></a>[Lazy](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-loading-lazy-state) state&#44; the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;sizes&#45;3"></a><code>[sizes](#attr-img-sizes)</code> attribute may be specified with the value &#34;<code>auto</code>&#34; &#40;<a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive)&#41;&#46; The <a id="attr&#45;img&#45;sizes"></a><strong><code>sizes</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;sizes&#45;attribute"></a>[sizes attribute](#sizes-attribute)&#44; which contributes the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;source&#45;size&#45;2"></a>[source size](#source-size-2) to the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;source&#45;set&#45;2"></a>[source set](#source-set) &#40;if no <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element was selected&#41;&#46;

An <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element <a id="allows&#45;auto&#45;sizes"></a><strong>allows auto&#45;sizes</strong> if&#58;

- its <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;loading&#45;3"></a><code>[loading](#attr-img-loading)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;loading&#45;lazy&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Lazy](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-loading-lazy-state) state&#44; and
- its <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;sizes&#45;4"></a><code>[sizes](#attr-img-sizes)</code> attribute&#39;s value is &#34;<code>auto</code>&#34; &#40;<a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;2"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive)&#41;&#44; or starts with &#34;<code>auto&#44;</code>&#34; &#40;<a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;3"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive)&#41;&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;img&#45;crossorigin"></a><strong><code>crossorigin</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;cors&#45;settings&#45;attribute"></a>[CORS settings attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#cors-settings-attribute)&#46; Its purpose is to allow images from third&#45;party sites that allow cross&#45;origin access to be used with <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-canvas-element)</code>&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;img&#45;referrerpolicy"></a><strong><code>referrerpolicy</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;referrer&#45;policy&#45;attribute"></a>[referrer policy attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#referrer-policy-attribute)&#46; Its purpose is to set the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;referrer&#45;policy&#45;2"></a>[referrer policy](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy) used when <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fetch&#45;3"></a>[fetching](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch) the image&#46; [&#91;REFERRERPOLICY&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsREFERRERPOLICY)

The <a id="attr&#45;img&#45;decoding"></a><strong><code>decoding</code></strong> attribute indicates the preferred method to <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;decoding&#45;process"></a>[decode](#img-decoding-process) this image&#46; The attribute&#44; if present&#44; must be an <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;image&#45;decoding&#45;hint"></a>[image decoding hint](#image-decoding-hint)&#46; This attribute&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;missing&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[missing value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#missing-value-default)</em> and <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;invalid&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[invalid value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#invalid-value-default)</em> are both the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;decoding&#45;auto&#45;state"></a>[Auto](#attr-img-decoding-auto-state) state&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;img&#45;fetchpriority"></a><strong><code>fetchpriority</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;fetch&#45;priority&#45;attribute"></a>[fetch priority attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fetch-priority-attribute)&#46; Its purpose is to set the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;priority&#45;2"></a>[priority](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-priority) used when <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fetch&#45;4"></a>[fetching](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch) the image&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;img&#45;loading"></a><strong><code>loading</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;lazy&#45;loading&#45;attribute"></a>[lazy loading attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-loading-attribute)&#46; Its purpose is to indicate the policy for loading images that are outside the viewport&#46;

When the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;loading&#45;4"></a><code>[loading](#attr-img-loading)</code> attribute&#39;s state is changed to the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;loading&#45;eager&#45;state"></a>[Eager](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-loading-eager-state) state&#44; the user agent must run these steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>resumptionSteps</var> be the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps"></a>[lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-load-resumption-steps)&#46;

2.  If <var>resumptionSteps</var> is null&#44; then return&#46;

3.  Set the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-load-resumption-steps) to null&#46;

4.  Invoke <var>resumptionSteps</var>&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

``` text
<img src="1.jpeg" alt="1">
<img src="2.jpeg" loading=eager alt="2">
<img src="3.jpeg" loading=lazy alt="3">
<div id=very-large></div> <!-- Everything after this div is below the viewport -->
<img src="4.jpeg" alt="4">
<img src="5.jpeg" loading=lazy alt="5">
```

In the example above&#44; the images load as follows&#58;

<strong><code>1&#46;jpeg</code>&#44; <code>2&#46;jpeg</code>&#44; <code>4&#46;jpeg</code></strong>

The images load eagerly and delay the window&#39;s load event&#46;

<strong><code>3&#46;jpeg</code></strong>

The image loads when layout is known&#44; due to being in the viewport&#44; however it does not delay the window&#39;s load event&#46;

<strong><code>5&#46;jpeg</code></strong>

The image loads only once scrolled into the viewport&#44; and does not delay the window&#39;s load event&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Developers are encouraged to specify a preferred aspect ratio via <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;width&#45;2"></a><code>[width](#attr-dim-width)</code> and <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;height&#45;2"></a><code>[height](#attr-dim-height)</code> attributes on lazy loaded images&#44; even if CSS sets the image&#39;s width and height properties&#44; to prevent the page layout from shifting around after the image loads&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;html&#45;element&#45;insertion&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element insertion steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-insertion-steps)&#44; given <var>insertedNode</var>&#44; are&#58;

1.  If <var>insertedNode</var>&#39;s parent is a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code> element&#44; then&#44; count this as a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;relevant&#45;mutations"></a>[relevant mutation](#relevant-mutations) for <var>insertedNode</var>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;html&#45;element&#45;moving&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element moving steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-moving-steps)&#44; given <var>movedNode</var>&#44; <var>isSubtreeRoot</var>&#44; and <var>oldAncestor</var> are&#58;

1.  If <var>isSubtreeRoot</var> is true and <var>oldAncestor</var> is a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code> element&#44; then count this as a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;relevant&#45;mutations&#45;2"></a>[relevant mutation](#relevant-mutations) for <var>movedNode</var>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;html&#45;element&#45;removing&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element removing steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-removing-steps)&#44; given <var>removedNode</var>&#44; <var>isSubtreeRoot</var>&#44; and <var>oldAncestor</var> are&#58;

1.  If <var>isSubtreeRoot</var> is true and <var>oldAncestor</var> is a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code> element&#44; then count this as a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;relevant&#45;mutations&#45;3"></a>[relevant mutation](#relevant-mutations) for <var>removedNode</var>&#46;

2.  Set <var>removedNode</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;last&#45;auto&#45;sizes&#45;width"></a>[last auto&#45;sizes width](#last-auto-sizes-width) to null&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element must not be used as a layout tool&#46; In particular&#44; <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> elements should not be used to display transparent images&#44; as such images rarely convey meaning and rarely add anything useful to the document&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

What an <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element represents depends on the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src&#45;5"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code> attribute and the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;4"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute&#46;

<strong>If the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src&#45;6"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code> attribute is set and the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;5"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute is set to the empty string</strong>

The image is either decorative or supplemental to the rest of the content&#44; redundant with some other information in the document&#46;

If the image is <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;available"></a>[available](#img-available) and the user agent is configured to display that image&#44; then the element <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) the element&#39;s image data&#46;

Otherwise&#44; the element <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;2"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) nothing&#44; and may be omitted completely from the rendering&#46; User agents may provide the user with a notification that an image is present but has been omitted from the rendering&#46;

<strong>If the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src&#45;7"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code> attribute is set and the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;6"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute is set to a value that isn&#39;t empty</strong>

The image is a key part of the content&#59; the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;7"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute gives a textual equivalent or replacement for the image&#46;

If the image is <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;available&#45;2"></a>[available](#img-available) and the user agent is configured to display that image&#44; then the element <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;3"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) the element&#39;s image data&#46;

Otherwise&#44; the element <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;4"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) the text given by the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;8"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute&#46; User agents may provide the user with a notification that an image is present but has been omitted from the rendering&#46;

<strong>If the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src&#45;8"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code> attribute is set and the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;9"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute is not</strong>

The image might be a key part of the content&#44; and there is no textual equivalent of the image available&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In a conforming document&#44; the absence of the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;10"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute indicates that the image is a key part of the content but that a textual replacement for the image was not available when the image was generated&#46;

If the image is <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;available&#45;3"></a>[available](#img-available) and the user agent is configured to display that image&#44; then the element <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;5"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) the element&#39;s image data&#46;

If the image has a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src&#45;9"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code> attribute whose value is the empty string&#44; then the element <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;6"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) nothing&#46;

Otherwise&#44; the user agent should display some sort of indicator that there is an image that is not being rendered&#44; and may&#44; if requested by the user&#44; or if so configured&#44; or when required to provide contextual information in response to navigation&#44; provide caption information for the image&#44; derived as follows&#58;

1.  If the image has a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;title"></a><code>[title](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-title)</code> attribute whose value is not the empty string&#44; then return the value of that attribute&#46;

2.  If the image is a descendant of a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;figure&#45;element"></a><code>[figure](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figure-element)</code> element that has a child <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;figcaption&#45;element"></a><code>[figcaption](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figcaption-element)</code> element&#44; and&#44; ignoring the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;figcaption&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[figcaption](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figcaption-element)</code> element and its descendants&#44; the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;figure&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[figure](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figure-element)</code> element has no <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[flow content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#flow-content-2) descendants other than <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;inter&#45;element&#45;whitespace"></a>[inter&#45;element whitespace](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#inter-element-whitespace) and the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#44; then return the contents of the first such <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;figcaption&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[figcaption](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figcaption-element)</code> element&#46;

3.  Return nothing&#46; &#40;There is no caption information&#46;&#41;

<strong>If the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src&#45;10"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code> attribute is not set and either the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;11"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute is set to the empty string or the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;12"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute is not set at all</strong>

The element <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;7"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) nothing&#46;

<strong>Otherwise</strong>

The element <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;8"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) the text given by the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;13"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;14"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute does not represent advisory information&#46; User agents must not present the contents of the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;15"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute in the same way as content of the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;title&#45;2"></a><code>[title](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-title)</code> attribute&#46;

User agents may always provide the user with the option to display any image&#44; or to prevent any image from being displayed&#46; User agents may also apply heuristics to help the user make use of the image when the user is unable to see it&#44; e&#46;g&#46; due to a visual disability or because they are using a text terminal with no graphics capabilities&#46; Such heuristics could include&#44; for instance&#44; optical character recognition &#40;OCR&#41; of text found within the image&#46;

<strong>Warning&#58;</strong>

While user agents are encouraged to repair cases of missing <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;16"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attributes&#44; authors must not rely on such behavior&#46; [Requirements for providing text to act as an alternative for images](#alt) are described in detail below&#46;

The <em>contents</em> of <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> elements&#44; if any&#44; are ignored for the purposes of rendering&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;usemap&#45;3"></a><code>[usemap](#attr-hyperlink-usemap)</code> attribute&#44; if present&#44; can indicate that the image has an associated <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;image&#45;map&#45;2"></a>[image map](#image-map)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;img&#45;ismap"></a><strong><code>ismap</code></strong> attribute&#44; when used on an element that is a descendant of an <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> element with an <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;href"></a><code>[href](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-href)</code> attribute&#44; indicates by its presence that the element provides access to a server&#45;side image map&#46; This affects how events are handled on the corresponding <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> element&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;ismap&#45;2"></a><code>[ismap](#attr-img-ismap)</code> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46; The attribute must not be specified on an element that does not have an ancestor <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;a&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[a](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-a-element)</code> element with an <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;href&#45;2"></a><code>[href](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-href)</code> attribute&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;usemap&#45;4"></a><code>[usemap](#attr-hyperlink-usemap)</code> and <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;ismap&#45;3"></a><code>[ismap](#attr-img-ismap)</code> attributes can result in confusing behavior when used together with <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> elements with the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;media"></a><code>[media](#attr-source-media)</code> attribute specified in a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code> element&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;img&#45;controls"></a><strong><code>controls</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46; If present&#44; it indicates that the user agent may expose a user interface to the user&#46; The attribute must not be specified on an element that does not have an <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;17"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute&#44; or whose <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;18"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute&#39;s value is the empty string&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;controls&#45;3"></a><code>[controls](#attr-img-controls)</code> attribute is present&#44; the user agent may expose controls over the image &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; a control for fullscreen viewing&#41;&#46; The specific controls provided are <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;implementation&#45;defined"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined)&#44; and can be platform&#45;specific or based on the user&#39;s preferences&#46;

If the user agent exposes a user interface by displaying controls over the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#44; then the user agent should suppress any user interaction events while the user agent is interacting with this interface&#46;

[Issue &#35;12318](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/12318) tracks the interaction between image controls and animated images&#46; User agents should not expose animation controls for images before that issue is resolved&#46;

This method causes the user agent to <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;decoding&#45;process&#45;2"></a>[decode](#img-decoding-process) the image <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;in&#45;parallel"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel)&#44; returning a promise that fulfills when decoding is complete&#46;

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android10&#46;1&#43;

Returns a new <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#44; with the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;width&#45;4"></a><code>[width](#attr-dim-width)</code> and <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;height&#45;4"></a><code>[height](#attr-dim-height)</code> attributes set to the values passed in the relevant arguments&#44; if applicable&#46;

To determine the <a id="img&#45;dimensions"></a><strong>dimensions</strong> of an <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element <var>image</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>naturalDimensions</var> be null&#46;

2.  If <var>image</var> is <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;available&#45;5"></a><em>[available](#img-available)</em>&#44; then set <var>naturalDimensions</var> to <var>image</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;density&#45;corrected&#45;intrinsic&#45;width&#45;and&#45;height&#45;2"></a>[density&#45;corrected natural width and height](#density-corrected-intrinsic-width-and-height)&#46;

3.  Return the result of <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;determine&#45;dimensions"></a>[determining the dimensions](#determine-dimensions) of <var>image</var> given <var>naturalDimensions</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;img&#45;width"></a><strong><code>width</code></strong> getter steps are to return the width of <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;dimensions"></a>[dimensions](#img-dimensions)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;img&#45;height"></a><strong><code>height</code></strong> getter steps are to return the height of <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;dimensions&#45;2"></a>[dimensions](#img-dimensions)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;img&#45;naturalwidth"></a><strong><code>naturalWidth</code></strong> and <a id="dom&#45;img&#45;naturalheight"></a><strong><code>naturalHeight</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  If the image is not <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;available&#45;6"></a><em>[available](#img-available)</em>&#44; then return 0&#46;

2.  Return the respective component of the image&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;density&#45;corrected&#45;intrinsic&#45;width&#45;and&#45;height&#45;3"></a>[density&#45;corrected natural width and height](#density-corrected-intrinsic-width-and-height)&#44; in <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;&#39;px&#39;"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46; [&#91;CSS&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSS)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Since the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;density&#45;corrected&#45;intrinsic&#45;width&#45;and&#45;height&#45;4"></a>[density&#45;corrected natural width and height](#density-corrected-intrinsic-width-and-height) of an image take into account any orientation specified in its metadata&#44; <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;img&#45;naturalwidth&#45;3"></a><code>[naturalWidth](#dom-img-naturalwidth)</code> and <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;img&#45;naturalheight&#45;3"></a><code>[naturalHeight](#dom-img-naturalheight)</code> reflect the dimensions after applying any rotation needed to correctly orient the image&#44; regardless of the value of the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;&#39;image&#45;orientation&#39;"></a>[&#39;image&#45;orientation&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images-3/#the-image-orientation) property&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;img&#45;complete"></a><strong><code>complete</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  If any of the following are true&#58;

    - both the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src&#45;11"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code> attribute and the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;srcset&#45;7"></a><code>[srcset](#attr-img-srcset)</code> attribute are omitted&#59;

    - the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;srcset&#45;8"></a><code>[srcset](#attr-img-srcset)</code> attribute is omitted and the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src&#45;12"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code> attribute&#39;s value is the empty string&#59;

    - the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;current&#45;request"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state"></a>[state](#img-req-state) is <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;all"></a>[completely available](#img-all) and its <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;pending&#45;request"></a>[pending request](#pending-request) is null&#59; or

    - the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;current&#45;request&#45;2"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[state](#img-req-state) is <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;error"></a>[broken](#img-error) and its <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;2"></a>[pending request](#pending-request) is null&#44;

    then return true&#46;

2.  Return false&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;img&#45;currentsrc"></a><strong><code>currentSrc</code></strong> IDL attribute must return the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;current&#45;request&#45;3"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;req&#45;url"></a>[current URL](#img-req-url)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;img&#45;decode"></a><strong><code>decode&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must perform the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>promise</var> be a new promise&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;microtask"></a>[Queue a microtask](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-microtask) to perform the following steps&#58;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This is done because <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;update&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data"></a>[updating the image data](#update-the-image-data) takes place in a microtask as well&#46; Thus&#44; to make code such as

    ``` text
    img.src = "stars.jpg";
    img.decode();
    ```

    properly decode <code>stars&#46;jpg</code>&#44; we need to delay any processing by one microtask&#46;

    1.  Let <var>global</var> be <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#46;

    2.  If any of the following are true&#58;

        - <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is not <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;fully&#45;active"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active)&#59; or

        - <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;current&#45;request&#45;4"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;3"></a>[state](#img-req-state) is <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;error&#45;2"></a>[broken](#img-error)&#44;

        then reject <var>promise</var> with an <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;encodingerror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>EncodingError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#encodingerror) <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

    3.  Otherwise&#44; <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;in&#45;parallel&#45;2"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel)&#44; wait for one of the following cases to occur&#44; and perform the corresponding actions&#58;

        <strong>This <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;22"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) stops being <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;fully&#45;active&#45;2"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active)</strong>

        <strong>This <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;23"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;current&#45;request&#45;5"></a>[current request](#current-request) changes or is mutated</strong>

        <strong>This <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;24"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;current&#45;request&#45;6"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;4"></a>[state](#img-req-state) becomes <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;error&#45;3"></a>[broken](#img-error)</strong>

        <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;global&#45;task"></a>[Queue a global task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-global-task) on the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) with <var>global</var> to reject <var>promise</var> with an <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;encodingerror&#45;3"></a>[&#34;<code>EncodingError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#encodingerror) <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

        <strong>This <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;25"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;current&#45;request&#45;7"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;5"></a>[state](#img-req-state) becomes <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;all&#45;2"></a>[completely available](#img-all)</strong>

        <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;img&#45;decoding&#45;process&#45;3"></a>[Decode](#img-decoding-process) the image&#46;

        If decoding does not need to be performed for this image &#40;for example because it is a vector graphic&#41; or the decoding process completes successfully&#44; then <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;global&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[queue a global task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-global-task) on the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source&#45;2"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) with <var>global</var> to resolve <var>promise</var> with undefined&#46;

        If decoding fails &#40;for example due to invalid image data&#41;&#44; then <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;global&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[queue a global task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-global-task) on the <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source&#45;3"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) with <var>global</var> to reject <var>promise</var> with an <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;encodingerror&#45;4"></a>[&#34;<code>EncodingError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#encodingerror) <a id="the&#45;img&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;4"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;
