When obtaining images on demand&#44; the user agent must <a id="when&#45;to&#45;obtain&#45;images&#58;update&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#45;2"></a>[update the image data](#update-the-image-data) of an <a id="when&#45;to&#45;obtain&#45;images&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element whenever it needs the image data &#40;i&#46;e&#46;&#44; on demand&#41;&#44; but only if the <a id="when&#45;to&#45;obtain&#45;images&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="when&#45;to&#45;obtain&#45;images&#58;current&#45;request"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="when&#45;to&#45;obtain&#45;images&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state"></a>[state](#img-req-state) is <a id="when&#45;to&#45;obtain&#45;images&#58;img&#45;none"></a>[unavailable](#img-none)&#46; When an <a id="when&#45;to&#45;obtain&#45;images&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element has experienced <a id="when&#45;to&#45;obtain&#45;images&#58;relevant&#45;mutations&#45;2"></a>[relevant mutations](#relevant-mutations)&#44; if the user agent only obtains images on demand&#44; the <a id="when&#45;to&#45;obtain&#45;images&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="when&#45;to&#45;obtain&#45;images&#58;current&#45;request&#45;2"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="when&#45;to&#45;obtain&#45;images&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[state](#img-req-state) must return to <a id="when&#45;to&#45;obtain&#45;images&#58;img&#45;none&#45;2"></a>[unavailable](#img-none)&#46;

###### <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations"></a>4&#46;8&#46;4&#46;3&#46;2 Reacting to DOM mutations[](#reacting-to-dom-mutations)

The <a id="relevant&#45;mutations"></a><strong>relevant mutations</strong> for an <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element are as follows&#58;

- The element&#39;s <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code>&#44; <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;srcset"></a><code>[srcset](#attr-img-srcset)</code>&#44; or <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;sizes"></a><code>[sizes](#attr-img-sizes)</code> attributes are set&#44; changed&#44; or removed&#46;

- The element&#39;s <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src&#45;2"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code> attribute is set to the same value as the previous value&#46; This must set the <em>restart animation</em> flag for the <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;update&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data"></a>[update the image data](#update-the-image-data) algorithm&#46;

- The element&#39;s <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;crossorigin"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-img-crossorigin)</code> attribute&#39;s state is changed&#46;

- The element&#39;s <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;referrerpolicy"></a><code>[referrerpolicy](#attr-img-referrerpolicy)</code> attribute&#39;s state is changed&#46;

- The <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> or <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;html&#45;element&#45;insertion&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element insertion steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-insertion-steps)&#44; <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;html&#45;element&#45;removing&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element removing steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-removing-steps)&#44; and <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;html&#45;element&#45;moving&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element moving steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-moving-steps) count the mutation as a <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;relevant&#45;mutations"></a>[relevant mutation](#relevant-mutations)&#46;

- The element&#39;s parent is a <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code> element and a <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element that is a previous sibling has its <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;srcset"></a><code>[srcset](#attr-source-srcset)</code>&#44; <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;sizes"></a><code>[sizes](#attr-source-sizes)</code>&#44; <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;media"></a><code>[media](#attr-source-media)</code>&#44; <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-source-type)</code>&#44; <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;width"></a><code>[width](#attr-dim-width)</code> or <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;height"></a><code>[height](#attr-dim-height)</code> attributes set&#44; changed&#44; or removed&#46;

- The element&#39;s <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;adopt&#45;ext"></a>[adopting steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-adopt-ext) are run&#46;

- If the element <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;allows&#45;auto&#45;sizes"></a>[allows auto&#45;sizes](#allows-auto-sizes)&#58; the element starts <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;being&#45;rendered"></a>[being rendered](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#being-rendered)&#44; or its <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;concrete&#45;object&#45;size"></a>[concrete object size](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#concrete-object-size) width changes&#46; This must set the <em>maybe omit events</em> flag for the <a id="reacting&#45;to&#45;dom&#45;mutations&#58;update&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#45;2"></a>[update the image data](#update-the-image-data) algorithm&#46;

###### <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images"></a>4&#46;8&#46;4&#46;3&#46;3 The list of available images[](#the-list-of-available-images)

Each <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object must have a <a id="list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images"></a><strong>list of available images</strong>&#46; Each image in this list is identified by a tuple consisting of an <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#58;absolute&#45;url"></a>[absolute URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-url-absolute)&#44; a <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#58;cors&#45;settings&#45;attribute"></a>[CORS settings attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#cors-settings-attribute) mode&#44; and&#44; if the mode is not <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#58;attr&#45;crossorigin&#45;none"></a>[No CORS](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-crossorigin-none)&#44; an <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#58;concept&#45;origin"></a>[origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-origin)&#46; Each image furthermore has an <a id="ignore&#45;higher&#45;layer&#45;caching"></a><strong>ignore higher&#45;layer caching</strong> flag&#46; User agents may copy entries from one <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#58;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images"></a>[list of available images](#list-of-available-images) to another at any time &#40;e&#46;g&#46; when the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> is created&#44; user agents can add to it all the images that are loaded in other <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#58;document&#45;4"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>s&#41;&#44; but must not change the keys of entries copied in this way when doing so&#44; and must unset the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#58;ignore&#45;higher&#45;layer&#45;caching"></a>[ignore higher&#45;layer caching](#ignore-higher-layer-caching) flag for the copied entry&#46; User agents may also remove images from such lists at any time &#40;e&#46;g&#46; to save memory&#41;&#46; User agents must remove entries in the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#58;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#45;2"></a>[list of available images](#list-of-available-images) as appropriate given higher&#45;layer caching semantics for the resource &#40;e&#46;g&#46; the HTTP &#96;<a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#58;http&#45;cache&#45;control"></a><code>[Cache&#45;Control](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7234.html#header.cache-control)</code>&#96; response header&#41; when the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#58;ignore&#45;higher&#45;layer&#45;caching&#45;2"></a>[ignore higher&#45;layer caching](#ignore-higher-layer-caching) flag is unset&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#58;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#45;3"></a>[list of available images](#list-of-available-images) is intended to enable synchronous switching when changing the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code> attribute to a URL that has previously been loaded&#44; and to avoid re&#45;downloading images in the same document even when they don&#39;t allow caching per HTTP&#46; It is not used to avoid re&#45;downloading the same image while the previous image is still loading&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The user agent can also store the image data separately from the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#58;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#45;4"></a>[list of available images](#list-of-available-images)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; if a resource has the HTTP response header &#96;<code>Cache&#45;Control&#58; must&#45;revalidate</code>&#96;&#44; and its <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#58;ignore&#45;higher&#45;layer&#45;caching&#45;3"></a>[ignore higher&#45;layer caching](#ignore-higher-layer-caching) flag is unset&#44; the user agent would remove it from the <a id="the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#58;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#45;5"></a>[list of available images](#list-of-available-images) but could keep the image data separately&#44; and use that if the server responds with a <code>304 Not Modified</code> status&#46;

###### <a id="decoding&#45;images"></a>4&#46;8&#46;4&#46;3&#46;4 Decoding images[](#decoding-images)

Image data is usually encoded in order to reduce file size&#46; This means that in order for the user agent to present the image to the screen&#44; the data needs to be decoded&#46; <a id="img&#45;decoding&#45;process"></a><strong>Decoding</strong> is the process which converts an image&#39;s media data into a bitmap form&#44; suitable for presentation to the screen&#46; Note that this process can be slow relative to other processes involved in presenting content&#46; Thus&#44; the user agent can choose when to perform decoding&#44; in order to create the best user experience&#46;

Image decoding is said to be synchronous if it prevents presentation of other content until it is finished&#46; Typically&#44; this has an effect of atomically presenting the image and any other content at the same time&#46; However&#44; this presentation is delayed by the amount of time it takes to perform the decode&#46;

Image decoding is said to be asynchronous if it does not prevent presentation of other content&#46; This has an effect of presenting non&#45;image content faster&#46; However&#44; the image content is missing on screen until the decode finishes&#46; Once the decode is finished&#44; the screen is updated with the image&#46;

In both synchronous and asynchronous decoding modes&#44; the final content is presented to screen after the same amount of time has elapsed&#46; The main difference is whether the user agent presents non&#45;image content ahead of presenting the final content&#46;

In order to aid the user agent in deciding whether to perform synchronous or asynchronous decode&#44; the <a id="decoding&#45;images&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;decoding"></a><code>[decoding](#attr-img-decoding)</code> attribute can be set on <a id="decoding&#45;images&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> elements&#46; The possible values of the <a id="decoding&#45;images&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;decoding&#45;2"></a><code>[decoding](#attr-img-decoding)</code> attribute are the following <a id="image&#45;decoding&#45;hint"></a><strong>image decoding hint</strong> keywords&#58;

<table><thead><tr><th>Keyword      </th><th>State      </th><th>Description    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="img/decoding" id="attr-img-decoding-sync" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>sync</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-img-decoding-sync-state">Sync</dfn>      </td><td>Indicates a preference to <a href="#img-decoding-process" id="decoding-images:img-decoding-process">decode</a> this image      synchronously for atomic presentation with other content&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="img/decoding" id="attr-img-decoding-async" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>async</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-img-decoding-async-state">Async</dfn>      </td><td>Indicates a preference to <a href="#img-decoding-process" id="decoding-images:img-decoding-process-2">decode</a> this image      asynchronously to avoid delaying presentation of other content&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="img/decoding" id="attr-img-decoding-auto" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>auto</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-img-decoding-auto-state">Auto</dfn>      </td><td>Indicates no preference in decoding mode &#40;the default&#41;&#46;   </td></tr></tbody></table>

When <a id="decoding&#45;images&#58;img&#45;decoding&#45;process&#45;3"></a>[decoding](#img-decoding-process) an image&#44; the user agent should respect the preference indicated by the <a id="decoding&#45;images&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;decoding&#45;3"></a><code>[decoding](#attr-img-decoding)</code> attribute&#39;s state&#46; If the state indicated is <a id="decoding&#45;images&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;decoding&#45;auto&#45;state"></a>[Auto](#attr-img-decoding-auto-state)&#44; then the user agent is free to choose any decoding behavior&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

It is also possible to control the decoding behavior using the <a id="decoding&#45;images&#58;dom&#45;img&#45;decode"></a><code>[decode&#40;&#41;](#dom-img-decode)</code> method&#46; Since the <a id="decoding&#45;images&#58;dom&#45;img&#45;decode&#45;2"></a><code>[decode&#40;&#41;](#dom-img-decode)</code> method performs <a id="decoding&#45;images&#58;img&#45;decoding&#45;process&#45;4"></a>[decoding](#img-decoding-process) independently from the process responsible for presenting content to screen&#44; it is unaffected by the <a id="decoding&#45;images&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;decoding&#45;4"></a><code>[decoding](#attr-img-decoding)</code> attribute&#46;

###### <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data"></a>4&#46;8&#46;4&#46;3&#46;5 Updating the image data[](#updating-the-image-data)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This algorithm cannot be called from steps running <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;in&#45;parallel"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel)&#46; If a user agent needs to call this algorithm from steps running <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;in&#45;parallel&#45;2"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel)&#44; it needs to <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;task"></a>[queue](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-task) a task to do so&#46;

When the user agent is to <a id="update&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data"></a><strong>update the image data</strong> of an <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element <var>element</var>&#44; optionally with the <em>restart animation</em> flag set&#44; optionally with the <em>maybe omit events</em> flag set&#44; it must run the following steps&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is not <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;fully&#45;active"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active)&#58;

    1.  Continue running this algorithm <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;in&#45;parallel&#45;3"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel)&#46;

    2.  Wait until <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;fully&#45;active&#45;2"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active)&#46;

    3.  If another instance of this algorithm for <var>element</var> was started after this instance &#40;even if it aborted and is no longer running&#41;&#44; then return&#46;

    4.  <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;microtask"></a>[Queue a microtask](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-microtask) to continue this algorithm&#46;

2.  If the user agent cannot support images&#44; or its support for images has been disabled&#44; then <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;abort&#45;the&#45;image&#45;request"></a>[abort the image request](#abort-the-image-request) for the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request"></a>[current request](#current-request) and the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request"></a>[pending request](#pending-request)&#44; set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;2"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state"></a>[state](#img-req-state) to <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;none"></a>[unavailable](#img-none)&#44; set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;2"></a>[pending request](#pending-request) to null&#44; and return&#46;

3.  Let <var>previousURL</var> be the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;3"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;url"></a>[current URL](#img-req-url)&#46;

4.  Let <var>selected source</var> be null and <var>selected pixel density</var> be undefined&#46;

5.  If <var>element</var> does not <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;use&#45;srcset&#45;or&#45;picture"></a>[use <code>srcset</code> or <code>picture</code>](#use-srcset-or-picture) and it has a <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code> attribute specified whose value is not the empty string&#44; then set <var>selected source</var> to the value of <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src&#45;2"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code> attribute and set <var>selected pixel density</var> to 1&#46;0&#46;

6.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;last&#45;selected&#45;source"></a>[last selected source](#last-selected-source) to <var>selected source</var>&#46;

7.  If <var>selected source</var> is not null&#58;

    1.  Let <var>urlString</var> be the result of <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;and&#45;serializing&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[encoding&#45;parsing&#45;and&#45;serializing a URL](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#encoding-parsing-and-serializing-a-url) given <var>selected source</var>&#44; relative to <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;node&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

    2.  If <var>urlString</var> is failure&#44; then abort this inner set of steps&#46;

    3.  Let <var>key</var> be a tuple consisting of <var>urlString</var>&#44; <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;crossorigin"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-img-crossorigin)</code> attribute&#39;s mode&#44; and&#44; if that mode is not <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;attr&#45;crossorigin&#45;none"></a>[No CORS](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-crossorigin-none)&#44; <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;node&#45;document&#45;4"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin)&#46;

    4.  If the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images"></a>[list of available images](#list-of-available-images) contains an entry for <var>key</var>&#58;

        1.  Set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;ignore&#45;higher&#45;layer&#45;caching"></a>[ignore higher&#45;layer caching](#ignore-higher-layer-caching) flag for that entry&#46;

        2.  <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;abort&#45;the&#45;image&#45;request&#45;2"></a>[Abort the image request](#abort-the-image-request) for the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;4"></a>[current request](#current-request) and the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;3"></a>[pending request](#pending-request)&#46;

        3.  Set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;4"></a>[pending request](#pending-request) to null&#46;

        4.  Set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;5"></a>[current request](#current-request) to a new <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;image&#45;request"></a>[image request](#image-request) whose <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;data"></a>[image data](#img-req-data) is that of the entry and whose <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[state](#img-req-state) is <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;all"></a>[completely available](#img-all)&#46;

        5.  <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;prepare&#45;an&#45;image&#45;for&#45;presentation"></a>[Prepare the current request for presentation](#prepare-an-image-for-presentation) given <var>element</var>&#46;

        6.  Set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;6"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;pixel&#45;density"></a>[current pixel density](#current-pixel-density) to <var>selected pixel density</var>&#46;

        7.  <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[Queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) given <var>element</var> and the following steps&#58;

            1.  If <em>restart animation</em> is set&#44; then <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;restart&#45;the&#45;animation"></a>[restart the animation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#restart-the-animation)&#46;

            2.  Set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;7"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;url&#45;2"></a>[current URL](#img-req-url) to <var>urlString</var>&#46;

            3.  If <em>maybe omit events</em> is not set or <var>previousURL</var> is not equal to <var>urlString</var>&#44; then <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;event&#45;load"></a><code>[load](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-load)</code> at <var>element</var>&#46;

        8.  Abort the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;update&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data"></a>[update the image data](#update-the-image-data) algorithm&#46;

8.  <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;microtask&#45;2"></a>[Queue a microtask](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-microtask) to perform the rest of this algorithm&#44; allowing the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;task"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that invoked this algorithm to continue&#46;

9.  If another instance of this algorithm for <var>element</var> was started after this instance &#40;even if it aborted and is no longer running&#41;&#44; then return&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    Only the last instance takes effect&#44; to avoid multiple requests when&#44; for example&#44; the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src&#45;3"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code>&#44; <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;srcset"></a><code>[srcset](#attr-img-srcset)</code>&#44; and <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;crossorigin&#45;2"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-img-crossorigin)</code> attributes are all set in succession&#46;

10. Let <var>selected source</var> and <var>selected pixel density</var> be the URL and pixel density that results from <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;select&#45;an&#45;image&#45;source"></a>[selecting an image source](#select-an-image-source)&#44; respectively&#46;

11. If <var>selected source</var> is null&#58;

    1.  Set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;8"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;3"></a>[state](#img-req-state) to <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;error"></a>[broken](#img-error)&#44; <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;abort&#45;the&#45;image&#45;request&#45;3"></a>[abort the image request](#abort-the-image-request) for the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;9"></a>[current request](#current-request) and the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;5"></a>[pending request](#pending-request)&#44; and set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;6"></a>[pending request](#pending-request) to null&#46;

    2.  <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[Queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source&#45;2"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) given <var>element</var> and the following steps&#58;

        1.  Change the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;10"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;url&#45;3"></a>[current URL](#img-req-url) to the empty string&#46;

        2.  If all of the following are true&#58;

            - <var>element</var> has a <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src&#45;4"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code> attribute or it <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;use&#45;srcset&#45;or&#45;picture&#45;2"></a>[uses <code>srcset</code> or <code>picture</code>](#use-srcset-or-picture)&#59; and

            - <em>maybe omit events</em> is not set or <var>previousURL</var> is not the empty string&#44;

            then <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;event&#45;error"></a><code>[error](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-error)</code> at <var>element</var>&#46;

    3.  Return&#46;

12. Let <var>urlString</var> be the result of <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;and&#45;serializing&#45;a&#45;url&#45;2"></a>[encoding&#45;parsing&#45;and&#45;serializing a URL](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#encoding-parsing-and-serializing-a-url) given <var>selected source</var>&#44; relative to <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;node&#45;document&#45;5"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

13. If <var>urlString</var> is failure&#58;

    1.  <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;abort&#45;the&#45;image&#45;request&#45;4"></a>[Abort the image request](#abort-the-image-request) for the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;11"></a>[current request](#current-request) and the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;7"></a>[pending request](#pending-request)&#46;

    2.  Set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;12"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;4"></a>[state](#img-req-state) to <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;error&#45;2"></a>[broken](#img-error)&#46;

    3.  Set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;8"></a>[pending request](#pending-request) to null&#46;

    4.  <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[Queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source&#45;3"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) given <var>element</var> and the following steps&#58;

        1.  Change the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;13"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;url&#45;4"></a>[current URL](#img-req-url) to <var>selected source</var>&#46;

        2.  If <em>maybe omit events</em> is not set or <var>previousURL</var> is not equal to <var>selected source</var>&#44; then <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;3"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;event&#45;error&#45;2"></a><code>[error](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-error)</code> at <var>element</var>&#46;

    5.  Return&#46;

14. If the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;9"></a>[pending request](#pending-request) is not null and <var>urlString</var> is the same as the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;10"></a>[pending request](#pending-request)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;url&#45;5"></a>[current URL](#img-req-url)&#44; then return&#46;

15. If <var>urlString</var> is the same as the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;14"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;url&#45;6"></a>[current URL](#img-req-url) and the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;15"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;5"></a>[state](#img-req-state) is <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;inc"></a>[partially available](#img-inc)&#58;

    1.  <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;abort&#45;the&#45;image&#45;request&#45;5"></a>[Abort the image request](#abort-the-image-request) for the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;11"></a>[pending request](#pending-request)&#46;

    2.  If <em>restart animation</em> is set&#44; then <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;4"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source&#45;4"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) given <var>element</var> to <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;restart&#45;the&#45;animation&#45;2"></a>[restart the animation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#restart-the-animation)&#46;

    3.  Return&#46;

16. <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;abort&#45;the&#45;image&#45;request&#45;6"></a>[Abort the image request](#abort-the-image-request) for the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;12"></a>[pending request](#pending-request)&#46;

17. Set <var>image request</var> to a new <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;image&#45;request&#45;2"></a>[image request](#image-request) whose <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;url&#45;7"></a>[current URL](#img-req-url) is <var>urlString</var>&#46;

18. If the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;16"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;6"></a>[state](#img-req-state) is <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;none&#45;2"></a>[unavailable](#img-none) or <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;error&#45;3"></a>[broken](#img-error)&#44; then set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;17"></a>[current request](#current-request) to <var>image request</var>&#46; Otherwise&#44; set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;13"></a>[pending request](#pending-request) to <var>image request</var>&#46;

19. Let <var>request</var> be the result of <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;create&#45;a&#45;potential&#45;cors&#45;request"></a>[creating a potential&#45;CORS request](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#create-a-potential-cors-request) given <var>urlString</var>&#44; &#34;<code>image</code>&#34;&#44; and the current state of <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;crossorigin&#45;3"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-img-crossorigin)</code> content attribute&#46;

20. Set <var>request</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;client"></a>[client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-client) to <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;node&#45;document&#45;6"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;relevant&#45;settings&#45;object"></a>[relevant settings object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-settings-object)&#46;

21. If <var>element</var> <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;use&#45;srcset&#45;or&#45;picture&#45;3"></a>[uses <code>srcset</code> or <code>picture</code>](#use-srcset-or-picture)&#44; set <var>request</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;initiator"></a>[initiator](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-initiator) to &#34;<code>imageset</code>&#34;&#46;

22. Set <var>request</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;referrer&#45;policy"></a>[referrer policy](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer-policy) to the current state of <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;referrerpolicy"></a><code>[referrerpolicy](#attr-img-referrerpolicy)</code> attribute&#46;

23. Set <var>request</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;priority"></a>[priority](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-priority) to the current state of <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;fetchpriority"></a><code>[fetchpriority](#attr-img-fetchpriority)</code> attribute&#46;

24. Let <var>delay load event</var> be true if the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;lazy&#45;loading&#45;attribute"></a>[lazy loading attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-loading-attribute) is in the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;attr&#45;loading&#45;eager&#45;state"></a>[Eager](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-loading-eager-state) state&#44; or if <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;noscript"></a>[scripting is disabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-noscript) for the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code>&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

25. If the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;will&#45;lazy&#45;load&#45;element&#45;steps"></a>[will lazy load element steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#will-lazy-load-element-steps) given the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> return true&#58;

    1.  Set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps"></a>[lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-load-resumption-steps) to the rest of this algorithm starting with the step labeled <em>fetch the image</em>&#46;

    2.  <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;start&#45;intersection&#45;observing&#45;a&#45;lazy&#45;loading&#45;element"></a>[Start intersection&#45;observing a lazy loading element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#start-intersection-observing-a-lazy-loading-element) for <var>element</var>&#46;

    3.  Return&#46;

26. <em>Fetch the image</em>&#58; <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;fetch"></a>[Fetch](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch) <var>request</var>&#46; Return from this algorithm&#44; and run the remaining steps as part of the fetch&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;processresponse"></a><em>[processResponse](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#process-response)</em> for the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;response"></a>[response](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response) <var>response</var>&#46;

    The resource obtained in this fashion&#44; if any&#44; is <var>image request</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;data&#45;2"></a>[image data](#img-req-data)&#46; It can be either <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;cors&#45;same&#45;origin"></a>[CORS&#45;same&#45;origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#cors-same-origin) or <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;cors&#45;cross&#45;origin"></a>[CORS&#45;cross&#45;origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#cors-cross-origin)&#59; this affects the image&#39;s interaction with other APIs &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; when used on a <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-canvas-element)</code>&#41;&#46;

    When <var>delay load event</var> is true&#44; fetching the image must <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event"></a>[delay the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event) of <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;node&#45;document&#45;7"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) until the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that is <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[queued](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-task) by the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;networking&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[networking task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#networking-task-source) once the resource has been fetched &#40;[defined below](#img-load)&#41; has been run&#46;

    <strong>Warning&#58;</strong>

    This&#44; unfortunately&#44; can be used to perform a rudimentary port scan of the user&#39;s local network &#40;especially in conjunction with scripting&#44; though scripting isn&#39;t actually necessary to carry out such an attack&#41;&#46; User agents may implement <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;origin"></a>[cross&#45;origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-origin) access control policies that are stricter than those described above to mitigate this attack&#44; but unfortunately such policies are typically not compatible with existing web content&#46;

27. As soon as possible&#44; jump to the first applicable entry from the following list&#58;

    <strong>If the resource type is <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;multipart&#47;x&#45;mixed&#45;replace"></a><code>[multipart&#47;x&#45;mixed&#45;replace](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#multipart/x-mixed-replace)</code></strong>

    The next <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that is <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[queued](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-task) by the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;networking&#45;task&#45;source&#45;2"></a>[networking task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#networking-task-source) while the image is being fetched must run the following steps&#58;

    1.  If <var>image request</var> is the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;14"></a>[pending request](#pending-request) and at least one body part has been completely decoded&#44; <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;abort&#45;the&#45;image&#45;request&#45;7"></a>[abort the image request](#abort-the-image-request) for the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;18"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#44; and <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;upgrade&#45;the&#45;pending&#45;request&#45;to&#45;the&#45;current&#45;request"></a>[upgrade the pending request to the current request](#upgrade-the-pending-request-to-the-current-request)&#46;

    2.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>image request</var> is the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;15"></a>[pending request](#pending-request) and the user agent is able to determine that <var>image request</var>&#39;s image is corrupted in some fatal way such that the image dimensions cannot be obtained&#44; <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;abort&#45;the&#45;image&#45;request&#45;8"></a>[abort the image request](#abort-the-image-request) for the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;19"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#44; <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;upgrade&#45;the&#45;pending&#45;request&#45;to&#45;the&#45;current&#45;request&#45;2"></a>[upgrade the pending request to the current request](#upgrade-the-pending-request-to-the-current-request)&#44; and set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;20"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;7"></a>[state](#img-req-state) to <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;error&#45;4"></a>[broken](#img-error)&#46;

    3.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>image request</var> is the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;21"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#44; its <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;8"></a>[state](#img-req-state) is <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;none&#45;3"></a>[unavailable](#img-none)&#44; and the user agent is able to determine <var>image request</var>&#39;s image&#39;s width and height&#44; set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;22"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;9"></a>[state](#img-req-state) to <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;inc&#45;2"></a>[partially available](#img-inc)&#46;

    4.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>image request</var> is the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;23"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#44; its <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;10"></a>[state](#img-req-state) is <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;none&#45;4"></a>[unavailable](#img-none)&#44; and the user agent is able to determine that <var>image request</var>&#39;s image is corrupted in some fatal way such that the image dimensions cannot be obtained&#44; set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;24"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;11"></a>[state](#img-req-state) to <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;error&#45;5"></a>[broken](#img-error)&#46;

    Each <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;4"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that is <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;task&#45;4"></a>[queued](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-task) by the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;networking&#45;task&#45;source&#45;3"></a>[networking task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#networking-task-source) while the image is being fetched must update the presentation of the image&#44; but as each new body part comes in&#44; if the user agent is able to determine the image&#39;s width and height&#44; it must <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;prepare&#45;an&#45;image&#45;for&#45;presentation&#45;2"></a>[prepare <var>element</var>&#39;s current request for presentation](#prepare-an-image-for-presentation) given <var>element</var> and replace the previous image&#46; Once one body part has been completely decoded&#44; perform the following steps&#58;

    1.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;25"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;12"></a>[state](#img-req-state) to <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;all&#45;2"></a>[completely available](#img-all)&#46;

    2.  If <em>maybe omit events</em> is not set or <var>previousURL</var> is not equal to <var>urlString</var>&#44; then <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;5"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source&#45;5"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) given <var>element</var> to <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;4"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;event&#45;load&#45;2"></a><code>[load](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-load)</code> at <var>element</var>&#46;

    <strong>If the resource type and data corresponds to a supported image format&#44; [as described below](#img-determine-type)</strong>

    The next <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;5"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that is <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;task&#45;5"></a>[queued](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-task) by the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;networking&#45;task&#45;source&#45;4"></a>[networking task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#networking-task-source) while the image is being fetched must run the following steps&#58;

    1.  If the user agent is able to determine <var>image request</var>&#39;s image&#39;s width and height&#44; and <var>image request</var> is the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;16"></a>[pending request](#pending-request)&#44; set <var>image request</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;13"></a>[state](#img-req-state) to <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;inc&#45;3"></a>[partially available](#img-inc)&#46;

    2.  Otherwise&#44; if the user agent is able to determine <var>image request</var>&#39;s image&#39;s width and height&#44; and <var>image request</var> is the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;26"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#44; <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;prepare&#45;an&#45;image&#45;for&#45;presentation&#45;3"></a>[prepare <var>image request</var> for presentation](#prepare-an-image-for-presentation) given <var>element</var> and set <var>image request</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;14"></a>[state](#img-req-state) to <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;inc&#45;4"></a>[partially available](#img-inc)&#46;

    3.  Otherwise&#44; if the user agent is able to determine that <var>image request</var>&#39;s image is corrupted in some fatal way such that the image dimensions cannot be obtained&#44; and <var>image request</var> is the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;17"></a>[pending request](#pending-request)&#58;

        1.  <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;abort&#45;the&#45;image&#45;request&#45;9"></a>[Abort the image request](#abort-the-image-request) for the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;27"></a>[current request](#current-request) and the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;18"></a>[pending request](#pending-request)&#46;

        2.  <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;upgrade&#45;the&#45;pending&#45;request&#45;to&#45;the&#45;current&#45;request&#45;3"></a>[Upgrade the pending request to the current request](#upgrade-the-pending-request-to-the-current-request)&#46;

        3.  Set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;28"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;15"></a>[state](#img-req-state) to <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;error&#45;6"></a>[broken](#img-error)&#46;

        4.  <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;5"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;event&#45;error&#45;3"></a><code>[error](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-error)</code> at <var>element</var>&#46;

    4.  Otherwise&#44; if the user agent is able to determine that <var>image request</var>&#39;s image is corrupted in some fatal way such that the image dimensions cannot be obtained&#44; and <var>image request</var> is the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;29"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#58;

        1.  <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;abort&#45;the&#45;image&#45;request&#45;10"></a>[Abort the image request](#abort-the-image-request) for <var>image request</var>&#46;

        2.  If <em>maybe omit events</em> is not set or <var>previousURL</var> is not equal to <var>urlString</var>&#44; then <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;6"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;event&#45;error&#45;4"></a><code>[error](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-error)</code> at <var>element</var>&#46;

    <a id="img&#45;load"></a>That <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;6"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task)&#44; and each subsequent <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;7"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that is <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;task&#45;6"></a>[queued](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-task) by the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;networking&#45;task&#45;source&#45;5"></a>[networking task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#networking-task-source) while the image is being fetched&#44; must&#44; if <var>image request</var> is the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;30"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#44; update the presentation of the image appropriately &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; if the image is a progressive JPEG&#44; each packet can improve the resolution of the image&#41;&#46;

    Furthermore&#44; the last <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;8"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that is <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;task&#45;7"></a>[queued](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-task) by the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;networking&#45;task&#45;source&#45;6"></a>[networking task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#networking-task-source) once the resource has been fetched must additionally run these steps&#58;

    1.  If <var>image request</var> is the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;19"></a>[pending request](#pending-request)&#44; <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;abort&#45;the&#45;image&#45;request&#45;11"></a>[abort the image request](#abort-the-image-request) for the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;31"></a>[current request](#current-request)&#44; <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;upgrade&#45;the&#45;pending&#45;request&#45;to&#45;the&#45;current&#45;request&#45;4"></a>[upgrade the pending request to the current request](#upgrade-the-pending-request-to-the-current-request)&#44; and <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;prepare&#45;an&#45;image&#45;for&#45;presentation&#45;4"></a>[prepare <var>image request</var> for presentation](#prepare-an-image-for-presentation) given <var>element</var>&#46;

    2.  Set <var>image request</var> to the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;all&#45;3"></a>[completely available](#img-all) state&#46;

    3.  Add the image to the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;list&#45;of&#45;available&#45;images&#45;2"></a>[list of available images](#list-of-available-images) using the key <var>key</var>&#44; with the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;ignore&#45;higher&#45;layer&#45;caching&#45;2"></a>[ignore higher&#45;layer caching](#ignore-higher-layer-caching) flag set&#46;

    4.  If <em>maybe omit events</em> is not set or <var>previousURL</var> is not equal to <var>urlString</var>&#44; then <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;7"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;event&#45;load&#45;3"></a><code>[load](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-load)</code> at <var>element</var>&#46;

    <strong>Otherwise</strong>

    The image data is not in a supported file format&#59; the user agent must set <var>image request</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;state&#45;16"></a>[state](#img-req-state) to <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;error&#45;7"></a>[broken](#img-error)&#44; <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;abort&#45;the&#45;image&#45;request&#45;12"></a>[abort the image request](#abort-the-image-request) for the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;32"></a>[current request](#current-request) and the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;20"></a>[pending request](#pending-request)&#44; <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;upgrade&#45;the&#45;pending&#45;request&#45;to&#45;the&#45;current&#45;request&#45;5"></a>[upgrade the pending request to the current request](#upgrade-the-pending-request-to-the-current-request) if <var>image request</var> is the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;21"></a>[pending request](#pending-request)&#44; and then&#44; if <em>maybe omit events</em> is not set or <var>previousURL</var> is not equal to <var>urlString</var>&#44; <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;6"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source&#45;6"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) given <var>element</var> to <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;8"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;event&#45;error&#45;5"></a><code>[error](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-error)</code> at <var>element</var>&#46;

While a user agent is running the above algorithm for an element <var>x</var>&#44; there must be a strong reference from the element&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;node&#45;document&#45;8"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) to the element <var>x</var>&#44; even if that element is not <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;connected"></a>[connected](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected)&#46;

To <a id="abort&#45;the&#45;image&#45;request"></a><strong>abort the image request</strong> for an <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;image&#45;request&#45;3"></a>[image request](#image-request) or null <var>image request</var> means to run the following steps&#58;

1.  If <var>image request</var> is null&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Forget <var>image request</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;img&#45;req&#45;data&#45;3"></a>[image data](#img-req-data)&#44; if any&#46;

3.  Abort any instance of the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;concept&#45;fetch&#45;2"></a>[fetching](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch) algorithm for <var>image request</var>&#44; discarding any pending tasks generated by that algorithm&#46;

To <a id="upgrade&#45;the&#45;pending&#45;request&#45;to&#45;the&#45;current&#45;request"></a><strong>upgrade the pending request to the current request</strong> for an <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element means to run the following steps&#58;

1.  Set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;current&#45;request&#45;33"></a>[current request](#current-request) to the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;22"></a>[pending request](#pending-request)&#46;

2.  Set the <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;image&#45;data&#58;pending&#45;request&#45;23"></a>[pending request](#pending-request) to null&#46;

###### <a id="preparing&#45;an&#45;image&#45;for&#45;presentation"></a>4&#46;8&#46;4&#46;3&#46;6 Preparing an image for presentation[](#preparing-an-image-for-presentation)

To <a id="prepare&#45;an&#45;image&#45;for&#45;presentation"></a><strong>prepare an image for presentation</strong> for an <a id="preparing&#45;an&#45;image&#45;for&#45;presentation&#58;image&#45;request"></a>[image request](#image-request) <var>req</var> given image element <var>img</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>exifTagMap</var> be the EXIF tags obtained from <var>req</var>&#39;s <a id="preparing&#45;an&#45;image&#45;for&#45;presentation&#58;img&#45;req&#45;data"></a>[image data](#img-req-data)&#44; as defined by the relevant codec&#46; [&#91;EXIF&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsEXIF)

2.  Let <var>physicalWidth</var> and <var>physicalHeight</var> be the width and height obtained from <var>req</var>&#39;s <a id="preparing&#45;an&#45;image&#45;for&#45;presentation&#58;img&#45;req&#45;data&#45;2"></a>[image data](#img-req-data)&#44; as defined by the relevant codec&#46;

3.  Let <var>dimX</var> be the value of <var>exifTagMap</var>&#39;s tag <code>0xA002</code> &#40;<code>PixelXDimension</code>&#41;&#46;

4.  Let <var>dimY</var> be the value of <var>exifTagMap</var>&#39;s tag <code>0xA003</code> &#40;<code>PixelYDimension</code>&#41;&#46;

5.  Let <var>resX</var> be the value of <var>exifTagMap</var>&#39;s tag <code>0x011A</code> &#40;<code>XResolution</code>&#41;&#46;

6.  Let <var>resY</var> be the value of <var>exifTagMap</var>&#39;s tag <code>0x011B</code> &#40;<code>YResolution</code>&#41;&#46;

7.  Let <var>resUnit</var> be the value of <var>exifTagMap</var>&#39;s tag <code>0x0128</code> &#40;<code>ResolutionUnit</code>&#41;&#46;

8.  If all the following are true&#58;

    - <var>dimX</var> is a positive integer&#59;

    - <var>dimY</var> is a positive integer&#59;

    - <var>resX</var> is a positive floating&#45;point number&#59;

    - <var>resY</var> is a positive floating&#45;point number&#59;

    - <var>physicalWidth</var> × 72 &#47; <var>resX</var> is <var>dimX</var>&#59;

    - <var>physicalHeight</var> × 72 &#47; <var>resY</var> is <var>dimY</var>&#59;

    - <var>resUnit</var> is <code>2</code> &#40;<code>Inch</code>&#41;&#44;

    then&#58;

    1.  If <var>req</var>&#39;s <a id="preparing&#45;an&#45;image&#45;for&#45;presentation&#58;img&#45;req&#45;data&#45;3"></a>[image data](#img-req-data) is <a id="preparing&#45;an&#45;image&#45;for&#45;presentation&#58;cors&#45;cross&#45;origin"></a>[CORS&#45;cross&#45;origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#cors-cross-origin)&#44; then set <var>img</var>&#39;s <a id="preparing&#45;an&#45;image&#45;for&#45;presentation&#58;natural&#45;dimensions"></a>[natural dimensions](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-dimensions) to <var>dimX</var> and <var>dimY</var>&#44; and scale <var>img</var>&#39;s pixel data accordingly&#46;

    2.  Otherwise&#44; set <var>req</var>&#39;s <a id="preparing&#45;an&#45;image&#45;for&#45;presentation&#58;preferred&#45;density&#45;corrected&#45;dimensions"></a>[preferred density&#45;corrected dimensions](#preferred-density-corrected-dimensions) to a struct with its width set to <var>dimX</var> and its height set to <var>dimY</var>&#46;

9.  Update <var>req</var>&#39;s <a id="preparing&#45;an&#45;image&#45;for&#45;presentation&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#39;s presentation appropriately&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Resolution in EXIF is equivalent to <a id="preparing&#45;an&#45;image&#45;for&#45;presentation&#58;&#39;pt&#39;"></a>[CSS points per inch](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#pt)&#44; therefore 72 is the base for computing size from resolution&#46;

It is not yet specified what would be the case if EXIF arrives after the image is already presented&#46; See [issue &#35;4929](https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/4929)&#46;

###### <a id="selecting&#45;an&#45;image&#45;source"></a>4&#46;8&#46;4&#46;3&#46;7 Selecting an image source[](#selecting-an-image-source)

To <a id="select&#45;an&#45;image&#45;source"></a><strong>select an image source</strong> given an <a id="selecting&#45;an&#45;image&#45;source&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element <var>el</var>&#58;

1.  <a id="selecting&#45;an&#45;image&#45;source&#58;update&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set"></a>[Update the source set](#update-the-source-set) for <var>el</var>&#46;

2.  If <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="selecting&#45;an&#45;image&#45;source&#58;source&#45;set"></a>[source set](#source-set) is empty&#44; return null as the URL and undefined as the pixel density&#46;

3.  Return the result of <a id="selecting&#45;an&#45;image&#45;source&#58;select&#45;an&#45;image&#45;source&#45;from&#45;a&#45;source&#45;set"></a>[selecting an image](#select-an-image-source-from-a-source-set) from <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="selecting&#45;an&#45;image&#45;source&#58;source&#45;set&#45;2"></a>[source set](#source-set)&#46;

To <a id="select&#45;an&#45;image&#45;source&#45;from&#45;a&#45;source&#45;set"></a><strong>select an image source from a source set</strong> given a <a id="selecting&#45;an&#45;image&#45;source&#58;source&#45;set&#45;3"></a>[source set](#source-set) <var>sourceSet</var>&#58;

1.  If an entry <var>b</var> in <var>sourceSet</var> has the same associated <a id="selecting&#45;an&#45;image&#45;source&#58;pixel&#45;density&#45;descriptor"></a>[pixel density descriptor](#pixel-density-descriptor) as an earlier entry <var>a</var> in <var>sourceSet</var>&#44; then remove entry <var>b</var>&#46; Repeat this step until none of the entries in <var>sourceSet</var> have the same associated <a id="selecting&#45;an&#45;image&#45;source&#58;pixel&#45;density&#45;descriptor&#45;2"></a>[pixel density descriptor](#pixel-density-descriptor) as an earlier entry&#46;

2.  In an <a id="selecting&#45;an&#45;image&#45;source&#58;implementation&#45;defined"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined) manner&#44; choose one <a id="selecting&#45;an&#45;image&#45;source&#58;image&#45;source"></a>[image source](#image-source) from <var>sourceSet</var>&#46; Let <var>selectedSource</var> be this choice&#46;

3.  Return <var>selectedSource</var> and its associated pixel density&#46;

###### <a id="creating&#45;a&#45;source&#45;set&#45;from&#45;attributes"></a>4&#46;8&#46;4&#46;3&#46;8 Creating a source set from attributes[](#creating-a-source-set-from-attributes)

When asked to <a id="create&#45;a&#45;source&#45;set"></a><strong>create a source set</strong> given a string <var>default source</var>&#44; a string <var>srcset</var>&#44; a string <var>sizes</var>&#44; and an element or null <var>img</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>source set</var> be an empty <a id="creating&#45;a&#45;source&#45;set&#45;from&#45;attributes&#58;source&#45;set"></a>[source set](#source-set)&#46;

2.  If <var>srcset</var> is not an empty string&#44; then set <var>source set</var> to the result of <a id="creating&#45;a&#45;source&#45;set&#45;from&#45;attributes&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;srcset&#45;attribute"></a>[parsing](#parse-a-srcset-attribute) <var>srcset</var>&#46;

3.  Set <var>source set</var>&#39;s <a id="creating&#45;a&#45;source&#45;set&#45;from&#45;attributes&#58;source&#45;size&#45;2"></a>[source size](#source-size-2) to the result of <a id="creating&#45;a&#45;source&#45;set&#45;from&#45;attributes&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;sizes&#45;attribute"></a>[parsing](#parse-a-sizes-attribute) <var>sizes</var> with <var>img</var>&#46;

4.  If <var>default source</var> is not the empty string and <var>source set</var> does not contain an <a id="creating&#45;a&#45;source&#45;set&#45;from&#45;attributes&#58;image&#45;source"></a>[image source](#image-source) with a <a id="creating&#45;a&#45;source&#45;set&#45;from&#45;attributes&#58;pixel&#45;density&#45;descriptor"></a>[pixel density descriptor](#pixel-density-descriptor) value of 1&#44; and no <a id="creating&#45;a&#45;source&#45;set&#45;from&#45;attributes&#58;image&#45;source&#45;2"></a>[image source](#image-source) with a <a id="creating&#45;a&#45;source&#45;set&#45;from&#45;attributes&#58;width&#45;descriptor"></a>[width descriptor](#width-descriptor)&#44; append <var>default source</var> to <var>source set</var>&#46;

5.  <a id="creating&#45;a&#45;source&#45;set&#45;from&#45;attributes&#58;normalise&#45;the&#45;source&#45;densities"></a>[Normalize the source densities](#normalise-the-source-densities) of <var>source set</var>&#46;

6.  Return <var>source set</var>&#46;

###### <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set"></a>4&#46;8&#46;4&#46;3&#46;9 Updating the source set[](#updating-the-source-set)

When asked to <a id="update&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set"></a><strong>update the source set</strong> for a given <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> or <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;the&#45;link&#45;element"></a><code>[link](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-link-element)</code> element <var>el</var>&#44; user agents must do the following&#58;

1.  Set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;source&#45;set"></a>[source set](#source-set) to an empty <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;source&#45;set&#45;2"></a>[source set](#source-set)&#46;

2.  Let <var>elements</var> be « <var>el</var> »&#46;

3.  If <var>el</var> is an <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element whose parent node is a <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code> element&#44; then <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;list&#45;replace"></a>[replace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-replace) the contents of <var>elements</var> with <var>el</var>&#39;s parent node&#39;s child elements&#44; retaining relative order&#46;

4.  Let <var>img</var> be <var>el</var> if <var>el</var> is an <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#44; otherwise null&#46;

5.  <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;list&#45;iterate"></a>[For each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) <var>child</var> in <var>elements</var>&#58;

    1.  If <var>child</var> is <var>el</var>&#58;

        1.  Let <var>default source</var> be the empty string&#46;

        2.  Let <var>srcset</var> be the empty string&#46;

        3.  Let <var>sizes</var> be the empty string&#46;

        4.  If <var>el</var> is an <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element that has a <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;srcset"></a><code>[srcset](#attr-img-srcset)</code> attribute&#44; then set <var>srcset</var> to that attribute&#39;s value&#46;

        5.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>el</var> is a <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;the&#45;link&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[link](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-link-element)</code> element that has an <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;link&#45;imagesrcset"></a><code>[imagesrcset](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#attr-link-imagesrcset)</code> attribute&#44; then set <var>srcset</var> to that attribute&#39;s value&#46;

        6.  If <var>el</var> is an <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element that has a <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;sizes"></a><code>[sizes](#attr-img-sizes)</code> attribute&#44; then set <var>sizes</var> to that attribute&#39;s value&#46;

        7.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>el</var> is a <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;the&#45;link&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[link](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-link-element)</code> element that has an <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;link&#45;imagesizes"></a><code>[imagesizes](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#attr-link-imagesizes)</code> attribute&#44; then set <var>sizes</var> to that attribute&#39;s value&#46;

        8.  If <var>el</var> is an <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element that has a <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-img-src)</code> attribute&#44; then set <var>default source</var> to that attribute&#39;s value&#46;

        9.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>el</var> is a <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;the&#45;link&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[link](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-link-element)</code> element that has an <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;link&#45;href"></a><code>[href](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#attr-link-href)</code> attribute&#44; then set <var>default source</var> to that attribute&#39;s value&#46;

        10. Set <var>el</var>&#39;s <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;source&#45;set&#45;3"></a>[source set](#source-set) to the result of <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;create&#45;a&#45;source&#45;set"></a>[creating a source set](#create-a-source-set) given <var>default source</var>&#44; <var>srcset</var>&#44; <var>sizes</var>&#44; and <var>img</var>&#46;

        11. Return&#46;

            <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

            If <var>el</var> is a <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;the&#45;link&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[link](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-link-element)</code> element&#44; then <var>elements</var> contains only <var>el</var>&#44; so this step will be reached immediately and the rest of the algorithm will not run&#46;

    2.  If <var>child</var> is not a <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element&#44; then <a id="updating&#45;the&#45;source&#45;set&#58;continue"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue)&#46;

    3.
