``` text
  ><a href="?go=right"><img src="fsm-right.png" alt="Right side."></a></p>
```

###### <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content"></a>4&#46;8&#46;4&#46;4&#46;11 A key part of the content[](#a-key-part-of-the-content)

In some cases&#44; the image is a critical part of the content&#46; This could be the case&#44; for instance&#44; on a page that is part of a photo gallery&#46; The image is the whole <em>point</em> of the page containing it&#46;

How to provide alternative text for an image that is a key part of the content depends on the image&#39;s provenance&#46;

<strong>The general case</strong>

When it is possible for detailed alternative text to be provided&#44; for example if the image is part of a series of screenshots in a magazine review&#44; or part of a comic strip&#44; or is a photograph in a blog entry about that photograph&#44; text that can serve as a substitute for the image must be given as the contents of the <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

A screenshot in a gallery of screenshots for a new OS&#44; with some alternative text&#58;

``` text
<figure>
 <img src="KDE%20Light%20desktop.png"
      alt="The desktop is blue, with icons along the left hand side in
           two columns, reading System, Home, K-Mail, etc. A window is
           open showing that menus wrap to a second line if they
           cannot fit in the window. The window has a list of icons
           along the top, with an address bar below it, a list of
           icons for tabs along the left edge, a status bar on the
           bottom, and two panes in the middle. The desktop has a bar
           at the bottom of the screen with a few buttons, a pager, a
           list of open applications, and a clock.">
 <figcaption>Screenshot of a KDE desktop.</figcaption>
</figure>
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

A graph in a financial report&#58;

``` text
<img src="sales.gif"
     title="Sales graph"
     alt="From 1998 to 2005, sales increased by the following percentages
     with each year: 624%, 75%, 138%, 40%, 35%, 9%, 21%">
```

Note that &#34;sales graph&#34; would be inadequate alternative text for a sales graph&#46; Text that would be a good <em>caption</em> is not generally suitable as replacement text&#46;

<strong>Images that defy a complete description</strong>

In certain cases&#44; the nature of the image might be such that providing thorough alternative text is impractical&#46; For example&#44; the image could be indistinct&#44; or could be a complex fractal&#44; or could be a detailed topographical map&#46;

In these cases&#44; the <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;2"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute must contain some suitable alternative text&#44; but it may be somewhat brief&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Sometimes there simply is no text that can do justice to an image&#46; For example&#44; there is little that can be said to usefully describe a Rorschach inkblot test&#46; However&#44; a description&#44; even if brief&#44; is still better than nothing&#58;

``` text
<figure>
 <img src="/commons/a/a7/Rorschach1.jpg" alt="A shape with left-right
 symmetry with indistinct edges, with a small gap in the center, two
 larger gaps offset slightly from the center, with two similar gaps
 under them. The outline is wider in the top half than the bottom
 half, with the sides extending upwards higher than the center, and
 the center extending below the sides.">
 <figcaption>A black outline of the first of the ten cards
 in the Rorschach inkblot test.</figcaption>
</figure>
```

Note that the following would be a very bad use of alternative text&#58;

``` text
<!-- This example is wrong. Do not copy it. -->
<figure>
 <img src="/commons/a/a7/Rorschach1.jpg" alt="A black outline
 of the first of the ten cards in the Rorschach inkblot test.">
 <figcaption>A black outline of the first of the ten cards
 in the Rorschach inkblot test.</figcaption>
</figure>
```

Including the caption in the alternative text like this isn&#39;t useful because it effectively duplicates the caption for users who don&#39;t have images&#44; taunting them twice yet not helping them any more than if they had only read or heard the caption once&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Another example of an image that defies full description is a fractal&#44; which&#44; by definition&#44; is infinite in detail&#46;

The following example shows one possible way of providing alternative text for the full view of an image of the Mandelbrot set&#46;

``` text
<img src="ms1.jpeg" alt="The Mandelbrot set appears as a cardioid with
its cusp on the real axis in the positive direction, with a smaller
bulb aligned along the same center line, touching it in the negative
direction, and with these two shapes being surrounded by smaller bulbs
of various sizes.">
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Similarly&#44; a photograph of a person&#39;s face&#44; for example in a biography&#44; can be considered quite relevant and key to the content&#44; but it can be hard to fully substitute text for&#58;

``` text
<section class="bio">
 <h1>A Biography of Isaac Asimov</h1>
 <p>Born <b>Isaak Yudovich Ozimov</b> in 1920, Isaac was a prolific author.</p>
 <p><img src="headpics/asimov.jpeg" alt="Isaac Asimov had dark hair, a tall forehead, and wore glasses.
 Later in life, he wore long white sideburns."></p>
 <p>Asimov was born in Russia, and moved to the US when he was three years old.</p>
 <p>...</p>
</section>
```

In such cases it is unnecessary &#40;and indeed discouraged&#41; to include a reference to the presence of the image itself in the alternative text&#44; since such text would be redundant with the browser itself reporting the presence of the image&#46; For example&#44; if the alternative text was &#34;A photo of Isaac Asimov&#34;&#44; then a conforming user agent might read that out as &#34;&#40;Image&#41; A photo of Isaac Asimov&#34; rather than the more useful &#34;&#40;Image&#41; Isaac Asimov had dark hair&#44; a tall forehead&#44; and wore glasses&#46;&#46;&#46;&#34;&#46;

<a id="unknown&#45;images"></a><strong>Images whose contents are not known</strong>

In some unfortunate cases&#44; there might be no alternative text available at all&#44; either because the image is obtained in some automated fashion without any associated alternative text &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; a webcam&#41;&#44; or because the page is being generated by a script using user&#45;provided images where the user did not provide suitable or usable alternative text &#40;e&#46;g&#46; photograph sharing sites&#41;&#44; or because the author does not themself know what the images represent &#40;e&#46;g&#46; a blind photographer sharing an image on their blog&#41;&#46;

In such cases&#44; the <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;3"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute may be omitted&#44; but one of the following conditions must be met as well&#58;

- <a id="figcaption&#45;as&#45;alt&#45;condition"></a>

  The <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element is in a <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;the&#45;figure&#45;element"></a><code>[figure](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figure-element)</code> element that contains a <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;the&#45;figcaption&#45;element"></a><code>[figcaption](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figcaption-element)</code> element that contains content other than <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;inter&#45;element&#45;whitespace"></a>[inter&#45;element whitespace](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#inter-element-whitespace)&#44; and&#44; ignoring the <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;the&#45;figcaption&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[figcaption](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figcaption-element)</code> element and its descendants&#44; the <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;the&#45;figure&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[figure](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figure-element)</code> element has no <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[flow content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#flow-content-2) descendants other than <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;inter&#45;element&#45;whitespace&#45;2"></a>[inter&#45;element whitespace](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#inter-element-whitespace) and the <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#46;

- The <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;attr&#45;title"></a><code>[title](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-title)</code> attribute is present and has a non&#45;empty value&#46;

  <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

  Relying on the <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;attr&#45;title&#45;2"></a><code>[title](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-title)</code> attribute is currently discouraged as many user agents do not expose the attribute in an accessible manner as required by this specification &#40;e&#46;g&#46; requiring a pointing device such as a mouse to cause a tooltip to appear&#44; which excludes keyboard&#45;only users and touch&#45;only users&#44; such as anyone with a modern phone or tablet&#41;&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Such cases are to be kept to an absolute minimum&#46; If there is even the slightest possibility of the author having the ability to provide real alternative text&#44; then it would not be acceptable to omit the <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;4"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

A photo on a photo&#45;sharing site&#44; if the site received the image with no metadata other than the caption&#44; could be marked up as follows&#58;

``` text
<figure>
 <img src="1100670787_6a7c664aef.jpg">
 <figcaption>Bubbles traveled everywhere with us.</figcaption>
</figure>
```

It would be better&#44; however&#44; if a detailed description of the important parts of the image obtained from the user and included on the page&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

A blind user&#39;s blog in which a photo taken by the user is shown&#46; Initially&#44; the user might not have any idea what the photo they took shows&#58;

``` text
<article>
 <h1>I took a photo</h1>
 <p>I went out today and took a photo!</p>
 <figure>
  <img src="photo2.jpeg">
  <figcaption>A photograph taken blindly from my front porch.</figcaption>
 </figure>
</article>
```

Eventually though&#44; the user might obtain a description of the image from their friends and could then include alternative text&#58;

``` text
<article>
 <h1>I took a photo</h1>
 <p>I went out today and took a photo!</p>
 <figure>
  <img src="photo2.jpeg" alt="The photograph shows my squirrel
  feeder hanging from the edge of my roof. It is half full, but there
  are no squirrels around. In the background, out-of-focus trees fill the
  shot. The feeder is made of wood with a metal grate, and it contains
  peanuts. The edge of the roof is wooden too, and is painted white
  with light blue streaks.">
  <figcaption>A photograph taken blindly from my front porch.</figcaption>
 </figure>
</article>
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Sometimes the entire point of the image is that a textual description is not available&#44; and the user is to provide the description&#46; For instance&#44; the point of a CAPTCHA image is to see if the user can literally read the graphic&#46; Here is one way to mark up a CAPTCHA &#40;note the <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;attr&#45;title&#45;3"></a><code>[title](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-title)</code> attribute&#41;&#58;

``` text
<p><label>What does this image say?
<img src="captcha.cgi?id=8934" title="CAPTCHA">
<input type=text name=captcha></label>
(If you cannot see the image, you can use an <a
href="?audio">audio</a> test instead.)</p>
```

Another example would be software that displays images and asks for alternative text precisely for the purpose of then writing a page with correct alternative text&#46; Such a page could have a table of images&#44; like this&#58;

``` text
<table>
 <thead>
  <tr> <th> Image <th> Description
 <tbody>
  <tr>
   <td> <img src="2421.png" title="Image 640 by 100, filename 'banner.gif'">
   <td> <input name="alt2421">
  <tr>
   <td> <img src="2422.png" title="Image 200 by 480, filename 'ad3.gif'">
   <td> <input name="alt2422">
</table>
```

Notice that even in this example&#44; as much useful information as possible is still included in the <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;attr&#45;title&#45;4"></a><code>[title](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-title)</code> attribute&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Since some users cannot use images at all &#40;e&#46;g&#46; because they have a very slow connection&#44; or because they are using a text&#45;only browser&#44; or because they are listening to the page being read out by a hands&#45;free automobile voice web browser&#44; or simply because they are blind&#41;&#44; the <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;5"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute is only allowed to be omitted rather than being provided with replacement text when no alternative text is available and none can be made available&#44; as in the above examples&#46; Lack of effort from the part of the author is not an acceptable reason for omitting the <a id="a&#45;key&#45;part&#45;of&#45;the&#45;content&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;6"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute&#46;

###### <a id="an&#45;image&#45;not&#45;intended&#45;for&#45;the&#45;user"></a>4&#46;8&#46;4&#46;4&#46;12 An image not intended for the user[](#an-image-not-intended-for-the-user)

Generally authors should avoid using <a id="an&#45;image&#45;not&#45;intended&#45;for&#45;the&#45;user&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> elements for purposes other than showing images&#46;

If an <a id="an&#45;image&#45;not&#45;intended&#45;for&#45;the&#45;user&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element is being used for purposes other than showing an image&#44; e&#46;g&#46; as part of a service to count page views&#44; then the <a id="an&#45;image&#45;not&#45;intended&#45;for&#45;the&#45;user&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute must be the empty string&#46;

In such cases&#44; the <a id="an&#45;image&#45;not&#45;intended&#45;for&#45;the&#45;user&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;width"></a><code>[width](#attr-dim-width)</code> and <a id="an&#45;image&#45;not&#45;intended&#45;for&#45;the&#45;user&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;height"></a><code>[height](#attr-dim-height)</code> attributes should both be set to zero&#46;

###### <a id="an&#45;image&#45;in&#45;an&#45;e&#45;mail&#45;or&#45;private&#45;document&#45;intended&#45;for&#45;a&#45;specific&#45;person&#45;who&#45;is&#45;known&#45;to&#45;be&#45;able&#45;to&#45;view&#45;images"></a>4&#46;8&#46;4&#46;4&#46;13 An image in an email or private document intended for a specific person who is known to be able to view images[](#an-image-in-an-e-mail-or-private-document-intended-for-a-specific-person-who-is-known-to-be-able-to-view-images)

<em>This section does not apply to documents that are publicly accessible&#44; or whose target audience is not necessarily personally known to the author&#44; such as documents on a web site&#44; emails sent to public mailing lists&#44; or software documentation&#46;</em>

When an image is included in a private communication &#40;such as an HTML email&#41; aimed at a specific person who is known to be able to view images&#44; the <a id="an&#45;image&#45;in&#45;an&#45;e&#45;mail&#45;or&#45;private&#45;document&#45;intended&#45;for&#45;a&#45;specific&#45;person&#45;who&#45;is&#45;known&#45;to&#45;be&#45;able&#45;to&#45;view&#45;images&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute may be omitted&#46; However&#44; even in such cases authors are strongly urged to include alternative text &#40;as appropriate according to the kind of image involved&#44; as described in the above entries&#41;&#44; so that the email is still usable should the user use a mail client that does not support images&#44; or should the document be forwarded on to other users whose abilities might not include easily seeing images&#46;

###### <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;markup&#45;generators"></a>4&#46;8&#46;4&#46;4&#46;14 Guidance for markup generators[](#guidance-for-markup-generators)

Markup generators &#40;such as WYSIWYG authoring tools&#41; should&#44; wherever possible&#44; obtain alternative text from their users&#46; However&#44; it is recognized that in many cases&#44; this will not be possible&#46;

For images that are the sole contents of links&#44; markup generators should examine the link target to determine the title of the target&#44; or the URL of the target&#44; and use information obtained in this manner as the alternative text&#46;

For images that have captions&#44; markup generators should use the <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;markup&#45;generators&#58;the&#45;figure&#45;element"></a><code>[figure](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figure-element)</code> and <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;markup&#45;generators&#58;the&#45;figcaption&#45;element"></a><code>[figcaption](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figcaption-element)</code> elements&#44; or the <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;markup&#45;generators&#58;attr&#45;title"></a><code>[title](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-title)</code> attribute&#44; to provide the image&#39;s caption&#46;

As a last resort&#44; implementers should either set the <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;markup&#45;generators&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute to the empty string&#44; under the assumption that the image is a purely decorative image that doesn&#39;t add any information but is still specific to the surrounding content&#44; or omit the <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;markup&#45;generators&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;2"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute altogether&#44; under the assumption that the image is a key part of the content&#46;

Markup generators may specify a <a id="attr&#45;img&#45;generator&#45;unable&#45;to&#45;provide&#45;required&#45;alt"></a><strong><code>generator&#45;unable&#45;to&#45;provide&#45;required&#45;alt</code></strong> attribute on <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;markup&#45;generators&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> elements for which they have been unable to obtain alternative text and for which they have therefore omitted the <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;markup&#45;generators&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;3"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute&#46; The value of this attribute must be the empty string&#46; Documents containing such attributes are not conforming&#44; but conformance checkers will [silently ignore](#guidance-for-conformance-checkers) this error&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This is intended to avoid markup generators from being pressured into replacing the error of omitting the <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;markup&#45;generators&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;4"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute with the even more egregious error of providing phony alternative text&#44; because state&#45;of&#45;the&#45;art automated conformance checkers cannot distinguish phony alternative text from correct alternative text&#46;

Markup generators should generally avoid using the image&#39;s own filename as the alternative text&#46; Similarly&#44; markup generators should avoid generating alternative text from any content that will be equally available to presentation user agents &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; web browsers&#41;&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This is because once a page is generated&#44; it will typically not be updated&#44; whereas the browsers that later read the page can be updated by the user&#44; therefore the browser is likely to have more up&#45;to&#45;date and finely&#45;tuned heuristics than the markup generator did when generating the page&#46;

###### <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;conformance&#45;checkers"></a>4&#46;8&#46;4&#46;4&#46;15 Guidance for conformance checkers[](#guidance-for-conformance-checkers)

A conformance checker must report the lack of an <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;conformance&#45;checkers&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute as an error unless one of the conditions listed below applies&#58;

- The <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;conformance&#45;checkers&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element is in a <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;conformance&#45;checkers&#58;the&#45;figure&#45;element"></a><code>[figure](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figure-element)</code> element that satisfies [the conditions described above](#figcaption-as-alt-condition)&#46;

- The <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;conformance&#45;checkers&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element has a <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;conformance&#45;checkers&#58;attr&#45;title"></a><code>[title](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-title)</code> attribute with a value that is not the empty string &#40;also as [described above](#unknown-images)&#41;&#46;

- The conformance checker has been configured to assume that the document is an email or document intended for a specific person who is known to be able to view images&#46;

- The <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;conformance&#45;checkers&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element has a &#40;non&#45;conforming&#41; <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;conformance&#45;checkers&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;generator&#45;unable&#45;to&#45;provide&#45;required&#45;alt"></a><code>[generator&#45;unable&#45;to&#45;provide&#45;required&#45;alt](#attr-img-generator-unable-to-provide-required-alt)</code> attribute whose value is the empty string&#46; A conformance checker that is not reporting the lack of an <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;conformance&#45;checkers&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;2"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute as an error must also not report the presence of the empty <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;conformance&#45;checkers&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;generator&#45;unable&#45;to&#45;provide&#45;required&#45;alt&#45;2"></a><code>[generator&#45;unable&#45;to&#45;provide&#45;required&#45;alt](#attr-img-generator-unable-to-provide-required-alt)</code> attribute as an error&#46; &#40;This case does not represent a case where the document is conforming&#44; only that the generator could not determine appropriate alternative text — validators are not required to show an error in this case&#44; because such an error might encourage markup generators to include bogus alternative text purely in an attempt to silence validators&#46; Naturally&#44; conformance checkers <em>may</em> report the lack of an <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;conformance&#45;checkers&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;3"></a><code>[alt](#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute as an error even in the presence of the <a id="guidance&#45;for&#45;conformance&#45;checkers&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;generator&#45;unable&#45;to&#45;provide&#45;required&#45;alt&#45;3"></a><code>[generator&#45;unable&#45;to&#45;provide&#45;required&#45;alt](#attr-img-generator-unable-to-provide-required-alt)</code> attribute&#59; for example&#44; there could be a user option to report <em>all</em> conformance errors even those that might be the more or less inevitable result of using a markup generator&#46;&#41;

<a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;palpable&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Palpable content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#palpable-content-2)&#46;

Where <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;embedded&#45;content&#45;category&#45;2"></a>[embedded content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#embedded-content-category) is expected&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a>[Tag omission in text&#47;html](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-tag-omission)&#58;</strong>

Neither tag is omissible&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes"></a>[Content attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-attributes)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;global&#45;attributes"></a>[Global attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#global-attributes)

<a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-iframe-src)</code> — Address of the resource

<a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc"></a><code>[srcdoc](#attr-iframe-srcdoc)</code> — A document to render in the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code>

<a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;name"></a><code>[name](#attr-iframe-name)</code> — Name of <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable)

<a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox"></a><code>[sandbox](#attr-iframe-sandbox)</code> — Security rules for nested content

<a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;allow"></a><code>[allow](#attr-iframe-allow)</code> — <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;permissions&#45;policy"></a>[Permissions policy](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-feature-policy/#permissions-policy) to be applied to the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code>&#39;s contents

<a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;allowfullscreen"></a><code>[allowfullscreen](#attr-iframe-allowfullscreen)</code> — Whether to allow the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code>&#39;s contents to use <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;element&#45;requestfullscreen"></a><code>[requestFullscreen&#40;&#41;](https://fullscreen.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-element-requestfullscreen)</code>

<a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;width"></a><code>[width](#attr-dim-width)</code> — Horizontal dimension

<a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;height"></a><code>[height](#attr-dim-height)</code> — Vertical dimension

<a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;referrerpolicy"></a><code>[referrerpolicy](#attr-iframe-referrerpolicy)</code> — <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;referrer&#45;policy"></a>[Referrer policy](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy) for <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fetch"></a>[fetches](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch) initiated by the element

<a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;loading"></a><code>[loading](#attr-iframe-loading)</code> — Used when determining loading deferral

id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;getsvgdocument"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLIFrameElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, ReflectURL] attribute USVString src;
  [CEReactions] attribute (TrustedHTML or DOMString) srcdoc;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString name;
  [SameObject, PutForwards=value, Reflect] readonly attribute DOMTokenList sandbox;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString allow;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean allowFullscreen;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString width;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString height;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString referrerPolicy;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString loading;
  readonly attribute Document? contentDocument;
  readonly attribute WindowProxy? contentWindow;
  Document? getSVGDocument();

  // also has obsolete members
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) its <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;2"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;iframe&#45;src"></a><strong><code>src</code></strong> attribute gives the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) of a page that the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;3"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) is to contain&#46; The attribute&#44; if present&#44; must be a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;empty&#45;url&#45;potentially&#45;surrounded&#45;by&#45;spaces"></a>[valid non&#45;empty URL potentially surrounded by spaces](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-empty-url-potentially-surrounded-by-spaces)&#46; If the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;names&#58;&#45;the&#45;itemprop&#45;attribute"></a><code>[itemprop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#names:-the-itemprop-attribute)</code> attribute is specified on an <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element&#44; then the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;src&#45;2"></a><code>[src](#attr-iframe-src)</code> attribute must also be specified&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;iframe&#35;attr&#45;srcdoc](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/iframe#attr-srcdoc)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox25&#43;Safari6&#43;Chrome20&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;&#63;Internet ExplorerNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

The <a id="attr&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc"></a><strong><code>srcdoc</code></strong> attribute gives the content of the page that the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;4"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) is to contain&#46; The value of the attribute is used to <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;create&#45;navigation&#45;params&#45;from&#45;a&#45;srcdoc&#45;resource"></a>[construct](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#create-navigation-params-from-a-srcdoc-resource) <a id="an&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;document"></a><strong>an <code>iframe</code> <code>srcdoc</code> document</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> whose <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url) <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;matches&#45;about&#58;srcdoc"></a>[matches <code>about&#58;srcdoc</code>](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#matches-about:srcdoc)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;2"></a><code>[srcdoc](#attr-iframe-srcdoc)</code> attribute&#44; if present&#44; must have a value using <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;syntax"></a>[the HTML syntax](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax) that consists of the following syntactic components&#44; in the given order&#58;

1.  Any number of <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;comments"></a>[comments](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-comments) and <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;
2.  Optionally&#44; a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;doctype"></a>[DOCTYPE](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-doctype)&#46;
3.  Any number of <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;comments&#45;2"></a>[comments](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-comments) and <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;2"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;
4.  The <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;document&#45;element"></a>[document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element)&#44; in the form of an <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code> <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;elements"></a>[element](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-elements)&#46;
5.  Any number of <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;comments&#45;3"></a>[comments](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-comments) and <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;space&#45;characters&#45;3"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The above requirements apply in <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;xml&#45;documents"></a>[XML documents](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-document) as well&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Here a blog uses the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;3"></a><code>[srcdoc](#attr-iframe-srcdoc)</code> attribute in conjunction with the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;2"></a><code>[sandbox](#attr-iframe-sandbox)</code> attribute described below to provide users of user agents that support this feature with an extra layer of protection from script injection in the blog post comments&#58;

``` text
<article>
 <h1>I got my own magazine!</h1>
 <p>After much effort, I've finally found a publisher, and so now I
 have my own magazine! Isn't that awesome?! The first issue will come
 out in September, and we have articles about getting food, and about
 getting in boxes, it's going to be great!</p>
 <footer>
  <p>Written by <a href="/users/cap">cap</a>, 1 hour ago.
 </footer>
 <article>
  <footer> Thirteen minutes ago, <a href="/users/ch">ch</a> wrote: </footer>
  <iframe sandbox srcdoc="<p>did you get a cover picture yet?"></iframe>
 </article>
 <article>
  <footer> Nine minutes ago, <a href="/users/cap">cap</a> wrote: </footer>
  <iframe sandbox srcdoc="<p>Yeah, you can see it <a href=&quot;/gallery?mode=cover&amp;amp;page=1&quot;>in my gallery</a>."></iframe>
 </article>
 <article>
  <footer> Five minutes ago, <a href="/users/ch">ch</a> wrote: </footer>
  <iframe sandbox srcdoc="<p>hey that's earl's table.
<p>you should get earl&amp;amp;me on the next cover."></iframe>
 </article>
```

Notice the way that quotes have to be escaped &#40;otherwise the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;4"></a><code>[srcdoc](#attr-iframe-srcdoc)</code> attribute would end prematurely&#41;&#44; and the way raw ampersands &#40;e&#46;g&#46; in URLs or in prose&#41; mentioned in the sandboxed content have to be <em>doubly</em> escaped — once so that the ampersand is preserved when originally parsing the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;5"></a><code>[srcdoc](#attr-iframe-srcdoc)</code> attribute&#44; and once more to prevent the ampersand from being misinterpreted when parsing the sandboxed content&#46;

Furthermore&#44; notice that since the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;doctype&#45;2"></a>[DOCTYPE](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-doctype) is optional in <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;an&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;document"></a>[<code>iframe</code> <code>srcdoc</code> documents](#an-iframe-srcdoc-document)&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;html&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[html](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-html-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;head&#45;element"></a><code>[head](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-head-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> elements have <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a>[optional start and end tags](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-tag-omission)&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;title&#45;element"></a><code>[title](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#the-title-element)</code> element is also optional in <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;an&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[<code>iframe</code> <code>srcdoc</code> documents](#an-iframe-srcdoc-document)&#44; the markup in a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;6"></a><code>[srcdoc](#attr-iframe-srcdoc)</code> attribute can be relatively succinct despite representing an entire document&#44; since only the contents of the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;body&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[body](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-body-element)</code> element need appear literally in the syntax&#46; The other elements are still present&#44; but only by implication&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;2"></a>[the HTML syntax](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax)&#44; authors need only remember to use U&#43;0022 QUOTATION MARK characters &#40;&#34;&#41; to wrap the attribute contents and then to escape all U&#43;0026 AMPERSAND &#40;&#38;&#41; and U&#43;0022 QUOTATION MARK &#40;&#34;&#41; characters&#44; and to specify the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;3"></a><code>[sandbox](#attr-iframe-sandbox)</code> attribute&#44; to ensure safe embedding of content&#46; &#40;And remember to escape ampersands before quotation marks&#44; to ensure quotation marks become &#38;quot&#59; and not &#38;amp&#59;quot&#59;&#46;&#41;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In XML the U&#43;003C LESS&#45;THAN SIGN character &#40;&#60;&#41; needs to be escaped as well&#46; In order to prevent [attribute&#45;value normalization](https://www.w3.org/TR/xml/#AVNormalize)&#44; some of XML&#39;s whitespace characters — specifically U&#43;0009 CHARACTER TABULATION &#40;tab&#41;&#44; U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;&#44; and U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41; — also need to be escaped&#46; [&#91;XML&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsXML)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

If the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;src&#45;3"></a><code>[src](#attr-iframe-src)</code> attribute and the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;7"></a><code>[srcdoc](#attr-iframe-srcdoc)</code> attribute are both specified together&#44; the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;8"></a><code>[srcdoc](#attr-iframe-srcdoc)</code> attribute takes priority&#46; This allows authors to provide a fallback <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;url&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) for legacy user agents that do not support the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;9"></a><code>[srcdoc](#attr-iframe-srcdoc)</code> attribute&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;html&#45;element&#45;post&#45;connection&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element post&#45;connection steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-post-connection-steps)&#44; given <var>insertedNode</var>&#44; are&#58;

1.  If <var>insertedNode</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;bc"></a>[browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-bc) is null&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If <var>insertedNode</var> has a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;4"></a><code>[sandbox](#attr-iframe-sandbox)</code> attribute&#44; then <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;sandboxing&#45;directive"></a>[parse the sandboxing directive](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#parse-a-sandboxing-directive) given the attribute&#39;s value and <var>insertedNode</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;iframe&#45;sandboxing&#45;flag&#45;set"></a>[<code>iframe</code> sandboxing flag set](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#iframe-sandboxing-flag-set)&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;create&#45;a&#45;new&#45;child&#45;navigable"></a>[Create a new child navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#create-a-new-child-navigable) for <var>insertedNode</var>&#46;

4.  <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;process&#45;the&#45;iframe&#45;attributes"></a>[Process the <code>iframe</code> attributes](#process-the-iframe-attributes) for <var>insertedNode</var>&#44; with <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;process&#45;iframe&#45;initial&#45;insertion"></a><em>[initialInsertion](#process-iframe-initial-insertion)</em> set to true&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;html&#45;element&#45;removing&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element removing steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-removing-steps)&#44; given <var>removedNode</var>&#44; are to <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;destroy&#45;a&#45;child&#45;navigable"></a>[destroy a child navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#destroy-a-child-navigable) given <var>removedNode</var>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This happens without any <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;event&#45;unload"></a><code>[unload](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-unload)</code> events firing &#40;the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;bcc&#45;content&#45;document"></a>[content document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-bcc-content-document) is <em><a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;destroy&#45;a&#45;child&#45;navigable&#45;2"></a>[destroyed](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#destroy-a-child-navigable)</em>&#44; not <em><a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;unload&#45;a&#45;document"></a>[unloaded](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#unload-a-document)</em>&#41;&#46;

Although <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code>s are processed while in a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;shadow&#45;tree"></a>[shadow tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-tree)&#44; per the above&#44; several other aspects of their behavior are not well&#45;defined with regards to shadow trees&#46; See [issue &#35;763](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/763) for more detail&#46;

Whenever an <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element with a non&#45;null <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;5"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) has its <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;10"></a><code>[srcdoc](#attr-iframe-srcdoc)</code> attribute set&#44; changed&#44; or removed&#44; the user agent must <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;process&#45;the&#45;iframe&#45;attributes&#45;2"></a>[process the <code>iframe</code> attributes](#process-the-iframe-attributes)&#46;

Similarly&#44; whenever an <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element with a non&#45;null <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;6"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) but with no <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;11"></a><code>[srcdoc](#attr-iframe-srcdoc)</code> attribute specified has its <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;src&#45;4"></a><code>[src](#attr-iframe-src)</code> attribute set&#44; changed&#44; or removed&#44; the user agent must <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;process&#45;the&#45;iframe&#45;attributes&#45;3"></a>[process the <code>iframe</code> attributes](#process-the-iframe-attributes)&#46;

To <a id="process&#45;the&#45;iframe&#45;attributes"></a><strong>process the <code>iframe</code> attributes</strong> for an element <var>element</var>&#44; with an optional boolean <a id="process&#45;iframe&#45;initial&#45;insertion"></a><strong><var>initialInsertion</var></strong> &#40;default false&#41;&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;12"></a><code>[srcdoc](#attr-iframe-srcdoc)</code> attribute is specified&#58;

    1.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;current&#45;navigation&#45;was&#45;lazy&#45;loaded"></a>[current navigation was lazy loaded](#current-navigation-was-lazy-loaded) boolean to false&#46;

    2.  If the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;will&#45;lazy&#45;load&#45;element&#45;steps"></a>[will lazy load element steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#will-lazy-load-element-steps) given <var>element</var> return true&#58;

        1.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps"></a>[lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-load-resumption-steps) to the rest of this algorithm starting with the step labeled <em>navigate to the srcdoc resource</em>&#46;

        2.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;current&#45;navigation&#45;was&#45;lazy&#45;loaded&#45;2"></a>[current navigation was lazy loaded](#current-navigation-was-lazy-loaded) boolean to true&#46;

        3.  <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;start&#45;intersection&#45;observing&#45;a&#45;lazy&#45;loading&#45;element"></a>[Start intersection&#45;observing a lazy loading element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#start-intersection-observing-a-lazy-loading-element) for <var>element</var>&#46;

        4.  Return&#46;

    3.  <em>Navigate to the srcdoc resource</em>&#58; <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;navigate&#45;an&#45;iframe&#45;or&#45;frame"></a>[Navigate an <code>iframe</code> or <code>frame</code>](#navigate-an-iframe-or-frame) given <var>element</var>&#44; <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;about&#58;srcdoc"></a><code>[about&#58;srcdoc](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#about:srcdoc)</code>&#44; the empty string&#44; and the value of <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;13"></a><code>[srcdoc](#attr-iframe-srcdoc)</code> attribute&#46;

        The resulting <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;document&#45;4"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> must be considered <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;an&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[an <code>iframe</code> <code>srcdoc</code> document](#an-iframe-srcdoc-document)&#46;

2.  Otherwise&#58;

    1.  Let <var>url</var> be the result of running the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;shared&#45;attribute&#45;processing&#45;steps&#45;for&#45;iframe&#45;and&#45;frame&#45;elements"></a>[shared attribute processing steps for <code>iframe</code> and <code>frame</code> elements](#shared-attribute-processing-steps-for-iframe-and-frame-elements) given <var>element</var> and <var>initialInsertion</var>&#46;

    2.  If <var>url</var> is null&#44; then return&#46;

    3.  If <var>url</var> <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;matches&#45;about&#58;blank"></a>[matches <code>about&#58;blank</code>](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#matches-about:blank) and <var>initialInsertion</var> is true&#58;

        1.  Run the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;iframe&#45;load&#45;event&#45;steps"></a>[iframe load event steps](#iframe-load-event-steps) given <var>element</var>&#46;

        2.  Return&#46;

    4.  Let <var>referrerPolicy</var> be the current state of <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;referrerpolicy&#45;2"></a><code>[referrerpolicy](#attr-iframe-referrerpolicy)</code> content attribute&#46;

    5.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;current&#45;navigation&#45;was&#45;lazy&#45;loaded&#45;3"></a>[current navigation was lazy loaded](#current-navigation-was-lazy-loaded) boolean to false&#46;

    6.  If the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;will&#45;lazy&#45;load&#45;element&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[will lazy load element steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#will-lazy-load-element-steps) given <var>element</var> return true&#58;

        1.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-load-resumption-steps) to the rest of this algorithm starting with the step labeled <em>navigate</em>&#46;

        2.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;current&#45;navigation&#45;was&#45;lazy&#45;loaded&#45;4"></a>[current navigation was lazy loaded](#current-navigation-was-lazy-loaded) boolean to true&#46;

        3.  <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;start&#45;intersection&#45;observing&#45;a&#45;lazy&#45;loading&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[Start intersection&#45;observing a lazy loading element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#start-intersection-observing-a-lazy-loading-element) for <var>element</var>&#46;

        4.  Return&#46;

    7.  <em>Navigate</em>&#58; <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;navigate&#45;an&#45;iframe&#45;or&#45;frame&#45;2"></a>[Navigate an <code>iframe</code> or <code>frame</code>](#navigate-an-iframe-or-frame) given <var>element</var>&#44; <var>url</var>&#44; <var>referrerPolicy</var>&#44; null&#44; and <var>initialInsertion</var>&#46;

<a id="otherwise&#45;steps&#45;for&#45;iframe&#45;or&#45;frame&#45;elements"></a>The <a id="shared&#45;attribute&#45;processing&#45;steps&#45;for&#45;iframe&#45;and&#45;frame&#45;elements"></a><strong>shared attribute processing steps for <code>iframe</code> and <code>frame</code> elements</strong>&#44; given an element <var>element</var> and a boolean <var>initialInsertion</var>&#44; are&#58;

1.  Let <var>url</var> be the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;url&#45;record"></a>[URL record](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;about&#58;blank"></a><code>[about&#58;blank](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#about:blank)</code>&#46;

2.  If <var>element</var> has a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;src&#45;5"></a><code>[src](#attr-iframe-src)</code> attribute specified&#44; and its value is not the empty string&#58;

    1.  Let <var>maybeURL</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[encoding&#45;parsing a URL](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#encoding-parsing-a-url) given that attribute&#39;s value&#44; relative to <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

    2.  If <var>maybeURL</var> is not failure&#44; then set <var>url</var> to <var>maybeURL</var>&#46;

3.  If the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;inclusive&#45;ancestor&#45;navigables"></a>[inclusive ancestor navigables](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#inclusive-ancestor-navigables) of <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;node&#45;navigable"></a>[node navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#node-navigable) contains a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;navigable"></a>[navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigable) whose <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;nav&#45;document"></a>[active document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nav-document)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url) <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;equals"></a>[equals](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-equals) <var>url</var> with <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;url&#45;equals&#45;exclude&#45;fragments"></a><em>[exclude fragments](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#url-equals-exclude-fragments)</em> set to true&#44; then return null&#46;

4.  If <var>url</var> <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;matches&#45;about&#58;blank&#45;2"></a>[matches <code>about&#58;blank</code>](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#matches-about:blank) and <var>initialInsertion</var> is true&#44; then perform the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;url&#45;and&#45;history&#45;update&#45;steps"></a>[URL and history update steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#url-and-history-update-steps) given <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;7"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;nav&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[active document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nav-document) and <var>url</var>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This is necessary in case <var>url</var> is something like <code>about&#58;blank&#63;foo</code>&#46; If <var>url</var> is just plain <code>about&#58;blank</code>&#44; this will do nothing&#46;

5.  Return <var>url</var>&#46;

To <a id="navigate&#45;an&#45;iframe&#45;or&#45;frame"></a><strong>navigate an <code>iframe</code> or <code>frame</code></strong> given an element <var>element</var>&#44; a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;url&#45;3"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) <var>url</var>&#44; a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;referrer&#45;policy&#45;2"></a>[referrer policy](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy) <var>referrerPolicy</var>&#44; an optional string&#45;or&#45;null <var>srcdocString</var> &#40;default null&#41;&#44; and an optional boolean <var>initialInsertion</var> &#40;default false&#41;&#58;

1.  Let <var>historyHandling</var> be &#34;<a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;navigationhistorybehavior&#45;auto"></a><code>[auto](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigationhistorybehavior-auto)</code>&#34;&#46;

2.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;8"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;nav&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[active document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nav-document) is not <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;completely&#45;loaded"></a>[completely loaded](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#completely-loaded)&#44; then set <var>historyHandling</var> to &#34;<a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;navigationhistorybehavior&#45;replace"></a><code>[replace](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)</code>&#34;&#46;

3.  If <var>element</var> is an <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code>&#58;

    1.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;iframe&#45;pending&#45;resource&#45;timing&#45;start&#45;time"></a>[pending resource&#45;timing start time](#iframe-pending-resource-timing-start-time) to the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;current&#45;high&#45;resolution&#45;time"></a>[current high resolution time](https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dfn-current-high-resolution-time) given <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#46;

    2.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;iframe&#45;pending&#45;resource&#45;timing&#45;url"></a>[pending resource&#45;timing URL](#iframe-pending-resource-timing-url) to <var>url</var>&#46;

4.  <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;navigate"></a>[Navigate](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigate) <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;9"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) to <var>url</var> using <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;4"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#44; with <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;navigation&#45;hh"></a><em>[historyHandling](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigation-hh)</em> set to <var>historyHandling</var>&#44; <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;navigation&#45;referrer&#45;policy"></a><em>[referrerPolicy](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigation-referrer-policy)</em> set to <var>referrerPolicy</var>&#44; <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;navigation&#45;resource"></a><em>[documentResource](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigation-resource)</em> set to <var>srcdocString</var>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;navigation&#45;initial&#45;insertion"></a><em>[initialInsertion](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigation-initial-insertion)</em> set to <var>initialInsertion</var>&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;document&#45;5"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> has an <a id="iframe&#45;load&#45;in&#45;progress"></a><strong>iframe load in progress</strong> flag and a <a id="mute&#45;iframe&#45;load"></a><strong>mute iframe load</strong> flag&#46; When a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;document&#45;6"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> is created&#44; these flags must be unset for that <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;document&#45;7"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#46;

To run the <a id="iframe&#45;load&#45;event&#45;steps"></a><strong>iframe load event steps</strong>&#44; given an <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element <var>element</var>&#58;

1.  <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;10"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) is not null&#46;

2.  Let <var>childDocument</var> be <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;11"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;nav&#45;document&#45;4"></a>[active document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nav-document)&#46;

3.  If <var>childDocument</var> has its <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;mute&#45;iframe&#45;load"></a>[mute iframe load](#mute-iframe-load) flag set&#44; then return&#46;

4.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;iframe&#45;pending&#45;resource&#45;timing&#45;start&#45;time&#45;2"></a>[pending resource&#45;timing start time](#iframe-pending-resource-timing-start-time) is not null&#58;

    1.  <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;assert&#45;2"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;iframe&#45;pending&#45;resource&#45;timing&#45;url&#45;2"></a>[pending resource&#45;timing URL](#iframe-pending-resource-timing-url) is not null&#46;

    2.  Let <var>global</var> be <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;5"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global&#45;2"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#46;

    3.  Let <var>fallbackTimingInfo</var> be a new <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;fetch&#45;timing&#45;info"></a>[fetch timing info](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-timing-info) whose <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;fetch&#45;timing&#45;info&#45;start&#45;time"></a>[start time](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-timing-info-start-time) is <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;iframe&#45;pending&#45;resource&#45;timing&#45;start&#45;time&#45;3"></a>[pending resource&#45;timing start time](#iframe-pending-resource-timing-start-time) and whose <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;fetch&#45;timing&#45;info&#45;end&#45;time"></a>[response end time](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-timing-info-end-time) is the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;current&#45;high&#45;resolution&#45;time&#45;2"></a>[current high resolution time](https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dfn-current-high-resolution-time) given <var>global</var>&#46;

    4.  <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;mark&#45;resource&#45;timing"></a>[Mark resource timing](https://w3c.github.io/resource-timing/#dfn-mark-resource-timing) given <var>fallbackTimingInfo</var>&#44; the result of <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[parsing](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#parse-a-url) <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;iframe&#45;pending&#45;resource&#45;timing&#45;url&#45;3"></a>[pending resource&#45;timing URL](#iframe-pending-resource-timing-url)&#44; &#34;<a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code>&#34;&#44; <var>global</var>&#44; the empty string&#44; a new <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;response&#45;body&#45;info"></a>[response body info](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#response-body-info)&#44; and 0&#46;

    5.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;iframe&#45;pending&#45;resource&#45;timing&#45;start&#45;time&#45;4"></a>[pending resource&#45;timing start time](#iframe-pending-resource-timing-start-time) to null&#46;

    6.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;iframe&#45;pending&#45;resource&#45;timing&#45;url&#45;4"></a>[pending resource&#45;timing URL](#iframe-pending-resource-timing-url) to null&#46;

5.  Set <var>childDocument</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;iframe&#45;load&#45;in&#45;progress"></a>[iframe load in progress](#iframe-load-in-progress) flag&#46;

6.  <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;event&#45;load"></a><code>[load](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-load)</code> at <var>element</var>&#46;

7.  Unset <var>childDocument</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;iframe&#45;load&#45;in&#45;progress&#45;2"></a>[iframe load in progress](#iframe-load-in-progress) flag&#46;

<strong>Warning&#58;</strong>

This&#44; in conjunction with scripting&#44; can be used to probe the URL space of the local network&#39;s HTTP servers&#46; User agents may implement <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;origin"></a>[cross&#45;origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-origin) access control policies that are stricter than those described above to mitigate this attack&#44; but unfortunately such policies are typically not compatible with existing web content&#46;

If an element type <a id="potentially&#45;delays&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event"></a><strong>potentially delays the load event</strong>&#44; then for each element <var>element</var> of that type&#44; the user agent must <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event"></a>[delay the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event) of <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;6"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) if <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;12"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) is non&#45;null and any of the following are true&#58;

- <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;13"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;nav&#45;document&#45;5"></a>[active document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nav-document) is not <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;ready&#45;for&#45;post&#45;load&#45;tasks"></a>[ready for post&#45;load tasks](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#ready-for-post-load-tasks)&#59;

- <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;14"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;delaying&#45;load&#45;events&#45;mode"></a>[is delaying <code>load</code> events](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#delaying-load-events-mode) is true&#59; or

- anything is <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;2"></a>[delaying the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event) of <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;15"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;nav&#45;document&#45;6"></a>[active document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nav-document)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

If&#44; during the handling of the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;event&#45;load&#45;2"></a><code>[load](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-load)</code> event&#44; <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;16"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) is again <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;navigate&#45;2"></a>[navigated](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigate)&#44; that will further <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;3"></a>[delay the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event)&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element has an associated <a id="current&#45;navigation&#45;was&#45;lazy&#45;loaded"></a><strong>current navigation was lazy loaded</strong> boolean&#44; initially false&#46; It is set and unset in the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;process&#45;the&#45;iframe&#45;attributes&#45;4"></a>[process the <code>iframe</code> attributes](#process-the-iframe-attributes) algorithm&#46;

An <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element whose <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;current&#45;navigation&#45;was&#45;lazy&#45;loaded&#45;5"></a>[current navigation was lazy loaded](#current-navigation-was-lazy-loaded) boolean is false <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;potentially&#45;delays&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event"></a>[potentially delays the load event](#potentially-delays-the-load-event)&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element has an associated null or <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;domhighrestimestamp"></a>[<code>DOMHighResTimeStamp</code>](https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dom-domhighrestimestamp) <a id="iframe&#45;pending&#45;resource&#45;timing&#45;start&#45;time"></a><strong>pending resource&#45;timing start time</strong>&#44; initially set to null&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element has an associated null or <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;url&#45;4"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) <a id="iframe&#45;pending&#45;resource&#45;timing&#45;url"></a><strong>pending resource&#45;timing URL</strong>&#44; initially set to null&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

If&#44; when the element is created&#44; the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;14"></a><code>[srcdoc](#attr-iframe-srcdoc)</code> attribute is not set&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;src&#45;6"></a><code>[src](#attr-iframe-src)</code> attribute is either also not set or set but its value cannot be <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;a&#45;url&#45;2"></a>[parsed](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#encoding-parsing-a-url)&#44; the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;17"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) will remain at the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;is&#45;initial&#45;about&#58;blank"></a>[initial <code>about&#58;blank</code>](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#is-initial-about:blank) <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;document&#45;8"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

If the user <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;navigate&#45;3"></a>[navigates](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigate) away from this page&#44; the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;18"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;nav&#45;wp"></a>[active <code>WindowProxy</code>](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nav-wp) object will proxy new <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;window"></a><code>[Window](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#window)</code> objects for new <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;document&#45;9"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> objects&#44; but the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;src&#45;7"></a><code>[src](#attr-iframe-src)</code> attribute will not change&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="attr&#45;iframe&#45;name"></a><strong><code>name</code></strong> attribute&#44; if present&#44; must be a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;navigable&#45;target&#45;name"></a>[valid navigable target name](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#valid-navigable-target-name)&#46; The given value is used to name the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;19"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) if present when that is <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;create&#45;a&#45;new&#45;child&#45;navigable&#45;2"></a>[created](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#create-a-new-child-navigable)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;iframe&#35;attr&#45;sandbox](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/iframe#attr-sandbox)

Support in all current engines&#46;
