The <a id="attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox"></a><strong><code>sandbox</code></strong> attribute&#44; when specified&#44; enables a set of extra restrictions on any content hosted by the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code>&#46; Its value must be an <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;unordered&#45;set&#45;of&#45;unique&#45;space&#45;separated&#45;tokens"></a>[unordered set of unique space&#45;separated tokens](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#unordered-set-of-unique-space-separated-tokens) that are <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive)&#46; The allowed values are&#58;

- <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;downloads"></a><code>[allow&#45;downloads](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-downloads)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;forms"></a><code>[allow&#45;forms](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-forms)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;modals"></a><code>[allow&#45;modals](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-modals)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;orientation&#45;lock"></a><code>[allow&#45;orientation&#45;lock](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-orientation-lock)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;pointer&#45;lock"></a><code>[allow&#45;pointer&#45;lock](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-pointer-lock)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;popups"></a><code>[allow&#45;popups](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-popups)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;popups&#45;to&#45;escape&#45;sandbox"></a><code>[allow&#45;popups&#45;to&#45;escape&#45;sandbox](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;presentation"></a><code>[allow&#45;presentation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-presentation)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;same&#45;origin"></a><code>[allow&#45;same&#45;origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-same-origin)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;scripts"></a><code>[allow&#45;scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-scripts)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;top&#45;navigation"></a><code>[allow&#45;top&#45;navigation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;top&#45;navigation&#45;by&#45;user&#45;activation"></a><code>[allow&#45;top&#45;navigation&#45;by&#45;user&#45;activation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation)</code>
- <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;top&#45;navigation&#45;to&#45;custom&#45;protocols"></a><code>[allow&#45;top&#45;navigation&#45;to&#45;custom&#45;protocols](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation-to-custom-protocols)</code>

When the attribute is set&#44; the content is treated as being from a unique <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;origin&#45;opaque"></a>[opaque origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-origin-opaque)&#44; forms&#44; scripts&#44; and various potentially annoying APIs are disabled&#44; and links are prevented from targeting other <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;navigable&#45;2"></a>[navigables](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigable)&#46; The <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;same&#45;origin&#45;2"></a><code>[allow&#45;same&#45;origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-same-origin)</code> keyword causes the content to be treated as being from its real origin instead of forcing it into an <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;origin&#45;opaque&#45;2"></a>[opaque origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-origin-opaque)&#59; the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;top&#45;navigation&#45;2"></a><code>[allow&#45;top&#45;navigation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation)</code> keyword allows the content to <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;navigate&#45;4"></a>[navigate](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigate) its <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;nav&#45;traversable"></a>[traversable navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nav-traversable)&#59; the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;top&#45;navigation&#45;by&#45;user&#45;activation&#45;2"></a><code>[allow&#45;top&#45;navigation&#45;by&#45;user&#45;activation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation)</code> keyword behaves similarly but allows such <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;navigate&#45;5"></a>[navigation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigate) only when the browsing context&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;nav&#45;window"></a>[active window](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nav-window) has <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;transient&#45;activation"></a>[transient activation](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#transient-activation)&#59; the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;top&#45;navigation&#45;to&#45;custom&#45;protocols&#45;2"></a><code>[allow&#45;top&#45;navigation&#45;to&#45;custom&#45;protocols](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation-to-custom-protocols)</code> reenables navigations toward non <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;fetch&#45;scheme"></a>[fetch scheme](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme) to be <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;hand&#45;off&#45;to&#45;external&#45;software"></a>[handed off to external software](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#hand-off-to-external-software)&#59; and the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;forms&#45;2"></a><code>[allow&#45;forms](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-forms)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;modals&#45;2"></a><code>[allow&#45;modals](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-modals)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;orientation&#45;lock&#45;2"></a><code>[allow&#45;orientation&#45;lock](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-orientation-lock)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;pointer&#45;lock&#45;2"></a><code>[allow&#45;pointer&#45;lock](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-pointer-lock)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;popups&#45;2"></a><code>[allow&#45;popups](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-popups)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;presentation&#45;2"></a><code>[allow&#45;presentation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-presentation)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;scripts&#45;2"></a><code>[allow&#45;scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-scripts)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;popups&#45;to&#45;escape&#45;sandbox&#45;2"></a><code>[allow&#45;popups&#45;to&#45;escape&#45;sandbox](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox)</code> keywords re&#45;enable forms&#44; modal dialogs&#44; screen orientation lock&#44; the pointer lock API&#44; popups&#44; the presentation API&#44; scripts&#44; and the creation of unsandboxed <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;auxiliary&#45;browsing&#45;context"></a>[auxiliary browsing contexts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#auxiliary-browsing-context) respectively&#46; The <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;downloads&#45;2"></a><code>[allow&#45;downloads](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-downloads)</code> keyword allows content to perform downloads&#46; [&#91;POINTERLOCK&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsPOINTERLOCK) [&#91;SCREENORIENTATION&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsSCREENORIENTATION) [&#91;PRESENTATION&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsPRESENTATION)

The <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;top&#45;navigation&#45;3"></a><code>[allow&#45;top&#45;navigation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation)</code> and <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;top&#45;navigation&#45;by&#45;user&#45;activation&#45;3"></a><code>[allow&#45;top&#45;navigation&#45;by&#45;user&#45;activation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation)</code> keywords must not both be specified&#44; as doing so is redundant&#59; only <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;top&#45;navigation&#45;4"></a><code>[allow&#45;top&#45;navigation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation)</code> will have an effect in such non&#45;conformant markup&#46;

Similarly&#44; the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;top&#45;navigation&#45;to&#45;custom&#45;protocols&#45;3"></a><code>[allow&#45;top&#45;navigation&#45;to&#45;custom&#45;protocols](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation-to-custom-protocols)</code> keyword must not be specified if either <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;top&#45;navigation&#45;5"></a><code>[allow&#45;top&#45;navigation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation)</code> or <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;popups&#45;3"></a><code>[allow&#45;popups](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-popups)</code> are specified&#44; as doing so is redundant&#46;

<strong>Warning&#58;</strong>

Setting both the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;scripts&#45;3"></a><code>[allow&#45;scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-scripts)</code> and <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;same&#45;origin&#45;3"></a><code>[allow&#45;same&#45;origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-same-origin)</code> keywords together when the embedded page has the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;same&#45;origin"></a>[same origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#same-origin) as the page containing the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> allows the embedded page to simply remove the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;5"></a><code>[sandbox](#attr-iframe-sandbox)</code> attribute and then reload itself&#44; effectively breaking out of the sandbox altogether&#46;

<strong>Warning&#58;</strong>

These flags only take effect when the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;20"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) of the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element is <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;navigate&#45;6"></a>[navigated](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigate)&#46; Removing them&#44; or removing the entire <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;6"></a><code>[sandbox](#attr-iframe-sandbox)</code> attribute&#44; has no effect on an already&#45;loaded page&#46;

<strong>Warning&#58;</strong>

Potentially hostile files should not be served from the same server as the file containing the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;22"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element&#46; Sandboxing hostile content is of minimal help if an attacker can convince the user to just visit the hostile content directly&#44; rather than in the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;23"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code>&#46; To limit the damage that can be caused by hostile HTML content&#44; it should be served from a separate dedicated domain&#46; Using a different domain ensures that scripts in the files are unable to attack the site&#44; even if the user is tricked into visiting those pages directly&#44; without the protection of the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;7"></a><code>[sandbox](#attr-iframe-sandbox)</code> attribute&#46;

When an <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;24"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;8"></a><code>[sandbox](#attr-iframe-sandbox)</code> attribute is set or changed while it has a non&#45;null <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;21"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable)&#44; the user agent must <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;sandboxing&#45;directive&#45;2"></a>[parse the sandboxing directive](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#parse-a-sandboxing-directive) given the attribute&#39;s value and the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;25"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;iframe&#45;sandboxing&#45;flag&#45;set&#45;2"></a>[<code>iframe</code> sandboxing flag set](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#iframe-sandboxing-flag-set)&#46;

When an <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;26"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;9"></a><code>[sandbox](#attr-iframe-sandbox)</code> attribute is removed while it has a non&#45;null <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;22"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable)&#44; the user agent must empty the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;27"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;iframe&#45;sandboxing&#45;flag&#45;set&#45;3"></a>[<code>iframe</code> sandboxing flag set](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#iframe-sandboxing-flag-set)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; some completely&#45;unknown&#44; potentially hostile&#44; user&#45;provided HTML content is embedded in a page&#46; Because it is served from a separate domain&#44; it is affected by all the normal cross&#45;site restrictions&#46; In addition&#44; the embedded page has scripting disabled&#44; plugins disabled&#44; forms disabled&#44; and it cannot navigate any frames or windows other than itself &#40;or any frames or windows it itself embeds&#41;&#46;

``` text
<p>We're not scared of you! Here is your content, unedited:</p>
<iframe sandbox src="https://usercontent.example.net/getusercontent.cgi?id=12193"></iframe>
```

<strong>Warning&#58;</strong>

It is important to use a separate domain so that if the attacker convinces the user to visit that page directly&#44; the page doesn&#39;t run in the context of the site&#39;s origin&#44; which would make the user vulnerable to any attack found in the page&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; a gadget from another site is embedded&#46; The gadget has scripting and forms enabled&#44; and the origin sandbox restrictions are lifted&#44; allowing the gadget to communicate with its originating server&#46; The sandbox is still useful&#44; however&#44; as it disables plugins and popups&#44; thus reducing the risk of the user being exposed to malware and other annoyances&#46;

``` text
<iframe sandbox="allow-same-origin allow-forms allow-scripts"
        src="https://maps.example.com/embedded.html"></iframe>
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Suppose a file A contained the following fragment&#58;

``` text
<iframe sandbox="allow-same-origin allow-forms" src=B></iframe>
```

Suppose that file B contained an iframe also&#58;

``` text
<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts" src=C></iframe>
```

Further&#44; suppose that file C contained a link&#58;

``` text
<a href=D>Link</a>
```

For this example&#44; suppose all the files were served as <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;text&#47;html"></a><code>[text&#47;html](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#text/html)</code>&#46;

Page C in this scenario has all the sandboxing flags set&#46; Scripts are disabled&#44; because the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;28"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> in A has scripts disabled&#44; and this overrides the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;scripts&#45;4"></a><code>[allow&#45;scripts](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-scripts)</code> keyword set on the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;29"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> in B&#46; Forms are also disabled&#44; because the inner <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;30"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> &#40;in B&#41; does not have the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;forms&#45;3"></a><code>[allow&#45;forms](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-forms)</code> keyword set&#46;

Suppose now that a script in A removes all the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;10"></a><code>[sandbox](#attr-iframe-sandbox)</code> attributes in A and B&#46; This would change nothing immediately&#46; If the user clicked the link in C&#44; loading page D into the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;31"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> in B&#44; page D would now act as if the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;32"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> in B had the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;same&#45;origin&#45;4"></a><code>[allow&#45;same&#45;origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-same-origin)</code> and <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;allow&#45;forms&#45;4"></a><code>[allow&#45;forms](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-forms)</code> keywords set&#44; because that was the state of the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;23"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) in the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;33"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> in A when page B was loaded&#46;

Generally speaking&#44; dynamically removing or changing the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;11"></a><code>[sandbox](#attr-iframe-sandbox)</code> attribute is ill&#45;advised&#44; because it can make it quite hard to reason about what will be allowed and what will not&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="attr&#45;iframe&#45;allow"></a><strong><code>allow</code></strong> attribute&#44; when specified&#44; determines the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;container&#45;policy"></a>[container policy](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-feature-policy/#container-policy) that will be used when the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;permissions&#45;policy"></a>[permissions policy](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-document-permissions-policy) for a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;document&#45;10"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> in the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;34"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;24"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) is initialized&#46; Its value must be a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;serialized&#45;permissions&#45;policy"></a>[serialized permissions policy](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-feature-policy/#serialized-permissions-policy)&#46; [&#91;PERMISSIONSPOLICY&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsPERMISSIONSPOLICY)

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; an <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;35"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> is used to embed a map from an online navigation service&#46; The <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;allow&#45;2"></a><code>[allow](#attr-iframe-allow)</code> attribute is used to enable the Geolocation API within the nested context&#46;

``` text
<iframe src="https://maps.example.com/" allow="geolocation"></iframe>
```

The <a id="attr&#45;iframe&#45;allowfullscreen"></a><strong><code>allowfullscreen</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46; When specified&#44; it indicates that <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;document&#45;11"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> objects in the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;36"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;25"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) will be initialized with a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;permissions&#45;policy&#45;2"></a>[permissions policy](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-document-permissions-policy) which allows the &#34;<code>fullscreen</code>&#34; feature to be used from any <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;origin&#45;2"></a>[origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-origin)&#46; This is enforced by the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;process&#45;permissions&#45;policy&#45;attributes"></a>[process permissions policy attributes](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-feature-policy/#process-policy-attributes) algorithm&#46; [&#91;PERMISSIONSPOLICY&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsPERMISSIONSPOLICY)

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Here&#44; an <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;37"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> is used to embed a player from a video site&#46; The <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;allowfullscreen&#45;2"></a><code>[allowfullscreen](#attr-iframe-allowfullscreen)</code> attribute is needed to enable the player to show its video fullscreen&#46;

``` text
<article>
 <header>
  <p><img src="/usericons/1627591962735"> <b>Fred Flintstone</b></p>
  <p><a href="/posts/3095182851" rel=bookmark>12:44</a> — <a href="#acl-3095182851">Private Post</a></p>
 </header>
 <p>Check out my new ride!</p>
 <iframe src="https://video.example.com/embed?id=92469812" allowfullscreen></iframe>
</article>
```

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Neither <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;allow&#45;3"></a><code>[allow](#attr-iframe-allow)</code> nor <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;allowfullscreen&#45;3"></a><code>[allowfullscreen](#attr-iframe-allowfullscreen)</code> can grant access to a feature in an <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;38"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;26"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) if the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;7"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is not already allowed to use that feature&#46;

<a id="fullscreen&#45;logic"></a>To determine whether a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;document&#45;12"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object <var>document</var> is <a id="allowed&#45;to&#45;use"></a><strong>allowed to use</strong> the policy&#45;controlled&#45;feature <var>feature</var>&#44; run these steps&#58;

1.  If <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;bc&#45;2"></a>[browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-bc) is null&#44; then return false&#46;

2.  If <var>document</var> is not <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;fully&#45;active"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active)&#44; then return false&#46;

3.  If the result of running <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;is&#45;feature&#45;enabled"></a>[is feature enabled in document for origin](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-feature-policy/#is-feature-enabled) on <var>feature</var>&#44; <var>document</var>&#44; and <var>document</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin"></a>[origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin) is &#34;<code>Enabled</code>&#34;&#44; then return true&#46;

4.  Return false&#46;

<strong>Warning&#58;</strong>

Because they only influence the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;permissions&#45;policy&#45;3"></a>[permissions policy](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-document-permissions-policy) of the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;27"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;nav&#45;document&#45;7"></a>[active document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nav-document)&#44; the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;allow&#45;4"></a><code>[allow](#attr-iframe-allow)</code> and <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;allowfullscreen&#45;4"></a><code>[allowfullscreen](#attr-iframe-allowfullscreen)</code> attributes only take effect when the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;28"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) of the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;39"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> is <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;navigate&#45;7"></a>[navigated](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigate)&#46; Adding or removing them has no effect on an already&#45;loaded document&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;40"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element supports <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;dimension&#45;attributes"></a>[dimension attributes](#dimension-attributes) for cases where the embedded content has specific dimensions &#40;e&#46;g&#46; ad units have well&#45;defined dimensions&#41;&#46;

An <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;41"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element never has <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;fallback&#45;content"></a>[fallback content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#fallback-content)&#44; as it will always <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;create&#45;a&#45;new&#45;child&#45;navigable&#45;3"></a>[create a new child navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#create-a-new-child-navigable)&#44; regardless of whether the specified initial contents are successfully used&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="attr&#45;iframe&#45;referrerpolicy"></a><strong><code>referrerpolicy</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;referrer&#45;policy&#45;attribute"></a>[referrer policy attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#referrer-policy-attribute)&#46; Its purpose is to set the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;referrer&#45;policy&#45;3"></a>[referrer policy](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy) used when <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;process&#45;the&#45;iframe&#45;attributes&#45;5"></a>[processing the <code>iframe</code> attributes](#process-the-iframe-attributes) as well as allowing masking of some <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;origin&#45;2"></a>[origins](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin) in the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;internal&#45;ancestor&#45;origin&#45;objects&#45;list&#45;creation&#45;steps"></a>[internal ancestor origin objects list creation steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#internal-ancestor-origin-objects-list-creation-steps)&#46; [&#91;REFERRERPOLICY&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsREFERRERPOLICY)

The <a id="attr&#45;iframe&#45;loading"></a><strong><code>loading</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;lazy&#45;loading&#45;attribute"></a>[lazy loading attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-loading-attribute)&#46; Its purpose is to indicate the policy for loading <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;42"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> elements that are outside the viewport&#46;

When the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;loading&#45;2"></a><code>[loading](#attr-iframe-loading)</code> attribute&#39;s state is changed to the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;loading&#45;eager&#45;state"></a>[Eager](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-loading-eager-state) state&#44; the user agent must run these steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>resumptionSteps</var> be the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;43"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps&#45;3"></a>[lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-load-resumption-steps)&#46;

2.  If <var>resumptionSteps</var> is null&#44; then return&#46;

3.  Set the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;44"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps&#45;4"></a>[lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-load-resumption-steps) to null&#46;

4.  Invoke <var>resumptionSteps</var>&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Descendants of <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;45"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> elements represent nothing&#46; &#40;In legacy user agents that do not support <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;46"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> elements&#44; the contents would be parsed as markup that could act as fallback content&#46;&#41;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;html&#45;parser"></a>[HTML parser](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#html-parser) treats markup inside <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;47"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code> elements as text&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc"></a><strong><code>srcdoc</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>attribute</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;get&#45;by&#45;namespace"></a>[getting an attribute by namespace and local name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-get-by-namespace) given null&#44; <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;15"></a><code>[srcdoc](#attr-iframe-srcdoc)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;attribute&#45;local&#45;name"></a>[local name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-attribute-local-name)&#44; and <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

2.  If <var>attribute</var> is null&#44; then return the empty string&#46;

3.  Return <var>attribute</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;attribute&#45;value"></a>[value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-attribute-value)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;2"></a><code>[srcdoc](#dom-iframe-srcdoc)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>compliantString</var> be the result of invoking the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;tt&#45;getcompliantstring"></a>[get trusted type compliant string](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#get-trusted-type-compliant-string) algorithm with <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;tt&#45;trustedhtml&#45;2"></a><code>[TrustedHTML](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#trustedhtml)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global&#45;3"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#44; the given value&#44; &#34;<code>HTMLIFrameElement srcdoc</code>&#34;&#44; and &#34;<code>script</code>&#34;&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;set&#45;value"></a>[Set an attribute value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-set-value) given <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;srcdoc&#45;16"></a><code>[srcdoc](#attr-iframe-srcdoc)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;attribute&#45;local&#45;name&#45;2"></a>[local name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-attribute-local-name)&#44; and <var>compliantString</var>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;supported&#45;tokens"></a>[supported tokens](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-supported-tokens) for <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox"></a><code>[sandbox](#dom-iframe-sandbox)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;domtokenlist&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMTokenList](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-domtokenlist)</code> are the allowed values defined in the <a id="the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;iframe&#45;sandbox&#45;12"></a><code>[sandbox](#attr-iframe-sandbox)</code> attribute and supported by the user agent&#46;

``` text
        width="468" height="60"></iframe>
```

No <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag"></a>[end tag](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-end-tag)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmlembedelement"></a><a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflecturl"></a><a id="dom&#45;embed&#45;src"></a><a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect"></a><a id="dom&#45;embed&#45;type"></a><a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;3"></a><a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;2"></a><a id="dom&#45;embed&#45;width"></a><a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;4"></a><a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;3"></a><a id="dom&#45;embed&#45;height"></a><a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;document"></a><a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;getsvgdocument"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLEmbedElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, ReflectURL] attribute USVString src;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString type;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString width;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString height;
  Document? getSVGDocument();

  // also has obsolete members
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element"></a><code>[embed](#the-embed-element)</code> element provides an integration point for an external application or interactive content&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;embed&#45;src"></a><strong><code>src</code></strong> attribute gives the <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) of the resource being embedded&#46; The attribute&#44; if present&#44; must contain a <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;empty&#45;url&#45;potentially&#45;surrounded&#45;by&#45;spaces"></a>[valid non&#45;empty URL potentially surrounded by spaces](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-empty-url-potentially-surrounded-by-spaces)&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;names&#58;&#45;the&#45;itemprop&#45;attribute"></a><code>[itemprop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#names:-the-itemprop-attribute)</code> attribute is specified on an <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[embed](#the-embed-element)</code> element&#44; then the <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;embed&#45;src&#45;2"></a><code>[src](#attr-embed-src)</code> attribute must also be specified&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;embed&#45;type"></a><strong><code>type</code></strong> attribute&#44; if present&#44; gives the <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;mime&#45;type"></a>[MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type) by which the plugin to instantiate is selected&#46; The value must be a <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;mime&#45;type&#45;string"></a>[valid MIME type string](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-mime-type)&#46; If both the <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;embed&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](#attr-embed-type)</code> attribute and the <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;embed&#45;src&#45;3"></a><code>[src](#attr-embed-src)</code> attribute are present&#44; then the <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;embed&#45;type&#45;3"></a><code>[type](#attr-embed-type)</code> attribute must specify the same type as the explicit <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;content&#45;type"></a>[Content&#45;Type metadata](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-type) of the resource given by the <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;embed&#45;src&#45;4"></a><code>[src](#attr-embed-src)</code> attribute&#46;

While any of the following conditions are occurring&#44; any <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;plugin"></a>[plugin](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#plugin) instantiated for the element must be removed&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[embed](#the-embed-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) nothing&#58;

- The element has neither a <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;embed&#45;src&#45;5"></a><code>[src](#attr-embed-src)</code> attribute nor a <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;embed&#45;type&#45;4"></a><code>[type](#attr-embed-type)</code> attribute&#46;

- The element has a <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[media element](#media-element) ancestor&#46;

- The element has an ancestor <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element that is <em>not</em> showing its <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;fallback&#45;content"></a>[fallback content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#fallback-content)&#46;

An <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[embed](#the-embed-element)</code> element is said to be <a id="concept&#45;embed&#45;active"></a><strong>potentially active</strong> when the following conditions are all met simultaneously&#58;

- The element is <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;in&#45;a&#45;document"></a>[in a document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#in-a-document) or was <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;in&#45;a&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[in a document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#in-a-document) the last time the <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;event&#45;loop"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) reached [step 1](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#step1)&#46;

- The element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;fully&#45;active"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active)&#46;

- The element has either a <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;embed&#45;src&#45;6"></a><code>[src](#attr-embed-src)</code> attribute set or a <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;embed&#45;type&#45;5"></a><code>[type](#attr-embed-type)</code> attribute set &#40;or both&#41;&#46;

- The element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;embed&#45;src&#45;7"></a><code>[src](#attr-embed-src)</code> attribute is either absent or its value is not the empty string&#46;

- The element is not a descendant of a <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

- The element is not a descendant of an <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element that is not showing its <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;fallback&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[fallback content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#fallback-content)&#46;

- The element is <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;being&#45;rendered"></a>[being rendered](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#being-rendered)&#44; or was <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;being&#45;rendered&#45;2"></a>[being rendered](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#being-rendered) the last time the <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;event&#45;loop&#45;2"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) reached [step 1](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#step1)&#46;

Whenever an <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[embed](#the-embed-element)</code> element that was not <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;embed&#45;active"></a>[potentially active](#concept-embed-active) becomes <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;embed&#45;active&#45;2"></a>[potentially active](#concept-embed-active)&#44; and whenever a <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;embed&#45;active&#45;3"></a>[potentially active](#concept-embed-active) <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[embed](#the-embed-element)</code> element that is remaining <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;embed&#45;active&#45;4"></a>[potentially active](#concept-embed-active) has its <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;embed&#45;type&#45;6"></a><code>[src](#attr-embed-type)</code> attribute set&#44; changed&#44; or removed or its <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;embed&#45;type&#45;7"></a><code>[type](#attr-embed-type)</code> attribute set&#44; changed&#44; or removed&#44; the user agent must <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="embed&#45;task&#45;source"></a><strong>embed task source</strong> given the element to run <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element&#45;setup&#45;steps"></a>[the <code>embed</code> element setup steps](#the-embed-element-setup-steps) for that element&#46;

<a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#45;setup&#45;steps"></a><strong>The <code>embed</code> element setup steps</strong> for a given <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[embed](#the-embed-element)</code> element <var>element</var> are as follows&#58;

1.  If another <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;task"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) has since been queued to run <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element&#45;setup&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[the <code>embed</code> element setup steps](#the-embed-element-setup-steps) for <var>element</var>&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If <var>element</var> has a <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;embed&#45;src&#45;8"></a><code>[src](#attr-embed-src)</code> attribute set&#58;

    1.  Let <var>url</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[encoding&#45;parsing a URL](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#encoding-parsing-a-url) given <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;embed&#45;src&#45;9"></a><code>[src](#attr-embed-src)</code> attribute&#39;s value&#44; relative to <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

    2.  If <var>url</var> is failure&#44; then return&#46;

    3.  Let <var>request</var> be a new <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request"></a>[request](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request) whose <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;url"></a>[URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-url) is <var>url</var>&#44; <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;client"></a>[client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-client) is <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;relevant&#45;settings&#45;object"></a>[relevant settings object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-settings-object)&#44; <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;destination"></a>[destination](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination) is &#34;<code>embed</code>&#34;&#44; <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;credentials&#45;mode"></a>[credentials mode](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-credentials-mode) is &#34;<code>include</code>&#34;&#44; <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;mode"></a>[mode](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-mode) is &#34;<code>navigate</code>&#34;&#44; <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;initiator&#45;type"></a>[initiator type](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-initiator-type) is &#34;<code>embed</code>&#34;&#44; and whose <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;use&#45;url&#45;credentials&#45;flag"></a>[use&#45;URL&#45;credentials flag](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-use-url-credentials-flag) is set&#46;

    4.  <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fetch"></a>[Fetch](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch) <var>request</var>&#44; with <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;processresponse"></a><em>[processResponse](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#process-response)</em> set to the following steps given <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;response"></a>[response](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response) <var>response</var>&#58;

        1.  If another <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) has since been queued to run <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element&#45;setup&#45;steps&#45;3"></a>[the <code>embed</code> element setup steps](#the-embed-element-setup-steps) for <var>element</var>&#44; then return&#46;

        2.  If <var>response</var> is a <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;network&#45;error"></a>[network error](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error)&#44; then <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;event&#45;load"></a><code>[load](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-load)</code> at <var>element</var>&#44; and return&#46;

        3.  Let <var>type</var> be the result of determining the <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;embed&#45;type"></a>[type of content](#concept-embed-type) given <var>element</var> and <var>response</var>&#46;

        4.  Switch on <var>type</var>&#58;

            <strong>null</strong>

            1.  <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;display&#45;no&#45;plugin"></a>[Display no plugin](#display-no-plugin) for <var>element</var>&#46;

            <strong>Otherwise</strong>

            1.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) is null&#44; then <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;create&#45;a&#45;new&#45;child&#45;navigable"></a>[create a new child navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#create-a-new-child-navigable) for <var>element</var>&#46;

            2.  <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;navigate"></a>[Navigate](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigate) <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;2"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) to <var>response</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;response&#45;url"></a>[URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url) using <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;4"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#44; with <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;navigation&#45;response"></a><em>[response](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigation-response)</em> set to <var>response</var>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;navigation&#45;hh"></a><em>[historyHandling](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigation-hh)</em> set to &#34;<a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;navigationhistorybehavior&#45;replace"></a><code>[replace](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)</code>&#34;&#46;

                <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

                <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;embed&#45;src&#45;10"></a><code>[src](#attr-embed-src)</code> attribute does not get updated if the <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;3"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) gets further navigated to other locations&#46;

            3.  <var>element</var> now <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;2"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) its <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;4"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable)&#46;

        Fetching the resource must <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event"></a>[delay the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event) of <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;5"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

3.  Otherwise&#44; <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;display&#45;no&#45;plugin&#45;2"></a>[display no plugin](#display-no-plugin) for <var>element</var>&#46;

To determine the <a id="concept&#45;embed&#45;type"></a><strong>type of the content</strong> given an <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[embed](#the-embed-element)</code> element <var>element</var> and a <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;response&#45;2"></a>[response](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response) <var>response</var>&#44; run the following steps&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var> has a <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;embed&#45;type&#45;8"></a><code>[type](#attr-embed-type)</code> attribute&#44; and that attribute&#39;s value is a type that a <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;plugin&#45;2"></a>[plugin](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#plugin) supports&#44; then return the value of the <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;embed&#45;type&#45;9"></a><code>[type](#attr-embed-type)</code> attribute&#46;

2.  If the <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;path"></a>[path](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-path) component of <var>response</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;response&#45;url&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url) matches a pattern that a <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;plugin&#45;3"></a>[plugin](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#plugin) supports&#44; then return the type that that plugin can handle&#46;

    <strong>Example&#58;</strong>

    For example&#44; a plugin might say that it can handle URLs with <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;path&#45;2"></a>[path](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-path) components that end with the four character string &#34;<code>&#46;swf</code>&#34;&#46;

3.  If <var>response</var> has explicit <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;content&#45;type&#45;2"></a>[Content&#45;Type metadata](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-type)&#44; and that value is a type that a <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;plugin&#45;4"></a>[plugin](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#plugin) supports&#44; then return that value&#46;

4.  Return null&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

It is intentional that the above algorithm allows <var>response</var> to have a non&#45;<a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;ok&#45;status"></a>[ok status](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#ok-status)&#46; This allows servers to return data for plugins even with error responses &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; HTTP 500 Internal Server Error codes can still contain plugin data&#41;&#46;

To <a id="display&#45;no&#45;plugin"></a><strong>display no plugin</strong> for an <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[embed](#the-embed-element)</code> element <var>element</var>&#58;

1.  <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;destroy&#45;a&#45;child&#45;navigable"></a>[Destroy a child navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#destroy-a-child-navigable) given <var>element</var>&#46;

2.  Display an indication that no <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;plugin&#45;5"></a>[plugin](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#plugin) could be found for <var>element</var>&#44; as the contents of <var>element</var>&#46;

3.  <var>element</var> now <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;3"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) nothing&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[embed](#the-embed-element)</code> element has no <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;fallback&#45;content&#45;3"></a>[fallback content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#fallback-content)&#59; its descendants are ignored&#46;

Whenever an <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[embed](#the-embed-element)</code> element that was <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;embed&#45;active&#45;5"></a>[potentially active](#concept-embed-active) stops being <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;embed&#45;active&#45;6"></a>[potentially active](#concept-embed-active)&#44; any <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;plugin&#45;6"></a>[plugin](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#plugin) that had been instantiated for that element must be unloaded&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[embed](#the-embed-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;potentially&#45;delays&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event"></a>[potentially delays the load event](#potentially-delays-the-load-event)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[embed](#the-embed-element)</code> element supports <a id="the&#45;embed&#45;element&#58;dimension&#45;attributes"></a>[dimension attributes](#dimension-attributes)&#46;

#### <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element"></a>4&#46;8&#46;7 The <strong><code>object</code></strong> element[](#the-object-element)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;object](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/object)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari3&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------
