<strong><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmlobjectelement"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflecturl"></a><a id="dom&#45;object&#45;data"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect"></a><a id="dom&#45;object&#45;type"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;3"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;2"></a><a id="dom&#45;object&#45;name"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;htmlformelement"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;fae&#45;form"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;4"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;3"></a><a id="dom&#45;object&#45;width"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;5"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;4"></a><a id="dom&#45;object&#45;height"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;document"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;object&#45;contentdocument"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;windowproxy"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;object&#45;contentwindow"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;document&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;getsvgdocument"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;willvalidate"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;validitystate"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;validity"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;validationmessage"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;checkvalidity"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;reportvalidity"></a><a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;setcustomvalidity"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLObjectElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, ReflectURL] attribute USVString data;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString type;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString name;
  readonly attribute HTMLFormElement? form;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString width;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString height;
  readonly attribute Document? contentDocument;
  readonly attribute WindowProxy? contentWindow;
  Document? getSVGDocument();

  readonly attribute boolean willValidate;
  readonly attribute ValidityState validity;
  readonly attribute DOMString validationMessage;
  boolean checkValidity();
  boolean reportValidity();
  undefined setCustomValidity(DOMString error);

  // also has obsolete members
};
```

Depending on the type of content instantiated by the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element&#44; the node also supports other interfaces&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element can represent an external resource&#44; which&#44; depending on the type of the resource&#44; will either be treated as an image or as a <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;child&#45;navigable"></a>[child navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#child-navigable)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;object&#45;data"></a><strong><code>data</code></strong> attribute specifies the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) of the resource&#46; It must be present&#44; and must contain a <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;empty&#45;url&#45;potentially&#45;surrounded&#45;by&#45;spaces"></a>[valid non&#45;empty URL potentially surrounded by spaces](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-empty-url-potentially-surrounded-by-spaces)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;object&#45;type"></a><strong><code>type</code></strong> attribute&#44; if present&#44; specifies the type of the resource&#46; If present&#44; the attribute must be a <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;mime&#45;type&#45;string"></a>[valid MIME type string](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-mime-type)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;object&#45;name"></a><strong><code>name</code></strong> attribute&#44; if present&#44; must be a <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;navigable&#45;target&#45;name"></a>[valid navigable target name](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#valid-navigable-target-name)&#46; The given value is used to name the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;2"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable)&#44; if applicable&#44; and if present when the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;3"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) is <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;create&#45;a&#45;new&#45;child&#45;navigable"></a>[created](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#create-a-new-child-navigable)&#46;

Whenever one of the following conditions occur&#58;

- the element is created&#44;
- the element is popped off the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#stack-of-open-elements) of an <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;html&#45;parser"></a>[HTML parser](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#html-parser) or <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;xml&#45;parser"></a>[XML parser](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#xml-parser)&#44;
- the element is not on the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[stack of open elements](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#stack-of-open-elements) of an <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[HTML parser](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#html-parser) or <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;xml&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[XML parser](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#xml-parser)&#44; and it is either <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;insert&#45;an&#45;element&#45;into&#45;a&#45;document"></a>[inserted into a document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#insert-an-element-into-a-document) or <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;remove&#45;an&#45;element&#45;from&#45;a&#45;document"></a>[removed from a document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#remove-an-element-from-a-document)&#44;
- the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) changes whether it is <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;fully&#45;active"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active)&#44;
- one of the element&#39;s ancestor <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> elements changes to or from showing its <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;fallback&#45;content"></a>[fallback content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#fallback-content)&#44;
- the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;object&#45;classid"></a><code>[classid](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-object-classid)</code> attribute is set&#44; changed&#44; or removed&#44;
- the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;object&#45;classid&#45;2"></a><code>[classid](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-object-classid)</code> attribute is not present&#44; and its <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;object&#45;data&#45;2"></a><code>[data](#attr-object-data)</code> attribute is set&#44; changed&#44; or removed&#44;
- neither the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;object&#45;classid&#45;3"></a><code>[classid](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-object-classid)</code> attribute nor its <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;object&#45;data&#45;3"></a><code>[data](#attr-object-data)</code> attribute are present&#44; and its <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;object&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](#attr-object-type)</code> attribute is set&#44; changed&#44; or removed&#44;
- the element changes from <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;being&#45;rendered"></a>[being rendered](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#being-rendered) to not being rendered&#44; or vice versa&#44;

&#46;&#46;&#46;the user agent must <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) given the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element to run the following steps to &#40;re&#41;determine what the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element represents&#46; This <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;task"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) being <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;task"></a>[queued](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-task) or actively running must <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event"></a>[delay the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event) of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

1.  If the user has indicated a preference that this <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;fallback&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[fallback content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#fallback-content) be shown instead of the element&#39;s usual behavior&#44; then jump to the step below labeled <em>fallback</em>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    For example&#44; a user could ask for the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;fallback&#45;content&#45;3"></a>[fallback content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#fallback-content) to be shown because that content uses a format that the user finds more accessible&#46;

2.  If the element has an ancestor <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; or has an ancestor <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element that is <em>not</em> showing its <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;fallback&#45;content&#45;4"></a>[fallback content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#fallback-content)&#44; or if the element is not <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;in&#45;a&#45;document"></a>[in a document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#in-a-document) whose <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;bc"></a>[browsing context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-bc) is non&#45;null&#44; or if the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is not <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;fully&#45;active&#45;2"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active)&#44; or if the element is still in the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[stack of open elements](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#stack-of-open-elements) of an <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;3"></a>[HTML parser](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#html-parser) or <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;xml&#45;parser&#45;3"></a>[XML parser](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#xml-parser)&#44; or if the element is not <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;being&#45;rendered&#45;2"></a>[being rendered](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#being-rendered)&#44; then jump to the step below labeled <em>fallback</em>&#46;

3.  If the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;object&#45;data&#45;4"></a><code>[data](#attr-object-data)</code> attribute is present and its value is not the empty string&#58;

    1.  If the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;object&#45;type&#45;3"></a><code>[type](#attr-object-type)</code> attribute is present and its value is not a type that the user agent supports&#44; then the user agent may jump to the step below labeled <em>fallback</em> without fetching the content to examine its real type&#46;

    2.  Let <var>url</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[encoding&#45;parsing a URL](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#encoding-parsing-a-url) given the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;object&#45;data&#45;5"></a><code>[data](#attr-object-data)</code> attribute&#39;s value&#44; relative to the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;4"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

    3.  If <var>url</var> is failure&#44; then <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;event&#45;error"></a><code>[error](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-error)</code> at the element and jump to the step below labeled <em>fallback</em>&#46;

    4.  Let <var>request</var> be a new <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request"></a>[request](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request) whose <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;url"></a>[URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-url) is <var>url</var>&#44; <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;client"></a>[client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-client) is the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;5"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;relevant&#45;settings&#45;object"></a>[relevant settings object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-settings-object)&#44; <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;destination"></a>[destination](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination) is &#34;<code>object</code>&#34;&#44; <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;credentials&#45;mode"></a>[credentials mode](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-credentials-mode) is &#34;<code>include</code>&#34;&#44; <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;mode"></a>[mode](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-mode) is &#34;<code>navigate</code>&#34;&#44; <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;initiator&#45;type"></a>[initiator type](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-initiator-type) is &#34;<code>object</code>&#34;&#44; and whose <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;use&#45;url&#45;credentials&#45;flag"></a>[use&#45;URL&#45;credentials flag](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-use-url-credentials-flag) is set&#46;

    5.  <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fetch"></a>[Fetch](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch) <var>request</var>&#46;

        Fetching the resource must <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;2"></a>[delay the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event) of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;6"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) until the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that is <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[queued](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-task) by the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;networking&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[networking task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#networking-task-source) once the resource has been fetched &#40;defined next&#41; has been run&#46;

    6.  If the resource is not yet available &#40;e&#46;g&#46; because the resource was not available in the cache&#44; so that loading the resource required making a request over the network&#41;&#44; then jump to the step below labeled <em>fallback</em>&#46; The <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that is <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[queued](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-task) by the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;networking&#45;task&#45;source&#45;2"></a>[networking task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#networking-task-source) once the resource is available must restart this algorithm from this step&#46; Resources can load incrementally&#59; user agents may opt to consider a resource &#34;available&#34; whenever enough data has been obtained to begin processing the resource&#46;

    7.  If the load failed &#40;e&#46;g&#46; there was an HTTP 404 error&#44; there was a DNS error&#41;&#44; <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;event&#45;error&#45;2"></a><code>[error](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-error)</code> at the element&#44; then jump to the step below labeled <em>fallback</em>&#46;

    8.  <a id="object&#45;type&#45;detection"></a>

        Determine the <var>resource type</var>&#44; as follows&#58;

        1.  Let the <var>resource type</var> be unknown&#46;

        2.  If the user agent is configured to strictly obey Content&#45;Type headers for this resource&#44; and the resource has associated <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;content&#45;type"></a>[Content&#45;Type metadata](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-type)&#44; then let the <var>resource type</var> be the type specified in the resource&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;content&#45;type&#45;2"></a>[Content&#45;Type metadata](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-type)&#44; and jump to the step below labeled <em>handler</em>&#46;

            <strong>Warning&#58;</strong>

            This can introduce a vulnerability&#44; wherein a site is trying to embed a resource that uses a particular type&#44; but the remote site overrides that and instead furnishes the user agent with a resource that triggers a different type of content with different security characteristics&#46;

        3.  Run the appropriate set of steps from the following list&#58;

            <strong>If the resource has associated <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;content&#45;type&#45;3"></a>[Content&#45;Type metadata](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-type)</strong>

            1.  Let <var>binary</var> be false&#46;

            2.  If the type specified in the resource&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;content&#45;type&#45;4"></a>[Content&#45;Type metadata](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-type) is &#34;<a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;text&#47;plain"></a><code>[text&#47;plain](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.1.3)</code>&#34;&#44; and the result of applying the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;content&#45;type&#45;sniffing&#58;&#45;text&#45;or&#45;binary"></a>[rules for distinguishing if a resource is text or binary](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#rules-for-text-or-binary) to the resource is that the resource is not <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;text&#47;plain&#45;2"></a><code>[text&#47;plain](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.1.3)</code>&#44; then set <var>binary</var> to true&#46;

            3.  If the type specified in the resource&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;content&#45;type&#45;5"></a>[Content&#45;Type metadata](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-type) is &#34;<a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;application&#47;octet&#45;stream"></a><code>[application&#47;octet&#45;stream](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.5.1)</code>&#34;&#44; then set <var>binary</var> to true&#46;

            4.  If <var>binary</var> is false&#44; then let the <var>resource type</var> be the type specified in the resource&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;content&#45;type&#45;6"></a>[Content&#45;Type metadata](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-type)&#44; and jump to the step below labeled <em>handler</em>&#46;

            5.  If there is a <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;object&#45;type&#45;4"></a><code>[type](#attr-object-type)</code> attribute present on the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element&#44; and its value is not <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;application&#47;octet&#45;stream&#45;2"></a><code>[application&#47;octet&#45;stream](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.5.1)</code>&#44; then run the following steps&#58;

                1.  If the attribute&#39;s value is a type that starts with &#34;<code>image&#47;</code>&#34; that is not also an <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;xml&#45;mime&#45;type"></a>[XML MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-mime-type)&#44; then let the <var>resource type</var> be the type specified in that <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;object&#45;type&#45;5"></a><code>[type](#attr-object-type)</code> attribute&#46;

                2.  Jump to the step below labeled <em>handler</em>&#46;

            <strong>Otherwise&#44; if the resource does not have associated <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;content&#45;type&#45;7"></a>[Content&#45;Type metadata](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-type)</strong>

            1.  If there is a <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;object&#45;type&#45;6"></a><code>[type](#attr-object-type)</code> attribute present on the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element&#44; then let the <var>tentative type</var> be the type specified in that <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;object&#45;type&#45;7"></a><code>[type](#attr-object-type)</code> attribute&#46;

                Otherwise&#44; let <var>tentative type</var> be the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;content&#45;type&#45;sniffing&#45;2"></a>[computed type of the resource](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#computed-mime-type)&#46;

            2.  If <var>tentative type</var> is <em>not</em> <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;application&#47;octet&#45;stream&#45;3"></a><code>[application&#47;octet&#45;stream](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.5.1)</code>&#44; then let <var>resource type</var> be <var>tentative type</var> and jump to the step below labeled <em>handler</em>&#46;

        4.  If applying the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;url&#45;parser"></a>[URL parser](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-parser) algorithm to the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;url&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) of the specified resource &#40;after any redirects&#41; results in a <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;url&#45;record"></a>[URL record](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) whose <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;path"></a>[path](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-path) component matches a pattern that a <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;plugin"></a>[plugin](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#plugin) supports&#44; then let <var>resource type</var> be the type that that plugin can handle&#46;

            <strong>Example&#58;</strong>

            For example&#44; a plugin might say that it can handle resources with <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;path&#45;2"></a>[path](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-path) components that end with the four character string &#34;<code>&#46;swf</code>&#34;&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        It is possible for this step to finish&#44; or for one of the substeps above to jump straight to the next step&#44; with <var>resource type</var> still being unknown&#46; In both cases&#44; the next step will trigger fallback&#46;

    9.  <em>Handler</em>&#58; Handle the content as given by the first of the following cases that matches&#58;

        <strong>If the <var>resource type</var> is an <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;xml&#45;mime&#45;type&#45;2"></a>[XML MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-mime-type)&#44; or if the <var>resource type</var> does not start with &#34;<code>image&#47;</code>&#34;</strong>

        If the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;4"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) is null&#44; then <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;create&#45;a&#45;new&#45;child&#45;navigable&#45;2"></a>[create a new child navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#create-a-new-child-navigable) for the element&#46;

        Let <var>response</var> be the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;response"></a>[response](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response) from <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fetch&#45;2"></a>[fetch](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch)&#46;

        If <var>response</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;response&#45;url"></a>[URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url) does not <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;matches&#45;about&#58;blank"></a>[match <code>about&#58;blank</code>](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#matches-about:blank)&#44; then <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;navigate"></a>[navigate](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigate) the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;5"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) to <var>response</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;response&#45;url&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url) using the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;7"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#44; with <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;navigation&#45;hh"></a><em>[historyHandling](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigation-hh)</em> set to &#34;<a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;navigationhistorybehavior&#45;replace"></a><code>[replace](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)</code>&#34;&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        The <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;object&#45;data&#45;6"></a><code>[data](#attr-object-data)</code> attribute of the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element doesn&#39;t get updated if the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;6"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable) gets further <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;navigate&#45;2"></a>[navigated](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigate) to other locations&#46;
        The <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) its <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;7"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable)&#46;

        <strong>If the <var>resource type</var> starts with &#34;<code>image&#47;</code>&#34;&#44; and support for images has not been disabled</strong>

        <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;destroy&#45;a&#45;child&#45;navigable"></a>[Destroy a child navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#destroy-a-child-navigable) given the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element&#46;

        Apply the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;content&#45;type&#45;sniffing&#58;&#45;image"></a>[image sniffing](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#rules-for-sniffing-images-specifically) rules to determine the type of the image&#46;

        The <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;2"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) the specified image&#46;

        If the image cannot be rendered&#44; e&#46;g&#46; because it is malformed or in an unsupported format&#44; jump to the step below labeled <em>fallback</em>&#46;

        <strong>Otherwise</strong>

        The given <var>resource type</var> is not supported&#46; Jump to the step below labeled <em>fallback</em>&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        If the previous step ended with the <var>resource type</var> being unknown&#44; this is the case that is triggered&#46;

    10. The element&#39;s contents are not part of what the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element represents&#46;

    11. If the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element does not represent its <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;8"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable)&#44; then once the resource is completely loaded&#44; <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source&#45;2"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) given the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element to <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;3"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;event&#45;load"></a><code>[load](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-load)</code> at the element&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        If the element <em>does</em> represent its <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;content&#45;navigable&#45;9"></a>[content navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-navigable)&#44; then an analogous task will be queued when the created <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> is <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;completely&#45;finish&#45;loading"></a>[completely finished loading](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#completely-finish-loading)&#46;

    12. Return&#46;

4.  <em>Fallback</em>&#58; The <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;3"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) the element&#39;s children&#46; This is the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;fallback&#45;content&#45;5"></a>[fallback content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#fallback-content)&#46; <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;destroy&#45;a&#45;child&#45;navigable&#45;2"></a>[Destroy a child navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#destroy-a-child-navigable) given the element&#46;

Due to the algorithm above&#44; the contents of <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> elements act as <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;fallback&#45;content&#45;6"></a>[fallback content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#fallback-content)&#44; used only when referenced resources can&#39;t be shown &#40;e&#46;g&#46; because it returned a 404 error&#41;&#46; This allows multiple <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> elements to be nested inside each other&#44; targeting multiple user agents with different capabilities&#44; with the user agent picking the first one it supports&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;potentially&#45;delays&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event"></a>[potentially delays the load event](#potentially-delays-the-load-event)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fae&#45;form&#45;2"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-fae-form)</code> attribute is used to explicitly associate the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;22"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element with its <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#form-owner)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;23"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element supports <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dimension&#45;attributes"></a>[dimension attributes](#dimension-attributes)&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

The <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;willvalidate&#45;2"></a><code>[willValidate](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#dom-cva-willvalidate)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;validity&#45;2"></a><code>[validity](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#dom-cva-validity)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;validationmessage&#45;2"></a><code>[validationMessage](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#dom-cva-validationmessage)</code> attributes&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;checkvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[checkValidity&#40;&#41;](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#dom-cva-checkvalidity)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;reportvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[reportValidity&#40;&#41;](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#dom-cva-reportvalidity)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;setcustomvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[setCustomValidity&#40;&#41;](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#dom-cva-setcustomvalidity)</code> methods&#44; are part of the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api"></a>[constraint validation API](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-constraint-validation-api)&#46; The <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;fae&#45;form&#45;2"></a><code>[form](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#dom-fae-form)</code> IDL attribute is part of the element&#39;s forms API&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; an HTML page is embedded in another using the <a id="the&#45;object&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;24"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> element&#46;

``` text
<figure>
 <object data="clock.html"></object>
 <figcaption>My HTML Clock</figcaption>
</figure>
```

<a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;global&#45;attributes"></a>[Global attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#global-attributes)

<a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src&#45;3"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> — Address of the resource

<a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;crossorigin"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-media-crossorigin)</code> — How the element handles crossorigin requests

<a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;video&#45;poster"></a><code>[poster](#attr-video-poster)</code> — Poster frame to show prior to video playback

<a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload"></a><code>[preload](#attr-media-preload)</code> — Hints how much buffering the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) will likely need

<a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;autoplay"></a><code>[autoplay](#attr-media-autoplay)</code> — Hint that the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) can be started automatically when the page is loaded

<a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;video&#45;playsinline"></a><code>[playsinline](#attr-video-playsinline)</code> — Encourage the user agent to display video content within the element&#39;s playback area

<a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;loop"></a><code>[loop](#attr-media-loop)</code> — Whether to loop the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;3"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)

<a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;muted"></a><code>[muted](#attr-media-muted)</code> — Whether to mute the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;4"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) by default

<a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;controls&#45;2"></a><code>[controls](#attr-media-controls)</code> — Show user agent controls

<a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;loading"></a><code>[loading](#attr-media-loading)</code> — Used when determining loading deferral

<a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;width"></a><code>[width](#attr-dim-width)</code> — Horizontal dimension

<a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;height"></a><code>[height](#attr-dim-height)</code> — Vertical dimension

<strong><a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;accessibility&#45;considerations"></a>[Accessibility considerations](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-accessibility-considerations)&#58;</strong>

[For authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-video)&#46;

[For implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-video)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;sanitization"></a>[Sanitization](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-sanitization)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;sanitizer&#45;uncategorized"></a>[Uncategorized](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sanitizer-uncategorized)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmlvideoelement"></a><a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;htmlmediaelement"></a><a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect"></a><a id="dom&#45;video&#45;width"></a><a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;2"></a><a id="dom&#45;video&#45;height"></a><a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;video&#45;videowidth"></a><a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;video&#45;videoheight"></a><a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;3"></a><a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflecturl"></a><a id="dom&#45;video&#45;poster"></a><a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;4"></a><a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;3"></a><a id="dom&#45;video&#45;playsinline"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLVideoElement : HTMLMediaElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute unsigned long width;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute unsigned long height;
  readonly attribute unsigned long videoWidth;
  readonly attribute unsigned long videoHeight;
  [CEReactions, ReflectURL] attribute USVString poster;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean playsInline;

};
```

A <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element is used for playing videos or movies&#44; and audio files with captions&#46;

Content may be provided inside the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element&#46; User agents should not show this content to the user&#59; it is intended for older web browsers which do not support <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code>&#44; so that text can be shown to the users of these older browsers informing them of how to access the video contents&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In particular&#44; this content is not intended to address accessibility concerns&#46; To make video content accessible to the partially sighted&#44; the blind&#44; the hard&#45;of&#45;hearing&#44; the deaf&#44; and those with other physical or cognitive disabilities&#44; a variety of features are available&#46; Captions can be provided&#44; either embedded in the video stream or as external files using the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#46; Sign&#45;language tracks can be embedded in the video stream&#46; Audio descriptions can be embedded in the video stream or in text form using a <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;webvtt&#45;file"></a>[WebVTT file](https://w3c.github.io/webvtt/#webvtt-file) referenced using the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element and synthesized into speech by the user agent&#46; WebVTT can also be used to provide chapter titles&#46; For users who would rather not use a media element at all&#44; transcripts or other textual alternatives can be provided by simply linking to them in the prose near the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element&#46; [&#91;WEBVTT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBVTT)

The <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element is a <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[media element](#media-element) whose <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;media&#45;data"></a>[media data](#media-data) is ostensibly video data&#44; possibly with associated audio data&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element has an internal <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;shadow&#45;tree"></a>[shadow tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-tree) with no <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;slot&#45;element"></a><code>[slot](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-slot-element)</code> elements&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src&#45;4"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;crossorigin&#45;2"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-media-crossorigin)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload&#45;2"></a><code>[preload](#attr-media-preload)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;autoplay&#45;2"></a><code>[autoplay](#attr-media-autoplay)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;loop&#45;2"></a><code>[loop](#attr-media-loop)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;muted&#45;2"></a><code>[muted](#attr-media-muted)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;controls&#45;3"></a><code>[controls](#attr-media-controls)</code> attributes are <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;attributes"></a>[the attributes common to all media elements](#media-element-attributes)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;video&#45;poster"></a><strong><code>poster</code></strong> attribute gives the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) of an image file that the user agent can show while no video data is available&#46; The attribute&#44; if present&#44; must contain a <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;empty&#45;url&#45;potentially&#45;surrounded&#45;by&#45;spaces"></a>[valid non&#45;empty URL potentially surrounded by spaces](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-empty-url-potentially-surrounded-by-spaces)&#46;

If the specified resource is to be used&#44; then&#44; when the element is created or when the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;video&#45;poster&#45;2"></a><code>[poster](#attr-video-poster)</code> attribute is set&#44; changed&#44; or removed&#44; the user agent must run the following steps to determine the element&#39;s <a id="poster&#45;frame"></a><strong>poster frame</strong> &#40;regardless of the value of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;show&#45;poster&#45;flag"></a>[show poster flag](#show-poster-flag)&#41;&#58;

1.  If there is an existing instance of this algorithm running for this <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element&#44; abort that instance of this algorithm without changing the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;poster&#45;frame"></a>[poster frame](#poster-frame)&#46;

2.  If the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;video&#45;poster&#45;3"></a><code>[poster](#attr-video-poster)</code> attribute&#39;s value is the empty string or if the attribute is absent&#58;

    1.  Set the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;poster&#45;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps"></a>[poster lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#poster-lazy-load-resumption-steps) to null&#46;

    2.  There is no <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;poster&#45;frame&#45;2"></a>[poster frame](#poster-frame)&#59; return&#46;

3.  Let <var>url</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[encoding&#45;parsing a URL](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#encoding-parsing-a-url) given the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;video&#45;poster&#45;4"></a><code>[poster](#attr-video-poster)</code> attribute&#39;s value&#44; relative to the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

4.  If <var>url</var> is failure&#44; then return&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    There is no <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;poster&#45;frame&#45;3"></a>[poster frame](#poster-frame)&#46;

5.  Let <var>request</var> be a new <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request"></a>[request](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request) whose <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;url"></a>[URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-url) is <var>url</var>&#44; <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;client"></a>[client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-client) is the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;relevant&#45;settings&#45;object"></a>[relevant settings object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-settings-object)&#44; <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;destination"></a>[destination](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination) is &#34;<code>image</code>&#34;&#44; <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;initiator&#45;type"></a>[initiator type](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-initiator-type) is &#34;<code>video</code>&#34;&#44; <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;credentials&#45;mode"></a>[credentials mode](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-credentials-mode) is &#34;<code>include</code>&#34;&#44; and whose <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;use&#45;url&#45;credentials&#45;flag"></a>[use&#45;URL&#45;credentials flag](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-use-url-credentials-flag) is set&#46;

6.  If the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;will&#45;lazy&#45;load&#45;element&#45;steps"></a>[will lazy load element steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#will-lazy-load-element-steps) given the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> return true&#58;

    1.  Let <var>posterResumptionSteps</var> be the rest of this algorithm starting with the step labeled <em>Fetch</em>&#46;

    2.  Set the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;poster&#45;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[poster lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#poster-lazy-load-resumption-steps) to <var>posterResumptionSteps</var>&#46;

    3.  Return&#46;

7.  <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fetch"></a>[Fetch](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch) <var>request</var>&#46; This must <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event"></a>[delay the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event) of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

8.  If an image is thus obtained&#44; the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;poster&#45;frame&#45;4"></a>[poster frame](#poster-frame) is that image&#46; Otherwise&#44; there is no <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;poster&#45;frame&#45;5"></a>[poster frame](#poster-frame)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The image given by the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;video&#45;poster&#45;5"></a><code>[poster](#attr-video-poster)</code> attribute&#44; the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;poster&#45;frame&#45;6"></a><em>[poster frame](#poster-frame)</em>&#44; is intended to be a representative frame of the video &#40;typically one of the first non&#45;blank frames&#41; that gives the user an idea of what the video is like&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;video&#45;playsinline"></a><strong><code>playsinline</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46; If present&#44; it serves as a hint to the user agent that the video ought to be displayed &#34;inline&#34; in the document by default&#44; constrained to the element&#39;s playback area&#44; instead of being displayed fullscreen or in an independent resizable window&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The absence of the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;video&#45;playsinline&#45;2"></a><code>[playsinline](#attr-video-playsinline)</code> attribute does not imply that the video will display fullscreen by default&#46; Indeed&#44; most user agents have chosen to play all videos inline by default&#44; and in such user agents the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;video&#45;playsinline&#45;3"></a><code>[playsinline](#attr-video-playsinline)</code> attribute has no effect&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;video&#45;poster&#45;6"></a><code>[poster](#attr-video-poster)</code> attribute is present and the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;loading&#45;2"></a><code>[loading](#attr-media-loading)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;loading&#45;lazy&#45;state"></a>[Lazy](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-loading-lazy-state) state&#44; the user agent must defer loading the poster image source data until the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps"></a>[lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-load-resumption-steps) are invoked&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

``` text
<video src="1.mp4" poster="1.jpg" type="video/mp4">
<video src="2.mp4" type="video/mp4" loading="eager">
<video src="3.mp4" type="video/mp4" loading="lazy">
<video src="4.mp4" type="video/mp4" loading="lazy" autoplay>
<div id="very-large"></div> <!-- Everything after this div is below the viewport -->
<video src="5.mp4" type="video/mp4">
<video src="6.mp4" type="video/mp4" loading="lazy">
<video src="7.mp4" type="video/mp4" autoplay loading="lazy">
<video src="8.mp4" type="video/mp4" poster="8.jpg" loading="lazy">
<video src="9.mp4" type="video/mp4" preload="none" poster="9.jpg" loading="lazy">
<video src="10.mp4" type="video/mp4" preload="metadata" loading="lazy">
<video src="11.mp4" type="video/mp4" poster="11.jpg" preload="none" loading="eager">
```

In the example above&#44; the videos load as follows&#58;

<strong><code>1&#46;mp4</code></strong>

The video and poster image load eagerly and delay the window&#39;s load event&#46;

<strong><code>2&#46;mp4</code>&#44; <code>5&#46;mp4</code></strong>

The videos load eagerly and delay the window&#39;s load event&#46;

<strong><code>3&#46;mp4</code></strong>

The video loads when layout is known&#44; due to being in the viewport&#44; however it does not delay the window&#39;s load event&#46;

<strong><code>4&#46;mp4</code></strong>

The video loads and autoplay playback begins when layout is known&#44; due to being in the viewport&#44; however it does not delay the window&#39;s load event&#46;

<strong><code>6&#46;mp4</code></strong>

The video loads only once scrolled into the viewport&#44; and does not delay the window&#39;s load event&#46;

<strong><code>7&#46;mp4</code></strong>

The video loads and autoplay playback begins only once scrolled into the viewport&#44; and does not delay the window&#39;s load event&#46;

<strong><code>8&#46;mp4</code></strong>

The video and poster image load only once scrolled into the viewport&#44; and does not delay the window&#39;s load event&#46;

<strong><code>9&#46;mp4</code></strong>

The video does not load until played&#46; The poster image loads only once scrolled into the viewport&#44; and does not delay the window&#39;s load event&#46;

<strong><code>10&#46;mp4</code></strong>

The video&#39;s metadata loads only once scrolled into the viewport&#44; and does not delay the window&#39;s load event&#46;

<strong><code>11&#46;mp4</code></strong>

The video does not load until played&#46; The poster image loads eagerly and delays the window&#39;s load event&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

A <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element represents what is given for the first matching condition in the list below&#58;

<strong>When no video data is available &#40;the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute is either <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;nothing"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;NOTHING](#dom-media-have_nothing)</code>&#44; or <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;metadata"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;METADATA](#dom-media-have_metadata)</code> but no video data has yet been obtained at all&#44; or the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;2"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute is any subsequent value but the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;5"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) does not have a video channel&#41;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) its <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;poster&#45;frame&#45;7"></a>[poster frame](#poster-frame)&#44; if any&#44; or else <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;transparent&#45;black"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black) with no <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;natural&#45;dimensions"></a>[natural dimensions](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-dimensions)&#46;

<strong>When the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element is <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused"></a>[paused](#dom-media-paused)&#44; the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) is the first frame of video&#44; and the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;show&#45;poster&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[show poster flag](#show-poster-flag) is set</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;2"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) its <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;poster&#45;frame&#45;8"></a>[poster frame](#poster-frame)&#44; if any&#44; or else the first frame of the video&#46;

<strong>When the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element is <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused&#45;2"></a>[paused](#dom-media-paused)&#44; and the frame of video corresponding to the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;2"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) is not available &#40;e&#46;g&#46; because the video is seeking or buffering&#41;</strong>

<strong>When the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element is neither <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;potentially&#45;playing"></a>[potentially playing](#potentially-playing) nor <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused&#45;3"></a>[paused](#dom-media-paused) &#40;e&#46;g&#46; when seeking or stalled&#41;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;3"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) the last frame of the video to have been rendered&#46;

<strong>When the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element is <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused&#45;4"></a>[paused](#dom-media-paused)</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;4"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) the frame of video corresponding to the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;3"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#46;

<strong>Otherwise &#40;the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element has a video channel and is <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;potentially&#45;playing&#45;2"></a>[potentially playing](#potentially-playing)&#41;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;5"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) the frame of video at the continuously increasing <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;4"></a>[&#34;current&#34; position](#current-playback-position)&#46; When the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;5"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) changes such that the last frame rendered is no longer the frame corresponding to the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;6"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) in the video&#44; the new frame must be rendered&#46;

Frames of video must be obtained from the video track that was <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;videotrack&#45;selected"></a>[selected](#dom-videotrack-selected) when the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;event&#45;loop"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) last reached [step 1](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#step1)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Which frame in a video stream corresponds to a particular playback position is defined by the video stream&#39;s format&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;22"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element also <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;6"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) any <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue"></a>[text track cues](#text-track-cue) whose <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;active&#45;flag"></a>[text track cue active flag](#text-track-cue-active-flag) is set and whose <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;text&#45;track"></a>[text track](#text-track) is in the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;text&#45;track&#45;showing"></a>[showing](#text-track-showing) mode&#44; and any audio from the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;6"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; at the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;7"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#46;

Any audio associated with the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;7"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) must&#44; if played&#44; be played synchronized with the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;8"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#44; at the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;effective&#45;media&#45;volume"></a>[effective media volume](#effective-media-volume)&#46; The user agent must play the audio from audio tracks that were <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;audiotrack&#45;enabled"></a>[enabled](#dom-audiotrack-enabled) when the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;event&#45;loop&#45;2"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) last reached step 1&#46;

In addition to the above&#44; the user agent may provide messages to the user &#40;such as &#34;buffering&#34;&#44; &#34;no video loaded&#34;&#44; &#34;error&#34;&#44; or more detailed information&#41; by overlaying text or icons on the video or other areas of the element&#39;s playback area&#44; or in another appropriate manner&#46;

User agents that cannot render the video may instead make the element <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;7"></a>[represent](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a link to an external video playback utility or to the video data itself&#46;

When a <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;23"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;8"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) has a video channel&#44; the element provides a <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;paint&#45;source"></a>[paint source](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images-4/#paint-source) whose width is the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;9"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;video&#45;intrinsic&#45;width"></a>[natural width](#concept-video-intrinsic-width)&#44; whose height is the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;10"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;video&#45;intrinsic&#45;height"></a>[natural height](#concept-video-intrinsic-height)&#44; and whose appearance is the frame of video corresponding to the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;9"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#44; if that is available&#44; or else &#40;e&#46;g&#46; when the video is seeking or buffering&#41; its previous appearance&#44; if any&#44; or else &#40;e&#46;g&#46; because the video is still loading the first frame&#41; blackness&#46;

<strong><code><var>video</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;video&#45;videowidth&#45;dev"></a>[videoWidth](#dom-video-videowidth)</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLVideoElement&#47;videoWidth](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLVideoElement/videoWidth)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox3&#46;5&#43;Safari3&#46;1&#43;Chrome3&#43;
