<strong><code><var>video</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;video&#45;videoheight&#45;dev"></a>[videoHeight](#dom-video-videoheight)</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLVideoElement&#47;videoHeight](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLVideoElement/videoHeight)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox3&#46;5&#43;Safari3&#46;1&#43;Chrome3&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera10&#46;5&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS3&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android11&#43;

These attributes return the natural dimensions of the video&#44; or 0 if the dimensions are not known&#46;

The <a id="concept&#45;video&#45;intrinsic&#45;width"></a><strong>natural width</strong> and <a id="concept&#45;video&#45;intrinsic&#45;height"></a><strong>natural height</strong> of the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;11"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) are the dimensions of the resource in <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;&#39;px&#39;"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px) after taking into account the resource&#39;s dimensions&#44; aspect ratio&#44; clean aperture&#44; resolution&#44; and so forth&#44; as defined for the format used by the resource&#46; If an anamorphic format does not define how to apply the aspect ratio to the video data&#39;s dimensions to obtain the &#34;correct&#34; dimensions&#44; then the user agent must apply the ratio by increasing one dimension and leaving the other unchanged&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;video&#45;videowidth"></a><strong><code>videoWidth</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  If <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;3"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute is <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;nothing&#45;2"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;NOTHING](#dom-media-have_nothing)</code>&#44; then return 0&#46;

2.  Return the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;video&#45;intrinsic&#45;width&#45;2"></a>[natural width](#concept-video-intrinsic-width) of the video in <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;2"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;video&#45;videoheight"></a><strong><code>videoHeight</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  If <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;4"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute is <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;nothing&#45;3"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;NOTHING](#dom-media-have_nothing)</code>&#44; then return 0&#46;

2.  Return the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;video&#45;intrinsic&#45;height&#45;2"></a>[natural height](#concept-video-intrinsic-height) of the video in <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;3"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46;

<a id="dimUpdate"></a>Whenever the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;video&#45;intrinsic&#45;width&#45;3"></a>[natural width](#concept-video-intrinsic-width) or <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;video&#45;intrinsic&#45;height&#45;3"></a>[natural height](#concept-video-intrinsic-height) of the video changes &#40;including&#44; for example&#44; because the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;videotrack&#45;selected&#45;2"></a>[selected video track](#dom-videotrack-selected) was changed&#41;&#44; if the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;5"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute is not <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;nothing&#45;4"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;NOTHING](#dom-media-have_nothing)</code>&#44; the user agent must <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;event&#45;media&#45;resize"></a><code>[resize](#event-media-resize)</code> at the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;24"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element supports <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;dimension&#45;attributes"></a>[dimension attributes](#dimension-attributes)&#46;

In the absence of style rules to the contrary&#44; video content should be rendered inside the element&#39;s playback area such that the video content is shown centered in the playback area at the largest possible size that fits completely within it&#44; with the video content&#39;s aspect ratio being preserved&#46; Thus&#44; if the aspect ratio of the playback area does not match the aspect ratio of the video&#44; the video will be shown letterboxed or pillarboxed&#46; Areas of the element&#39;s playback area that do not contain the video represent nothing&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In user agents that implement CSS&#44; the above requirement can be implemented by using the [style rule suggested in the Rendering section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#video-object-fit)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;natural&#45;width"></a>[natural width](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-width) of a <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;25"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element&#39;s playback area is the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;natural&#45;width&#45;2"></a>[natural width](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-width) of the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;poster&#45;frame&#45;9"></a>[poster frame](#poster-frame)&#44; if that is available and the element currently <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;8"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) its poster frame&#59; otherwise&#44; it is the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;video&#45;intrinsic&#45;width&#45;4"></a>[natural width](#concept-video-intrinsic-width) of the video resource&#44; if that is available&#59; otherwise the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;natural&#45;width&#45;3"></a>[natural width](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-width) is missing&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;natural&#45;height"></a>[natural height](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-height) of a <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;26"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element&#39;s playback area is the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;natural&#45;height&#45;2"></a>[natural height](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-height) of the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;poster&#45;frame&#45;10"></a>[poster frame](#poster-frame)&#44; if that is available and the element currently <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;9"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) its poster frame&#59; otherwise it is the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;video&#45;intrinsic&#45;height&#45;4"></a>[natural height](#concept-video-intrinsic-height) of the video resource&#44; if that is available&#59; otherwise the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;natural&#45;height&#45;3"></a>[natural height](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-height) is missing&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;default&#45;object&#45;size"></a>[default object size](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#default-object-size) is a width of 300 <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;4"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px) and a height of 150 <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;5"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46; [&#91;CSSIMAGES&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSSIMAGES)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

User agents should provide controls to enable or disable the display of closed captions&#44; audio description tracks&#44; and other additional data associated with the video stream&#44; though such features should&#44; again&#44; not interfere with the page&#39;s normal rendering&#46;

User agents may allow users to view the video content in manners more suitable to the user&#44; such as fullscreen or in an independent resizable window&#46; User agents may even trigger such a viewing mode by default upon playing a video&#44; although they should not do so when the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;video&#45;playsinline&#45;4"></a><code>[playsinline](#attr-video-playsinline)</code> attribute is specified&#46; As with the other user interface features&#44; controls to enable this should not interfere with the page&#39;s normal rendering unless the user agent is <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;expose&#45;a&#45;user&#45;interface&#45;to&#45;the&#45;user"></a>[exposing a user interface](#expose-a-user-interface-to-the-user)&#46; In such an independent viewing mode&#44; however&#44; user agents may make full user interfaces visible&#44; even if the <a id="the&#45;video&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;controls&#45;4"></a><code>[controls](#attr-media-controls)</code> attribute is absent&#46;

User agents may allow video playback to affect system features that could interfere with the user&#39;s experience&#59; for example&#44; user agents could disable screensavers while video playback is in progress&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

This example shows how to detect when a video has failed to play correctly&#58;

``` text
<script>
 function failed(e) {
   // video playback failed - show a message saying why
   switch (e.target.error.code) {
     case e.target.error.MEDIA_ERR_ABORTED:
       alert('You aborted the video playback.');
       break;
     case e.target.error.MEDIA_ERR_NETWORK:
       alert('A network error caused the video download to fail part-way.');
       break;
     case e.target.error.MEDIA_ERR_DECODE:
       alert('The video playback was aborted due to a corruption problem or because the video used features your browser did not support.');
       break;
     case e.target.error.MEDIA_ERR_SRC_NOT_SUPPORTED:
       alert('The video could not be loaded, either because the server or network failed or because the format is not supported.');
       break;
     default:
       alert('An unknown error occurred.');
       break;
   }
 }
</script>
<p><video src="tgif.vid" autoplay controls onerror="failed(event)"></video></p>
<p><a href="tgif.vid">Download the video file</a>.</p>
```

Neither tag is omissible&#46;

<a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;global&#45;attributes"></a>[Global attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#global-attributes)

<a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src&#45;3"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> — Address of the resource

<a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;crossorigin"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-media-crossorigin)</code> — How the element handles crossorigin requests

<a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload"></a><code>[preload](#attr-media-preload)</code> — Hints how much buffering the <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) will likely need

<a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;autoplay"></a><code>[autoplay](#attr-media-autoplay)</code> — Hint that the <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) can be started automatically when the page is loaded

<a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;loop"></a><code>[loop](#attr-media-loop)</code> — Whether to loop the <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;3"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)

<a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;muted"></a><code>[muted](#attr-media-muted)</code> — Whether to mute the <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;4"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) by default

<a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;controls&#45;3"></a><code>[controls](#attr-media-controls)</code> — Show user agent controls

<a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;loading"></a><code>[loading](#attr-media-loading)</code> — Used when determining loading deferral

<strong><a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;accessibility&#45;considerations"></a>[Accessibility considerations](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-accessibility-considerations)&#58;</strong>

[For authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-audio)&#46;

[For implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-audio)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;sanitization"></a>[Sanitization](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-sanitization)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;sanitizer&#45;uncategorized"></a>[Uncategorized](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sanitizer-uncategorized)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;legacyfactoryfunction"></a><a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;audio"></a><a id="htmlaudioelement"></a><a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;htmlmediaelement"></a><a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window,
 LegacyFactoryFunction=Audio(optional DOMString src)]
interface HTMLAudioElement : HTMLMediaElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();
};
```

An <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a sound or audio stream&#46;

Content may be provided inside the <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> element&#46; User agents should not show this content to the user&#59; it is intended for older web browsers which do not support <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code>&#44; so that text can be shown to the users of these older browsers informing them of how to access the audio contents&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In particular&#44; this content is not intended to address accessibility concerns&#46; To make audio content accessible to the deaf or to those with other physical or cognitive disabilities&#44; a variety of features are available&#46; If captions or a sign language video are available&#44; the <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element can be used instead of the <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> element to play the audio&#44; allowing users to enable the visual alternatives&#46; Chapter titles can be provided to aid navigation&#44; using the <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element and a <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;webvtt&#45;file"></a>[WebVTT file](https://w3c.github.io/webvtt/#webvtt-file)&#46; And&#44; naturally&#44; transcripts or other textual alternatives can be provided by simply linking to them in the prose near the <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> element&#46; [&#91;WEBVTT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBVTT)

The <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> element is a <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[media element](#media-element) whose <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;media&#45;data"></a>[media data](#media-data) is ostensibly audio data&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> element has an internal <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;shadow&#45;tree"></a>[shadow tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-tree) with no <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;the&#45;slot&#45;element"></a><code>[slot](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-slot-element)</code> elements&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src&#45;4"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;crossorigin&#45;2"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-media-crossorigin)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload&#45;2"></a><code>[preload](#attr-media-preload)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;autoplay&#45;2"></a><code>[autoplay](#attr-media-autoplay)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;loop&#45;2"></a><code>[loop](#attr-media-loop)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;muted&#45;2"></a><code>[muted](#attr-media-muted)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;controls&#45;4"></a><code>[controls](#attr-media-controls)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;loading&#45;2"></a><code>[loading](#attr-media-loading)</code> attributes are <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;attributes"></a>[the attributes common to all media elements](#media-element-attributes)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> elements without a <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;controls&#45;5"></a><code>[controls](#attr-media-controls)</code> attribute will not be displayed by the user agent&#44; preventing them from lazy loading&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

``` text
<audio src="1.mp3" type="audio/mpeg" controls>
<audio src="2.mp3" type="audio/mpeg" controls loading="eager">
<audio src="3.mp3" type="audio/mpeg" controls loading="lazy">
<audio src="4.mp3" type="audio/mpeg" controls loading="lazy" autoplay>
<div id="very-large"></div> <!-- Everything after this div is below the viewport -->
<audio src="5.mp3" type="audio/mpeg" controls>
<audio src="6.mp3" type="audio/mpeg" controls loading="lazy">
<audio src="7.mp3" type="audio/mpeg" controls autoplay loading="lazy">
<audio src="8.mp3" type="audio/mpeg" controls preload="metadata" loading="lazy">
```

In the example above&#44; the audio files load as follows&#58;

<strong><code>1&#46;mp3</code>&#44; <code>2&#46;mp3</code>&#44; <code>5&#46;mp3</code></strong>

The audio file loads eagerly and delays the window&#39;s load event&#46;

<strong><code>3&#46;mp3</code></strong>

The audio loads when layout is known&#44; due to being in the viewport&#44; however it does not delay the window&#39;s load event&#46;

<strong><code>4&#46;mp3</code></strong>

The audio loads and autoplay playback begins when layout is known&#44; due to being in the viewport&#44; however it does not delay the window&#39;s load event&#46;

<strong><code>6&#46;mp3</code></strong>

The audio loads only once scrolled into the viewport&#44; and does not delay the window&#39;s load event&#46;

<strong><code>7&#46;mp3</code></strong>

The audio loads and autoplay playback begins only once scrolled into the viewport&#44; and does not delay the window&#39;s load event&#46;

<strong><code>8&#46;mp3</code></strong>

The audio&#39;s metadata loads only once scrolled into the viewport&#44; and does not delay the window&#39;s load event&#46;

<strong><code><var>audio</var> &#61; new <a id="dom&#45;audio&#45;dev"></a>[Audio](#dom-audio)&#40;&#91; <var>url</var> &#93;&#41;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLAudioElement&#47;Audio](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLAudioElement/Audio)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox3&#46;5&#43;Safari3&#46;1&#43;Chrome4&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS3&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns a new <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> element&#44; with the <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src&#45;5"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> attribute set to the value passed in the argument&#44; if applicable&#46;

A legacy factory function is provided for creating <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;htmlaudioelement"></a><code>[HTMLAudioElement](#htmlaudioelement)</code> objects &#40;in addition to the factory methods from DOM such as <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;createelement"></a><code>[createElement&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-document-createelement)</code>&#41;&#58; <a id="dom&#45;audio"></a><strong><code>Audio&#40;<var>src</var>&#41;</code></strong>&#46; When invoked&#44; the legacy factory function must perform the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>document</var> be the <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;current&#45;global&#45;object"></a>[current global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#current-global-object)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;window"></a>[associated <code>Document</code>](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-window)&#46;

2.  Let <var>audio</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;create&#45;an&#45;element"></a>[creating an element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-create-element) given <var>document</var>&#44; &#34;<code>audio</code>&#34;&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;set&#45;value"></a>[Set an attribute value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-set-value) for <var>audio</var> using &#34;<a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload&#45;3"></a><code>[preload](#attr-media-preload)</code>&#34; and &#34;<a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload&#45;auto"></a><code>[auto](#attr-media-preload-auto)</code>&#34;&#46;

4.  If <var>src</var> is given&#44; then <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;set&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[set an attribute value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-set-value) for <var>audio</var> using &#34;<a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src&#45;6"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code>&#34; and <var>src</var>&#46; &#40;This will [cause the user agent to invoke](#concept-media-load-algorithm-at-creation) the object&#39;s <a id="the&#45;audio&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm) before returning&#46;&#41;

5.  Return <var>audio</var>&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmltrackelement"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;track&#45;kind"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflecturl"></a><a id="dom&#45;track&#45;src"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;3"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect"></a><a id="dom&#45;track&#45;srclang"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;4"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;2"></a><a id="dom&#45;track&#45;label"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;5"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;3"></a><a id="dom&#45;track&#45;default"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;track&#45;none"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;track&#45;loading"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;track&#45;loaded"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;track&#45;error"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;track&#45;readystate"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;texttrack"></a><a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;track&#45;track"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLTrackElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString kind;
  [CEReactions, ReflectURL] attribute USVString src;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString srclang;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString label;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean default;

  const unsigned short NONE = 0;
  const unsigned short LOADING = 1;
  const unsigned short LOADED = 2;
  const unsigned short ERROR = 3;
  readonly attribute unsigned short readyState;

  readonly attribute TextTrack track;
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element allows authors to specify explicit external timed <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;text&#45;track&#45;2"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) for <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[media elements](#media-element)&#46; It does not <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represent](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) anything on its own&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;track&#45;kind"></a><strong><code>kind</code></strong> attribute is an <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;enumerated&#45;attribute"></a>[enumerated attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#enumerated-attribute) with the following keywords and states&#58;

<table><thead><tr><th>Keyword      </th><th>State      </th><th>Brief description    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="track/kind" id="attr-track-kind-keyword-subtitles" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>subtitles</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-track-kind-subtitles">Subtitles</dfn>      </td><td>       Transcription or translation of the dialogue&#44; suitable for when the sound is available but not understood &#40;e&#46;g&#46; because the user does not understand the language of the <a href="#media-resource" id="the-track-element:media-resource">media resource</a>&#39;s audio track&#41;&#46;       Overlaid on the video&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="track/kind" id="attr-track-kind-keyword-captions" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>captions</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-track-kind-captions">Captions</dfn>      </td><td>       Transcription or translation of the dialogue&#44; sound effects&#44; relevant musical cues&#44; and other relevant audio information&#44; suitable for when sound is unavailable or not clearly audible &#40;e&#46;g&#46; because it is muted&#44; drowned&#45;out by ambient noise&#44; or because the user is deaf&#41;&#46;       Overlaid on the video&#59; labeled as appropriate for the hard&#45;of&#45;hearing&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="track/kind" id="attr-track-kind-keyword-descriptions" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>descriptions</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-track-kind-descriptions">Descriptions</dfn>      </td><td>       Textual descriptions of the video component of the <a href="#media-resource" id="the-track-element:media-resource-2">media resource</a>&#44; intended for audio synthesis when the visual component is obscured&#44; unavailable&#44; or not usable &#40;e&#46;g&#46; because the user is interacting with the application without a screen while driving&#44; or because the user is blind&#41;&#46;       Synthesized as audio&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="track/kind" id="attr-track-kind-keyword-chapters" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>chapters</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-track-kind-chapters">Chapters metadata</dfn>      </td><td rowspan="2">       Tracks intended for use from script&#46;       Not displayed by the user agent&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="track/kind" id="attr-track-kind-keyword-metadata" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>metadata</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-track-kind-metadata">Metadata</dfn>   </td></tr></tbody></table>

The attribute&#39;s <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;missing&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[missing value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#missing-value-default)</em> is the <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;subtitles"></a>[subtitles](#attr-track-kind-subtitles) state&#44; and its <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;invalid&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[invalid value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#invalid-value-default)</em> is the <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;metadata"></a>[metadata](#attr-track-kind-metadata) state&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;track&#45;src"></a><strong><code>src</code></strong> attribute gives the <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) of the text track data&#46; The value must be a <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;empty&#45;url&#45;potentially&#45;surrounded&#45;by&#45;spaces"></a>[valid non&#45;empty URL potentially surrounded by spaces](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-empty-url-potentially-surrounded-by-spaces)&#46; This attribute must be present&#46;

The element has an associated <a id="track&#45;url"></a><strong>track URL</strong> &#40;a string&#41;&#44; initially the empty string&#46;

When the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;src&#45;2"></a><code>[src](#attr-track-src)</code> attribute is set&#44; run these steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>trackURL</var> be failure&#46;

2.  Let <var>value</var> be the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;src&#45;3"></a><code>[src](#attr-track-src)</code> attribute value&#46;

3.  If <var>value</var> is not the empty string&#44; then set <var>trackURL</var> to the result of <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;and&#45;serializing&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[encoding&#45;parsing&#45;and&#45;serializing a URL](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#encoding-parsing-and-serializing-a-url) given <var>value</var>&#44; relative to the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

4.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;track&#45;url"></a>[track URL](#track-url) to <var>trackURL</var> if it is not failure&#59; otherwise to the empty string&#46;

If the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;track&#45;url&#45;2"></a>[track URL](#track-url) identifies a WebVTT resource&#44; and the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;2"></a><code>[kind](#attr-track-kind)</code> attribute is not in the <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;chapters"></a>[chapters metadata](#attr-track-kind-chapters) or <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;metadata&#45;2"></a>[metadata](#attr-track-kind-metadata) state&#44; then the WebVTT file must be a <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;webvtt&#45;file&#45;using&#45;caption&#45;or&#45;subtitle&#45;cue&#45;text"></a>[WebVTT file using caption or subtitle cue text](https://w3c.github.io/webvtt/#webvtt-file-using-caption-or-subtitle-cue-text)&#46; [&#91;WEBVTT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBVTT)

The <a id="attr&#45;track&#45;srclang"></a><strong><code>srclang</code></strong> attribute gives the language of the text track data&#46; The value must be a valid BCP 47 language tag&#46; This attribute must be present if the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;3"></a><code>[kind](#attr-track-kind)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;subtitles&#45;2"></a>[subtitles](#attr-track-kind-subtitles) state&#46; [&#91;BCP47&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsBCP47)

If the element has a <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;srclang&#45;2"></a><code>[srclang](#attr-track-srclang)</code> attribute whose value is not the empty string&#44; then the element&#39;s <a id="track&#45;language"></a><strong>track language</strong> is the value of the attribute&#46; Otherwise&#44; the element has no <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;track&#45;language"></a>[track language](#track-language)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;track&#45;label"></a><strong><code>label</code></strong> attribute gives a user&#45;readable title for the track&#46; This title is used by user agents when listing <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;subtitles&#45;3"></a>[subtitle](#attr-track-kind-subtitles)&#44; <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;captions"></a>[caption](#attr-track-kind-captions)&#44; and <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;descriptions"></a>[audio description](#attr-track-kind-descriptions) tracks in their user interface&#46;

The value of the <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;label&#45;2"></a><code>[label](#attr-track-label)</code> attribute&#44; if the attribute is present&#44; must not be the empty string&#46; Furthermore&#44; there must not be two <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element children of the same <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[media element](#media-element) whose <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;4"></a><code>[kind](#attr-track-kind)</code> attributes are in the same state&#44; whose <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;srclang&#45;3"></a><code>[srclang](#attr-track-srclang)</code> attributes are both missing or have values that represent the same language&#44; and whose <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;label&#45;3"></a><code>[label](#attr-track-label)</code> attributes are again both missing or both have the same value&#46;

If the element has a <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;label&#45;4"></a><code>[label](#attr-track-label)</code> attribute whose value is not the empty string&#44; then the element&#39;s <a id="track&#45;label"></a><strong>track label</strong> is the value of the attribute&#46; Otherwise&#44; the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;track&#45;label"></a>[track label](#track-label) is an empty string&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;track&#45;default"></a><strong><code>default</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#44; which&#44; if specified&#44; indicates that the track is to be enabled if the user&#39;s preferences do not indicate that another track would be more appropriate&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[media element](#media-element) must have no more than one <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element child whose <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;5"></a><code>[kind](#attr-track-kind)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;subtitles&#45;4"></a>[subtitles](#attr-track-kind-subtitles) or <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;captions&#45;2"></a>[captions](#attr-track-kind-captions) state and whose <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;default&#45;2"></a><code>[default](#attr-track-default)</code> attribute is specified&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[media element](#media-element) must have no more than one <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element child whose <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;6"></a><code>[kind](#attr-track-kind)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;descriptions&#45;2"></a>[description](#attr-track-kind-descriptions) state and whose <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;default&#45;3"></a><code>[default](#attr-track-default)</code> attribute is specified&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;media&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[media element](#media-element) must have no more than one <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element child whose <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;7"></a><code>[kind](#attr-track-kind)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;chapters&#45;2"></a>[chapters metadata](#attr-track-kind-chapters) state and whose <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;default&#45;4"></a><code>[default](#attr-track-default)</code> attribute is specified&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

There is no limit on the number of <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> elements whose <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;8"></a><code>[kind](#attr-track-kind)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;metadata&#45;3"></a>[metadata](#attr-track-kind-metadata) state and whose <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;default&#45;5"></a><code>[default](#attr-track-default)</code> attribute is specified&#46;

<strong><code><var>track</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;track&#45;readystate&#45;dev"></a>[readyState](#dom-track-readystate)</code></strong>

Returns the <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;text&#45;track&#45;readiness&#45;state"></a>[text track readiness state](#text-track-readiness-state)&#44; represented by a number from the following list&#58;

<strong><code><var>track</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;track&#45;none&#45;dev"></a>[NONE](#dom-track-none) &#40;0&#41;</code></strong>

The <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;text&#45;track&#45;not&#45;loaded"></a>[text track not loaded](#text-track-not-loaded) state&#46;

<strong><code><var>track</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;track&#45;loading&#45;dev"></a>[LOADING](#dom-track-loading) &#40;1&#41;</code></strong>

The <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;text&#45;track&#45;loading"></a>[text track loading](#text-track-loading) state&#46;

<strong><code><var>track</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;track&#45;loaded&#45;dev"></a>[LOADED](#dom-track-loaded) &#40;2&#41;</code></strong>

The <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;text&#45;track&#45;loaded"></a>[text track loaded](#text-track-loaded) state&#46;

<strong><code><var>track</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;track&#45;error&#45;dev"></a>[ERROR](#dom-track-error) &#40;3&#41;</code></strong>

The <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;text&#45;track&#45;failed&#45;to&#45;load"></a>[text track failed to load](#text-track-failed-to-load) state&#46;

<strong><code><var>track</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;track&#45;track&#45;dev"></a>[track](#dom-track-track)</code></strong>

Returns the <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;text&#45;track&#45;3"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;track&#45;readystate"></a><strong><code>readyState</code></strong> attribute must return the numeric value corresponding to the <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;text&#45;track&#45;readiness&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[text track readiness state](#text-track-readiness-state) of the <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;text&#45;track&#45;4"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#44; as defined by the following list&#58;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;track&#45;none"></a><strong><code>NONE</code></strong> &#40;numeric value 0&#41;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;text&#45;track&#45;not&#45;loaded&#45;2"></a>[text track not loaded](#text-track-not-loaded) state&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;track&#45;loading"></a><strong><code>LOADING</code></strong> &#40;numeric value 1&#41;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;text&#45;track&#45;loading&#45;2"></a>[text track loading](#text-track-loading) state&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;track&#45;loaded"></a><strong><code>LOADED</code></strong> &#40;numeric value 2&#41;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;text&#45;track&#45;loaded&#45;2"></a>[text track loaded](#text-track-loaded) state&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;track&#45;error"></a><strong><code>ERROR</code></strong> &#40;numeric value 3&#41;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;text&#45;track&#45;failed&#45;to&#45;load&#45;2"></a>[text track failed to load](#text-track-failed-to-load) state&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;track&#45;track"></a><strong><code>track</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;text&#45;track&#45;5"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;track&#45;kind"></a><strong><code>kind</code></strong> IDL attribute must <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;reflect"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the content attribute of the same name&#44; <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values"></a>[limited to only known values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#limited-to-only-known-values)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

This video has subtitles in several languages&#58;

``` text
<video src="brave.webm">
 <track kind=subtitles src=brave.en.vtt srclang=en label="English">
 <track kind=captions src=brave.en.hoh.vtt srclang=en label="English for the Hard of Hearing">
 <track kind=subtitles src=brave.fr.vtt srclang=fr lang=fr label="Français">
 <track kind=subtitles src=brave.de.vtt srclang=de lang=de label="Deutsch">
</video>
```

&#40;The <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;lang"></a><code>[lang](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-lang)</code> attributes on the last two describe the language of the <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;label&#45;5"></a><code>[label](#attr-track-label)</code> attribute&#44; not the language of the subtitles themselves&#46; The language of the subtitles is given by the <a id="the&#45;track&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;srclang&#45;4"></a><code>[srclang](#attr-track-srclang)</code> attribute&#46;&#41;

``` text
enum CanPlayTypeResult { "" /* empty string */, "maybe", "probably" };
typedef (MediaStream or MediaSource or Blob) MediaProvider;

[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLMediaElement : HTMLElement {

  // error state
  readonly attribute MediaError? error;

  // network state
  [CEReactions, ReflectURL] attribute USVString src;
  attribute MediaProvider? srcObject;
  readonly attribute USVString currentSrc;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString? crossOrigin;
  const unsigned short NETWORK_EMPTY = 0;
  const unsigned short NETWORK_IDLE = 1;
  const unsigned short NETWORK_LOADING = 2;
  const unsigned short NETWORK_NO_SOURCE = 3;
  readonly attribute unsigned short networkState;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString preload;
  readonly attribute TimeRanges buffered;
  undefined load();
  CanPlayTypeResult canPlayType(DOMString type);

  // ready state
  const unsigned short HAVE_NOTHING = 0;
  const unsigned short HAVE_METADATA = 1;
  const unsigned short HAVE_CURRENT_DATA = 2;
  const unsigned short HAVE_FUTURE_DATA = 3;
  const unsigned short HAVE_ENOUGH_DATA = 4;
  readonly attribute unsigned short readyState;
  readonly attribute boolean seeking;

  // playback state
  attribute double currentTime;
  undefined fastSeek(double time);
  readonly attribute unrestricted double duration;
  object getStartDate();
  readonly attribute boolean paused;
  attribute double defaultPlaybackRate;
  attribute double playbackRate;
  attribute boolean preservesPitch;
  readonly attribute TimeRanges played;
  readonly attribute TimeRanges seekable;
  readonly attribute boolean ended;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean autoplay;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean loop;
  Promise<undefined> play();
  undefined pause();

  // controls
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean controls;
  attribute double volume;
  attribute boolean muted;
  [CEReactions, Reflect="muted"] attribute boolean defaultMuted;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString loading;

  // tracks
  [SameObject] readonly attribute AudioTrackList audioTracks;
  [SameObject] readonly attribute VideoTrackList videoTracks;
  [SameObject] readonly attribute TextTrackList textTracks;
  TextTrack addTextTrack(TextTrackKind kind, optional DOMString label = "", optional DOMString language = "");
};
```

The <a id="media&#45;element&#45;attributes"></a><strong>media element attributes</strong>&#44; <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code>&#44; <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;crossorigin"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-media-crossorigin)</code>&#44; <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload"></a><code>[preload](#attr-media-preload)</code>&#44; <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;autoplay"></a><code>[autoplay](#attr-media-autoplay)</code>&#44; <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;loop"></a><code>[loop](#attr-media-loop)</code>&#44; <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;muted&#45;2"></a><code>[muted](#attr-media-muted)</code>&#44; <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;controls"></a><code>[controls](#attr-media-controls)</code>&#44; and <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;loading"></a><code>[loading](#attr-media-loading)</code>&#44; apply to all <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[media elements](#media-element)&#46; They are defined in this section&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;media&#45;loading"></a><strong><code>loading</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;lazy&#45;loading&#45;attribute"></a>[lazy loading attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-loading-attribute)&#46; Its purpose is to indicate the policy for loading media resources that are outside the viewport&#46;

When the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;loading&#45;2"></a><code>[loading](#attr-media-loading)</code> attribute&#39;s state is changed to the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;loading&#45;eager&#45;state"></a>[Eager](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-loading-eager-state) state&#44; the user agent must run these steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>resumptionSteps</var> be the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps"></a>[lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-load-resumption-steps)&#46;

2.  Let <var>posterResumptionSteps</var> be null&#46;

3.  If the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[media element](#media-element) is a <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element&#44; then set <var>posterResumptionSteps</var> to the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;poster&#45;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps"></a>[poster lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#poster-lazy-load-resumption-steps)&#46;

4.  If <var>resumptionSteps</var> is null and <var>posterResumptionSteps</var> is null&#44; then return&#46;

5.  If <var>resumptionSteps</var> is not null&#58;

    1.  Set the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-load-resumption-steps) to null&#46;

    2.  Invoke <var>resumptionSteps</var>&#46;

6.  If <var>posterResumptionSteps</var> is not null&#58;

    1.  Set the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;poster&#45;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[poster lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#poster-lazy-load-resumption-steps) to null&#46;

    2.  Invoke <var>posterResumptionSteps</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;loading"></a><strong><code>loading</code></strong> IDL attribute must <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;reflect"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;loading&#45;3"></a><code>[loading](#attr-media-loading)</code> content attribute&#44; <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values"></a>[limited to only known values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#limited-to-only-known-values)&#46;

When the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;loading&#45;4"></a><code>[loading](#attr-media-loading)</code> attribute is in the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;loading&#45;lazy&#45;state"></a>[Lazy](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-loading-lazy-state) state&#44; it takes precedence over the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload&#45;2"></a><code>[preload](#attr-media-preload)</code> attribute by deferring data fetching&#46;

If the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;autoplay&#45;2"></a><code>[autoplay](#attr-media-autoplay)</code> attribute is present and the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;loading&#45;5"></a><code>[loading](#attr-media-loading)</code> attribute is in the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;loading&#45;lazy&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Lazy](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-loading-lazy-state) state&#44; the user agent must also defer starting playback &#40;and any associated network requests autoplay can introduce&#41; until the element&#39;s <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps&#45;3"></a>[lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-load-resumption-steps) are invoked&#46;

<a id="media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[Media elements](#media-element) are used to present audio data&#44; or video and audio data&#44; to the user&#46; This is referred to as <a id="media&#45;data"></a><strong>media data</strong> in this section&#44; since this section applies equally to <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[media elements](#media-element) for audio or for video&#46; The term <a id="media&#45;resource"></a><strong>media resource</strong> is used to refer to the complete set of media data&#44; e&#46;g&#46; the complete video file&#44; or complete audio file&#46;

A <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) has an associated <a id="media&#45;resource&#45;origin"></a><strong>origin</strong>&#44; which is either &#34;<code>none</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>multiple</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>rewritten</code>&#34;&#44; or an <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;origin"></a>[origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-origin)&#46; It is initially set to &#34;<code>none</code>&#34;&#46;

A <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) can have multiple audio and video tracks&#46; For the purposes of a <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; the video data of the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;3"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is only that of the currently selected track &#40;if any&#41; as given by the element&#39;s <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;videotracks&#45;2"></a><code>[videoTracks](#dom-media-videotracks)</code> attribute when the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;event&#45;loop"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) last reached [step 1](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#step1)&#44; and the audio data of the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;4"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is the result of mixing all the currently enabled tracks &#40;if any&#41; given by the element&#39;s <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;audiotracks&#45;2"></a><code>[audioTracks](#dom-media-audiotracks)</code> attribute when the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;event&#45;loop&#45;2"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) last reached [step 1](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#step1)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Both <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> and <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> elements can be used for both audio and video&#46; The main difference between the two is simply that the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> element has no playback area for visual content &#40;such as video or captions&#41;&#44; whereas the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element does&#46;

Each <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;element&#45;8"></a>[media element](#media-element) has a unique <a id="media&#45;element&#45;event&#45;task&#45;source"></a><strong>media element event task source</strong>&#46;

To <a id="queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task"></a><strong>queue a media element task</strong> with a <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;element&#45;9"></a>[media element](#media-element) <var>element</var> and a series of steps <var>steps</var>&#44; <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;element&#45;10"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;element&#45;event&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[media element event task source](#media-element-event-task-source) given <var>element</var> and <var>steps</var>&#46;

Returns null if there is no error&#46;

All <a id="error&#45;codes&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[media elements](#media-element) have an associated error status&#44; which records the last error the element encountered since its <a id="error&#45;codes&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm) was last invoked&#46; The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;error"></a><strong><code>error</code></strong> attribute&#44; on getting&#44; must return the <a id="error&#45;codes&#58;mediaerror&#45;2"></a><code>[MediaError](#mediaerror)</code> object created for this last error&#44; or null if there has not been an error&#46;

<a id="mediaerror"></a><a id="error&#45;codes&#58;dom&#45;mediaerror&#45;media&#95;err&#95;aborted"></a><a id="error&#45;codes&#58;dom&#45;mediaerror&#45;media&#95;err&#95;network"></a><a id="error&#45;codes&#58;dom&#45;mediaerror&#45;media&#95;err&#95;decode"></a><a id="error&#45;codes&#58;dom&#45;mediaerror&#45;media&#95;err&#95;src&#95;not&#95;supported"></a><a id="error&#45;codes&#58;dom&#45;mediaerror&#45;code"></a><a id="error&#45;codes&#58;dom&#45;mediaerror&#45;message"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface MediaError {
  const unsigned short MEDIA_ERR_ABORTED = 1;
  const unsigned short MEDIA_ERR_NETWORK = 2;
  const unsigned short MEDIA_ERR_DECODE = 3;
  const unsigned short MEDIA_ERR_SRC_NOT_SUPPORTED = 4;

  readonly attribute unsigned short code;
  readonly attribute DOMString message;
};
```

Returns the current error&#39;s error code&#44; from the list below&#46;

<strong><code><var>media</var>&#46;<a id="error&#45;codes&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;error&#45;2"></a>[error](#dom-media-error)&#46;<a id="dom&#45;mediaerror&#45;message&#45;dev"></a>[message](#dom-mediaerror-message)</code></strong>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;&#63;Internet ExplorerNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

Returns a specific informative diagnostic message about the error condition encountered&#46; The message and message format are not generally uniform across different user agents&#46; If no such message is available&#44; then the empty string is returned&#46;

Every <a id="error&#45;codes&#58;mediaerror&#45;3"></a><code>[MediaError](#mediaerror)</code> object has a <a id="concept&#45;mediaerror&#45;message"></a><strong>message</strong>&#44; which is a string&#44; and a <a id="concept&#45;mediaerror&#45;code"></a><strong>code</strong>&#44; which is one of the following&#58;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;mediaerror&#45;media&#95;err&#95;aborted"></a><strong><code>MEDIA&#95;ERR&#95;ABORTED</code></strong> &#40;numeric value 1&#41;</strong>

The fetching process for the <a id="error&#45;codes&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) was aborted by the user agent at the user&#39;s request&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;mediaerror&#45;media&#95;err&#95;network"></a><strong><code>MEDIA&#95;ERR&#95;NETWORK</code></strong> &#40;numeric value 2&#41;</strong>

A network error of some description caused the user agent to stop fetching the <a id="error&#45;codes&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; after the resource was established to be usable&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;mediaerror&#45;media&#95;err&#95;decode"></a><strong><code>MEDIA&#95;ERR&#95;DECODE</code></strong> &#40;numeric value 3&#41;</strong>

An error of some description occurred while decoding the <a id="error&#45;codes&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;3"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; after the resource was established to be usable&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;mediaerror&#45;media&#95;err&#95;src&#95;not&#95;supported"></a><strong><code>MEDIA&#95;ERR&#95;SRC&#95;NOT&#95;SUPPORTED</code></strong> &#40;numeric value 4&#41;</strong>

The <a id="error&#45;codes&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;4"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) indicated by the <a id="error&#45;codes&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> attribute or <a id="error&#45;codes&#58;assigned&#45;media&#45;provider&#45;object"></a>[assigned media provider object](#assigned-media-provider-object) was not suitable&#46;

To <a id="creating&#45;a&#45;mediaerror"></a><strong>create a <code>MediaError</code></strong>&#44; given an error code which is one of the above values&#44; return a new <a id="error&#45;codes&#58;mediaerror&#45;4"></a><code>[MediaError](#mediaerror)</code> object whose <a id="error&#45;codes&#58;concept&#45;mediaerror&#45;code"></a>[code](#concept-mediaerror-code) is the given error code and whose <a id="error&#45;codes&#58;concept&#45;mediaerror&#45;message"></a>[message](#concept-mediaerror-message) is a string containing any details the user agent is able to supply about the cause of the error condition&#44; or the empty string if the user agent is unable to supply such details&#46; This message string must not contain only the information already available via the supplied error code&#59; for example&#44; it must not simply be a translation of the code into a string format&#46; If no additional information is available beyond that provided by the error code&#44; the <a id="error&#45;codes&#58;concept&#45;mediaerror&#45;message&#45;2"></a>[message](#concept-mediaerror-message) must be set to the empty string&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;mediaerror&#45;code"></a><strong><code>code</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="error&#45;codes&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="error&#45;codes&#58;concept&#45;mediaerror&#45;code&#45;2"></a>[code](#concept-mediaerror-code)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;mediaerror&#45;message"></a><strong><code>message</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="error&#45;codes&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="error&#45;codes&#58;concept&#45;mediaerror&#45;message&#45;3"></a>[message](#concept-mediaerror-message)&#46;

##### <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;2 Location of the media resource[](#location-of-the-media-resource)

The <a id="attr&#45;media&#45;src"></a><strong><code>src</code></strong> content attribute on <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[media elements](#media-element) gives the <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) of the media resource &#40;video&#44; audio&#41; to show&#46; The attribute&#44; if present&#44; must contain a <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;empty&#45;url&#45;potentially&#45;surrounded&#45;by&#45;spaces"></a>[valid non&#45;empty URL potentially surrounded by spaces](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-empty-url-potentially-surrounded-by-spaces)&#46;

If the <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;names&#58;&#45;the&#45;itemprop&#45;attribute"></a><code>[itemprop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#names:-the-itemprop-attribute)</code> attribute is specified on the <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; then the <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> attribute must also be specified&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;media&#45;crossorigin"></a><strong><code>crossorigin</code></strong> content attribute on <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[media elements](#media-element) is a <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;cors&#45;settings&#45;attribute"></a>[CORS settings attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#cors-settings-attribute)&#46;

<a id="concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm&#45;at&#45;creation"></a>If a <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[media element](#media-element) is created with a <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src&#45;2"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> attribute&#44; the user agent must <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;immediately"></a>[immediately](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#immediately) invoke the <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm)&#46;

If a <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src&#45;3"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> attribute of a <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[media element](#media-element) is set or changed&#44; the user agent must invoke the <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;load&#45;algorithm"></a>[media element load algorithm](#media-element-load-algorithm)&#46; &#40;<em>Removing</em> the <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src&#45;4"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> attribute does not do this&#44; even if there are <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> elements present&#46;&#41;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;crossorigin"></a><strong><code>crossOrigin</code></strong> IDL attribute must <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;reflect"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;crossorigin"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-media-crossorigin)</code> content attribute&#44; <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values"></a>[limited to only known values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#limited-to-only-known-values)&#46;

A <a id="media&#45;provider&#45;object"></a><strong>media provider object</strong> is an object that can represent a <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; separate from a <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;url&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url)&#46; <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;mediastream"></a><code>[MediaStream](https://w3c.github.io/mediacapture-main/getusermedia.html#idl-def-mediastream)</code> objects&#44; <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;mediasource"></a><code>[MediaSource](https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#idl-def-mediasource)</code> objects&#44; and <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;blob"></a><code>[Blob](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-Blob)</code> objects are all <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;provider&#45;object"></a>[media provider objects](#media-provider-object)&#46;

Each <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;8"></a>[media element](#media-element) has an <a id="assigned&#45;media&#45;provider&#45;object"></a><strong>assigned media provider object</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;provider&#45;object&#45;2"></a>[media provider object](#media-provider-object) or null&#44; initially null&#46;

Returns the <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;url&#45;3"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) of the current <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; if any&#46;

Returns the empty string when there is no <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;3"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; or it doesn&#39;t have a <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;url&#45;4"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;currentsrc"></a><strong><code>currentSrc</code></strong> IDL attribute must initially be set to the empty string&#46; Its value is changed by the <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm) defined below&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;srcobject"></a><strong><code>srcObject</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;assigned&#45;media&#45;provider&#45;object"></a>[assigned media provider object](#assigned-media-provider-object)&#46;

The <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;srcobject"></a><code>[srcObject](#dom-media-srcobject)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  Set <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;assigned&#45;media&#45;provider&#45;object&#45;2"></a>[assigned media provider object](#assigned-media-provider-object) to the given value&#46;

2.  Invoke <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;load&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[media element load algorithm](#media-element-load-algorithm)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

There are three ways to specify a <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;4"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#58; the <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;srcobject&#45;2"></a><code>[srcObject](#dom-media-srcobject)</code> IDL attribute&#44; the <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src&#45;5"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> content attribute&#44; and <a id="location&#45;of&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> elements&#46; The IDL attribute takes priority&#44; followed by the content attribute&#44; followed by the elements&#46;

##### <a id="mime&#45;types"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;3 MIME types[](#mime-types)

A <a id="mime&#45;types&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) can be described in terms of its <em>type</em>&#44; specifically a <a id="mime&#45;types&#58;mime&#45;type"></a>[MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type)&#44; in some cases with a <code>codecs</code> parameter&#46; &#40;Whether the <code>codecs</code> parameter is allowed or not depends on the MIME type&#46;&#41; [&#91;RFC6381&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsRFC6381)

Types are usually somewhat incomplete descriptions&#59; for example &#34;<code>video&#47;mpeg</code>&#34; doesn&#39;t say anything except what the container type is&#44; and even a type like &#34;<code>video&#47;mp4&#59; codecs&#61;&#34;avc1&#46;42E01E&#44; mp4a&#46;40&#46;2&#34;</code>&#34; doesn&#39;t include information like the actual bitrate &#40;only the maximum bitrate&#41;&#46; Thus&#44; given a type&#44; a user agent can often only know whether it <em>might</em> be able to play media of that type &#40;with varying levels of confidence&#41;&#44; or whether it definitely <em>cannot</em> play media of that type&#46;

<a id="a&#45;type&#45;that&#45;the&#45;user&#45;agent&#45;knows&#45;it&#45;cannot&#45;render"></a><strong>A type that the user agent knows it cannot render</strong> is one that describes a resource that the user agent definitely does not support&#44; for example because it doesn&#39;t recognize the container type&#44; or it doesn&#39;t support the listed codecs&#46;

The <a id="mime&#45;types&#58;mime&#45;type&#45;2"></a>[MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type) &#34;<a id="mime&#45;types&#58;application&#47;octet&#45;stream"></a><code>[application&#47;octet&#45;stream](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.5.1)</code>&#34; with no parameters is never <a id="mime&#45;types&#58;a&#45;type&#45;that&#45;the&#45;user&#45;agent&#45;knows&#45;it&#45;cannot&#45;render"></a>[a type that the user agent knows it cannot render](#a-type-that-the-user-agent-knows-it-cannot-render)&#46; User agents must treat that type as equivalent to the lack of any explicit <a id="mime&#45;types&#58;content&#45;type"></a>[Content&#45;Type metadata](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-type) when it is used to label a potential <a id="mime&#45;types&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Only the <a id="mime&#45;types&#58;mime&#45;type&#45;3"></a>[MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type) &#34;<a id="mime&#45;types&#58;application&#47;octet&#45;stream&#45;2"></a><code>[application&#47;octet&#45;stream](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.5.1)</code>&#34; with no parameters is special&#45;cased here&#59; if any parameter appears with it&#44; it will be treated just like any other <a id="mime&#45;types&#58;mime&#45;type&#45;4"></a>[MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type)&#46; This is a deviation from the rule that unknown <a id="mime&#45;types&#58;mime&#45;type&#45;5"></a>[MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type) parameters should be ignored&#46;

<strong><code><var>media</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;navigator&#45;canplaytype&#45;dev"></a>[canPlayType](#dom-navigator-canplaytype)&#40;<var>type</var>&#41;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLMediaElement&#47;canPlayType](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLMediaElement/canPlayType)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox3&#46;5&#43;Safari4&#43;Chrome3&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS3&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns the empty string &#40;a negative response&#41;&#44; &#34;maybe&#34;&#44; or &#34;probably&#34; based on how confident the user agent is that it can play media resources of the given type&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;navigator&#45;canplaytype"></a><strong><code>canPlayType&#40;<var>type</var>&#41;</code></strong> method must return <a id="dom&#45;canplaytyperesult&#45;nil"></a><strong>the empty string</strong> if <var>type</var> is <a id="mime&#45;types&#58;a&#45;type&#45;that&#45;the&#45;user&#45;agent&#45;knows&#45;it&#45;cannot&#45;render&#45;2"></a>[a type that the user agent knows it cannot render](#a-type-that-the-user-agent-knows-it-cannot-render) or is the type &#34;<a id="mime&#45;types&#58;application&#47;octet&#45;stream&#45;3"></a><code>[application&#47;octet&#45;stream](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.5.1)</code>&#34;&#59; it must return &#34;<a id="dom&#45;canplaytyperesult&#45;probably"></a><strong><code>probably</code></strong>&#34; if the user agent is confident that the type represents a <a id="mime&#45;types&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;3"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) that it can render if used with this <a id="mime&#45;types&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> or <a id="mime&#45;types&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element&#59; and it must return &#34;<a id="dom&#45;canplaytyperesult&#45;maybe"></a><strong><code>maybe</code></strong>&#34; otherwise&#46; Implementers are encouraged to return &#34;<a id="mime&#45;types&#58;dom&#45;canplaytyperesult&#45;maybe"></a><code>[maybe](#dom-canplaytyperesult-maybe)</code>&#34; unless the type can be confidently established as being supported or not&#46; Generally&#44; a user agent should never return &#34;<a id="mime&#45;types&#58;dom&#45;canplaytyperesult&#45;probably"></a><code>[probably](#dom-canplaytyperesult-probably)</code>&#34; for a type that allows the <code>codecs</code> parameter if that parameter is not present&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

This script tests to see if the user agent supports a &#40;fictional&#41; new format to dynamically decide whether to use a <a id="mime&#45;types&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element&#58;

``` text
<section id="video">
 <p><a href="playing-cats.nfv">Download video</a></p>
</section>
<script>
 const videoSection = document.getElementById('video');
```
