``` text
 const videoElement = document.createElement('video');
 const support = videoElement.canPlayType('video/x-new-fictional-format;codecs="kittens,bunnies"');
 if (support === "probably") {
   videoElement.setAttribute("src", "playing-cats.nfv");
   videoSection.replaceChildren(videoElement);
 }
</script>
```

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="mime&#45;types&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-source-type)</code> attribute of the <a id="mime&#45;types&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element allows the user agent to avoid downloading resources that use formats it cannot render&#46;

##### <a id="network&#45;states"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;4 Network states[](#network-states)

<strong><code><var>media</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;dev"></a>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLMediaElement&#47;networkState](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLMediaElement/networkState)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox3&#46;5&#43;Safari3&#46;1&#43;Chrome3&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android4&#43;Safari iOS3&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns the current state of network activity for the element&#44; from the codes in the list below&#46;

As <a id="network&#45;states&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[media elements](#media-element) interact with the network&#44; their current network activity is represented by the <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate"></a><strong><code>networkState</code></strong> attribute&#46; On getting&#44; it must return the current network state of the element&#44; which must be one of the following values&#58;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;empty"></a><strong><code>NETWORK&#95;EMPTY</code></strong> &#40;numeric value 0&#41;</strong>

The element has not yet been initialized&#46; All attributes are in their initial states&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;idle"></a><strong><code>NETWORK&#95;IDLE</code></strong> &#40;numeric value 1&#41;</strong>

The element&#39;s <a id="network&#45;states&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm) is active and has selected a <a id="network&#45;states&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[resource](#media-resource)&#44; but it is not actually using the network at this time&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;loading"></a><strong><code>NETWORK&#95;LOADING</code></strong> &#40;numeric value 2&#41;</strong>

The user agent is actively trying to download data&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;no&#95;source"></a><strong><code>NETWORK&#95;NO&#95;SOURCE</code></strong> &#40;numeric value 3&#41;</strong>

The element&#39;s <a id="network&#45;states&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm) is active&#44; but it has not yet found a <a id="network&#45;states&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[resource](#media-resource) to use&#46;

The <a id="network&#45;states&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm&#45;3"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm) defined below describes exactly when the <a id="network&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> attribute changes value and what events fire to indicate changes in this state&#46;

##### <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;5 Loading the media resource[](#loading-the-media-resource)

<strong><code><var>media</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;media&#45;load&#45;dev"></a>[load](#dom-media-load)&#40;&#41;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLMediaElement&#47;load](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLMediaElement/load)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox3&#46;5&#43;Safari3&#46;1&#43;Chrome3&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS3&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Causes the element to reset and start selecting and loading a new <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) from scratch&#46;

All <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[media elements](#media-element) have a <a id="can&#45;autoplay&#45;flag"></a><strong>can autoplay flag</strong>&#44; which must begin in the true state&#44; and a <a id="delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;flag"></a><strong>delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event flag</strong>&#44; which must begin in the false state&#46; While the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;flag"></a>[delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event flag](#delaying-the-load-event-flag) is true&#44; the element must <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event"></a>[delay the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event) of its document&#46;

When the <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;load"></a><strong><code>load&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method on a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[media element](#media-element) is invoked&#44; the user agent must run the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>resumptionSteps</var> be the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps"></a>[lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-load-resumption-steps)&#46;

2.  If <var>resumptionSteps</var> is not null&#58;

    1.  Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-load-resumption-steps) to null&#46;

    2.  Invoke <var>resumptionSteps</var>&#46;

3.  Run the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;load&#45;algorithm"></a>[media element load algorithm](#media-element-load-algorithm)&#46;

A <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[media element](#media-element) has an associated boolean <a id="is&#45;currently&#45;stalled"></a><strong>is currently stalled</strong>&#44; which is initially false&#46;

The <a id="media&#45;element&#45;load&#45;algorithm"></a><strong>media element load algorithm</strong> consists of the following steps&#58;

1.  Set this element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;is&#45;currently&#45;stalled"></a>[is currently stalled](#is-currently-stalled) to false&#46;

2.  Abort any already&#45;running instance of the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm) for this element&#46;

3.  Let <var>pending tasks</var> be a list of all <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task"></a>[tasks](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) from the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;event&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[media element event task source](#media-element-event-task-source) in one of the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;task&#45;queue"></a>[task queues](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#task-queue)&#46;

4.  For each task in <var>pending tasks</var> that would <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;resolve&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises"></a>[resolve pending play promises](#resolve-pending-play-promises) or <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;reject&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises"></a>[reject pending play promises](#reject-pending-play-promises)&#44; immediately resolve or reject those promises in the order the corresponding tasks were queued&#46;

5.  Remove each <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) in <var>pending tasks</var> from its <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;task&#45;queue&#45;2"></a>[task queue](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#task-queue)&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    Basically&#44; pending events and callbacks are discarded and promises in&#45;flight to be resolved&#47;rejected are resolved&#47;rejected immediately when the media element starts loading a new resource&#46;

6.  If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> is set to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;loading"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;LOADING](#dom-media-network_loading)</code> or <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;idle"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;IDLE](#dom-media-network_idle)</code>&#44; <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;8"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;abort"></a><code>[abort](#event-media-abort)</code> at the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;9"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

7.  If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;10"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;2"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> is not set to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;empty"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;EMPTY](#dom-media-network_empty)</code>&#58;

    1.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;11"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;emptied"></a><code>[emptied](#event-media-emptied)</code> at the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;12"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

    2.  If a fetching process is in progress for the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;13"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; the user agent should stop it&#46;

    3.  If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;14"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;assigned&#45;media&#45;provider&#45;object"></a>[assigned media provider object](#assigned-media-provider-object) is a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;mediasource"></a><code>[MediaSource](https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#idl-def-mediasource)</code> object&#44; then <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;detaching&#45;from&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element"></a>[detach](https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#mediasource-detach) it&#46;

    4.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;forget&#45;the&#45;media&#45;element&#39;s&#45;media&#45;resource&#45;specific&#45;tracks"></a>[Forget the media element&#39;s media&#45;resource&#45;specific tracks](#forget-the-media-element's-media-resource-specific-tracks)&#46;

    5.  If <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> is not set to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;nothing"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;NOTHING](#dom-media-have_nothing)</code>&#44; then set it to that state&#46;

    6.  If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused"></a><code>[paused](#dom-media-paused)</code> attribute is false&#58;

        1.  Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused&#45;2"></a><code>[paused](#dom-media-paused)</code> attribute to true&#46;

        2.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;take&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises"></a>[Take pending play promises](#take-pending-play-promises) and <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;reject&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises&#45;2"></a>[reject pending play promises](#reject-pending-play-promises) with the result and an <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;aborterror"></a>[&#34;<code>AbortError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#aborterror) <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

    7.  If <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seeking"></a><code>[seeking](#dom-media-seeking)</code> is true&#44; set it to false&#46;

    8.  Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) to 0&#46;

        Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;official&#45;playback&#45;position"></a>[official playback position](#official-playback-position) to 0&#46;

        If this changed the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;official&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;2"></a>[official playback position](#official-playback-position)&#44; then <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;15"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;3"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;timeupdate"></a><code>[timeupdate](#event-media-timeupdate)</code> at the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;16"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

    9.  Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;timeline&#45;offset"></a>[timeline offset](#timeline-offset) to Not&#45;a&#45;Number &#40;NaN&#41;&#46;

    10. Update the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;duration"></a><code>[duration](#dom-media-duration)</code> attribute to Not&#45;a&#45;Number &#40;NaN&#41;&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        The user agent [will not](#durationChange) fire a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;durationchange"></a><code>[durationchange](#event-media-durationchange)</code> event for this particular change of the duration&#46;

8.  Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;playbackrate"></a><code>[playbackRate](#dom-media-playbackrate)</code> attribute to the value of the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;defaultplaybackrate"></a><code>[defaultPlaybackRate](#dom-media-defaultplaybackrate)</code> attribute&#46;

9.  Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;error"></a><code>[error](#dom-media-error)</code> attribute to null and the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;can&#45;autoplay&#45;flag"></a>[can autoplay flag](#can-autoplay-flag) to true&#46;

10. Invoke the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;17"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm)&#46;

11. <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    Playback of any previously playing <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) for this element stops&#46;

The <a id="concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm"></a><strong>resource selection algorithm</strong> for a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;18"></a>[media element](#media-element) is as follows&#46; This algorithm is always invoked as part of a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task)&#44; but one of the first steps in the algorithm is to return and continue running the remaining steps <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;in&#45;parallel"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel)&#46; In addition&#44; this algorithm interacts closely with the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;loop"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) mechanism&#59; in particular&#44; it has <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section"></a>[synchronous sections](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) &#40;which are triggered as part of the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;loop&#45;2"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) algorithm&#41;&#46; Steps in such sections are marked with ⌛&#46;

1.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;3"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> attribute to the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;no&#95;source"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;NO&#95;SOURCE](#dom-media-network_no_source)</code> value&#46;

2.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;show&#45;poster&#45;flag"></a>[show poster flag](#show-poster-flag) to true&#46;

3.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;await&#45;a&#45;stable&#45;state"></a>[Await a stable state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#await-a-stable-state)&#44; allowing the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;4"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that invoked this algorithm to continue&#46; The <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;2"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) consists of all the remaining steps of this algorithm until the algorithm says the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;3"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) has ended&#46; &#40;Steps in <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;4"></a>[synchronous sections](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) are marked with ⌛&#46;&#41;

4.  ⌛ If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;19"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;lazy&#45;loading&#45;attribute"></a>[lazy loading attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-loading-attribute) is in the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;loading&#45;eager&#45;state"></a>[Eager](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-loading-eager-state) state or <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;noscript"></a>[scripting is disabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-noscript)&#44; then set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;20"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event flag](#delaying-the-load-event-flag) to true &#40;this <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;2"></a>[delays the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event)&#41;&#46;

5.  ⌛ If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;21"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;blocked&#45;on&#45;parser"></a>[blocked&#45;on&#45;parser](#blocked-on-parser) flag is false&#44; then <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;populate&#45;the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;pending&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a>[populate the list of pending text tracks](#populate-the-list-of-pending-text-tracks)&#46;

6.  ⌛ Let <var>mode</var> be null&#46;

7.  ⌛ Let <var>candidate</var> be null&#46;

8.  ⌛ If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;22"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;assigned&#45;media&#45;provider&#45;object&#45;2"></a>[assigned media provider object](#assigned-media-provider-object) is not null&#44; then set <var>mode</var> to <em>object</em>&#46;

9.  ⌛ Otherwise&#44; if the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;23"></a>[media element](#media-element) has a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> attribute&#44; then set <var>mode</var> to <em>attribute</em>&#46;

10. ⌛ Otherwise&#44; if the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;24"></a>[media element](#media-element) has a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element child&#44; then set <var>mode</var> to <em>children</em> and set <var>candidate</var> to the first <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element child in <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#46;

11. ⌛ Otherwise&#58;

    1.  ⌛ Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;4"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;empty&#45;2"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;EMPTY](#dom-media-network_empty)</code>&#46;

    2.  ⌛ Set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;flag&#45;3"></a>[delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event flag](#delaying-the-load-event-flag) to false&#46; This stops <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;3"></a>[delaying the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event)&#46;

    3.  End the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;5"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) and return&#46;

12. ⌛ Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;25"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;5"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;loading&#45;2"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;LOADING](#dom-media-network_loading)</code>&#46;

13. ⌛ <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;4"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;26"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;4"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;loadstart"></a><code>[loadstart](#event-media-loadstart)</code> at the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;27"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

14. Run the appropriate steps from the following list&#58;

    <strong>If <var>mode</var> is <em>object</em></strong>

    1.  ⌛ Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;currentsrc"></a><code>[currentSrc](#dom-media-currentsrc)</code> attribute to the empty string&#46;

    2.  End the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;6"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section)&#44; continuing the remaining steps <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;in&#45;parallel&#45;2"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel)&#46;

    3.  Run the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;resource"></a>[resource fetch algorithm](#concept-media-load-resource) with the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;assigned&#45;media&#45;provider&#45;object&#45;3"></a>[assigned media provider object](#assigned-media-provider-object)&#46; If that algorithm returns without aborting <em>this</em> one&#44; then the load failed&#46;

    4.  <em>Failed with media provider</em>&#58; Reaching this step indicates that the media resource failed to load&#46; <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;take&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises&#45;2"></a>[Take pending play promises](#take-pending-play-promises) and <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;5"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;28"></a>[media element](#media-element) to run the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dedicated&#45;media&#45;source&#45;failure&#45;steps"></a>[dedicated media source failure steps](#dedicated-media-source-failure-steps) with the result&#46;

    5.  Wait for the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;5"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) queued by the previous step to have executed&#46;

    6.  Return&#46; The element won&#39;t attempt to load another resource until this algorithm is triggered again&#46;

    <strong>If <var>mode</var> is <em>attribute</em></strong>

    1.  ⌛ If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src&#45;2"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> attribute&#39;s value is the empty string&#44; then end the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;7"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section)&#44; and jump down to the <em>failed with attribute</em> step below&#46;

    2.  ⌛ Let <var>urlRecord</var> be the result of <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[encoding&#45;parsing a URL](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#encoding-parsing-a-url) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src&#45;3"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> attribute&#39;s value&#44; relative to the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;29"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) when the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src&#45;4"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> attribute was last changed&#46;

    3.  ⌛ If <var>urlRecord</var> is not failure&#44; then set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;currentsrc&#45;2"></a><code>[currentSrc](#dom-media-currentsrc)</code> attribute to the result of applying the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;serializer"></a>[URL serializer](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer) to <var>urlRecord</var>&#46;

    4.  End the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;8"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section)&#44; continuing the remaining steps <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;in&#45;parallel&#45;3"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel)&#46;

    5.  If <var>urlRecord</var> is not failure&#44; then run the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[resource fetch algorithm](#concept-media-load-resource) with <var>urlRecord</var>&#46; If that algorithm returns without aborting <em>this</em> one&#44; then the load failed&#46;

    6.  <em>Failed with attribute</em>&#58; Reaching this step indicates that the media resource failed to load or that <var>urlRecord</var> is failure&#46; <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;take&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises&#45;3"></a>[Take pending play promises](#take-pending-play-promises) and <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;6"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;30"></a>[media element](#media-element) to run the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dedicated&#45;media&#45;source&#45;failure&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[dedicated media source failure steps](#dedicated-media-source-failure-steps) with the result&#46;

    7.  Wait for the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;6"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) queued by the previous step to have executed&#46;

    8.  Return&#46; The element won&#39;t attempt to load another resource until this algorithm is triggered again&#46;

    <strong>Otherwise &#40;<var>mode</var> is <em>children</em>&#41;</strong>

    1.  ⌛ Let <var>pointer</var> be a position defined by two adjacent nodes in the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;31"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s child list&#44; treating the start of the list &#40;before the first child in the list&#44; if any&#41; and end of the list &#40;after the last child in the list&#44; if any&#41; as nodes in their own right&#46; One node is the node before <var>pointer</var>&#44; and the other node is the node after <var>pointer</var>&#46; Initially&#44; let <var>pointer</var> be the position between the <var>candidate</var> node and the next node&#44; if there are any&#44; or the end of the list&#44; if it is the last node&#46;

        As nodes are <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;insert&#45;ext"></a>[inserted](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-insert-ext)&#44; <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;remove&#45;ext"></a>[removed](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-remove-ext)&#44; and <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;move&#45;ext"></a>[moved](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-move-ext) into the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;32"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; <var>pointer</var> must be updated as follows&#58;

        <strong>If a new node is <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;insert&#45;ext&#45;2"></a>[inserted](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-insert-ext) or <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;move&#45;ext&#45;2"></a>[moved](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-move-ext) between the two nodes that define <var>pointer</var></strong>

        Let <var>pointer</var> be the point between the node before <var>pointer</var> and the new node&#46; In other words&#44; insertions at <var>pointer</var> go after <var>pointer</var>&#46;
        <strong>If the node before <var>pointer</var> is removed</strong>

        Let <var>pointer</var> be the point between the node after <var>pointer</var> and the node before the node after <var>pointer</var>&#46; In other words&#44; <var>pointer</var> doesn&#39;t move relative to the remaining nodes&#46;
        <strong>If the node after <var>pointer</var> is removed</strong>

        Let <var>pointer</var> be the point between the node before <var>pointer</var> and the node after the node before <var>pointer</var>&#46; Just as with the previous case&#44; <var>pointer</var> doesn&#39;t move relative to the remaining nodes&#46;
        Other changes don&#39;t affect <var>pointer</var>&#46;

    2.  ⌛ <em>Process candidate</em>&#58; If <var>candidate</var> does not have a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-source-src)</code> attribute&#44; or if its <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;src&#45;2"></a><code>[src](#attr-source-src)</code> attribute&#39;s value is the empty string&#44; then end the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;9"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section)&#44; and jump down to the <em>failed with elements</em> step below&#46;

    3.  ⌛ If <var>candidate</var> has a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;media"></a><code>[media](#attr-source-media)</code> attribute whose value does not <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;matches&#45;the&#45;environment"></a>[match the environment](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#matches-the-environment)&#44; then end the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;10"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section)&#44; and jump down to the <em>failed with elements</em> step below&#46;

    4.  ⌛ Let <var>urlRecord</var> be the result of <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;a&#45;url&#45;2"></a>[encoding&#45;parsing a URL](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#encoding-parsing-a-url) given <var>candidate</var>&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src&#45;5"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> attribute&#39;s value&#44; relative to <var>candidate</var>&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) when the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src&#45;6"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> attribute was last changed&#46;

    5.  ⌛ If <var>urlRecord</var> is failure&#44; then end the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;11"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section)&#44; and jump down to the <em>failed with elements</em> step below&#46;

    6.  ⌛ If <var>candidate</var> has a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;source&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-source-type)</code> attribute whose value&#44; when parsed as a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;mime&#45;type"></a>[MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type) &#40;including any codecs described by the <code>codecs</code> parameter&#44; for types that define that parameter&#41;&#44; represents <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;a&#45;type&#45;that&#45;the&#45;user&#45;agent&#45;knows&#45;it&#45;cannot&#45;render"></a>[a type that the user agent knows it cannot render](#a-type-that-the-user-agent-knows-it-cannot-render)&#44; then end the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;12"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section)&#44; and jump down to the <em>failed with elements</em> step below&#46;

    7.  ⌛ Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;currentsrc&#45;3"></a><code>[currentSrc](#dom-media-currentsrc)</code> attribute to the result of applying the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;serializer&#45;2"></a>[URL serializer](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer) to <var>urlRecord</var>&#46;

    8.  End the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;13"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section)&#44; continuing the remaining steps <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;in&#45;parallel&#45;4"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel)&#46;

    9.  Run the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;resource&#45;3"></a>[resource fetch algorithm](#concept-media-load-resource) with <var>urlRecord</var>&#46; If that algorithm returns without aborting <em>this</em> one&#44; then the load failed&#46;

    10. <em>Failed with elements</em>&#58; <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;7"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;33"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;5"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;source&#45;error"></a><code>[error](#event-source-error)</code> at <var>candidate</var>&#46;

    11. <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;await&#45;a&#45;stable&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Await a stable state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#await-a-stable-state)&#46; The <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;14"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) consists of all the remaining steps of this algorithm until the algorithm says the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;15"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) has ended&#46; &#40;Steps in <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;16"></a>[synchronous sections](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) are marked with ⌛&#46;&#41;

    12. ⌛ <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;forget&#45;the&#45;media&#45;element&#39;s&#45;media&#45;resource&#45;specific&#45;tracks&#45;2"></a>[Forget the media element&#39;s media&#45;resource&#45;specific tracks](#forget-the-media-element's-media-resource-specific-tracks)&#46;

    13. ⌛ <em>Find next candidate</em>&#58; Let <var>candidate</var> be null&#46;

    14. ⌛ <em>Search loop</em>&#58; If the node after <var>pointer</var> is the end of the list&#44; then jump to the <em>waiting</em> step below&#46;

    15. ⌛ If the node after <var>pointer</var> is a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> element&#44; let <var>candidate</var> be that element&#46;

    16. ⌛ Advance <var>pointer</var> so that the node before <var>pointer</var> is now the node that was after <var>pointer</var>&#44; and the node after <var>pointer</var> is the node after the node that used to be after <var>pointer</var>&#44; if any&#46;

    17. ⌛ If <var>candidate</var> is null&#44; jump back to the <em>search loop</em> step&#46; Otherwise&#44; jump back to the <em>process candidate</em> step&#46;

    18. ⌛ <em>Waiting</em>&#58; Set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;6"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> attribute to the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;no&#95;source&#45;2"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;NO&#95;SOURCE](#dom-media-network_no_source)</code> value&#46;

    19. ⌛ Set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;show&#45;poster&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[show poster flag](#show-poster-flag) to true&#46;

    20. ⌛ <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;8"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;34"></a>[media element](#media-element) to set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;flag&#45;4"></a>[delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event flag](#delaying-the-load-event-flag) to false&#46; This stops <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;4"></a>[delaying the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event)&#46;

    21. End the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;17"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section)&#44; continuing the remaining steps <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;in&#45;parallel&#45;5"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel)&#46;

    22. Wait until the node after <var>pointer</var> is a node other than the end of the list&#46; &#40;This step might wait forever&#46;&#41;

    23. <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;await&#45;a&#45;stable&#45;state&#45;3"></a>[Await a stable state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#await-a-stable-state)&#46; The <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;18"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) consists of all the remaining steps of this algorithm until the algorithm says the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;19"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) has ended&#46; &#40;Steps in <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;20"></a>[synchronous sections](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) are marked with ⌛&#46;&#41;

    24. ⌛ If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;35"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;lazy&#45;loading&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a>[lazy loading attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-loading-attribute) is in the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;loading&#45;eager&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Eager](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-loading-eager-state) state or <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;noscript&#45;2"></a>[scripting is disabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-noscript)&#44; then set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;flag&#45;5"></a>[delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event flag](#delaying-the-load-event-flag) back to true &#40;this <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;5"></a>[delays the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event) again&#44; in case it hasn&#39;t been fired yet&#41;&#46;

    25. ⌛ Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;7"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> back to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;loading&#45;3"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;LOADING](#dom-media-network_loading)</code>&#46;

    26. ⌛ Jump back to the <em>find next candidate</em> step above&#46;

    The <a id="dedicated&#45;media&#45;source&#45;failure&#45;steps"></a><strong>dedicated media source failure steps</strong> with a list of promises <var>promises</var> are the following steps&#58;

    1.  Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;error&#45;2"></a><code>[error](#dom-media-error)</code> attribute to the result of <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;creating&#45;a&#45;mediaerror"></a>[creating a <code>MediaError</code>](#creating-a-mediaerror) with <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;mediaerror&#45;media&#95;err&#95;src&#95;not&#95;supported"></a><code>[MEDIA&#95;ERR&#95;SRC&#95;NOT&#95;SUPPORTED](#dom-mediaerror-media_err_src_not_supported)</code>&#46;

    2.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;forget&#45;the&#45;media&#45;element&#39;s&#45;media&#45;resource&#45;specific&#45;tracks&#45;3"></a>[Forget the media element&#39;s media&#45;resource&#45;specific tracks](#forget-the-media-element's-media-resource-specific-tracks)&#46;

    3.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;8"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> attribute to the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;no&#95;source&#45;3"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;NO&#95;SOURCE](#dom-media-network_no_source)</code> value&#46;

    4.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;show&#45;poster&#45;flag&#45;3"></a>[show poster flag](#show-poster-flag) to true&#46;

    5.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;6"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;error"></a><code>[error](#event-media-error)</code> at the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;36"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

    6.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;reject&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises&#45;3"></a>[Reject pending play promises](#reject-pending-play-promises) with <var>promises</var> and a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;notsupportederror"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

    7.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;flag&#45;6"></a>[delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event flag](#delaying-the-load-event-flag) to false&#46; This stops <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;6"></a>[delaying the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event)&#46;

To <a id="verify&#45;a&#45;media&#45;response"></a><strong>verify a media response</strong> given a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;response"></a>[response](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response) <var>response</var>&#44; a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;3"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) <var>resource</var>&#44; and &#34;<code>entire resource</code>&#34; or a &#40;number&#44; number or &#34;<code>until end</code>&#34;&#41; tuple <var>byteRange</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>response</var> is a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;network&#45;error"></a>[network error](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error)&#44; then return false&#46;

2.  If <var>byteRange</var> is &#34;<code>entire resource</code>&#34;&#44; then return true&#46;

3.  Let <var>internalResponse</var> be <var>response</var>&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;unsafe&#45;response"></a>[unsafe response](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#unsafe-response)&#46;

4.  If <var>internalResponse</var>&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;response&#45;status"></a>[status](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-status) is 200&#44; then return true&#46;

5.  If <var>internalResponse</var>&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;response&#45;status&#45;2"></a>[status](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-status) is not 206&#44; then return false&#46;

6.  If the result of <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;extract&#45;content&#45;range&#45;values"></a>[extracting content&#45;range values](https://wicg.github.io/background-fetch/#extract-content-range-values) from <var>internalResponse</var> is failure&#44; then return false&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    Note that the extracted values are not used&#44; and in particular are not compared to <var>byteRange</var>&#46; So this step serves as syntactic validation of the &#96;<a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;http&#45;content&#45;range"></a><code>[Content&#45;Range](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7233.html#header.content-range)</code>&#96; header&#44; but if the &#96;<a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;http&#45;content&#45;range&#45;2"></a><code>[Content&#45;Range](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7233.html#header.content-range)</code>&#96; values on the response mismatch the &#96;<a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;http&#45;range"></a><code>[Range](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7233.html#header.range)</code>&#96; values on the request&#44; that is not considered a failure&#46;

7.  Let <var>origin</var> be &#34;<code>rewritten</code>&#34; if <var>internalResponse</var>&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;response&#45;url"></a>[URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url) is null&#59; otherwise <var>internalResponse</var>&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;response&#45;url&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;origin"></a>[origin](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-origin)&#46;

8.  Let <var>previousOrigin</var> be <var>resource</var>&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;origin"></a>[origin](#media-resource-origin)&#46;

9.  If any of the following are true&#58;

    - <var>previousOrigin</var> is &#34;<code>none</code>&#34;&#59;

    - <var>origin</var> and <var>previousOrigin</var> are &#34;<code>rewritten</code>&#34;&#59; or

    - <var>origin</var> and <var>previousOrigin</var> are <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;origin"></a>[origins](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-origin)&#44; and <var>origin</var> is <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;same&#45;origin"></a>[same origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#same-origin) with <var>previousOrigin</var>&#44;

    then set <var>resource</var>&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;origin&#45;2"></a>[origin](#media-resource-origin) to <var>origin</var>&#46;

    Otherwise&#44; if <var>response</var> is <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;cors&#45;cross&#45;origin"></a>[CORS&#45;cross&#45;origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#cors-cross-origin)&#44; then return false&#46;

    Otherwise&#44; set <var>resource</var>&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;origin&#45;3"></a>[origin](#media-resource-origin) to &#34;<code>multiple</code>&#34;&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This ensures that opaque responses with range headers do not leak information by being patched together with other responses from different origins&#46;

10. Return true&#46;

The <a id="concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;resource"></a><strong>resource fetch algorithm</strong> for a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;37"></a>[media element](#media-element) and a given <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;url&#45;record"></a>[URL record](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) or <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;provider&#45;object"></a>[media provider object](#media-provider-object) is as follows&#58;

1.  If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;will&#45;lazy&#45;load&#45;element&#45;steps"></a>[will lazy load element steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#will-lazy-load-element-steps) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;38"></a>[media element](#media-element) return true&#58;

    1.  Let <var>resumptionSteps</var> be the rest of this algorithm starting with the step labeled <em>Let mode be remote</em>&#46;

    2.  Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;39"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps&#45;3"></a>[lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-load-resumption-steps) to <var>resumptionSteps</var>&#46;

    3.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;start&#45;intersection&#45;observing&#45;a&#45;lazy&#45;loading&#45;element"></a>[Start intersection&#45;observing a lazy loading element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#start-intersection-observing-a-lazy-loading-element) for the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;40"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

    4.  Return&#46;

2.  Let <var>mode</var> be <em>remote</em>&#46;

3.  If the algorithm was invoked with <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;provider&#45;object&#45;2"></a>[media provider object](#media-provider-object)&#44; then set <var>mode</var> to <em>local</em>&#46;

    Otherwise&#58;

    1.  Let <var>isTopLevelSelfFetch</var> be false&#46;

    2.  Let <var>settingsObject</var> be the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;41"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;node&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;relevant&#45;settings&#45;object"></a>[relevant settings object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-settings-object)&#46;

    3.  Let <var>global</var> be the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;42"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;node&#45;document&#45;4"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#46;

    4.  If all of the following conditions are true&#58;

        - <var>global</var> is a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;window"></a><code>[Window](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#window)</code> object&#59;

        - <var>global</var>&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;window&#45;navigable"></a>[navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#window-navigable) is not null&#59;

        - <var>global</var>&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;window&#45;navigable&#45;2"></a>[navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#window-navigable)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;nav&#45;parent"></a>[parent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nav-parent) is null&#59; and

        - <var>settingsObject</var>&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;environment&#45;creation&#45;url"></a>[creation URL](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-environment-creation-url) <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;equals"></a>[equals](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-equals) the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;url&#45;record&#45;2"></a>[URL record](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url)&#44;

        then set <var>isTopLevelSelfFetch</var> to true&#46;

    5.  Let <var>stringOrEnvironment</var> be &#34;<code>top&#45;level&#45;self&#45;fetch</code>&#34; if <var>isTopLevelSelfFetch</var> is true&#59; otherwise <var>settingsObject</var>&#46;

    6.  Let <var>object</var> be the result of <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;blob&#45;url&#45;obtain&#45;object"></a>[obtaining a blob object](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#blob-url-obtain-object) using the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;url&#45;record&#45;3"></a>[URL record](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;blob&#45;entry"></a>[blob URL entry](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-blob-entry) and <var>stringOrEnvironment</var>&#46;

    7.  If <var>object</var> is a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;provider&#45;object&#45;3"></a>[media provider object](#media-provider-object)&#44; then set <var>mode</var> to <em>local</em>&#46;

4.  If <var>mode</var> is <em>remote</em>&#44; then let the <var>current media resource</var> be the resource given by the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;url&#45;record&#45;4"></a>[URL record](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) passed to this algorithm&#59; otherwise&#44; let the <var>current media resource</var> be the resource given by the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;provider&#45;object&#45;4"></a>[media provider object](#media-provider-object)&#46; Either way&#44; the <var>current media resource</var> is now the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;4"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#46;

5.  Remove all <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;specific&#45;text&#45;track"></a>[media&#45;resource&#45;specific text tracks](#media-resource-specific-text-track) from the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;43"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;list&#45;of&#45;pending&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a>[list of pending text tracks](#list-of-pending-text-tracks)&#44; if any&#46;

6.  Run the appropriate steps from the following list&#58;

    <strong>If <var>mode</var> is remote</strong>

    1.  Optionally&#44; run the following substeps&#46; This is the expected behavior if the user agent intends to not attempt to fetch the resource until the user requests it explicitly &#40;e&#46;g&#46; as a way to implement the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload"></a><code>[preload](#attr-media-preload)</code> attribute&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload&#45;none"></a><code>[none](#attr-media-preload-none)</code> keyword&#41;&#46;

        1.  Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;9"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;idle&#45;2"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;IDLE](#dom-media-network_idle)</code>&#46;

        2.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;9"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;44"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;7"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;suspend"></a><code>[suspend](#event-media-suspend)</code> at the element&#46;

        3.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;10"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;45"></a>[media element](#media-element) to set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;flag&#45;7"></a>[delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event flag](#delaying-the-load-event-flag) to false&#46; This stops <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;7"></a>[delaying the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event)&#46;

        4.  Wait for the task to be run&#46;

        5.  Wait for an <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;implementation&#45;defined"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined) event &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; the user requesting that the media element begin playback&#41;&#46;

        6.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;flag&#45;8"></a>[delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event flag](#delaying-the-load-event-flag) back to true &#40;this <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;8"></a>[delays the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event) again&#44; in case it hasn&#39;t been fired yet&#41;&#46;

        7.  Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;10"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;loading&#45;4"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;LOADING](#dom-media-network_loading)</code>&#46;

    2.  Let <var>destination</var> be &#34;<code>audio</code>&#34; if the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;46"></a>[media element](#media-element) is an <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> element&#44; or &#34;<code>video</code>&#34; otherwise&#46;

    3.  Let <var>request</var> be the result of <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;create&#45;a&#45;potential&#45;cors&#45;request"></a>[creating a potential&#45;CORS request](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#create-a-potential-cors-request) given <var>current media resource</var>&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;url&#45;record&#45;5"></a>[URL record](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url)&#44; <var>destination</var>&#44; and the current state of the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;47"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;script&#45;crossorigin"></a><code>[crossorigin](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#attr-script-crossorigin)</code> content attribute&#46;

    4.  Set <var>request</var>&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;client"></a>[client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-client) to the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;48"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;node&#45;document&#45;5"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;relevant&#45;settings&#45;object&#45;2"></a>[relevant settings object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-settings-object)&#46;

    5.  Set <var>request</var>&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;initiator&#45;type"></a>[initiator type](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-initiator-type) to <var>destination</var>&#46;

    6.  Let <var>byteRange</var>&#44; which is &#34;<code>entire resource</code>&#34; or a &#40;number&#44; number or &#34;<code>until end</code>&#34;&#41; tuple&#44; be the byte range required to satisfy missing data in <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data"></a>[media data](#media-data)&#46; This value is <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;implementation&#45;defined&#45;2"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined) and may rely on codec&#44; network conditions or other heuristics&#46; The user&#45;agent may determine to fetch the resource in full&#44; in which case <var>byteRange</var> would be &#34;<code>entire resource</code>&#34;&#44; to fetch from a byte offset until the end&#44; in which case <var>byteRange</var> would be &#40;number&#44; &#34;<code>until end</code>&#34;&#41;&#44; or to fetch a range between two byte offsets&#44; in which case <var>byteRange</var> would be a &#40;number&#44; number&#41; tuple representing the two offsets&#46;

    7.  If <var>byteRange</var> is not &#34;<code>entire resource</code>&#34;&#58;

        1.  If <var>byteRange</var>&#91;1&#93; is &#34;<code>until end</code>&#34;&#44; then <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;add&#45;a&#45;range&#45;header"></a>[add a range header](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-add-range-header) to <var>request</var> given <var>byteRange</var>&#91;0&#93;&#46;

        2.  Otherwise&#44; <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;add&#45;a&#45;range&#45;header&#45;2"></a>[add a range header](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-add-range-header) to <var>request</var> given <var>byteRange</var>&#91;0&#93; and <var>byteRange</var>&#91;1&#93;&#46;

    8.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;fetch"></a>[Fetch](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch) <var>request</var>&#44; with <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;processresponse"></a><em>[processResponse](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#process-response)</em> set to the following steps given <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;response&#45;2"></a>[response](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response) <var>response</var>&#58;

        1.  Let <var>global</var> be the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;49"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;node&#45;document&#45;6"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global&#45;2"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#46;

        2.  Let <var>updateMedia</var> be to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;11"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;50"></a>[media element](#media-element) to run the first appropriate steps from the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;processing&#45;steps&#45;list"></a>[media data processing steps list](#media-data-processing-steps-list) below&#46; &#40;A new task is used for this so that the work described below occurs relative to the appropriate <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;event&#45;task&#45;source&#45;2"></a>[media element event task source](#media-element-event-task-source) rather than using the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;networking&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[networking task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#networking-task-source)&#46;&#41;

        3.  Let <var>processEndOfMedia</var> be the following step&#58; If the fetching process has completed without errors&#44; including decoding the media data&#44; and if all of the data is available to the user agent without network access&#44; then&#44; the user agent must move on to the <em>final step</em> below&#46; This might never happen&#44; e&#46;g&#46; when streaming an infinite resource such as web radio&#44; or if the resource is longer than the user agent&#39;s ability to cache data&#46;

        4.  If the result of <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;verify&#45;a&#45;media&#45;response"></a>[verifying](#verify-a-media-response) <var>response</var> given the <var>current media resource</var> and <var>byteRange</var> is false&#44; then abort these steps&#46;

        5.  Otherwise&#44; <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;body&#45;incrementally&#45;read"></a>[incrementally read](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#body-incrementally-read) <var>response</var>&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;response&#45;body"></a>[body](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-body) given <var>updateMedia</var>&#44; <var>processEndOfMedia</var>&#44; an empty algorithm&#44; and <var>global</var>&#46;

        6.  Update the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;2"></a>[media data](#media-data) with the contents of <var>response</var>&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;unsafe&#45;response&#45;2"></a>[unsafe response](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#unsafe-response) obtained in this fashion&#46; <var>response</var> can be <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;cors&#45;same&#45;origin"></a>[CORS&#45;same&#45;origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#cors-same-origin) or <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;cors&#45;cross&#45;origin&#45;2"></a>[CORS&#45;cross&#45;origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#cors-cross-origin)&#59; this affects whether subtitles referenced in the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;3"></a>[media data](#media-data) are exposed in the API and&#44; for <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> elements&#44; whether a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-canvas-element)</code> gets tainted when the video is drawn on it&#46;

        The <a id="stall&#45;timeout"></a><strong>media element stall timeout</strong> is an <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;implementation&#45;defined&#45;3"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined) length of time&#44; which should be about three seconds&#46; When a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;51"></a>[media element](#media-element) that is actively attempting to obtain <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;4"></a>[media data](#media-data) has failed to receive any data for a duration equal to the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;stall&#45;timeout"></a>[media element stall timeout](#stall-timeout)&#44; the user agent must <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;12"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;52"></a>[media element](#media-element) to&#58;

        1.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;is&#45;currently&#45;stalled&#45;2"></a>[is currently stalled](#is-currently-stalled) to true&#46;

        2.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;8"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;stalled"></a><code>[stalled](#event-media-stalled)</code> at the element&#46;

        User agents may allow users to selectively block or slow <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;5"></a>[media data](#media-data) downloads&#46; When a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;53"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s download has been blocked altogether&#44; the user agent must act as if it was stalled &#40;as opposed to acting as if the connection was closed&#41;&#46; The rate of the download may also be throttled automatically by the user agent&#44; e&#46;g&#46; to balance the download with other connections sharing the same bandwidth&#46;

        <a id="resourceSuspend"></a>User agents may decide to not download more content at any time&#44; e&#46;g&#46; after buffering five minutes of a one hour media resource&#44; while waiting for the user to decide whether to play the resource or not&#44; while waiting for user input in an interactive resource&#44; or when the user navigates away from the page&#46; When a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;54"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s download has been suspended&#44; the user agent must <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;13"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;55"></a>[media element](#media-element) to set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;11"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;idle&#45;3"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;IDLE](#dom-media-network_idle)</code> and <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;9"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;suspend&#45;2"></a><code>[suspend](#event-media-suspend)</code> at the element&#46; If and when downloading of the resource resumes&#44; the user agent must <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;14"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;56"></a>[media element](#media-element) to set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;12"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;loading&#45;5"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;LOADING](#dom-media-network_loading)</code>&#46;
