Between the queuing of these tasks&#44; the load is suspended &#40;so <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;progress"></a><code>[progress](#event-media-progress)</code> events don&#39;t fire&#44; as described above&#41;&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        The <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload&#45;2"></a><code>[preload](#attr-media-preload)</code> attribute provides a hint regarding how much buffering the author thinks is advisable&#44; even in the absence of the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;autoplay"></a><code>[autoplay](#attr-media-autoplay)</code> attribute&#46;

        When a user agent decides to completely suspend a download&#44; e&#46;g&#46;&#44; if it is waiting until the user starts playback before downloading any further content&#44; the user agent must <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;15"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;57"></a>[media element](#media-element) to set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;flag&#45;9"></a>[delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event flag](#delaying-the-load-event-flag) to false&#46; This stops <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;9"></a>[delaying the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event)&#46;

        Although the above steps give an algorithm for issuing requests&#44; the user agent may use other means besides those exact ones&#44; especially in the face of error conditions&#46; For example&#44; the user agent may reconnect to the server or switch to a streaming protocol&#46; The user agent must only consider the resource erroneous&#44; and proceed into the error branches of the above steps&#44; if the user agent has given up trying to fetch the resource&#46;

        To determine the format of the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;5"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; the user agent must use the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;content&#45;type&#45;sniffing&#58;&#45;video"></a>[rules for sniffing audio and video specifically](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#rules-for-sniffing-audio-and-video-specifically)&#46;

        While the load is not suspended &#40;see below&#41;&#44; every 350ms &#40;±200ms&#41; or for every byte received&#44; whichever is <em>least</em> frequent&#44; <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;16"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;58"></a>[media element](#media-element) to&#58;

        1.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;is&#45;currently&#45;stalled&#45;3"></a>[is currently stalled](#is-currently-stalled) to false&#46;

        2.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;10"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;progress&#45;2"></a><code>[progress](#event-media-progress)</code> at the element&#46;

        While the user agent might still need network access to obtain parts of the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;6"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; the user agent must remain on this step&#46;

        <strong>Example&#58;</strong>

        For example&#44; if the user agent has discarded the first half of a video&#44; the user agent will remain at this step even once the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;ended&#45;playback"></a>[playback has ended](#ended-playback)&#44; because there is always the chance the user will seek back to the start&#46; In fact&#44; in this situation&#44; once <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;ended&#45;playback&#45;2"></a>[playback has ended](#ended-playback)&#44; the user agent will end up firing a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;suspend&#45;3"></a><code>[suspend](#event-media-suspend)</code> event&#44; as described earlier&#46;

    <strong>Otherwise &#40;<var>mode</var> is <em>local</em>&#41;</strong>

    The resource described by the <var>current media resource</var>&#44; if any&#44; contains the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;6"></a>[media data](#media-data)&#46; It is <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;cors&#45;same&#45;origin&#45;2"></a>[CORS&#45;same&#45;origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#cors-same-origin)&#46;

    If the <var>current media resource</var> is a raw data stream &#40;e&#46;g&#46; from a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;file"></a><code>[File](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file)</code> object&#41;&#44; then to determine the format of the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;7"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; the user agent must use the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;content&#45;type&#45;sniffing&#58;&#45;video&#45;2"></a>[rules for sniffing audio and video specifically](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#rules-for-sniffing-audio-and-video-specifically)&#46; Otherwise&#44; if the data stream is pre&#45;decoded&#44; then the format is the format given by the relevant specification&#46;

    Whenever new data for the <var>current media resource</var> becomes available&#44; <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;17"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;59"></a>[media element](#media-element) to run the first appropriate steps from the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;processing&#45;steps&#45;list&#45;2"></a>[media data processing steps list](#media-data-processing-steps-list) below&#46;

    When the <var>current media resource</var> is permanently exhausted &#40;e&#46;g&#46; all the bytes of a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;blob"></a><code>[Blob](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-Blob)</code> have been processed&#41;&#44; if there were no decoding errors&#44; then the user agent must move on to the <em>final step</em> below&#46; This might never happen&#44; e&#46;g&#46; if the <var>current media resource</var> is a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;mediastream"></a><code>[MediaStream](https://w3c.github.io/mediacapture-main/getusermedia.html#idl-def-mediastream)</code>&#46;

    The <a id="media&#45;data&#45;processing&#45;steps&#45;list"></a><strong>media data processing steps list</strong> is as follows&#58;

    <strong>If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;7"></a>[media data](#media-data) cannot be fetched at all&#44; due to network errors&#44; causing the user agent to give up trying to fetch the resource</strong>

    <strong>If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;8"></a>[media data](#media-data) can be fetched but is found by inspection to be in an unsupported format&#44; or can otherwise not be rendered at all</strong>

    DNS errors&#44; HTTP 4xx and 5xx errors &#40;and equivalents in other protocols&#41;&#44; and other fatal network errors that occur before the user agent has established whether the <var>current media resource</var> is usable&#44; as well as the file using an unsupported container format&#44; or using unsupported codecs for all the data&#44; must cause the user agent to execute the following steps&#58;

    1.  The user agent should cancel the fetching process&#46;

    2.  Abort this subalgorithm&#44; returning to the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm&#45;3"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm)&#46;

    <a id="found&#45;another&#45;audio&#45;track"></a><strong>If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;8"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is found to have an audio track</strong>

    1.  Create an <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;audiotrack"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> object to represent the audio track&#46;

    2.  Update the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;60"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;audiotracks"></a><code>[audioTracks](#dom-media-audiotracks)</code> attribute&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;audiotracklist"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> object with the new <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;audiotrack&#45;2"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> object&#46;

    3.  Let <var>enable</var> be <em>unknown</em>&#46;

    4.  If either the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;9"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) or the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) of the <var>current media resource</var> indicate a particular set of audio tracks to enable&#44; or if the user agent has information that would facilitate the selection of specific audio tracks to improve the user&#39;s experience&#58; if this audio track is one of the ones to enable&#44; then set <var>enable</var> to <em>true</em>&#44; otherwise&#44; set <var>enable</var> to <em>false</em>&#46;

        <strong>Example&#58;</strong>

        This could be triggered by <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;fragment&#45;syntax"></a>[media fragment syntax](https://www.w3.org/TR/media-frags/#media-fragment-syntax)&#44; but it could also be triggered e&#46;g&#46; by the user agent selecting a 5&#46;1 surround sound audio track over a stereo audio track&#46;

    5.  If <var>enable</var> is still <em>unknown</em>&#44; then&#44; if the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;61"></a>[media element](#media-element) does not yet have an <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;audiotrack&#45;enabled"></a>[enabled](#dom-audiotrack-enabled) audio track&#44; then set <var>enable</var> to <em>true</em>&#44; otherwise&#44; set <var>enable</var> to <em>false</em>&#46;

    6.  If <var>enable</var> is <em>true</em>&#44; then enable this audio track&#44; otherwise&#44; do not enable this audio track&#46;

    7.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;11"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;addtrack"></a><code>[addtrack](#event-media-addtrack)</code> at this <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;audiotracklist&#45;2"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> object&#44; using <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;trackevent"></a><code>[TrackEvent](#trackevent)</code>&#44; with the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;trackevent&#45;track"></a><code>[track](#dom-trackevent-track)</code> attribute initialized to the new <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;audiotrack&#45;3"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> object&#46;

    <a id="found&#45;another&#45;video&#45;track"></a><strong>If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;10"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is found to have a video track</strong>

    1.  Create a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;videotrack"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> object to represent the video track&#46;

    2.  Update the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;62"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;videotracks"></a><code>[videoTracks](#dom-media-videotracks)</code> attribute&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;videotracklist"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> object with the new <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;videotrack&#45;2"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> object&#46;

    3.  Let <var>enable</var> be <em>unknown</em>&#46;

    4.  If either the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;11"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) or the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;url&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) of the <var>current media resource</var> indicate a particular set of video tracks to enable&#44; or if the user agent has information that would facilitate the selection of specific video tracks to improve the user&#39;s experience&#58; if this video track is the first such video track&#44; then set <var>enable</var> to <em>true</em>&#44; otherwise&#44; set <var>enable</var> to <em>false</em>&#46;

        <strong>Example&#58;</strong>

        This could again be triggered by <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;fragment&#45;syntax&#45;2"></a>[media fragment syntax](https://www.w3.org/TR/media-frags/#media-fragment-syntax)&#46;

    5.  If <var>enable</var> is still <em>unknown</em>&#44; then&#44; if the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;63"></a>[media element](#media-element) does not yet have a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;videotrack&#45;selected"></a>[selected](#dom-videotrack-selected) video track&#44; then set <var>enable</var> to <em>true</em>&#44; otherwise&#44; set <var>enable</var> to <em>false</em>&#46;

    6.  If <var>enable</var> is <em>true</em>&#44; then select this track and unselect any previously selected video tracks&#44; otherwise&#44; do not select this video track&#46; If other tracks are unselected&#44; then [a <code>change</code> event will be fired](#toggle-video-track)&#46;

    7.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;12"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;addtrack&#45;2"></a><code>[addtrack](#event-media-addtrack)</code> at this <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;videotracklist&#45;2"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> object&#44; using <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;trackevent&#45;2"></a><code>[TrackEvent](#trackevent)</code>&#44; with the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;trackevent&#45;track&#45;2"></a><code>[track](#dom-trackevent-track)</code> attribute initialized to the new <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;videotrack&#45;3"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> object&#46;

    <a id="getting&#45;media&#45;metadata"></a><strong>Once enough of the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;9"></a>[media data](#media-data) has been fetched to determine the duration of the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;12"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; its dimensions&#44; and other metadata</strong>

    This indicates that the resource is usable&#46; The user agent must follow these substeps&#58;

    1.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;defineTimeline"></a>[Establish the media timeline](#defineTimeline) for the purposes of the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;2"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) and the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;earliest&#45;possible&#45;position"></a>[earliest possible position](#earliest-possible-position)&#44; based on the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;10"></a>[media data](#media-data)&#46;

    2.  Update the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;timeline&#45;offset&#45;2"></a>[timeline offset](#timeline-offset) to the date and time that corresponds to the zero time in the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;timeline"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline) established in the previous step&#44; if any&#46; If no explicit time and date is given by the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;13"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;timeline&#45;offset&#45;3"></a>[timeline offset](#timeline-offset) must be set to Not&#45;a&#45;Number &#40;NaN&#41;&#46;

    3.  Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;3"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) and the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;official&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;3"></a>[official playback position](#official-playback-position) to the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;earliest&#45;possible&#45;position&#45;2"></a>[earliest possible position](#earliest-possible-position)&#46;

    4.  Update the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;duration&#45;2"></a><code>[duration](#dom-media-duration)</code> attribute with the time of the last frame of the resource&#44; if known&#44; on the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;timeline&#45;2"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline) established above&#46; If it is not known &#40;e&#46;g&#46; a stream that is in principle infinite&#41;&#44; update the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;duration&#45;3"></a><code>[duration](#dom-media-duration)</code> attribute to the value positive Infinity&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        The user agent [will](#durationChange) <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;18"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;64"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;13"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;durationchange&#45;2"></a><code>[durationchange](#event-media-durationchange)</code> at the element at this point&#46;

    5.  For <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> elements&#44; set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;video&#45;videowidth"></a><code>[videoWidth](#dom-video-videowidth)</code> and <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;video&#45;videoheight"></a><code>[videoHeight](#dom-video-videoheight)</code> attributes&#44; and <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;19"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;65"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;14"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;resize"></a><code>[resize](#event-media-resize)</code> at the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;66"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        Further <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;resize&#45;2"></a><code>[resize](#event-media-resize)</code> events will be fired if the dimensions subsequently change&#46;

    6.  Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;2"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;metadata"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;METADATA](#dom-media-have_metadata)</code>&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        A <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;loadedmetadata"></a><code>[loadedmetadata](#event-media-loadedmetadata)</code> DOM event [will be fired](#fire-loadedmetadata) as part of setting the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;3"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute to a new value&#46;

    7.  Let <var>jumped</var> be false&#46;

    8.  If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;67"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;default&#45;playback&#45;start&#45;position"></a>[default playback start position](#default-playback-start-position) is greater than zero&#44; then <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seek"></a>[seek](#dom-media-seek) to that time&#44; and let <var>jumped</var> be true&#46;

    9.  Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;68"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;default&#45;playback&#45;start&#45;position&#45;2"></a>[default playback start position](#default-playback-start-position) to zero&#46;

    10. Let the <var>initial playback position</var> be 0&#46;

    11. If either the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;14"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) or the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;url&#45;3"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) of the <var>current media resource</var> indicate a particular start time&#44; then set the <var>initial playback position</var> to that time and&#44; if <var>jumped</var> is still false&#44; <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seek&#45;2"></a>[seek](#dom-media-seek) to that time&#46;

        <strong>Example&#58;</strong>

        For example&#44; with media formats that support <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;fragment&#45;syntax&#45;3"></a>[media fragment syntax](https://www.w3.org/TR/media-frags/#media-fragment-syntax)&#44; the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;fragment"></a>[fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment) can be used to indicate a start position&#46;

    12. If there is no <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;audiotrack&#45;enabled&#45;2"></a>[enabled](#dom-audiotrack-enabled) audio track&#44; then enable an audio track&#46; This [will cause a <code>change</code> event to be fired](#toggle-audio-track)&#46;

    13. If there is no <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;videotrack&#45;selected&#45;2"></a>[selected](#dom-videotrack-selected) video track&#44; then select a video track&#46; This [will cause a <code>change</code> event to be fired](#toggle-video-track)&#46;

    Once the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;4"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute reaches <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;current&#95;data"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;CURRENT&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_current_data)</code>&#44; [after the <code>loadeddata</code> event has been fired](#fire-loadeddata)&#44; set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;flag&#45;10"></a>[delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event flag](#delaying-the-load-event-flag) to false&#46; This stops <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;10"></a>[delaying the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event)&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    A user agent that is attempting to reduce network usage while still fetching the metadata for each <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;15"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) would also stop buffering at this point&#44; following [the rules described previously](#resourceSuspend)&#44; which involve the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;13"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> attribute switching to the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;idle&#45;4"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;IDLE](#dom-media-network_idle)</code> value and a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;suspend&#45;4"></a><code>[suspend](#event-media-suspend)</code> event firing&#46;
    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    The user agent is <em>required</em> to determine the duration of the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;16"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) and go through this step before playing&#46;
    <strong>Once the entire <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;17"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) has been fetched &#40;but potentially before any of it has been decoded&#41;</strong>

    <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;15"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;progress&#45;3"></a><code>[progress](#event-media-progress)</code> at the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;69"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

    Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;14"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;idle&#45;5"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;IDLE](#dom-media-network_idle)</code> and <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;16"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;suspend&#45;5"></a><code>[suspend](#event-media-suspend)</code> at the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;70"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

    If the user agent ever discards any <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;11"></a>[media data](#media-data) and then needs to resume the network activity to obtain it again&#44; then it must <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;20"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;71"></a>[media element](#media-element) to set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;15"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;loading&#45;6"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;LOADING](#dom-media-network_loading)</code>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    If the user agent can keep the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;18"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) loaded&#44; then the algorithm will continue to its <em>final step</em> below&#44; which aborts the algorithm&#46;
    <strong>If the connection is interrupted after some <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;12"></a>[media data](#media-data) has been received&#44; causing the user agent to give up trying to fetch the resource</strong>

    Fatal network errors that occur after the user agent has established whether the <var>current media resource</var> is usable &#40;i&#46;e&#46; once the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;72"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;5"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute is no longer <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;nothing&#45;2"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;NOTHING](#dom-media-have_nothing)</code>&#41; must cause the user agent to execute the following steps&#58;

    1.  The user agent should cancel the fetching process&#46;

    2.  Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;error&#45;3"></a><code>[error](#dom-media-error)</code> attribute to the result of <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;creating&#45;a&#45;mediaerror&#45;2"></a>[creating a <code>MediaError</code>](#creating-a-mediaerror) with <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;mediaerror&#45;media&#95;err&#95;network"></a><code>[MEDIA&#95;ERR&#95;NETWORK](#dom-mediaerror-media_err_network)</code>&#46;

    3.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;16"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> attribute to the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;idle&#45;6"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;IDLE](#dom-media-network_idle)</code> value&#46;

    4.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;flag&#45;11"></a>[delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event flag](#delaying-the-load-event-flag) to false&#46; This stops <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;11"></a>[delaying the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event)&#46;

    5.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;17"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;error&#45;2"></a><code>[error](#event-media-error)</code> at the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;73"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

    6.  Abort the overall <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm&#45;4"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm)&#46;

    <a id="fatal&#45;decode&#45;error"></a><strong>If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;13"></a>[media data](#media-data) is corrupted</strong>

    Fatal errors in decoding the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;14"></a>[media data](#media-data) that occur after the user agent has established whether the <var>current media resource</var> is usable &#40;i&#46;e&#46; once the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;74"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;6"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute is no longer <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;nothing&#45;3"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;NOTHING](#dom-media-have_nothing)</code>&#41; must cause the user agent to execute the following steps&#58;

    1.  The user agent should cancel the fetching process&#46;

    2.  Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;error&#45;4"></a><code>[error](#dom-media-error)</code> attribute to the result of <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;creating&#45;a&#45;mediaerror&#45;3"></a>[creating a <code>MediaError</code>](#creating-a-mediaerror) with <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;mediaerror&#45;media&#95;err&#95;decode"></a><code>[MEDIA&#95;ERR&#95;DECODE](#dom-mediaerror-media_err_decode)</code>&#46;

    3.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;17"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> attribute to the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;idle&#45;7"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;IDLE](#dom-media-network_idle)</code> value&#46;

    4.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;flag&#45;12"></a>[delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event flag](#delaying-the-load-event-flag) to false&#46; This stops <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;12"></a>[delaying the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event)&#46;

    5.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;18"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;error&#45;3"></a><code>[error](#event-media-error)</code> at the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;75"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

    6.  Abort the overall <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm&#45;5"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm)&#46;

    <strong>If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;15"></a>[media data](#media-data) fetching process is aborted by the user</strong>

    The fetching process is aborted by the user&#44; e&#46;g&#46; because the user pressed a &#34;stop&#34; button&#44; the user agent must execute the following steps&#46; These steps are not followed if the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;load"></a><code>[load&#40;&#41;](#dom-media-load)</code> method itself is invoked while these steps are running&#44; as the steps above handle that particular kind of abort&#46;

    1.  The user agent should cancel the fetching process&#46;

    2.  Set the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;error&#45;5"></a><code>[error](#dom-media-error)</code> attribute to the result of <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;creating&#45;a&#45;mediaerror&#45;4"></a>[creating a <code>MediaError</code>](#creating-a-mediaerror) with <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;mediaerror&#45;media&#95;err&#95;aborted"></a><code>[MEDIA&#95;ERR&#95;ABORTED](#dom-mediaerror-media_err_aborted)</code>&#46;

    3.  <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;19"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;abort&#45;2"></a><code>[abort](#event-media-abort)</code> at the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;76"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

    4.  If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;77"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;7"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute has a value equal to <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;nothing&#45;4"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;NOTHING](#dom-media-have_nothing)</code>&#44; set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;18"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> attribute to the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;empty&#45;3"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;EMPTY](#dom-media-network_empty)</code> value&#44; set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;show&#45;poster&#45;flag&#45;4"></a>[show poster flag](#show-poster-flag) to true&#44; and <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;20"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;emptied&#45;2"></a><code>[emptied](#event-media-emptied)</code> at the element&#46;

        Otherwise&#44; set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;19"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> attribute to the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;idle&#45;8"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;IDLE](#dom-media-network_idle)</code> value&#46;

    5.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;flag&#45;13"></a>[delaying&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event flag](#delaying-the-load-event-flag) to false&#46; This stops <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event&#45;13"></a>[delaying the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event)&#46;

    6.  Abort the overall <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm&#45;6"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm)&#46;

    <a id="non&#45;fatal&#45;media&#45;error"></a><strong>If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;16"></a>[media data](#media-data) can be fetched but has non&#45;fatal errors or uses&#44; in part&#44; codecs that are unsupported&#44; preventing the user agent from rendering the content completely correctly but not preventing playback altogether</strong>

    The server returning data that is partially usable but cannot be optimally rendered must cause the user agent to render just the bits it can handle&#44; and ignore the rest&#46;

    <a id="found&#45;a&#45;media&#45;resource&#45;specific&#45;timed&#45;track"></a><strong>If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;19"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is found to declare a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;specific&#45;text&#45;track&#45;2"></a>[media&#45;resource&#45;specific text track](#media-resource-specific-text-track) that the user agent supports</strong>

    If the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;17"></a>[media data](#media-data) is <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;cors&#45;same&#45;origin&#45;3"></a>[CORS&#45;same&#45;origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#cors-same-origin)&#44; run the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;steps&#45;to&#45;expose&#45;a&#45;media&#45;resource&#45;specific&#45;text&#45;track"></a>[steps to expose a media&#45;resource&#45;specific text track](#steps-to-expose-a-media-resource-specific-text-track) with the relevant data&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    Cross&#45;origin videos do not expose their subtitles&#44; since that would allow attacks such as hostile sites reading subtitles from confidential videos on a user&#39;s intranet&#46;

7.  <em>Final step</em>&#58; If the user agent ever reaches this step &#40;which can only happen if the entire resource gets loaded and kept available&#41;&#58; abort the overall <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm&#45;7"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm)&#46;

When a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;78"></a>[media element](#media-element) is to <a id="forget&#45;the&#45;media&#45;element&#39;s&#45;media&#45;resource&#45;specific&#45;tracks"></a><strong>forget the media element&#39;s media&#45;resource&#45;specific tracks</strong>&#44; the user agent must remove from the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;79"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks) all the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;specific&#45;text&#45;track&#45;3"></a>[media&#45;resource&#45;specific text tracks](#media-resource-specific-text-track)&#44; then empty the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;80"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;audiotracks&#45;2"></a><code>[audioTracks](#dom-media-audiotracks)</code> attribute&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;audiotracklist&#45;3"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> object&#44; then empty the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;81"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;videotracks&#45;2"></a><code>[videoTracks](#dom-media-videotracks)</code> attribute&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;videotracklist&#45;3"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> object&#46; No events &#40;in particular&#44; no <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;removetrack"></a><code>[removetrack](#event-media-removetrack)</code> events&#41; are fired as part of this&#59; the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;error&#45;4"></a><code>[error](#event-media-error)</code> and <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;emptied&#45;3"></a><code>[emptied](#event-media-emptied)</code> events&#44; fired by the algorithms that invoke this one&#44; can be used instead&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="attr&#45;media&#45;preload"></a><strong><code>preload</code></strong> attribute is an <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;enumerated&#45;attribute"></a>[enumerated attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#enumerated-attribute) with the following keywords and states&#58;

<table><thead><tr><th>Keyword      </th><th>State      </th><th>Brief description    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="audio/preload,video/preload" id="attr-media-preload-auto" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>auto</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-media-preload-auto-state">Automatic</dfn>      </td><td>Hints to the user agent that the user agent can put the user&#39;s needs first without risk to the server&#44; up to and including optimistically downloading the entire resource&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="audio/preload,video/preload" id="attr-media-preload-none" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>none</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-media-preload-none-state">None</dfn>      </td><td>Hints to the user agent that either the author does not expect the user to need the media resource&#44; or that the server wants to minimize unnecessary traffic&#46;          This state does not provide a hint regarding how aggressively to actually download the media resource if buffering starts anyway &#40;e&#46;g&#46; once the user hits &#34;play&#34;&#41;&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="audio/preload,video/preload" id="attr-media-preload-metadata" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>metadata</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-media-preload-metadata-state">Metadata</dfn>      </td><td>Hints to the user agent that the author does not expect the user to need the media resource&#44; but that fetching the resource metadata &#40;dimensions&#44; track list&#44; duration&#44; etc&#46;&#41;&#44; and maybe even the first few frames&#44; is reasonable&#46; If the user agent precisely fetches no more than the metadata&#44; then the <a href="#media-element" id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-82">media element</a> will end up with its <code id="loading-the-media-resource:dom-media-readystate-8"><a href="#dom-media-readystate">readyState</a></code> attribute set to <code id="loading-the-media-resource:dom-media-have_metadata-2"><a href="#dom-media-have_metadata">HAVE&#95;METADATA</a></code>&#59; typically though&#44; some frames will be obtained as well and it will probably be <code id="loading-the-media-resource:dom-media-have_current_data-2"><a href="#dom-media-have_current_data">HAVE&#95;CURRENT&#95;DATA</a></code> or <code id="loading-the-media-resource:dom-media-have_future_data"><a href="#dom-media-have_future_data">HAVE&#95;FUTURE&#95;DATA</a></code>&#46;          When the media resource is playing&#44; hints to the user agent that bandwidth is to be considered scarce&#44; e&#46;g&#46; suggesting throttling the download so that the media data is obtained at the slowest possible rate that still maintains consistent playback&#46;   </td></tr></tbody></table>

The attribute&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;empty&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[empty value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#empty-value-default)</em> is the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload&#45;auto&#45;state"></a>[Automatic](#attr-media-preload-auto-state) state&#46;

The attribute&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;missing&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[missing value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#missing-value-default)</em> and <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;invalid&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[invalid value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#invalid-value-default)</em> are both <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;implementation&#45;defined&#45;4"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined)&#44; though the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload&#45;metadata&#45;state"></a>[Metadata](#attr-media-preload-metadata-state) state is suggested as a compromise between reducing server load and providing an optimal user experience&#46;

The attribute can be changed even once the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;20"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is being buffered or played&#59; the descriptions in the table above are to be interpreted with that in mind&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Authors might switch the attribute from &#34;<a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload&#45;none&#45;2"></a><code>[none](#attr-media-preload-none)</code>&#34; or &#34;<a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload&#45;metadata"></a><code>[metadata](#attr-media-preload-metadata)</code>&#34; to &#34;<a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload&#45;auto"></a><code>[auto](#attr-media-preload-auto)</code>&#34; dynamically once the user begins playback&#46; For example&#44; on a page with many videos this might be used to indicate that the many videos are not to be downloaded unless requested&#44; but that once one <em>is</em> requested it is to be downloaded aggressively&#46;

The <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload&#45;3"></a><code>[preload](#attr-media-preload)</code> attribute is intended to provide a hint to the user agent about what the author thinks will lead to the best user experience&#46; The attribute may be ignored altogether&#44; for example based on explicit user preferences or based on the available connectivity&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;preload"></a><strong><code>preload</code></strong> IDL attribute must <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;reflect"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the content attribute of the same name&#44; <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values"></a>[limited to only known values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#limited-to-only-known-values)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;autoplay&#45;2"></a><code>[autoplay](#attr-media-autoplay)</code> attribute can override the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload&#45;4"></a><code>[preload](#attr-media-preload)</code> attribute &#40;since if the media plays&#44; it naturally has to buffer first&#44; regardless of the hint given by the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload&#45;5"></a><code>[preload](#attr-media-preload)</code> attribute&#41;&#46; Including both is not an error&#44; however&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> and <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> elements&#44; if <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;script"></a>[scripting is enabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-script)&#44; the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;loading"></a><code>[loading](#attr-media-loading)</code> attribute can defer the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;preload&#45;6"></a><code>[preload](#attr-media-preload)</code> attribute&#39;s hinted behavior until the element&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps&#45;4"></a>[lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-load-resumption-steps) are run&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<strong><code><var>media</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;media&#45;buffered&#45;dev"></a>[buffered](#dom-media-buffered)</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLMediaElement&#47;buffered](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLMediaElement/buffered)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox4&#43;Safari3&#46;1&#43;Chrome3&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS3&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns a <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;timeranges"></a><code>[TimeRanges](#timeranges)</code> object that represents the ranges of the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;21"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) that the user agent has buffered&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;buffered"></a><strong><code>buffered</code></strong> getter steps are to return a new <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;normalised&#45;timeranges&#45;object"></a>[normalized <code>TimeRanges</code> object](#normalised-timeranges-object) that represents the ranges of <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;22"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; if any&#44; that the user agent has buffered&#46; User agents must accurately determine the ranges available&#44; even for media streams where this can only be determined by tedious inspection&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Typically this will be a single range anchored at the zero point&#44; but if&#44; e&#46;g&#46; the user agent uses HTTP range requests in response to seeking&#44; then there could be multiple ranges&#46;

User agents may discard previously buffered data&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Thus&#44; a time position included within a range of the objects return by the <a id="loading&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;buffered"></a><code>[buffered](#dom-media-buffered)</code> attribute at one time can end up being not included in the range&#40;s&#41; of objects returned by the same attribute at later times&#46;

<strong>Warning&#58;</strong>

Returning a new object each time is a bad pattern for attribute getters and is only enshrined here as it would be costly to change it&#46; It is not to be copied to new APIs&#46;

##### <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;6 Offsets into the media resource[](#offsets-into-the-media-resource)

<strong><code><var>media</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;media&#45;duration&#45;dev"></a>[duration](#dom-media-duration)</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLMediaElement&#47;duration](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLMediaElement/duration)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox3&#46;5&#43;Safari3&#46;1&#43;Chrome3&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS3&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns the length of the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; in seconds&#44; assuming that the start of the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is at time zero&#46;

Returns NaN if the duration isn&#39;t available&#46;

Returns Infinity for unbounded streams&#46;

<strong><code><var>media</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;media&#45;currenttime&#45;dev"></a>[currentTime](#dom-media-currenttime) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLMediaElement&#47;currentTime](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLMediaElement/currentTime)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox3&#46;5&#43;Safari3&#46;1&#43;Chrome3&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS3&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;official&#45;playback&#45;position"></a>[official playback position](#official-playback-position)&#44; in seconds&#46;

Can be set&#44; to seek to the given time&#46;

A <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;3"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) has a <a id="media&#45;timeline"></a><strong>media timeline</strong> that maps times &#40;in seconds&#41; to positions in the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;4"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#46; The origin of a timeline is its earliest defined position&#46; The duration of a timeline is its last defined position&#46;

<a id="defineTimeline"></a><strong>Establishing the media timeline</strong>&#58; if the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;5"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) somehow specifies an explicit timeline whose origin is not negative &#40;i&#46;e&#46; gives each frame a specific time offset and gives the first frame a zero or positive offset&#41;&#44; then the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;timeline"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline) should be that timeline&#46; &#40;Whether the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;6"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) can specify a timeline or not depends on the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;7"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#39;s format&#46;&#41; If the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;8"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) specifies an explicit start time <em>and date</em>&#44; then that time and date should be considered the zero point in the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;timeline&#45;2"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline)&#59; the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;timeline&#45;offset"></a>[timeline offset](#timeline-offset) will be the time and date&#44; exposed using the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;getstartdate"></a><code>[getStartDate&#40;&#41;](#dom-media-getstartdate)</code> method&#46;

If the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;9"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) has a discontinuous timeline&#44; the user agent must extend the timeline used at the start of the resource across the entire resource&#44; so that the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;timeline&#45;3"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline) of the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;10"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) increases linearly starting from the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;earliest&#45;possible&#45;position"></a>[earliest possible position](#earliest-possible-position) &#40;as defined below&#41;&#44; even if the underlying <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data"></a>[media data](#media-data) has out&#45;of&#45;order or even overlapping time codes&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; if two clips have been concatenated into one video file&#44; but the video format exposes the original times for the two clips&#44; the video data might expose a timeline that goes&#44; say&#44; 00&#58;15&#46;&#46;00&#58;29 and then 00&#58;05&#46;&#46;00&#58;38&#46; However&#44; the user agent would not expose those times&#59; it would instead expose the times as 00&#58;15&#46;&#46;00&#58;29 and 00&#58;29&#46;&#46;01&#58;02&#44; as a single video&#46;

<a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;tracking&#45;vector"></a>[![&#40;This is a tracking vector&#46;&#41;](https://resources.whatwg.org/tracking-vector.svg)](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#tracking-vector) In the rare case of a <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;11"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) that does not have an explicit timeline&#44; the zero time on the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;timeline&#45;4"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline) should correspond to the first frame of the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;12"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#46; In the even rarer case of a <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;13"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) with no explicit timings of any kind&#44; not even frame durations&#44; the user agent must itself determine the time for each frame in an <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;implementation&#45;defined"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined) manner&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

An example of a file format with no explicit timeline but with explicit frame durations is the Animated GIF format&#46; An example of a file format with no explicit timings at all is the JPEG&#45;push format &#40;<a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;multipart&#47;x&#45;mixed&#45;replace"></a><code>[multipart&#47;x&#45;mixed&#45;replace](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#multipart/x-mixed-replace)</code> with JPEG frames&#44; often used as the format for MJPEG streams&#41;&#46;

If&#44; in the case of a resource with no timing information&#44; the user agent will nonetheless be able to seek to an earlier point than the first frame originally provided by the server&#44; then the zero time should correspond to the earliest seekable time of the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;14"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#59; otherwise&#44; it should correspond to the first frame received from the server &#40;the point in the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;15"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) at which the user agent began receiving the stream&#41;&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

At the time of writing&#44; there is no known format that lacks explicit frame time offsets yet still supports seeking to a frame before the first frame sent by the server&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Consider a stream from a TV broadcaster&#44; which begins streaming on a sunny Friday afternoon in October&#44; and always sends connecting user agents the media data on the same media timeline&#44; with its zero time set to the start of this stream&#46; Months later&#44; user agents connecting to this stream will find that the first frame they receive has a time with millions of seconds&#46; The <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;getstartdate&#45;2"></a><code>[getStartDate&#40;&#41;](#dom-media-getstartdate)</code> method would always return the date that the broadcast started&#59; this would allow controllers to display real times in their scrubber &#40;e&#46;g&#46; &#34;2&#58;30pm&#34;&#41; rather than a time relative to when the broadcast began &#40;&#34;8 months&#44; 4 hours&#44; 12 minutes&#44; and 23 seconds&#34;&#41;&#46;

Consider a stream that carries a video with several concatenated fragments&#44; broadcast by a server that does not allow user agents to request specific times but instead just streams the video data in a predetermined order&#44; with the first frame delivered always being identified as the frame with time zero&#46; If a user agent connects to this stream and receives fragments defined as covering timestamps 2010&#45;03&#45;20 23&#58;15&#58;00 UTC to 2010&#45;03&#45;21 00&#58;05&#58;00 UTC and 2010&#45;02&#45;12 14&#58;25&#58;00 UTC to 2010&#45;02&#45;12 14&#58;35&#58;00 UTC&#44; it would expose this with a <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;timeline&#45;5"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline) starting at 0s and extending to 3&#44;600s &#40;one hour&#41;&#46; Assuming the streaming server disconnected at the end of the second clip&#44; the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;duration"></a><code>[duration](#dom-media-duration)</code> attribute would then return 3&#44;600&#46; The <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;getstartdate&#45;3"></a><code>[getStartDate&#40;&#41;](#dom-media-getstartdate)</code> method would return a <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;date"></a><code>[Date](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-date-objects)</code> object with a time corresponding to 2010&#45;03&#45;20 23&#58;15&#58;00 UTC&#46; However&#44; if a different user agent connected five minutes later&#44; <em>it</em> would &#40;presumably&#41; receive fragments covering timestamps 2010&#45;03&#45;20 23&#58;20&#58;00 UTC to 2010&#45;03&#45;21 00&#58;05&#58;00 UTC and 2010&#45;02&#45;12 14&#58;25&#58;00 UTC to 2010&#45;02&#45;12 14&#58;35&#58;00 UTC&#44; and would expose this with a <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;timeline&#45;6"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline) starting at 0s and extending to 3&#44;300s &#40;fifty five minutes&#41;&#46; In this case&#44; the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;getstartdate&#45;4"></a><code>[getStartDate&#40;&#41;](#dom-media-getstartdate)</code> method would return a <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;date&#45;2"></a><code>[Date](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-date-objects)</code> object with a time corresponding to 2010&#45;03&#45;20 23&#58;20&#58;00 UTC&#46;

In both of these examples&#44; the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seekable"></a><code>[seekable](#dom-media-seekable)</code> attribute would give the ranges that the controller would want to actually display in its UI&#59; typically&#44; if the servers don&#39;t support seeking to arbitrary times&#44; this would be the range of time from the moment the user agent connected to the stream up to the latest frame that the user agent has obtained&#59; however&#44; if the user agent starts discarding earlier information&#44; the actual range might be shorter&#46;

In any case&#44; the user agent must ensure that the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;earliest&#45;possible&#45;position&#45;2"></a>[earliest possible position](#earliest-possible-position) &#40;as defined below&#41; using the established <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;timeline&#45;7"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline)&#44; is greater than or equal to zero&#46;

The <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;timeline&#45;8"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline) also has an associated clock&#46; Which clock is used is user&#45;agent defined&#44; and may be <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;16"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#45;dependent&#44; but it should approximate the user&#39;s wall clock&#46;

<a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[Media elements](#media-element) have a <a id="current&#45;playback&#45;position"></a><strong>current playback position</strong>&#44; which must initially &#40;i&#46;e&#46; in the absence of <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;2"></a>[media data](#media-data)&#41; be zero seconds&#46; The <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) is a time on the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;timeline&#45;9"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline)&#46;

<a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[Media elements](#media-element) also have an <a id="official&#45;playback&#45;position"></a><strong>official playback position</strong>&#44; which must initially be set to zero seconds&#46; The <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;official&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;2"></a>[official playback position](#official-playback-position) is an approximation of the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;2"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) that is kept stable while scripts are running&#46;

<a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[Media elements](#media-element) also have a <a id="default&#45;playback&#45;start&#45;position"></a><strong>default playback start position</strong>&#44; which must initially be set to zero seconds&#46; This time is used to allow the element to be seeked even before the media is loaded&#46;

Each <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[media element](#media-element) has a <a id="show&#45;poster&#45;flag"></a><strong>show poster flag</strong>&#46; When a <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[media element](#media-element) is created&#44; this flag must be set to true&#46; This flag is used to control when the user agent is to show a poster frame for a <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element instead of showing the video contents&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;currenttime"></a><strong><code>currentTime</code></strong> attribute must&#44; on getting&#44; return the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;default&#45;playback&#45;start&#45;position"></a>[default playback start position](#default-playback-start-position)&#44; unless that is zero&#44; in which case it must return the element&#39;s <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;official&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;3"></a>[official playback position](#official-playback-position)&#46; The returned value must be expressed in seconds&#46; On setting&#44; if the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> is <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;nothing"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;NOTHING](#dom-media-have_nothing)</code>&#44; then it must set the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;8"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;default&#45;playback&#45;start&#45;position&#45;2"></a>[default playback start position](#default-playback-start-position) to the new value&#59; otherwise&#44; it must set the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;official&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;4"></a>[official playback position](#official-playback-position) to the new value and then <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seek"></a>[seek](#dom-media-seek) to the new value&#46; The new value must be interpreted as being in seconds&#46;

If the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;17"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is a streaming resource&#44; then the user agent might be unable to obtain certain parts of the resource after it has expired from its buffer&#46; Similarly&#44; some <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;18"></a>[media resources](#media-resource) might have a <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;timeline&#45;10"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline) that doesn&#39;t start at zero&#46; The <a id="earliest&#45;possible&#45;position"></a><strong>earliest possible position</strong> is the earliest position in the stream or resource that the user agent can ever obtain again&#46; It is also a time on the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;timeline&#45;11"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;earliest&#45;possible&#45;position&#45;3"></a>[earliest possible position](#earliest-possible-position) is not explicitly exposed in the API&#59; it corresponds to the start time of the first range in the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seekable&#45;2"></a><code>[seekable](#dom-media-seekable)</code> attribute&#39;s <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;timeranges"></a><code>[TimeRanges](#timeranges)</code> object&#44; if any&#44; or the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;3"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) otherwise&#46;

When the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;earliest&#45;possible&#45;position&#45;4"></a>[earliest possible position](#earliest-possible-position) changes&#58; if the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;4"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) is before the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;earliest&#45;possible&#45;position&#45;5"></a>[earliest possible position](#earliest-possible-position)&#44; the user agent must <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seek&#45;2"></a>[seek](#dom-media-seek) to the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;earliest&#45;possible&#45;position&#45;6"></a>[earliest possible position](#earliest-possible-position)&#59; otherwise&#44; if the user agent has not fired a <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;timeupdate"></a><code>[timeupdate](#event-media-timeupdate)</code> event at the element in the past 15 to 250ms and is not still running event handlers for such an event&#44; then the user agent must <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;9"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;timeupdate&#45;2"></a><code>[timeupdate](#event-media-timeupdate)</code> at the element&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Because of the above requirement and the requirement in the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;resource"></a>[resource fetch algorithm](#concept-media-load-resource) that kicks in [when the metadata of the clip becomes known](#getting-media-metadata)&#44; the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;5"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) can never be less than the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;earliest&#45;possible&#45;position&#45;7"></a>[earliest possible position](#earliest-possible-position)&#46;

If at any time the user agent learns that an audio or video track has ended and all <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;3"></a>[media data](#media-data) relating to that track corresponds to parts of the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;timeline&#45;12"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline) that are <em>before</em> the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;earliest&#45;possible&#45;position&#45;8"></a>[earliest possible position](#earliest-possible-position)&#44; the user agent may <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;10"></a>[media element](#media-element) to run these steps&#58;

1.  Remove the track from the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;audiotracks"></a><code>[audioTracks](#dom-media-audiotracks)</code> attribute&#39;s <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;audiotracklist"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> object or the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;videotracks"></a><code>[videoTracks](#dom-media-videotracks)</code> attribute&#39;s <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;videotracklist"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> object as appropriate&#46;

2.  <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;removetrack"></a><code>[removetrack](#event-media-removetrack)</code> at the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;11"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s aforementioned <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;audiotracklist&#45;2"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> or <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;videotracklist&#45;2"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> object&#44; using <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;trackevent"></a><code>[TrackEvent](#trackevent)</code>&#44; with the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;trackevent&#45;track"></a><code>[track](#dom-trackevent-track)</code> attribute initialized to the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;audiotrack"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> or <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;videotrack"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> object representing the track&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;duration"></a><strong><code>duration</code></strong> attribute must return the time of the end of the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;19"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; in seconds&#44; on the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;timeline&#45;13"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline)&#46; If no <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;4"></a>[media data](#media-data) is available&#44; then the attributes must return the Not&#45;a&#45;Number &#40;NaN&#41; value&#46; If the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;20"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is not known to be bounded &#40;e&#46;g&#46; streaming radio&#44; or a live event with no announced end time&#41;&#44; then the attribute must return the positive Infinity value&#46;
