The user agent must determine the duration of the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;21"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) before playing any part of the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data&#45;5"></a>[media data](#media-data) and before setting <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;2"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> to a value greater than or equal to <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;metadata"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;METADATA](#dom-media-have_metadata)</code>&#44; even if doing so requires fetching multiple parts of the resource&#46;

<a id="durationChange"></a>When the length of the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;22"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) changes to a known value &#40;e&#46;g&#46; from being unknown to known&#44; or from a previously established length to a new length&#41;&#44; the user agent must <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;12"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;3"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;durationchange"></a><code>[durationchange](#event-media-durationchange)</code> at the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;13"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46; &#40;The event is not fired when the duration is reset as part of loading a new media resource&#46;&#41; If the duration is changed such that the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;6"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) ends up being greater than the time of the end of the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;23"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; then the user agent must also <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seek&#45;3"></a>[seek](#dom-media-seek) to the time of the end of the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;24"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

If an &#34;infinite&#34; stream ends for some reason&#44; then the duration would change from positive Infinity to the time of the last frame or sample in the stream&#44; and the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;durationchange&#45;2"></a><code>[durationchange](#event-media-durationchange)</code> event would be fired&#46; Similarly&#44; if the user agent initially estimated the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;25"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#39;s duration instead of determining it precisely&#44; and later revises the estimate based on new information&#44; then the duration would change and the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;durationchange&#45;3"></a><code>[durationchange](#event-media-durationchange)</code> event would be fired&#46;

Some video files also have an explicit date and time corresponding to the zero time in the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;timeline&#45;14"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline)&#44; known as the <a id="timeline&#45;offset"></a><strong>timeline offset</strong>&#46; Initially&#44; the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;timeline&#45;offset&#45;2"></a>[timeline offset](#timeline-offset) must be set to Not&#45;a&#45;Number &#40;NaN&#41;&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;getstartdate"></a><strong><code>getStartDate&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method must return <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;create&#45;a&#45;date&#45;object"></a>[a new <code>Date</code> object](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#create-a-date-object) representing the current <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;timeline&#45;offset&#45;3"></a>[timeline offset](#timeline-offset)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="attr&#45;media&#45;loop"></a><strong><code>loop</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute) that&#44; if specified&#44; indicates that the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;14"></a>[media element](#media-element) is to seek back to the start of the <a id="offsets&#45;into&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;26"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) upon reaching the end&#46;

##### <a id="ready&#45;states"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;7 Ready states[](#ready-states)

<strong><code><var>media</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;dev"></a>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLMediaElement&#47;readyState](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLMediaElement/readyState)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox3&#46;5&#43;Safari3&#46;1&#43;Chrome3&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer5&#46;5&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS3&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns a value that expresses the current state of the element with respect to rendering the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#44; from the codes in the list below&#46;

<a id="ready&#45;states&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[Media elements](#media-element) have a <em>ready state</em>&#44; which describes to what degree they are ready to be rendered at the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;2"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#46; The possible values are as follows&#59; the ready state of a media element at any particular time is the greatest value describing the state of the element&#58;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;nothing"></a><strong><code>HAVE&#95;NOTHING</code></strong> &#40;numeric value 0&#41;</strong>

No information regarding the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is available&#46; No data for the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;3"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) is available&#46; <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;media&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[Media elements](#media-element) whose <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> attribute are set to <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;empty"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;EMPTY](#dom-media-network_empty)</code> are always in the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;nothing"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;NOTHING](#dom-media-have_nothing)</code> state&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;metadata"></a><strong><code>HAVE&#95;METADATA</code></strong> &#40;numeric value 1&#41;</strong>

Enough of the resource has been obtained that the duration of the resource is available&#46; In the case of a <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element&#44; the dimensions of the video are also available&#46; No <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;media&#45;data"></a>[media data](#media-data) is available for the immediate <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;4"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;current&#95;data"></a><strong><code>HAVE&#95;CURRENT&#95;DATA</code></strong> &#40;numeric value 2&#41;</strong>

Data for the immediate <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;5"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) is available&#44; but either not enough data is available that the user agent could successfully advance the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;6"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) in the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;direction&#45;of&#45;playback"></a>[direction of playback](#direction-of-playback) at all without immediately reverting to the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;metadata"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;METADATA](#dom-media-have_metadata)</code> state&#44; or there is no more data to obtain in the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;direction&#45;of&#45;playback&#45;2"></a>[direction of playback](#direction-of-playback)&#46; For example&#44; in video this corresponds to the user agent having data from the current frame&#44; but not the next frame&#44; when the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;7"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) is at the end of the current frame&#59; and to when <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;ended&#45;playback"></a>[playback has ended](#ended-playback)&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;future&#95;data"></a><strong><code>HAVE&#95;FUTURE&#95;DATA</code></strong> &#40;numeric value 3&#41;</strong>

Data for the immediate <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;8"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) is available&#44; as well as enough data for the user agent to advance the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;9"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) in the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;direction&#45;of&#45;playback&#45;3"></a>[direction of playback](#direction-of-playback) at least a little without immediately reverting to the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;metadata&#45;2"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;METADATA](#dom-media-have_metadata)</code> state&#44; and <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;the&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;are&#45;ready"></a>[the text tracks are ready](#the-text-tracks-are-ready)&#46; For example&#44; in video this corresponds to the user agent having data for at least the current frame and the next frame when the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;10"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) is at the instant in time between the two frames&#44; or to the user agent having the video data for the current frame and audio data to keep playing at least a little when the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;11"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) is in the middle of a frame&#46; The user agent cannot be in this state if <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;ended&#45;playback&#45;2"></a>[playback has ended](#ended-playback)&#44; as the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;12"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) can never advance in this case&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;enough&#95;data"></a><strong><code>HAVE&#95;ENOUGH&#95;DATA</code></strong> &#40;numeric value 4&#41;</strong>

All the conditions described for the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;future&#95;data"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;FUTURE&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_future_data)</code> state are met&#44; and&#44; in addition&#44; either of the following conditions is also true&#58;

- The user agent estimates that data is being fetched at a rate where the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;13"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#44; if it were to advance at the element&#39;s <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;playbackrate"></a><code>[playbackRate](#dom-media-playbackrate)</code>&#44; would not overtake the available data before playback reaches the end of the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#46;
- The user agent has entered a state where waiting longer will not result in further data being obtained&#44; and therefore nothing would be gained by delaying playback any further&#46; &#40;For example&#44; the buffer might be full&#46;&#41;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In practice&#44; the difference between <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;metadata&#45;3"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;METADATA](#dom-media-have_metadata)</code> and <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;current&#95;data"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;CURRENT&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_current_data)</code> is negligible&#46; Really the only time the difference is relevant is when painting a <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element onto a <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;the&#45;canvas&#45;element"></a><code>[canvas](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-canvas-element)</code>&#44; where it distinguishes the case where something will be drawn &#40;<a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;current&#95;data&#45;2"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;CURRENT&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_current_data)</code> or greater&#41; from the case where nothing is drawn &#40;<a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;metadata&#45;4"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;METADATA](#dom-media-have_metadata)</code> or less&#41;&#46; Similarly&#44; the difference between <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;current&#95;data&#45;3"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;CURRENT&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_current_data)</code> &#40;only the current frame&#41; and <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;future&#95;data&#45;2"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;FUTURE&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_future_data)</code> &#40;at least this frame and the next&#41; can be negligible &#40;in the extreme&#44; only one frame&#41;&#46; The only time that distinction really matters is when a page provides an interface for &#34;frame&#45;by&#45;frame&#34; navigation&#46;

When the ready state of a <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;media&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[media element](#media-element) whose <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;2"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> is not <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;empty&#45;2"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;EMPTY](#dom-media-network_empty)</code> changes&#44; the user agent must follow the steps given below&#58;

1.  Apply the first applicable set of substeps from the following list&#58;

    <strong>If the previous ready state was <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;nothing&#45;2"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;NOTHING](#dom-media-have_nothing)</code>&#44; and the new ready state is <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;metadata&#45;5"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;METADATA](#dom-media-have_metadata)</code></strong>

    <a id="fire&#45;loadedmetadata"></a>
    <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;media&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;event&#45;media&#45;loadedmetadata"></a><code>[loadedmetadata](#event-media-loadedmetadata)</code> at the element&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    Before this task is run&#44; as part of the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;event&#45;loop"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) mechanism&#44; the rendering will have been updated to resize the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element if appropriate&#46;
    <a id="handling&#45;first&#45;frame&#45;available"></a><strong>If the previous ready state was <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;metadata&#45;6"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;METADATA](#dom-media-have_metadata)</code> and the new ready state is <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;current&#95;data&#45;4"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;CURRENT&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_current_data)</code> or greater</strong>

    <a id="fire&#45;loadeddata"></a>If this is the first time this occurs for this <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;media&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[media element](#media-element) since the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;load"></a><code>[load&#40;&#41;](#dom-media-load)</code> algorithm was last invoked&#44; the user agent must <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;media&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;event&#45;media&#45;loadeddata"></a><code>[loadeddata](#event-media-loadeddata)</code> at the element&#46;

    If the new ready state is <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;future&#95;data&#45;3"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;FUTURE&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_future_data)</code> or <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;enough&#95;data"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;ENOUGH&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_enough_data)</code>&#44; then the relevant steps below must then be run also&#46;

    <strong>If the previous ready state was <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;future&#95;data&#45;4"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;FUTURE&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_future_data)</code> or more&#44; and the new ready state is <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;current&#95;data&#45;5"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;CURRENT&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_current_data)</code> or less</strong>

    <a id="fire&#45;waiting&#45;when&#45;waiting"></a>If the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;media&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[media element](#media-element) was <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;potentially&#45;playing"></a>[potentially playing](#potentially-playing) before its <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute changed to a value lower than <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;future&#95;data&#45;5"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;FUTURE&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_future_data)</code>&#44; and the element has not <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;ended&#45;playback&#45;3"></a>[ended playback](#ended-playback)&#44; and playback has not <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;stopped&#45;due&#45;to&#45;errors"></a>[stopped due to errors](#stopped-due-to-errors)&#44; <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;paused&#45;for&#45;user&#45;interaction"></a>[paused for user interaction](#paused-for-user-interaction)&#44; or <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;paused&#45;for&#45;in&#45;band&#45;content"></a>[paused for in&#45;band content](#paused-for-in-band-content)&#44; the user agent must <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;media&#45;element&#45;8"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;3"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;event&#45;media&#45;timeupdate"></a><code>[timeupdate](#event-media-timeupdate)</code> at the element&#44; and <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;4"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;media&#45;element&#45;9"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;4"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;event&#45;media&#45;waiting"></a><code>[waiting](#event-media-waiting)</code> at the element&#46;

    <strong>If the previous ready state was <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;current&#95;data&#45;6"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;CURRENT&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_current_data)</code> or less&#44; and the new ready state is <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;future&#95;data&#45;6"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;FUTURE&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_future_data)</code></strong>

    The user agent must <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;5"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;media&#45;element&#45;10"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;5"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;event&#45;media&#45;canplay"></a><code>[canplay](#event-media-canplay)</code> at the element&#46;

    If the element&#39;s <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused"></a><code>[paused](#dom-media-paused)</code> attribute is false&#44; the user agent must <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;notify&#45;about&#45;playing"></a>[notify about playing](#notify-about-playing) for the element&#46;

    <strong>If the new ready state is <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;enough&#95;data&#45;2"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;ENOUGH&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_enough_data)</code></strong>

    If the previous ready state was <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;current&#95;data&#45;7"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;CURRENT&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_current_data)</code> or less&#44; the user agent must <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;6"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;media&#45;element&#45;11"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;6"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;event&#45;media&#45;canplay&#45;2"></a><code>[canplay](#event-media-canplay)</code> at the element&#44; and&#44; if the element&#39;s <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused&#45;2"></a><code>[paused](#dom-media-paused)</code> attribute is false&#44; <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;notify&#45;about&#45;playing&#45;2"></a>[notify about playing](#notify-about-playing) for the element&#46;

    The user agent must <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;7"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;media&#45;element&#45;12"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;7"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;event&#45;media&#45;canplaythrough"></a><code>[canplaythrough](#event-media-canplaythrough)</code> at the element&#46;

    If the element is not <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;eligible&#45;for&#45;autoplay"></a>[eligible for autoplay](#eligible-for-autoplay)&#44; then the user agent must abort these substeps&#46;

    The user agent may run the following substeps&#58;

    1.  Set the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused&#45;3"></a><code>[paused](#dom-media-paused)</code> attribute to false&#46;
    2.  If the element&#39;s <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;show&#45;poster&#45;flag"></a>[show poster flag](#show-poster-flag) is true&#44; set it to false and run the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;time&#45;marches&#45;on"></a><em>[time marches on](#time-marches-on)</em> steps&#46;
    3.  <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;8"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the element to <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;8"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;event&#45;media&#45;play"></a><code>[play](#event-media-play)</code> at the element&#46;
    4.  <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;notify&#45;about&#45;playing&#45;3"></a>[Notify about playing](#notify-about-playing) for the element&#46;

    Alternatively&#44; if the element is a <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element&#44; the user agent may start observing whether the element <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;intersect&#45;the&#45;viewport"></a>[intersects the viewport](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#intersect-the-viewport)&#46; When the element starts <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;intersect&#45;the&#45;viewport&#45;2"></a>[intersecting the viewport](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#intersect-the-viewport)&#44; if the element is still <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;eligible&#45;for&#45;autoplay&#45;2"></a>[eligible for autoplay](#eligible-for-autoplay)&#44; run the substeps above&#46; Optionally&#44; when the element stops <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;intersect&#45;the&#45;viewport&#45;3"></a>[intersecting the viewport](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#intersect-the-viewport)&#44; if the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;can&#45;autoplay&#45;flag"></a>[can autoplay flag](#can-autoplay-flag) is still true and the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;autoplay"></a><code>[autoplay](#attr-media-autoplay)</code> attribute is still specified&#44; run the following substeps&#58;

    1.  Run the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;internal&#45;pause&#45;steps"></a>[internal pause steps](#internal-pause-steps) and set the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;can&#45;autoplay&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[can autoplay flag](#can-autoplay-flag) to true&#46;
    2.  <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;9"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the element to <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;9"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;event&#45;media&#45;pause"></a><code>[pause](#event-media-pause)</code> at the element&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    The substeps for playing and pausing can run multiple times as the element starts or stops <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;intersect&#45;the&#45;viewport&#45;4"></a>[intersecting the viewport](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#intersect-the-viewport)&#44; as long as the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;can&#45;autoplay&#45;flag&#45;3"></a>[can autoplay flag](#can-autoplay-flag) is true&#46;
    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    User agents do not need to support autoplay&#44; and it is suggested that user agents honor user preferences on the matter&#46; Authors are urged to use the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;autoplay&#45;2"></a><code>[autoplay](#attr-media-autoplay)</code> attribute rather than using script to force the video to play&#44; so as to allow the user to override the behavior if so desired&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

It is possible for the ready state of a media element to jump between these states discontinuously&#46; For example&#44; the state of a media element can jump straight from <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;metadata&#45;7"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;METADATA](#dom-media-have_metadata)</code> to <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;enough&#95;data&#45;3"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;ENOUGH&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_enough_data)</code> without passing through the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;current&#95;data&#45;8"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;CURRENT&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_current_data)</code> and <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;future&#95;data&#45;7"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;FUTURE&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_future_data)</code> states&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;readystate"></a><strong><code>readyState</code></strong> IDL attribute must&#44; on getting&#44; return the value described above that describes the current ready state of the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;media&#45;element&#45;13"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;media&#45;autoplay"></a><strong><code>autoplay</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46; When present&#44; the user agent &#40;as described in the algorithm described herein&#41; will automatically begin playback of the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;3"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) as soon as it can do so without stopping&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Authors are urged to use the <a id="ready&#45;states&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;autoplay&#45;3"></a><code>[autoplay](#attr-media-autoplay)</code> attribute rather than using script to trigger automatic playback&#44; as this allows the user to override the automatic playback when it is not desired&#44; e&#46;g&#46; when using a screen reader&#46; Authors are also encouraged to consider not using the automatic playback behavior at all&#44; and instead to let the user agent wait for the user to start playback explicitly&#46;

Returns the default rate of playback&#44; for when the user is not fast&#45;forwarding or reversing through the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#46;

Can be set&#44; to change the default rate of playback&#46;

The default rate has no direct effect on playback&#44; but if the user switches to a fast&#45;forward mode&#44; when they return to the normal playback mode&#44; it is expected that the rate of playback will be returned to the default rate of playback&#46;

Sets the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused"></a><code>[paused](#dom-media-paused)</code> attribute to false&#44; loading the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;5"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) and beginning playback if necessary&#46; If the playback had ended&#44; will restart it from the start&#46;

<strong><code><var>media</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;media&#45;pause&#45;dev"></a>[pause](#dom-media-pause)&#40;&#41;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLMediaElement&#47;pause](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLMediaElement/pause)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Sets the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused&#45;2"></a><code>[paused](#dom-media-paused)</code> attribute to true&#44; loading the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;6"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) if necessary&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;paused"></a><strong><code>paused</code></strong> attribute represents whether the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[media element](#media-element) is paused or not&#46; The attribute must initially be true&#46;

A <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[media element](#media-element) is a <a id="blocked&#45;media&#45;element"></a><strong>blocked media element</strong> if its <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute is in the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;nothing"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;NOTHING](#dom-media-have_nothing)</code> state&#44; the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;metadata"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;METADATA](#dom-media-have_metadata)</code> state&#44; or the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;current&#95;data"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;CURRENT&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_current_data)</code> state&#44; or if the element has <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;paused&#45;for&#45;user&#45;interaction"></a>[paused for user interaction](#paused-for-user-interaction) or <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;paused&#45;for&#45;in&#45;band&#45;content"></a>[paused for in&#45;band content](#paused-for-in-band-content)&#46;

A <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[media element](#media-element) is said to be <a id="potentially&#45;playing"></a><strong>potentially playing</strong> when its <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused&#45;3"></a><code>[paused](#dom-media-paused)</code> attribute is false&#44; the element has not <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;ended&#45;playback"></a>[ended playback](#ended-playback)&#44; playback has not <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;stopped&#45;due&#45;to&#45;errors"></a>[stopped due to errors](#stopped-due-to-errors)&#44; and the element is not a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;blocked&#45;media&#45;element"></a>[blocked media element](#blocked-media-element)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

A <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;waiting"></a><code>[waiting](#event-media-waiting)</code> DOM event [can be fired](#fire-waiting-when-waiting) as a result of an element that is <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;potentially&#45;playing"></a>[potentially playing](#potentially-playing) stopping playback due to its <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;2"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute changing to a value lower than <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;future&#95;data"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;FUTURE&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_future_data)</code>&#46;

A <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[media element](#media-element) is said to be <a id="eligible&#45;for&#45;autoplay"></a><strong>eligible for autoplay</strong> when all of the following are true&#58;

- its <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;can&#45;autoplay&#45;flag"></a>[can autoplay flag](#can-autoplay-flag) is true&#59;

- its <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused&#45;4"></a><code>[paused](#dom-media-paused)</code> attribute is true&#59;

- it has an <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;autoplay"></a><code>[autoplay](#attr-media-autoplay)</code> attribute specified&#59;

- if it is an <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> or <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element and its <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;lazy&#45;loading&#45;attribute"></a>[lazy loading attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-loading-attribute) is either in the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;loading&#45;eager&#45;state"></a>[Eager](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-loading-eager-state) state or has started loading while in the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;loading&#45;lazy&#45;state"></a>[Lazy](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-loading-lazy-state) state&#44; or <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;noscript"></a>[scripting is disabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-noscript) for the element&#59;

- its <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;active&#45;sandboxing&#45;flag&#45;set"></a>[active sandboxing flag set](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#active-sandboxing-flag-set) does not have the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;sandboxed&#45;automatic&#45;features&#45;browsing&#45;context&#45;flag"></a>[sandboxed automatic features browsing context flag](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sandboxed-automatic-features-browsing-context-flag) set&#59; and

- its <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;allowed&#45;to&#45;use"></a>[allowed to use](#allowed-to-use) the &#34;<a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;autoplay&#45;feature"></a><code>[autoplay](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#autoplay-feature)</code>&#34; feature&#46;

A <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[media element](#media-element) is said to be <a id="allowed&#45;to&#45;play"></a><strong>allowed to play</strong> if the user agent and the system allow media playback in the current context&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; a user agent could allow playback only when the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;window"></a><code>[Window](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#window)</code> object has <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;transient&#45;activation"></a>[transient activation](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#transient-activation)&#44; but an exception could be made to allow playback while <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;muted"></a>[muted](#concept-media-muted)&#46;

A <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[media element](#media-element) is said to have <a id="ended&#45;playback"></a><strong>ended playback</strong> when&#58;

- The element&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;3"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute is <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;metadata&#45;2"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;METADATA](#dom-media-have_metadata)</code> or greater&#44; and

- Either&#58;

  - The <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) is the end of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;7"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; and

  - The <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;direction&#45;of&#45;playback"></a>[direction of playback](#direction-of-playback) is forwards&#44; and

  - The <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;8"></a>[media element](#media-element) does not have a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;loop"></a><code>[loop](#attr-media-loop)</code> attribute specified&#46;

  Or&#58;

  - The <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;2"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) is the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;earliest&#45;possible&#45;position"></a>[earliest possible position](#earliest-possible-position)&#44; and

  - The <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;direction&#45;of&#45;playback&#45;2"></a>[direction of playback](#direction-of-playback) is backwards&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;ended"></a><strong><code>ended</code></strong> attribute must return true if&#44; the last time the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;loop"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) reached [step 1](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#step1)&#44; the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;9"></a>[media element](#media-element) had <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;ended&#45;playback&#45;2"></a>[ended playback](#ended-playback) and the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;direction&#45;of&#45;playback&#45;3"></a>[direction of playback](#direction-of-playback) was forwards&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

A <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;10"></a>[media element](#media-element) is said to have <a id="stopped&#45;due&#45;to&#45;errors"></a><strong>stopped due to errors</strong> when the element&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;4"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute is <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;metadata&#45;3"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;METADATA](#dom-media-have_metadata)</code> or greater&#44; and the user agent [encounters a non&#45;fatal error](#non-fatal-media-error) during the processing of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;data"></a>[media data](#media-data)&#44; and due to that error&#44; is not able to play the content at the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;3"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#46;

A <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;11"></a>[media element](#media-element) is said to have <a id="paused&#45;for&#45;user&#45;interaction"></a><strong>paused for user interaction</strong> when its <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused&#45;5"></a><code>[paused](#dom-media-paused)</code> attribute is false&#44; the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;5"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute is either <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;future&#95;data&#45;2"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;FUTURE&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_future_data)</code> or <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;enough&#95;data"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;ENOUGH&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_enough_data)</code>&#44; and the user agent has reached a point in the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;8"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) where the user has to make a selection for the resource to continue&#46;

It is possible for a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;12"></a>[media element](#media-element) to have both <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;ended&#45;playback&#45;3"></a>[ended playback](#ended-playback) and <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;paused&#45;for&#45;user&#45;interaction&#45;2"></a>[paused for user interaction](#paused-for-user-interaction) at the same time&#46;

When a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;13"></a>[media element](#media-element) that is <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;potentially&#45;playing&#45;2"></a>[potentially playing](#potentially-playing) stops playing because it has <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;paused&#45;for&#45;user&#45;interaction&#45;3"></a>[paused for user interaction](#paused-for-user-interaction)&#44; the user agent must <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;14"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;timeupdate"></a><code>[timeupdate](#event-media-timeupdate)</code> at the element&#46;

A <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;15"></a>[media element](#media-element) is said to have <a id="paused&#45;for&#45;in&#45;band&#45;content"></a><strong>paused for in&#45;band content</strong> when its <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused&#45;6"></a><code>[paused](#dom-media-paused)</code> attribute is false&#44; the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;6"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute is either <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;future&#95;data&#45;3"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;FUTURE&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_future_data)</code> or <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;enough&#95;data&#45;2"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;ENOUGH&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_enough_data)</code>&#44; and the user agent has suspended playback of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;9"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) in order to play content that is temporally anchored to the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;10"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) and has a nonzero length&#44; or to play content that is temporally anchored to a segment of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;11"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) but has a length longer than that segment&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

One example of when a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;16"></a>[media element](#media-element) would be <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;paused&#45;for&#45;in&#45;band&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[paused for in&#45;band content](#paused-for-in-band-content) is when the user agent is playing <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;descriptions"></a>[audio descriptions](#attr-track-kind-descriptions) from an external WebVTT file&#44; and the synthesized speech generated for a cue is longer than the time between the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;start&#45;time"></a>[text track cue start time](#text-track-cue-start-time) and the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;end&#45;time"></a>[text track cue end time](#text-track-cue-end-time)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a id="reaches&#45;the&#45;end"></a>When the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;4"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) reaches the end of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;12"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) when the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;direction&#45;of&#45;playback&#45;4"></a>[direction of playback](#direction-of-playback) is forwards&#44; then the user agent must follow these steps&#58;

1.  If the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;17"></a>[media element](#media-element) has a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;loop&#45;2"></a><code>[loop](#attr-media-loop)</code> attribute specified&#44; then <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seek"></a>[seek](#dom-media-seek) to the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;earliest&#45;possible&#45;position&#45;2"></a>[earliest possible position](#earliest-possible-position) of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;13"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) and return&#46;

2.  As defined above&#44; the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;ended"></a><code>[ended](#dom-media-ended)</code> IDL attribute starts returning true once the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;loop&#45;2"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) returns to [step 1](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#step1)&#46;

3.  <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;18"></a>[media element](#media-element) and the following steps&#58;

    1.  <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;timeupdate&#45;2"></a><code>[timeupdate](#event-media-timeupdate)</code> at the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;19"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

    2.  If the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;20"></a>[media element](#media-element) has <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;ended&#45;playback&#45;4"></a>[ended playback](#ended-playback)&#44; the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;direction&#45;of&#45;playback&#45;5"></a>[direction of playback](#direction-of-playback) is forwards&#44; and <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused&#45;7"></a>[paused](#dom-media-paused) is false&#58;

        1.  Set the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused&#45;8"></a><code>[paused](#dom-media-paused)</code> attribute to true&#46;

        2.  <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;3"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;pause"></a><code>[pause](#event-media-pause)</code> at the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;21"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

        3.  <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;take&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises"></a>[Take pending play promises](#take-pending-play-promises) and <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;reject&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises"></a>[reject pending play promises](#reject-pending-play-promises) with the result and an <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;aborterror"></a>[&#34;<code>AbortError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#aborterror) <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

    3.  <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;4"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;ended"></a><code>[ended](#event-media-ended)</code> at the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;22"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

When the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;5"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) reaches the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;earliest&#45;possible&#45;position&#45;3"></a>[earliest possible position](#earliest-possible-position) of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;14"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) when the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;direction&#45;of&#45;playback&#45;6"></a>[direction of playback](#direction-of-playback) is backwards&#44; then the user agent must only <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;23"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;5"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;timeupdate&#45;3"></a><code>[timeupdate](#event-media-timeupdate)</code> at the element&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The word &#34;reaches&#34; here does not imply that the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;6"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) needs to have changed during normal playback&#59; it could be via <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seek&#45;2"></a>[seeking](#dom-media-seek)&#44; for instance&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;defaultplaybackrate"></a><strong><code>defaultPlaybackRate</code></strong> attribute gives the desired speed at which the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;15"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is to play&#44; as a multiple of its intrinsic speed&#46; The attribute is mutable&#58; on getting it must return the last value it was set to&#44; or 1&#46;0 if it hasn&#39;t yet been set&#59; on setting the attribute must be set to the new value&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;defaultplaybackrate"></a><code>[defaultPlaybackRate](#dom-media-defaultplaybackrate)</code> is used by the user agent when it <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;expose&#45;a&#45;user&#45;interface&#45;to&#45;the&#45;user"></a>[exposes a user interface to the user](#expose-a-user-interface-to-the-user)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;playbackrate"></a><strong><code>playbackRate</code></strong> attribute gives the effective playback rate&#44; which is the speed at which the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;16"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) plays&#44; as a multiple of its intrinsic speed&#46; If it is not equal to the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;defaultplaybackrate&#45;2"></a><code>[defaultPlaybackRate](#dom-media-defaultplaybackrate)</code>&#44; then the implication is that the user is using a feature such as fast forward or slow motion playback&#46; The attribute is mutable&#58; on getting it must return the last value it was set to&#44; or 1&#46;0 if it hasn&#39;t yet been set&#59; on setting&#44; the user agent must follow these steps&#58;

1.  If the given value is not supported by the user agent&#44; then throw a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;notsupportederror"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  Set <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;playbackrate&#45;3"></a><code>[playbackRate](#dom-media-playbackrate)</code> to the new value&#44; and if the element is <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;potentially&#45;playing&#45;3"></a>[potentially playing](#potentially-playing)&#44; change the playback speed&#46;

<a id="rateUpdate"></a>When the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;defaultplaybackrate&#45;3"></a><code>[defaultPlaybackRate](#dom-media-defaultplaybackrate)</code> or <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;playbackrate&#45;4"></a><code>[playbackRate](#dom-media-playbackrate)</code> attributes change value &#40;either by being set by script or by being changed directly by the user agent&#44; e&#46;g&#46; in response to user control&#41;&#44; the user agent must <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;4"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;24"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;6"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;ratechange"></a><code>[ratechange](#event-media-ratechange)</code> at the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;25"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46; The user agent must process attribute changes smoothly and must not introduce any perceivable gaps or muting of playback in response&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;preservespitch"></a><strong><code>preservesPitch</code></strong> getter steps are to return true if a pitch&#45;preserving algorithm is in effect during playback&#46; The setter steps are to correspondingly switch the pitch&#45;preserving algorithm on or off&#44; without any perceivable gaps or muting of playback&#46; By default&#44; such a pitch&#45;preserving algorithm must be in effect &#40;i&#46;e&#46;&#44; the getter will initially return true&#41;&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;played"></a><strong><code>played</code></strong> getter steps are to return a new <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;normalised&#45;timeranges&#45;object"></a>[normalized <code>TimeRanges</code> object](#normalised-timeranges-object) that represents the ranges of points on the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;timeline"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline) of <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;17"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) reached through the usual monotonic increase of <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;7"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) during normal playback&#44; if any&#46;

<strong>Warning&#58;</strong>

Returning a new object each time is a bad pattern for attribute getters and is only enshrined here as it would be costly to change it&#46; It is not to be copied to new APIs&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Each <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;26"></a>[media element](#media-element) has a <a id="list&#45;of&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises"></a><strong>list of pending play promises</strong>&#44; which must initially be empty&#46;

To <a id="take&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises"></a><strong>take pending play promises</strong> for a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;27"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; the user agent must run the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>promises</var> be an empty list of promises&#46;

2.  Copy the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;28"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;list&#45;of&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises"></a>[list of pending play promises](#list-of-pending-play-promises) to <var>promises</var>&#46;

3.  Clear the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;29"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;list&#45;of&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises&#45;2"></a>[list of pending play promises](#list-of-pending-play-promises)&#46;

4.  Return <var>promises</var>&#46;

To <a id="resolve&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises"></a><strong>resolve pending play promises</strong> for a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;30"></a>[media element](#media-element) with a list of promises <var>promises</var>&#44; the user agent must resolve each promise in <var>promises</var> with undefined&#46;

To <a id="reject&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises"></a><strong>reject pending play promises</strong> for a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;31"></a>[media element](#media-element) with a list of promises <var>promises</var> and an exception name <var>error</var>&#44; the user agent must reject each promise in <var>promises</var> with <var>error</var>&#46;

To <a id="notify&#45;about&#45;playing"></a><strong>notify about playing</strong> for a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;32"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; the user agent must run the following steps&#58;

1.  <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;take&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises&#45;2"></a>[Take pending play promises](#take-pending-play-promises) and let <var>promises</var> be the result&#46;

2.  <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;5"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the element and the following steps&#58;

    1.  <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;7"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;playing"></a><code>[playing](#event-media-playing)</code> at the element&#46;

    2.  <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;resolve&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises"></a>[Resolve pending play promises](#resolve-pending-play-promises) with <var>promises</var>&#46;

When the <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;play"></a><strong><code>play&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method on a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;33"></a>[media element](#media-element) is invoked&#44; the user agent must run the following steps&#58;

1.  If the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;34"></a>[media element](#media-element) is not <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;allowed&#45;to&#45;play"></a>[allowed to play](#allowed-to-play)&#44; then return <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;a&#45;promise&#45;rejected&#45;with"></a>[a promise rejected with](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with) a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;notallowederror"></a>[&#34;<code>NotAllowedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notallowederror) <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;domexception&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  If the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;35"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;error"></a><code>[error](#dom-media-error)</code> attribute is not null and its <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;mediaerror&#45;code"></a>[code](#concept-mediaerror-code) is <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;mediaerror&#45;media&#95;err&#95;src&#95;not&#95;supported"></a><code>[MEDIA&#95;ERR&#95;SRC&#95;NOT&#95;SUPPORTED](#dom-mediaerror-media_err_src_not_supported)</code>&#44; then return <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;a&#45;promise&#45;rejected&#45;with&#45;2"></a>[a promise rejected with](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with) a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;notsupportederror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;domexception&#45;4"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This means that the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dedicated&#45;media&#45;source&#45;failure&#45;steps"></a>[dedicated media source failure steps](#dedicated-media-source-failure-steps) have run&#46; Playback is not possible until the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;load&#45;algorithm"></a>[media element load algorithm](#media-element-load-algorithm) clears the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;error&#45;2"></a><code>[error](#dom-media-error)</code> attribute&#46;

3.  Let <var>resumptionSteps</var> be the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;36"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps"></a>[lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-load-resumption-steps)&#46;

4.  If <var>resumptionSteps</var> is not null&#58;

    1.  Set the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;37"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;lazy&#45;load&#45;resumption&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[lazy load resumption steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#lazy-load-resumption-steps) to null&#46;

    2.  Invoke <var>resumptionSteps</var>&#46;

5.  Let <var>promise</var> be a new promise and append <var>promise</var> to the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;list&#45;of&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises&#45;3"></a>[list of pending play promises](#list-of-pending-play-promises)&#46;

6.  Run the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;internal&#45;play&#45;steps"></a>[internal play steps](#internal-play-steps) for the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;38"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

7.  Return <var>promise</var>&#46;

The <a id="internal&#45;play&#45;steps"></a><strong>internal play steps</strong> for a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;39"></a>[media element](#media-element) are as follows&#58;

1.  If the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;40"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> attribute has the value <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;empty"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;EMPTY](#dom-media-network_empty)</code>&#44; invoke the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;41"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm)&#46;

2.  If the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;ended&#45;playback&#45;5"></a>[playback has ended](#ended-playback) and the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;direction&#45;of&#45;playback&#45;7"></a>[direction of playback](#direction-of-playback) is forwards&#44; <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seek&#45;3"></a>[seek](#dom-media-seek) to the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;earliest&#45;possible&#45;position&#45;4"></a>[earliest possible position](#earliest-possible-position) of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;18"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This [will cause](#seekUpdate) the user agent to <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;6"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;42"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;8"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;timeupdate&#45;4"></a><code>[timeupdate](#event-media-timeupdate)</code> at the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;43"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

3.  If the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;44"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused&#45;9"></a><code>[paused](#dom-media-paused)</code> attribute is true&#58;

    1.  Change the value of <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused&#45;10"></a><code>[paused](#dom-media-paused)</code> to false&#46;

    2.  If the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;show&#45;poster&#45;flag"></a>[show poster flag](#show-poster-flag) is true&#44; set the element&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;show&#45;poster&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[show poster flag](#show-poster-flag) to false and run the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;time&#45;marches&#45;on"></a><em>[time marches on](#time-marches-on)</em> steps&#46;

    3.  <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;7"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;45"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;9"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;play"></a><code>[play](#event-media-play)</code> at the element&#46;

    4.  If the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;46"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;7"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute has the value <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;nothing&#45;2"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;NOTHING](#dom-media-have_nothing)</code>&#44; <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;metadata&#45;4"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;METADATA](#dom-media-have_metadata)</code>&#44; or <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;current&#95;data&#45;2"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;CURRENT&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_current_data)</code>&#44; <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;8"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;47"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;10"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;waiting&#45;2"></a><code>[waiting](#event-media-waiting)</code> at the element&#46;

        Otherwise&#44; the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;48"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;8"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute has the value <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;future&#95;data&#45;4"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;FUTURE&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_future_data)</code> or <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;enough&#95;data&#45;3"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;ENOUGH&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_enough_data)</code>&#58; <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;notify&#45;about&#45;playing"></a>[notify about playing](#notify-about-playing) for the element&#46;

4.  Otherwise&#44; if the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;49"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;9"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute has the value <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;future&#95;data&#45;5"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;FUTURE&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_future_data)</code> or <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;enough&#95;data&#45;4"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;ENOUGH&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_enough_data)</code>&#44; <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;take&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises&#45;3"></a>[take pending play promises](#take-pending-play-promises) and <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;9"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;50"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;resolve&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises&#45;2"></a>[resolve pending play promises](#resolve-pending-play-promises) with the result&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    The media element is already playing&#46; However&#44; it&#39;s possible that <var>promise</var> will be <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;reject&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises&#45;2"></a>[rejected](#reject-pending-play-promises) before the queued task is run&#46;

5.  Set the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;51"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;can&#45;autoplay&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[can autoplay flag](#can-autoplay-flag) to false&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

When the <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;pause"></a><strong><code>pause&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method is invoked&#44; and when the user agent is required to pause the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;52"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; the user agent must run the following steps&#58;

1.  If the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;53"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;networkstate&#45;2"></a><code>[networkState](#dom-media-networkstate)</code> attribute has the value <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;network&#95;empty&#45;2"></a><code>[NETWORK&#95;EMPTY](#dom-media-network_empty)</code>&#44; invoke the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;54"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[resource selection algorithm](#concept-media-load-algorithm)&#46;

2.  Run the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;internal&#45;pause&#45;steps"></a>[internal pause steps](#internal-pause-steps) for the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;55"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

The <a id="internal&#45;pause&#45;steps"></a><strong>internal pause steps</strong> for a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;56"></a>[media element](#media-element) are as follows&#58;

1.  Set the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;57"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;can&#45;autoplay&#45;flag&#45;3"></a>[can autoplay flag](#can-autoplay-flag) to false&#46;

2.  If the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;58"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused&#45;11"></a><code>[paused](#dom-media-paused)</code> attribute is false&#44; run the following steps&#58;

    1.  Change the value of <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused&#45;12"></a><code>[paused](#dom-media-paused)</code> to true&#46;

    2.  <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;take&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises&#45;4"></a>[Take pending play promises](#take-pending-play-promises) and let <var>promises</var> be the result&#46;

    3.  <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;10"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;59"></a>[media element](#media-element) and the following steps&#58;

        1.  <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;11"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;timeupdate&#45;5"></a><code>[timeupdate](#event-media-timeupdate)</code> at the element&#46;

        2.  <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;12"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;pause&#45;2"></a><code>[pause](#event-media-pause)</code> at the element&#46;

        3.  <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;reject&#45;pending&#45;play&#45;promises&#45;3"></a>[Reject pending play promises](#reject-pending-play-promises) with <var>promises</var> and an <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;aborterror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>AbortError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#aborterror) <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;domexception&#45;5"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

    4.
