Set the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;official&#45;playback&#45;position"></a>[official playback position](#official-playback-position) to the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;8"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

If the element&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;playbackrate&#45;5"></a><code>[playbackRate](#dom-media-playbackrate)</code> is positive or zero&#44; then the <a id="direction&#45;of&#45;playback"></a><strong>direction of playback</strong> is forwards&#46; Otherwise&#44; it is backwards&#46;

<a id="media&#45;playback"></a>When a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;60"></a>[media element](#media-element) is <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;potentially&#45;playing&#45;4"></a>[potentially playing](#potentially-playing) and its <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> is a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;fully&#45;active"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active) <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;document&#45;2"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code>&#44; its <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;9"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) must increase monotonically at the element&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;playbackrate&#45;6"></a><code>[playbackRate](#dom-media-playbackrate)</code> units of media time per unit time of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;timeline&#45;2"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline)&#39;s clock&#46; &#40;This specification always refers to this as an <em>increase</em>&#44; but that increase could actually be a <em>de</em>crease if the element&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;playbackrate&#45;7"></a><code>[playbackRate](#dom-media-playbackrate)</code> is negative&#46;&#41;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The element&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;playbackrate&#45;8"></a><code>[playbackRate](#dom-media-playbackrate)</code> can be 0&#46;0&#44; in which case the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;10"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) doesn&#39;t move&#44; despite playback not being paused &#40;<a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;paused&#45;13"></a><code>[paused](#dom-media-paused)</code> doesn&#39;t become true&#44; and the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;pause&#45;3"></a><code>[pause](#event-media-pause)</code> event doesn&#39;t fire&#41;&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This specification doesn&#39;t define how the user agent achieves the appropriate playback rate — depending on the protocol and media available&#44; it is plausible that the user agent could negotiate with the server to have the server provide the media data at the appropriate rate&#44; so that &#40;except for the period between when the rate is changed and when the server updates the stream&#39;s playback rate&#41; the client doesn&#39;t actually have to drop or interpolate any frames&#46;

Any time the user agent <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;await&#45;a&#45;stable&#45;state"></a>[provides a stable state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#await-a-stable-state)&#44; the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;official&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;2"></a>[official playback position](#official-playback-position) must be set to the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;11"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#46;

If the element&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;playbackrate&#45;9"></a><code>[playbackRate](#dom-media-playbackrate)</code> is not 1&#46;0 and <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;preservespitch"></a><code>[preservesPitch](#dom-media-preservespitch)</code> is true&#44; the user agent must apply pitch adjustment to preserve the original pitch of the audio&#46; Otherwise&#44; the user agent must speed up or slow down the audio without any pitch adjustment&#46;

When a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;61"></a>[media element](#media-element) is <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;potentially&#45;playing&#45;5"></a>[potentially playing](#potentially-playing)&#44; its audio data played must be synchronized with the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;12"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#44; at the element&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;effective&#45;media&#45;volume"></a>[effective media volume](#effective-media-volume)&#46; The user agent must play the audio from audio tracks that were enabled when the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;loop&#45;3"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) last reached [step 1](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#step1)&#46;

When a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;62"></a>[media element](#media-element) is not <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;potentially&#45;playing&#45;6"></a>[potentially playing](#potentially-playing)&#44; audio must not play for the element&#46;

<a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;63"></a>[Media elements](#media-element) that are <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;potentially&#45;playing&#45;7"></a>[potentially playing](#potentially-playing) while not <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;in&#45;a&#45;document"></a>[in a document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#in-a-document) must not play any video&#44; but should play any audio component&#46; Media elements must not stop playing just because all references to them have been removed&#59; only once a media element is in a state where no further audio could ever be played by that element may the element be garbage collected&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

It is possible for an element to which no explicit references exist to play audio&#44; even if such an element is not still actively playing&#58; for instance&#44; it could be unpaused but stalled waiting for content to buffer&#44; or it could be still buffering&#44; but with a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;suspend"></a><code>[suspend](#event-media-suspend)</code> event listener that begins playback&#46; Even a media element whose <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;19"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) has no audio tracks could eventually play audio again if it had an event listener that changes the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;20"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Each <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;64"></a>[media element](#media-element) has a <a id="list&#45;of&#45;newly&#45;introduced&#45;cues"></a><strong>list of newly introduced cues</strong>&#44; which must be initially empty&#46; Whenever a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) is added to the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues"></a>[list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues) of a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track"></a>[text track](#text-track) that is in the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks) for a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;65"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; that <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;2"></a>[cue](#text-track-cue) must be added to the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;66"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;list&#45;of&#45;newly&#45;introduced&#45;cues"></a>[list of newly introduced cues](#list-of-newly-introduced-cues)&#46; Whenever a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;2"></a>[text track](#text-track) is added to the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;2"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks) for a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;67"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; all of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;3"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) in that <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;3"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;2"></a>[list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues) must be added to the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;68"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;list&#45;of&#45;newly&#45;introduced&#45;cues&#45;2"></a>[list of newly introduced cues](#list-of-newly-introduced-cues)&#46; When a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;69"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;list&#45;of&#45;newly&#45;introduced&#45;cues&#45;3"></a>[list of newly introduced cues](#list-of-newly-introduced-cues) has new cues added while the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;70"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;show&#45;poster&#45;flag&#45;3"></a>[show poster flag](#show-poster-flag) is not set&#44; then the user agent must run the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;time&#45;marches&#45;on&#45;2"></a><em>[time marches on](#time-marches-on)</em> steps&#46;

When a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;4"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) is removed from the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;3"></a>[list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues) of a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;4"></a>[text track](#text-track) that is in the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;3"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks) for a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;71"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; and whenever a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;5"></a>[text track](#text-track) is removed from the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;4"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks) of a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;72"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; if the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;73"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;show&#45;poster&#45;flag&#45;4"></a>[show poster flag](#show-poster-flag) is not set&#44; then the user agent must run the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;time&#45;marches&#45;on&#45;3"></a><em>[time marches on](#time-marches-on)</em> steps&#46;

When the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;13"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) of a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;74"></a>[media element](#media-element) changes &#40;e&#46;g&#46; due to playback or seeking&#41;&#44; the user agent must run the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;time&#45;marches&#45;on&#45;4"></a><em>[time marches on](#time-marches-on)</em> steps&#46; To support use cases that depend on the timing accuracy of cue event firing&#44; such as synchronizing captions with shot changes in a video&#44; user agents should fire cue events as close as possible to their position on the media timeline&#44; and ideally within 20 milliseconds&#46; If the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;14"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) changes while the steps are running&#44; then the user agent must wait for the steps to complete&#44; and then must immediately rerun the steps&#46; These steps are thus run as often as possible or needed&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

If one iteration takes a long time&#44; this can cause short duration <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;5"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) to be skipped over as the user agent rushes ahead to &#34;catch up&#34;&#44; so these cues will not appear in the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;texttrack&#45;activecues"></a><code>[activeCues](#dom-texttrack-activecues)</code> list&#46;

The <a id="time&#45;marches&#45;on"></a><strong><em>time marches on</em></strong> steps are as follows&#58;

1.  Let <var>current cues</var> be a list of <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;6"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue)&#44; initialized to contain all the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;7"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) of all the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;hidden"></a>[hidden](#text-track-hidden) or <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;showing"></a>[showing](#text-track-showing) <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;6"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;75"></a>[media element](#media-element) &#40;not the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](#text-track-disabled) ones&#41; whose <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;start&#45;time&#45;2"></a>[start times](#text-track-cue-start-time) are less than or equal to the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;15"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) and whose <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;end&#45;time&#45;2"></a>[end times](#text-track-cue-end-time) are greater than the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;16"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#46;

2.  Let <var>other cues</var> be a list of <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;8"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue)&#44; initialized to contain all the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;9"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) of <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;hidden&#45;2"></a>[hidden](#text-track-hidden) and <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;showing&#45;2"></a>[showing](#text-track-showing) <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;7"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;76"></a>[media element](#media-element) that are not present in <var>current cues</var>&#46;

3.  Let <var>last time</var> be the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;17"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) at the time this algorithm was last run for this <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;77"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; if this is not the first time it has run&#46;

4.  If the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;18"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) has&#44; since the last time this algorithm was run&#44; only changed through its usual monotonic increase during normal playback&#44; then let <var>missed cues</var> be the list of <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;10"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) in <var>other cues</var> whose <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;start&#45;time&#45;3"></a>[start times](#text-track-cue-start-time) are greater than or equal to <var>last time</var> and whose <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;end&#45;time&#45;3"></a>[end times](#text-track-cue-end-time) are less than or equal to the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;19"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#46; Otherwise&#44; let <var>missed cues</var> be an empty list&#46;

5.  Remove all the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;11"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) in <var>missed cues</var> that are also in the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;78"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;list&#45;of&#45;newly&#45;introduced&#45;cues&#45;4"></a>[list of newly introduced cues](#list-of-newly-introduced-cues)&#44; and then empty the element&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;list&#45;of&#45;newly&#45;introduced&#45;cues&#45;5"></a>[list of newly introduced cues](#list-of-newly-introduced-cues)&#46;

6.  If the time was reached through the usual monotonic increase of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;20"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) during normal playback&#44; and if the user agent has not fired a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;timeupdate&#45;6"></a><code>[timeupdate](#event-media-timeupdate)</code> event at the element in the past 15 to 250ms and is not still running event handlers for such an event&#44; then the user agent must <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;11"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;79"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;13"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;timeupdate&#45;7"></a><code>[timeupdate](#event-media-timeupdate)</code> at the element&#46; &#40;In the other cases&#44; such as explicit seeks&#44; relevant events get fired as part of the overall process of changing the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;21"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#46;&#41;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    The event thus is not to be fired faster than about 66Hz or slower than 4Hz &#40;assuming the event handlers don&#39;t take longer than 250ms to run&#41;&#46; User agents are encouraged to vary the frequency of the event based on the system load and the average cost of processing the event each time&#44; so that the UI updates are not any more frequent than the user agent can comfortably handle while decoding the video&#46;

7.  If all of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;12"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) in <var>current cues</var> have their <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;active&#45;flag"></a>[text track cue active flag](#text-track-cue-active-flag) set&#44; none of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;13"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) in <var>other cues</var> have their <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;active&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[text track cue active flag](#text-track-cue-active-flag) set&#44; and <var>missed cues</var> is empty&#44; then return&#46;

8.  If the time was reached through the usual monotonic increase of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;22"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) during normal playback&#44; and there are <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;14"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) in <var>other cues</var> that have their <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;pause&#45;on&#45;exit&#45;flag"></a>[text track cue pause&#45;on&#45;exit flag](#text-track-cue-pause-on-exit-flag) set and that either have their <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;active&#45;flag&#45;3"></a>[text track cue active flag](#text-track-cue-active-flag) set or are also in <var>missed cues</var>&#44; then <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;immediately"></a>[immediately](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#immediately) <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;pause"></a>[pause](#dom-media-pause) the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;80"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    In the other cases&#44; such as explicit seeks&#44; playback is not paused by going past the end time of a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;15"></a>[cue](#text-track-cue)&#44; even if that <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;16"></a>[cue](#text-track-cue) has its <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;pause&#45;on&#45;exit&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[text track cue pause&#45;on&#45;exit flag](#text-track-cue-pause-on-exit-flag) set&#46;

9.  Let <var>events</var> be a list of <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task"></a>[tasks](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task)&#44; initially empty&#46; Each <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) in this list will be associated with a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;8"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#44; a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;17"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue)&#44; and a time&#44; which are used to sort the list before the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[tasks](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) are queued&#46;

    Let <var>affected tracks</var> be a list of <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;9"></a>[text tracks](#text-track)&#44; initially empty&#46;

    When the steps below say to <a id="prepare&#45;an&#45;event"></a><strong>prepare an event</strong> named <var>event</var> for a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;18"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) <var>target</var> with a time <var>time</var>&#44; the user agent must run these steps&#58;

    1.  Let <var>track</var> be the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;10"></a>[text track](#text-track) with which the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;19"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) <var>target</var> is associated&#46;

    2.  Create a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;4"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) to <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;14"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <var>event</var> at <var>target</var>&#46;

    3.  Add the newly created <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;5"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) to <var>events</var>&#44; associated with the time <var>time</var>&#44; the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;11"></a>[text track](#text-track) <var>track</var>&#44; and the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;20"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) <var>target</var>&#46;

    4.  Add <var>track</var> to <var>affected tracks</var>&#46;

10. For each <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;21"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) in <var>missed cues</var>&#44; <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;prepare&#45;an&#45;event"></a>[prepare an event](#prepare-an-event) named <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;enter"></a><code>[enter](#event-media-enter)</code> for the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;texttrackcue"></a><code>[TextTrackCue](#texttrackcue)</code> object with the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;start&#45;time&#45;4"></a>[text track cue start time](#text-track-cue-start-time)&#46;

11. For each <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;22"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) in <var>other cues</var> that either has its <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;active&#45;flag&#45;4"></a>[text track cue active flag](#text-track-cue-active-flag) set or is in <var>missed cues</var>&#44; <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;prepare&#45;an&#45;event&#45;2"></a>[prepare an event](#prepare-an-event) named <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;exit"></a><code>[exit](#event-media-exit)</code> for the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;texttrackcue&#45;2"></a><code>[TextTrackCue](#texttrackcue)</code> object with the later of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;end&#45;time&#45;4"></a>[text track cue end time](#text-track-cue-end-time) and the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;start&#45;time&#45;5"></a>[text track cue start time](#text-track-cue-start-time)&#46;

12. For each <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;23"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) in <var>current cues</var> that does not have its <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;active&#45;flag&#45;5"></a>[text track cue active flag](#text-track-cue-active-flag) set&#44; <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;prepare&#45;an&#45;event&#45;3"></a>[prepare an event](#prepare-an-event) named <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;enter&#45;2"></a><code>[enter](#event-media-enter)</code> for the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;texttrackcue&#45;3"></a><code>[TextTrackCue](#texttrackcue)</code> object with the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;start&#45;time&#45;6"></a>[text track cue start time](#text-track-cue-start-time)&#46;

13. Sort the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;6"></a>[tasks](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) in <var>events</var> in ascending time order &#40;<a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;7"></a>[tasks](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) with earlier times first&#41;&#46;

    Further sort <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;8"></a>[tasks](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) in <var>events</var> that have the same time by the relative <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;order"></a>[text track cue order](#text-track-cue-order) of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;24"></a>[text track cues](#text-track-cue) associated with these <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;9"></a>[tasks](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task)&#46;

    Finally&#44; sort <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;10"></a>[tasks](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) in <var>events</var> that have the same time and same <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;order&#45;2"></a>[text track cue order](#text-track-cue-order) by placing <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;11"></a>[tasks](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that fire <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;enter&#45;3"></a><code>[enter](#event-media-enter)</code> events before those that fire <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;exit&#45;2"></a><code>[exit](#event-media-exit)</code> events&#46;

14. <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;12"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;81"></a>[media element](#media-element) for each <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;12"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) in <var>events</var>&#44; in list order&#46;

15. Sort <var>affected tracks</var> in the same order as the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;12"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) appear in the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;82"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;5"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks)&#44; and remove duplicates&#46;

16. For each <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;13"></a>[text track](#text-track) in <var>affected tracks</var>&#44; in the list order&#44; <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;13"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;83"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;15"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;cuechange"></a><code>[cuechange](#event-media-cuechange)</code> at the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;texttrack"></a><code>[TextTrack](#texttrack)</code> object&#44; and&#44; if the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;14"></a>[text track](#text-track) has a corresponding <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#44; to then <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;16"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;event&#45;media&#45;cuechange&#45;2"></a><code>[cuechange](#event-media-cuechange)</code> at the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element as well&#46;

17. Set the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;active&#45;flag&#45;6"></a>[text track cue active flag](#text-track-cue-active-flag) of all the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;25"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) in the <var>current cues</var>&#44; and unset the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;active&#45;flag&#45;7"></a>[text track cue active flag](#text-track-cue-active-flag) of all the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;26"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) in the <var>other cues</var>&#46;

18. Run the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;updating&#45;the&#45;text&#45;track&#45;rendering"></a>[rules for updating the text track rendering](#rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering) of each of the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;15"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) in <var>affected tracks</var> that are <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;showing&#45;3"></a>[showing](#text-track-showing)&#44; providing the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;16"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;language"></a>[text track language](#text-track-language) as the fallback language if it is not the empty string&#46; For example&#44; for <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;17"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) based on WebVTT&#44; the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;updating&#45;the&#45;display&#45;of&#45;webvtt&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a>[rules for updating the display of WebVTT text tracks](https://w3c.github.io/webvtt/#rules-for-updating-the-display-of-webvtt-text-tracks)&#46; [&#91;WEBVTT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBVTT)

For the purposes of the algorithm above&#44; a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;27"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) is considered to be part of a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;18"></a>[text track](#text-track) only if it is listed in the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;4"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues)&#44; not merely if it is associated with the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;text&#45;track&#45;19"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

If the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;84"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;node&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) stops being a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;fully&#45;active&#45;2"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active) document&#44; then the playback will [stop](#media-playback) until the document is active again&#46;

When a <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;85"></a>[media element](#media-element) is <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;remove&#45;an&#45;element&#45;from&#45;a&#45;document"></a>[removed from a <code>Document</code>](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#remove-an-element-from-a-document)&#44; the user agent must run the following steps&#58;

1.  <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;await&#45;a&#45;stable&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Await a stable state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#await-a-stable-state)&#44; allowing the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;13"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that removed the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;86"></a>[media element](#media-element) from the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;document&#45;3"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> to continue&#46; The <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) consists of all the remaining steps of this algorithm&#46; &#40;Steps in the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;2"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) are marked with ⌛&#46;&#41;

2.  ⌛ If the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;87"></a>[media element](#media-element) is <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;in&#45;a&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[in a document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#in-a-document)&#44; return&#46;

3.  ⌛ Run the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;internal&#45;pause&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[internal pause steps](#internal-pause-steps) for the <a id="playing&#45;the&#45;media&#45;resource&#58;media&#45;element&#45;88"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

##### <a id="seeking"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;9 Seeking[](#seeking)

<strong><code><var>media</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;media&#45;seeking&#45;dev"></a>[seeking](#dom-media-seeking)</code></strong>

Returns true if the user agent is currently seeking&#46;

<strong><code><var>media</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;media&#45;seekable&#45;dev"></a>[seekable](#dom-media-seekable)</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLMediaElement&#47;seekable](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLMediaElement/seekable)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox8&#43;Safari3&#46;1&#43;Chrome3&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS3&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns a <a id="seeking&#58;timeranges"></a><code>[TimeRanges](#timeranges)</code> object that represents the ranges of the <a id="seeking&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) to which it is possible for the user agent to seek&#46;

<strong><code><var>media</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;media&#45;fastseek&#45;dev"></a>[fastSeek](#dom-media-fastseek)&#40;<var>time</var>&#41;</code></strong>

MDN

[HTMLMediaElement&#47;fastSeek](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLMediaElement/fastSeek)

Firefox31&#43;Safari8&#43;ChromeNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;EdgeNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;&#63;Internet ExplorerNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

Seeks to near the given <var>time</var> as fast as possible&#44; trading precision for speed&#46; &#40;To seek to a precise time&#44; use the <a id="seeking&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;currenttime"></a><code>[currentTime](#dom-media-currenttime)</code> attribute&#46;&#41;

This does nothing if the media resource has not been loaded&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;seeking"></a><strong><code>seeking</code></strong> attribute must initially have the value false&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;fastseek"></a><strong><code>fastSeek&#40;<var>time</var>&#41;</code></strong> method must <a id="seeking&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seek"></a>[seek](#dom-media-seek) to the time given by <var>time</var>&#44; with the <em>approximate&#45;for&#45;speed</em> flag set&#46;

When the user agent is required to <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;seek"></a><strong>seek</strong> to a particular <var>new playback position</var> in the <a id="seeking&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; optionally with the <em>approximate&#45;for&#45;speed</em> flag set&#44; it means that the user agent must run the following steps&#46; This algorithm interacts closely with the <a id="seeking&#58;event&#45;loop"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) mechanism&#59; in particular&#44; it has a <a id="seeking&#58;synchronous&#45;section"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) &#40;which is triggered as part of the <a id="seeking&#58;event&#45;loop&#45;2"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) algorithm&#41;&#46; Steps in that section are marked with ⌛&#46;

1.  Set the <a id="seeking&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="seeking&#58;show&#45;poster&#45;flag"></a>[show poster flag](#show-poster-flag) to false&#46;

2.  If the <a id="seeking&#58;media&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="seeking&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> is <a id="seeking&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;nothing"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;NOTHING](#dom-media-have_nothing)</code>&#44; return&#46;

3.  If the element&#39;s <a id="seeking&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seeking"></a><code>[seeking](#dom-media-seeking)</code> IDL attribute is true&#44; then another instance of this algorithm is already running&#46; Abort that other instance of the algorithm without waiting for the step that it is running to complete&#46;

4.  Set the <a id="seeking&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seeking&#45;2"></a><code>[seeking](#dom-media-seeking)</code> IDL attribute to true&#46;

5.  If the seek was in response to a DOM method call or setting of an IDL attribute&#44; then continue the script&#46; The remainder of these steps must be run <a id="seeking&#58;in&#45;parallel"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel)&#46; With the exception of the steps marked with ⌛&#44; they could be aborted at any time by another instance of this algorithm being invoked&#46;

6.  If the <var>new playback position</var> is later than the end of the <a id="seeking&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;3"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; then let it be the end of the <a id="seeking&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;4"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) instead&#46;

7.  If the <var>new playback position</var> is less than the <a id="seeking&#58;earliest&#45;possible&#45;position"></a>[earliest possible position](#earliest-possible-position)&#44; let it be that position instead&#46;

8.  If the &#40;possibly now changed&#41; <var>new playback position</var> is not in one of the ranges given in the <a id="seeking&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seekable"></a><code>[seekable](#dom-media-seekable)</code> attribute&#44; then let it be the position in one of the ranges given in the <a id="seeking&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seekable&#45;2"></a><code>[seekable](#dom-media-seekable)</code> attribute that is the nearest to the <var>new playback position</var>&#46; If two positions both satisfy that constraint &#40;i&#46;e&#46; the <var>new playback position</var> is exactly in the middle between two ranges in the <a id="seeking&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seekable&#45;3"></a><code>[seekable](#dom-media-seekable)</code> attribute&#41;&#44; then use the position that is closest to the <a id="seeking&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#46; If there are no ranges given in the <a id="seeking&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seekable&#45;4"></a><code>[seekable](#dom-media-seekable)</code> attribute&#44; then set the <a id="seeking&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seeking&#45;3"></a><code>[seeking](#dom-media-seeking)</code> IDL attribute to false and return&#46;

9.  If the <em>approximate&#45;for&#45;speed</em> flag is set&#44; adjust the <var>new playback position</var> to a value that will allow for playback to resume promptly&#46; If <var>new playback position</var> before this step is before <a id="seeking&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;2"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#44; then the adjusted <var>new playback position</var> must also be before the <a id="seeking&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;3"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#46; Similarly&#44; if the <var>new playback position</var> before this step is after <a id="seeking&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;4"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#44; then the adjusted <var>new playback position</var> must also be after the <a id="seeking&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;5"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#46;

    <strong>Example&#58;</strong>

    For example&#44; the user agent could snap to a nearby key frame&#44; so that it doesn&#39;t have to spend time decoding then discarding intermediate frames before resuming playback&#46;

10. <a id="seeking&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="seeking&#58;media&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="seeking&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="seeking&#58;event&#45;media&#45;seeking"></a><code>[seeking](#event-media-seeking)</code> at the element&#46;

11. Set the <a id="seeking&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;6"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) to the <var>new playback position</var>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    If the <a id="seeking&#58;media&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[media element](#media-element) was <a id="seeking&#58;potentially&#45;playing"></a>[potentially playing](#potentially-playing) immediately before it started seeking&#44; but seeking caused its <a id="seeking&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate&#45;2"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> attribute to change to a value lower than <a id="seeking&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;future&#95;data"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;FUTURE&#95;DATA](#dom-media-have_future_data)</code>&#44; then a <a id="seeking&#58;event&#45;media&#45;waiting"></a><code>[waiting](#event-media-waiting)</code> event [will be fired](#fire-waiting-when-waiting) at the element&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This step sets the <a id="seeking&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;7"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#44; and thus can immediately trigger other conditions&#44; such as the rules regarding when playback &#34;[reaches the end of the media resource](#reaches-the-end)&#34; &#40;part of the logic that handles looping&#41;&#44; even before the user agent is actually able to render the media data for that position &#40;as determined in the next step&#41;&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    The <a id="seeking&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;currenttime&#45;2"></a><code>[currentTime](#dom-media-currenttime)</code> attribute returns the <a id="seeking&#58;official&#45;playback&#45;position"></a>[official playback position](#official-playback-position)&#44; not the <a id="seeking&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;8"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position)&#44; and therefore gets updated before script execution&#44; separate from this algorithm&#46;

12. Wait until the user agent has established whether or not the <a id="seeking&#58;media&#45;data"></a>[media data](#media-data) for the <var>new playback position</var> is available&#44; and&#44; if it is&#44; until it has decoded enough data to play back that position&#46;

13. <a id="seeking&#58;await&#45;a&#45;stable&#45;state"></a>[Await a stable state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#await-a-stable-state)&#46; The <a id="seeking&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;2"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) consists of all the remaining steps of this algorithm&#46; &#40;Steps in the <a id="seeking&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;3"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) are marked with ⌛&#46;&#41;

14. ⌛ Set the <a id="seeking&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seeking&#45;4"></a><code>[seeking](#dom-media-seeking)</code> IDL attribute to false&#46;

15. ⌛ Run the <a id="seeking&#58;time&#45;marches&#45;on"></a>[time marches on](#time-marches-on) steps&#46;

16. <a id="seekUpdate"></a>

    ⌛ <a id="seeking&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="seeking&#58;media&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="seeking&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="seeking&#58;event&#45;media&#45;timeupdate"></a><code>[timeupdate](#event-media-timeupdate)</code> at the element&#46;

17. ⌛ <a id="seeking&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="seeking&#58;media&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="seeking&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;3"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="seeking&#58;event&#45;media&#45;seeked"></a><code>[seeked](#event-media-seeked)</code> at the element&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;seekable"></a><strong><code>seekable</code></strong> getter steps are to return a new <a id="seeking&#58;normalised&#45;timeranges&#45;object"></a>[normalized <code>TimeRanges</code> object](#normalised-timeranges-object) that represents the ranges of <a id="seeking&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="seeking&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;5"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; if any&#44; that the user agent is able to seek to&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

If the user agent can seek to anywhere in the <a id="seeking&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;6"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#44; e&#46;g&#46; because it is a simple movie file and the user agent and the server support HTTP Range requests&#44; then the attribute would return an object with one range&#44; whose start is the time of the first frame &#40;the <a id="seeking&#58;earliest&#45;possible&#45;position&#45;2"></a>[earliest possible position](#earliest-possible-position)&#44; typically zero&#41;&#44; and whose end is the same as the time of the first frame plus the <a id="seeking&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;duration"></a><code>[duration](#dom-media-duration)</code> attribute&#39;s value &#40;which would equal the time of the last frame&#44; and might be positive Infinity&#41;&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The range might be continuously changing&#44; e&#46;g&#46; if the user agent is buffering a sliding window on an infinite stream&#46; This is the behavior seen with DVRs viewing live TV&#44; for instance&#46;

<strong>Warning&#58;</strong>

Returning a new object each time is a bad pattern for attribute getters and is only enshrined here as it would be costly to change it&#46; It is not to be copied to new APIs&#46;

User agents should adopt a very liberal and optimistic view of what is seekable&#46; User agents should also buffer recent content where possible to enable seeking to be fast&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For instance&#44; consider a large video file served on an HTTP server without support for HTTP Range requests&#46; A browser <em>could</em> implement this by only buffering the current frame and data obtained for subsequent frames&#44; never allow seeking&#44; except for seeking to the very start by restarting the playback&#46; However&#44; this would be a poor implementation&#46; A high quality implementation would buffer the last few minutes of content &#40;or more&#44; if sufficient storage space is available&#41;&#44; allowing the user to jump back and rewatch something surprising without any latency&#44; and would in addition allow arbitrary seeking by reloading the file from the start if necessary&#44; which would be slower but still more convenient than having to literally restart the video and watch it all the way through just to get to an earlier unbuffered spot&#46;

<a id="seeking&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;7"></a>[Media resources](#media-resource) might be internally scripted or interactive&#46; Thus&#44; a <a id="seeking&#58;media&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[media element](#media-element) could play in a non&#45;linear fashion&#46; If this happens&#44; the user agent must act as if the algorithm for <a id="seeking&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seek&#45;2"></a>[seeking](#dom-media-seek) was used whenever the <a id="seeking&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;9"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) changes in a discontinuous fashion &#40;so that the relevant events fire&#41;&#46;

##### <a id="media&#45;resources&#45;with&#45;multiple&#45;media&#45;tracks"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;10 Media resources with multiple media tracks[](#media-resources-with-multiple-media-tracks)

A <a id="media&#45;resources&#45;with&#45;multiple&#45;media&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) can have multiple embedded audio and video tracks&#46; For example&#44; in addition to the primary video and audio tracks&#44; a <a id="media&#45;resources&#45;with&#45;multiple&#45;media&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) could have foreign&#45;language dubbed dialogues&#44; director&#39;s commentaries&#44; audio descriptions&#44; alternative angles&#44; or sign&#45;language overlays&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

There are only ever one <a id="media&#45;resources&#45;with&#45;multiple&#45;media&#45;tracks&#58;audiotracklist&#45;3"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> object and one <a id="media&#45;resources&#45;with&#45;multiple&#45;media&#45;tracks&#58;videotracklist&#45;3"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> object per <a id="media&#45;resources&#45;with&#45;multiple&#45;media&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; even if another <a id="media&#45;resources&#45;with&#45;multiple&#45;media&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;7"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is loaded into the element&#58; the objects are reused&#46; &#40;The <a id="media&#45;resources&#45;with&#45;multiple&#45;media&#45;tracks&#58;audiotrack"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> and <a id="media&#45;resources&#45;with&#45;multiple&#45;media&#45;tracks&#58;videotrack"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> objects are not&#44; though&#46;&#41;

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface AudioTrackList : EventTarget {
  readonly attribute unsigned long length;
  getter AudioTrack (unsigned long index);
  AudioTrack? getTrackById(DOMString id);

  attribute EventHandler onchange;
  attribute EventHandler onaddtrack;
  attribute EventHandler onremovetrack;
};

[Exposed=Window]
interface AudioTrack {
  readonly attribute DOMString id;
  readonly attribute DOMString kind;
  readonly attribute DOMString label;
  readonly attribute DOMString language;
  attribute boolean enabled;
};

[Exposed=Window]
interface VideoTrackList : EventTarget {
  readonly attribute unsigned long length;
  getter VideoTrack (unsigned long index);
  VideoTrack? getTrackById(DOMString id);
  readonly attribute long selectedIndex;

  attribute EventHandler onchange;
  attribute EventHandler onaddtrack;
  attribute EventHandler onremovetrack;
};

[Exposed=Window]
interface VideoTrack {
  readonly attribute DOMString id;
  readonly attribute DOMString kind;
  readonly attribute DOMString label;
  readonly attribute DOMString language;
  attribute boolean selected;
};
```

<strong><code><var>videoTrack</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;videotrack&#45;selected&#45;dev"></a>[selected](#dom-videotrack-selected) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

Returns true if the given track is active&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

Can be set&#44; to change whether the track is selected or not&#46; Either zero or one video track is selected&#59; selecting a new track while a previous one is selected will unselect the previous one&#46;

An <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotracklist&#45;3"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> object represents a dynamic list of zero or more audio tracks&#44; of which zero or more can be enabled at a time&#46; Each audio track is represented by an <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotrack&#45;5"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> object&#46;

A <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotracklist&#45;3"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> object represents a dynamic list of zero or more video tracks&#44; of which zero or one can be selected at a time&#46; Each video track is represented by a <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotrack&#45;5"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> object&#46;

Tracks in <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotracklist&#45;4"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> and <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotracklist&#45;4"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> objects must be consistently ordered&#46; If the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is in a format that defines an order&#44; then that order must be used&#59; otherwise&#44; the order must be the relative order in which the tracks are declared in the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#46; The order used is called the <em>natural order</em> of the list&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Each track in one of these objects thus has an index&#59; the first has the index 0&#44; and each subsequent track is numbered one higher than the previous one&#46; If a <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;3"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) dynamically adds or removes audio or video tracks&#44; then the indices of the tracks will change dynamically&#46; If the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;4"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) changes entirely&#44; then all the previous tracks will be removed and replaced with new tracks&#46;

The <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotracklist&#45;5"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> <a id="dom&#45;audiotracklist&#45;length"></a><strong><code>length</code></strong> and <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotracklist&#45;5"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> <a id="dom&#45;videotracklist&#45;length"></a><strong><code>length</code></strong> attribute getters must return the number of tracks represented by their objects at the time of getting&#46;

The <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;supported&#45;property&#45;indices"></a>[supported property indices](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-indices) of <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotracklist&#45;6"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> and <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotracklist&#45;6"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> objects at any instant are the numbers from zero to the number of tracks represented by the respective object minus one&#44; if any tracks are represented&#46; If an <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotracklist&#45;7"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> or <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotracklist&#45;7"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> object represents no tracks&#44; it has no <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;supported&#45;property&#45;indices&#45;2"></a>[supported property indices](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-indices)&#46;

<a id="dom&#45;tracklist&#45;item"></a>To <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;determine&#45;the&#45;value&#45;of&#45;an&#45;indexed&#45;property"></a>[determine the value of an indexed property](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-determine-the-value-of-an-indexed-property) for a given index <var>index</var> in an <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotracklist&#45;8"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> or <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotracklist&#45;8"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> object <var>list</var>&#44; the user agent must return the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotrack&#45;6"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> or <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotrack&#45;6"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> object that represents the <var>index</var>th track in <var>list</var>&#46;

The <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotracklist&#45;9"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> <a id="dom&#45;audiotracklist&#45;gettrackbyid"></a><strong><code>getTrackById&#40;<var>id</var>&#41;</code></strong> and <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotracklist&#45;9"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> <a id="dom&#45;videotracklist&#45;gettrackbyid"></a><strong><code>getTrackById&#40;<var>id</var>&#41;</code></strong> methods must return the first <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotrack&#45;7"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> or <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotrack&#45;7"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> object &#40;respectively&#41; in the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotracklist&#45;10"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> or <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotracklist&#45;10"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> object &#40;respectively&#41; whose identifier is equal to the value of the <var>id</var> argument &#40;in the natural order of the list&#44; as defined above&#41;&#46; When no tracks match the given argument&#44; the methods must return null&#46;

The <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotrack&#45;8"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> and <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotrack&#45;8"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> objects represent specific tracks of a <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;5"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#46; Each track can have an identifier&#44; category&#44; label&#44; and language&#46; These aspects of a track are permanent for the lifetime of the track&#59; even if a track is removed from a <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;6"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#39;s <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotracklist&#45;11"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> or <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotracklist&#45;11"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> objects&#44; those aspects do not change&#46;

In addition&#44; <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotrack&#45;9"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> objects can each be enabled or disabled&#59; this is the audio track&#39;s <em>enabled state</em>&#46; When an <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotrack&#45;10"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> is created&#44; its <em>enabled state</em> must be set to false &#40;disabled&#41;&#46; The <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;resource"></a>[resource fetch algorithm](#concept-media-load-resource) can override this&#46;

Similarly&#44; a single <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotrack&#45;9"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> object per <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotracklist&#45;12"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> object can be selected&#44; this is the video track&#39;s <em>selection state</em>&#46; When a <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotrack&#45;10"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> is created&#44; its <em>selection state</em> must be set to false &#40;not selected&#41;&#46; The <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;load&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[resource fetch algorithm](#concept-media-load-resource) can override this&#46;

The <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotrack&#45;11"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> <a id="dom&#45;audiotrack&#45;id"></a><strong><code>id</code></strong> and <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotrack&#45;11"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> <a id="dom&#45;videotrack&#45;id"></a><strong><code>id</code></strong> attributes must return the identifier of the track&#44; if it has one&#44; or the empty string otherwise&#46; If the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;7"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is in a format that supports <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;media&#45;fragment&#45;syntax&#45;2"></a>[media fragment syntax](https://www.w3.org/TR/media-frags/#media-fragment-syntax)&#44; the identifier returned for a particular track must be the same identifier that would enable the track if used as the name of a track in the track dimension of such a <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;fragment&#45;2"></a>[fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment)&#46; [&#91;INBAND&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsINBAND)

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; in Ogg files&#44; this would be the Name header field of the track&#46; [&#91;OGGSKELETONHEADERS&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsOGGSKELETONHEADERS)

The <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotrack&#45;12"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> <a id="dom&#45;audiotrack&#45;kind"></a><strong><code>kind</code></strong> and <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotrack&#45;12"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> <a id="dom&#45;videotrack&#45;kind"></a><strong><code>kind</code></strong> attributes must return the category of the track&#44; if it has one&#44; or the empty string otherwise&#46;

The category of a track is the string given in the first column of the table below that is the most appropriate for the track based on the definitions in the table&#39;s second and third columns&#44; as determined by the metadata included in the track in the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;8"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#46; The cell in the third column of a row says what the category given in the cell in the first column of that row applies to&#59; a category is only appropriate for an audio track if it applies to audio tracks&#44; and a category is only appropriate for video tracks if it applies to video tracks&#46; Categories must only be returned for <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotrack&#45;13"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> objects if they are appropriate for audio&#44; and must only be returned for <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotrack&#45;13"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> objects if they are appropriate for video&#46;

For Ogg files&#44; the Role header field of the track gives the relevant metadata&#46; For DASH media resources&#44; the <code>Role</code> element conveys the information&#46; For WebM&#44; only the <code>FlagDefault</code> element currently maps to a value&#46; Sourcing In&#45;band Media Resource Tracks from Media Containers into HTML has further details&#46; [&#91;OGGSKELETONHEADERS&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsOGGSKELETONHEADERS) [&#91;DASH&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsDASH) [&#91;WEBMCG&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBMCG) [&#91;INBAND&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsINBAND)

&#34;audio&#47;audiodesc&#34;&#46;      </td></tr><tr><td>&#34;<dfn id="value-track-kind-main"><code>main</code></dfn>&#34;      </td><td>The primary audio or video track&#46;      </td><td>Audio and video&#46; and &#34;dub&#34; roles &#40;other roles ignored&#41;&#46;      </td></tr><tr><td>&#34;<dfn id="value-track-kind-main-desc"><code>main&#45;desc</code></dfn>&#34;      </td><td>The primary audio track&#44;
