The <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotrack&#45;15"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> <a id="dom&#45;audiotrack&#45;label"></a><strong><code>label</code></strong> and <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotrack&#45;15"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> <a id="dom&#45;videotrack&#45;label"></a><strong><code>label</code></strong> attributes must return the label of the track&#44; if it has one&#44; or the empty string otherwise&#46; [&#91;INBAND&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsINBAND)

The <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotrack&#45;16"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> <a id="dom&#45;audiotrack&#45;language"></a><strong><code>language</code></strong> and <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotrack&#45;16"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> <a id="dom&#45;videotrack&#45;language"></a><strong><code>language</code></strong> attributes must return the BCP 47 language tag of the language of the track&#44; if it has one&#44; or the empty string otherwise&#46; If the user agent is not able to express that language as a BCP 47 language tag &#40;for example because the language information in the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;9"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#39;s format is a free&#45;form string without a defined interpretation&#41;&#44; then the method must return the empty string&#44; as if the track had no language&#46; [&#91;INBAND&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsINBAND)

The <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotrack&#45;17"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> <a id="dom&#45;audiotrack&#45;enabled"></a><strong><code>enabled</code></strong> attribute&#44; on getting&#44; must return true if the track is currently enabled&#44; and false otherwise&#46; On setting&#44; it must enable the track if the new value is true&#44; and disable it otherwise&#46; &#40;If the track is no longer in an <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotracklist&#45;12"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> object&#44; then the track being enabled or disabled has no effect beyond changing the value of the attribute on the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotrack&#45;18"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> object&#46;&#41;

<a id="toggle&#45;audio&#45;track"></a>Whenever an audio track in an <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotracklist&#45;13"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> that was disabled is enabled&#44; and whenever one that was enabled is disabled&#44; the user agent must <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;event&#45;media&#45;change"></a><code>[change](#event-media-change)</code> at the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotracklist&#45;14"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> object&#46;

An audio track that has no data for a particular position on the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;media&#45;timeline"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline)&#44; or that does not exist at that position&#44; must be interpreted as being silent at that point on the timeline&#46;

The <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotracklist&#45;13"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> <a id="dom&#45;videotracklist&#45;selectedindex"></a><strong><code>selectedIndex</code></strong> attribute must return the index of the currently selected track&#44; if any&#46; If the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotracklist&#45;14"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> object does not currently represent any tracks&#44; or if none of the tracks are selected&#44; it must instead return −1&#46;

The <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotrack&#45;17"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> <a id="dom&#45;videotrack&#45;selected"></a><strong><code>selected</code></strong> attribute&#44; on getting&#44; must return true if the track is currently selected&#44; and false otherwise&#46; On setting&#44; it must select the track if the new value is true&#44; and unselect it otherwise&#46; If the track is in a <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotracklist&#45;15"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code>&#44; then all the other <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotrack&#45;18"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> objects in that list must be unselected&#46; &#40;If the track is no longer in a <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotracklist&#45;16"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> object&#44; then the track being selected or unselected has no effect beyond changing the value of the attribute on the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotrack&#45;19"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> object&#46;&#41;

<a id="toggle&#45;video&#45;track"></a>Whenever a track in a <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotracklist&#45;17"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> that was previously not selected is selected&#44; and whenever the selected track in a <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotracklist&#45;18"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> is unselected without a new track being selected in its stead&#44; the user agent must <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;media&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;event&#45;media&#45;change&#45;2"></a><code>[change](#event-media-change)</code> at the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotracklist&#45;19"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> object&#46; This <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;concept&#45;task"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) must be <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[queued](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) before the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that fires the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;event&#45;media&#45;resize"></a><code>[resize](#event-media-resize)</code> event&#44; if any&#46;

A video track that has no data for a particular position on the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;media&#45;timeline&#45;2"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline) must be interpreted as being <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;transparent&#45;black"></a>[transparent black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black) at that point on the timeline&#44; with the same dimensions as the last frame before that position&#44; or&#44; if the position is before all the data for that track&#44; the same dimensions as the first frame for that track&#46; A track that does not exist at all at the current position must be treated as if it existed but had no data&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For instance&#44; if a video has a track that is only introduced after one hour of playback&#44; and the user selects that track then goes back to the start&#44; then the user agent will act as if that track started at the start of the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;10"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) but was simply transparent until one hour in&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The following are the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;event&#45;handlers"></a>[event handlers](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-handlers) &#40;and their corresponding <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;event&#45;handler&#45;event&#45;type"></a>[event handler event types](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-handler-event-type)&#41; that must be supported&#44; as <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;event&#45;handler&#45;idl&#45;attributes"></a>[event handler IDL attributes](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-handler-idl-attributes)&#44; by all objects implementing the <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;audiotracklist&#45;15"></a><code>[AudioTrackList](#audiotracklist)</code> and <a id="audiotracklist&#45;and&#45;videotracklist&#45;objects&#58;videotracklist&#45;20"></a><code>[VideoTrackList](#videotracklist)</code> interfaces&#58;

###### <a id="selecting&#45;specific&#45;audio&#45;and&#45;video&#45;tracks&#45;declaratively"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;10&#46;2 Selecting specific audio and video tracks declaratively[](#selecting-specific-audio-and-video-tracks-declaratively)

The <a id="selecting&#45;specific&#45;audio&#45;and&#45;video&#45;tracks&#45;declaratively&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;audiotracks"></a><code>[audioTracks](#dom-media-audiotracks)</code> and <a id="selecting&#45;specific&#45;audio&#45;and&#45;video&#45;tracks&#45;declaratively&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;videotracks"></a><code>[videoTracks](#dom-media-videotracks)</code> attributes allow scripts to select which track should play&#44; but it is also possible to select specific tracks declaratively&#44; by specifying particular tracks in the <a id="selecting&#45;specific&#45;audio&#45;and&#45;video&#45;tracks&#45;declaratively&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;fragment"></a>[fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment) of the <a id="selecting&#45;specific&#45;audio&#45;and&#45;video&#45;tracks&#45;declaratively&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) of the <a id="selecting&#45;specific&#45;audio&#45;and&#45;video&#45;tracks&#45;declaratively&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#46; The format of the <a id="selecting&#45;specific&#45;audio&#45;and&#45;video&#45;tracks&#45;declaratively&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;fragment&#45;2"></a>[fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment) depends on the <a id="selecting&#45;specific&#45;audio&#45;and&#45;video&#45;tracks&#45;declaratively&#58;mime&#45;type"></a>[MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type) of the <a id="selecting&#45;specific&#45;audio&#45;and&#45;video&#45;tracks&#45;declaratively&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#46; [&#91;RFC2046&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsRFC2046) [&#91;URL&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsURL)

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; a video that uses a format that supports <a id="selecting&#45;specific&#45;audio&#45;and&#45;video&#45;tracks&#45;declaratively&#58;media&#45;fragment&#45;syntax"></a>[media fragment syntax](https://www.w3.org/TR/media-frags/#media-fragment-syntax) is embedded in such a way that the alternative angles labeled &#34;Alternative&#34; are enabled instead of the default video track&#46;

``` text
<video src="myvideo#track=Alternative"></video>
```

##### <a id="timed&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;11 Timed text tracks[](#timed-text-tracks)

###### <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;11&#46;1 Text track model[](#text-track-model)

A <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[media element](#media-element) can have a group of associated <a id="text&#45;track"></a><strong>text tracks</strong>&#44; known as the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a><strong>list of text tracks</strong>&#46; The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) are sorted as follows&#58;

1.  The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;2"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) corresponding to <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element children of the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; in <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#46;

2.  Any <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;3"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) added using the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;addtexttrack"></a><code>[addTextTrack&#40;&#41;](#dom-media-addtexttrack)</code> method&#44; in the order they were added&#44; oldest first&#46;

3.  Any <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;specific&#45;text&#45;track"></a>[media&#45;resource&#45;specific text tracks](#media-resource-specific-text-track) &#40;<a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;4"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) corresponding to data in the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#41;&#44; in the order defined by the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#39;s format specification&#46;

A <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;5"></a>[text track](#text-track) is a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;texttrack"></a><code>[TextTrack](#texttrack)</code> object and consists of&#58;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;kind"></a><strong>The kind of text track</strong></strong>

This decides how the track is handled by the user agent&#46; The kind is represented by a string&#46; The possible strings are&#58;

- <a id="dom&#45;texttrack&#45;kind&#45;subtitles"></a><strong><code>subtitles</code></strong>
- <a id="dom&#45;texttrack&#45;kind&#45;captions"></a><strong><code>captions</code></strong>
- <a id="dom&#45;texttrack&#45;kind&#45;descriptions"></a><strong><code>descriptions</code></strong>
- <a id="dom&#45;texttrack&#45;kind&#45;chapters"></a><strong><code>chapters</code></strong>
- <a id="dom&#45;texttrack&#45;kind&#45;metadata"></a><strong><code>metadata</code></strong>

The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;kind"></a>[kind of track](#text-track-kind) can change dynamically&#44; in the case of a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;6"></a>[text track](#text-track) corresponding to a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;label"></a><strong>A label</strong></strong>

This is a human&#45;readable string intended to identify the track for the user&#46;

The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;label"></a>[label of a track](#text-track-label) can change dynamically&#44; in the case of a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;7"></a>[text track](#text-track) corresponding to a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#46;

When a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;label&#45;2"></a>[text track label](#text-track-label) is the empty string&#44; the user agent should automatically generate an appropriate label from the text track&#39;s other properties &#40;e&#46;g&#46; the kind of text track and the text track&#39;s language&#41; for use in its user interface&#46; This automatically&#45;generated label is not exposed in the API&#46;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;in&#45;band&#45;metadata&#45;track&#45;dispatch&#45;type"></a><strong>An in&#45;band metadata track dispatch type</strong></strong>

This is a string extracted from the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;3"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) specifically for in&#45;band metadata tracks to enable such tracks to be dispatched to different scripts in the document&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; a traditional TV station broadcast streamed on the web and augmented with web&#45;specific interactive features could include text tracks with metadata for ad targeting&#44; trivia game data during game shows&#44; player states during sports games&#44; recipe information during food programs&#44; and so forth&#46; As each program starts and ends&#44; new tracks might be added or removed from the stream&#44; and as each one is added&#44; the user agent could bind them to dedicated script modules using the value of this attribute&#46;

Other than for in&#45;band metadata text tracks&#44; the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;in&#45;band&#45;metadata&#45;track&#45;dispatch&#45;type"></a>[in&#45;band metadata track dispatch type](#text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) is the empty string&#46; How this value is populated for different media formats is described in <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;steps&#45;to&#45;expose&#45;a&#45;media&#45;resource&#45;specific&#45;text&#45;track"></a>[steps to expose a media&#45;resource&#45;specific text track](#steps-to-expose-a-media-resource-specific-text-track)&#46;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;language"></a><strong>A language</strong></strong>

This is a string &#40;a BCP 47 language tag&#41; representing the language of the text track&#39;s cues&#46; [&#91;BCP47&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsBCP47)

The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;language"></a>[language of a text track](#text-track-language) can change dynamically&#44; in the case of a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;8"></a>[text track](#text-track) corresponding to a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;identifier"></a><strong>An identifier</strong></strong>

A string&#46;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;readiness&#45;state"></a><strong>A readiness state</strong></strong>

One of the following&#58;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;not&#45;loaded"></a><strong>Not loaded</strong></strong>

Indicates that the text track&#39;s cues have not been obtained&#46;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;loading"></a><strong>Loading</strong></strong>

Indicates that the text track is loading and there have been no fatal errors encountered so far&#46; Further cues might still be added to the track by the parser&#46;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;loaded"></a><strong>Loaded</strong></strong>

Indicates that the text track has been loaded with no fatal errors&#46;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;failed&#45;to&#45;load"></a><strong>Failed to load</strong></strong>

Indicates that the text track was enabled&#44; but when the user agent attempted to obtain it&#44; this failed in some way &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) could not be <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[parsed](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#encoding-parsing-a-url)&#44; network error&#44; unknown text track format&#41;&#46; Some or all of the cues are likely missing and will not be obtained&#46;

The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;readiness&#45;state"></a>[readiness state](#text-track-readiness-state) of a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;9"></a>[text track](#text-track) changes dynamically as the track is obtained&#46;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;mode"></a><strong>A mode</strong></strong>

One of the following&#58;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;disabled"></a><strong>Disabled</strong></strong>

Indicates that the text track is not active&#46; Other than for the purposes of exposing the track in the DOM&#44; the user agent is ignoring the text track&#46; No cues are active&#44; no events are fired&#44; and the user agent will not attempt to obtain the track&#39;s cues&#46;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;hidden"></a><strong>Hidden</strong></strong>

Indicates that the text track is active&#44; but that the user agent is not actively displaying the cues&#46; If no attempt has yet been made to obtain the track&#39;s cues&#44; the user agent will perform such an attempt momentarily&#46; The user agent is maintaining a list of which cues are active&#44; and events are being fired accordingly&#46;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;showing"></a><strong>Showing</strong></strong>

Indicates that the text track is active&#46; If no attempt has yet been made to obtain the track&#39;s cues&#44; the user agent will perform such an attempt momentarily&#46; The user agent is maintaining a list of which cues are active&#44; and events are being fired accordingly&#46; In addition&#44; for text tracks whose <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;2"></a>[kind](#text-track-kind) is <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;texttrack&#45;kind&#45;subtitles"></a><code>[subtitles](#dom-texttrack-kind-subtitles)</code> or <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;texttrack&#45;kind&#45;captions"></a><code>[captions](#dom-texttrack-kind-captions)</code>&#44; the cues are being overlaid on the video as appropriate&#59; for text tracks whose <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;3"></a>[kind](#text-track-kind) is <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;texttrack&#45;kind&#45;descriptions"></a><code>[descriptions](#dom-texttrack-kind-descriptions)</code>&#44; the user agent is making the cues available to the user in a non&#45;visual fashion&#59; and for text tracks whose <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;4"></a>[kind](#text-track-kind) is <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;texttrack&#45;kind&#45;chapters"></a><code>[chapters](#dom-texttrack-kind-chapters)</code>&#44; the user agent is making available to the user a mechanism by which the user can navigate to any point in the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;4"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) by selecting a cue&#46;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues"></a><strong>A list of zero or more cues</strong></strong>

A list of <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue"></a>[text track cues](#text-track-cue)&#44; along with <a id="rules&#45;for&#45;updating&#45;the&#45;text&#45;track&#45;rendering"></a><strong>rules for updating the text track rendering</strong>&#46; For example&#44; for WebVTT&#44; the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;updating&#45;the&#45;display&#45;of&#45;webvtt&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a>[rules for updating the display of WebVTT text tracks](https://w3c.github.io/webvtt/#rules-for-updating-the-display-of-webvtt-text-tracks)&#46; [&#91;WEBVTT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBVTT)

The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues"></a>[list of cues of a text track](#text-track-list-of-cues) can change dynamically&#44; either because the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;10"></a>[text track](#text-track) has <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;not&#45;loaded"></a>[not yet been loaded](#text-track-not-loaded) or is still <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;loading"></a>[loading](#text-track-loading)&#44; or due to DOM manipulation&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Each <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[media element](#media-element) has a <a id="list&#45;of&#45;pending&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a><strong>list of pending text tracks</strong>&#44; which must initially be empty&#44; a <a id="blocked&#45;on&#45;parser"></a><strong>blocked&#45;on&#45;parser</strong> flag&#44; which must initially be false&#44; and a <a id="did&#45;perform&#45;automatic&#45;track&#45;selection"></a><strong>did&#45;perform&#45;automatic&#45;track&#45;selection</strong> flag&#44; which must also initially be false&#46;

When the user agent is required to <a id="populate&#45;the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;pending&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a><strong>populate the list of pending text tracks</strong> of a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; the user agent must add to the element&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;list&#45;of&#45;pending&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a>[list of pending text tracks](#list-of-pending-text-tracks) each <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;11"></a>[text track](#text-track) in the element&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks) whose <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode"></a>[text track mode](#text-track-mode) is not <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](#text-track-disabled) and whose <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;readiness&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[text track readiness state](#text-track-readiness-state) is <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;loading&#45;2"></a>[loading](#text-track-loading)&#46;

Whenever a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#39;s parent node changes&#44; the user agent must remove the corresponding <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;12"></a>[text track](#text-track) from any <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;list&#45;of&#45;pending&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;2"></a>[list of pending text tracks](#list-of-pending-text-tracks) that it is in&#46;

Whenever a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;13"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;readiness&#45;state&#45;3"></a>[text track readiness state](#text-track-readiness-state) changes to either <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;loaded"></a>[loaded](#text-track-loaded) or <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;failed&#45;to&#45;load"></a>[failed to load](#text-track-failed-to-load)&#44; the user agent must remove it from any <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;list&#45;of&#45;pending&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;3"></a>[list of pending text tracks](#list-of-pending-text-tracks) that it is in&#46;

When a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[media element](#media-element) is created by an <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;html&#45;parser"></a>[HTML parser](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#html-parser) or <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;xml&#45;parser"></a>[XML parser](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#xml-parser)&#44; the user agent must set the element&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;blocked&#45;on&#45;parser"></a>[blocked&#45;on&#45;parser](#blocked-on-parser) flag to true&#46; When a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[media element](#media-element) is popped off the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#stack-of-open-elements) of an <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;html&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[HTML parser](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#html-parser) or <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;xml&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[XML parser](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#xml-parser)&#44; the user agent must <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;honor&#45;user&#45;preferences&#45;for&#45;automatic&#45;text&#45;track&#45;selection"></a>[honor user preferences for automatic text track selection](#honor-user-preferences-for-automatic-text-track-selection)&#44; <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;populate&#45;the&#45;list&#45;of&#45;pending&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a>[populate the list of pending text tracks](#populate-the-list-of-pending-text-tracks)&#44; and set the element&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;blocked&#45;on&#45;parser&#45;2"></a>[blocked&#45;on&#45;parser](#blocked-on-parser) flag to false&#46;

The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;14"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) of a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;8"></a>[media element](#media-element) are <a id="the&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;are&#45;ready"></a><strong>ready</strong> when both the element&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;list&#45;of&#45;pending&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;4"></a>[list of pending text tracks](#list-of-pending-text-tracks) is empty and the element&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;blocked&#45;on&#45;parser&#45;3"></a>[blocked&#45;on&#45;parser](#blocked-on-parser) flag is false&#46;

Each <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;9"></a>[media element](#media-element) has a <a id="pending&#45;text&#45;track&#45;change&#45;notification&#45;flag"></a><strong>pending text track change notification flag</strong>&#44; which must initially be unset&#46;

Whenever a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;15"></a>[text track](#text-track) that is in a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;10"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;2"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks) has its <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[text track mode](#text-track-mode) change value&#44; the user agent must run the following steps for the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;11"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#58;

1.  If the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;12"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;pending&#45;text&#45;track&#45;change&#45;notification&#45;flag"></a>[pending text track change notification flag](#pending-text-track-change-notification-flag) is set&#44; return&#46;

2.  Set the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;13"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;pending&#45;text&#45;track&#45;change&#45;notification&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[pending text track change notification flag](#pending-text-track-change-notification-flag)&#46;

3.  <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;14"></a>[media element](#media-element) to run these steps&#58;

    1.  Unset the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;15"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;pending&#45;text&#45;track&#45;change&#45;notification&#45;flag&#45;3"></a>[pending text track change notification flag](#pending-text-track-change-notification-flag)&#46;

    2.  <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;event&#45;media&#45;change"></a><code>[change](#event-media-change)</code> at the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;16"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;texttracks"></a><code>[textTracks](#dom-media-texttracks)</code> attribute&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;texttracklist"></a><code>[TextTrackList](#texttracklist)</code> object&#46;

4.  If the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;17"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;show&#45;poster&#45;flag"></a>[show poster flag](#show-poster-flag) is not set&#44; run the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;time&#45;marches&#45;on"></a><em>[time marches on](#time-marches-on)</em> steps&#46;

The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;task&#45;source"></a>[task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#task-source) for the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;task"></a>[tasks](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) listed in this section is the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

A <a id="text&#45;track&#45;cue"></a><strong>text track cue</strong> is the unit of time&#45;sensitive data in a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;16"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#44; corresponding for instance for subtitles and captions to the text that appears at a particular time and disappears at another time&#46;

Each <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;2"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) consists of&#58;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;identifier"></a><strong>An identifier</strong></strong>

An arbitrary string&#46;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;start&#45;time"></a><strong>A start time</strong></strong>

The time&#44; in seconds and fractions of a second&#44; that describes the beginning of the range of the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;data"></a>[media data](#media-data) to which the cue applies&#46;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;end&#45;time"></a><strong>An end time</strong></strong>

The time&#44; in seconds and fractions of a second&#44; that describes the end of the range of the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;data&#45;2"></a>[media data](#media-data) to which the cue applies&#44; or positive Infinity for an <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;unbounded&#45;text&#45;track&#45;cue"></a>[unbounded text track cue](#unbounded-text-track-cue)&#46;

<strong><a id="text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;pause&#45;on&#45;exit&#45;flag"></a><strong>A pause&#45;on&#45;exit flag</strong></strong>

A boolean indicating whether playback of the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;5"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is to pause when the end of the range to which the cue applies is reached&#46;

<strong>Some additional format&#45;specific data</strong>

Additional fields&#44; as needed for the format&#44; including the actual data of the cue&#46; For example&#44; WebVTT has a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;writing&#45;direction"></a>[text track cue writing direction](https://w3c.github.io/webvtt/#webvtt-cue-writing-direction) and so forth&#46; [&#91;WEBVTT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBVTT)

An <a id="unbounded&#45;text&#45;track&#45;cue"></a><strong>unbounded text track cue</strong> is a text track cue with a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;end&#45;time"></a>[text track cue end time](#text-track-cue-end-time) set to positive Infinity&#46; An active <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;unbounded&#45;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;2"></a>[unbounded text track cue](#unbounded-text-track-cue) cannot become inactive through the usual monotonic increase of the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) during normal playback &#40;e&#46;g&#46; a metadata cue for a chapter in a live event with no announced end time&#46;&#41;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;start&#45;time"></a>[text track cue start time](#text-track-cue-start-time) and <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;end&#45;time&#45;2"></a>[text track cue end time](#text-track-cue-end-time) can be negative&#46; &#40;The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;current&#45;playback&#45;position&#45;2"></a>[current playback position](#current-playback-position) can never be negative&#44; though&#44; so cues entirely before time zero cannot be active&#46;&#41;

Each <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;3"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) has a corresponding <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;texttrackcue"></a><code>[TextTrackCue](#texttrackcue)</code> object &#40;or more specifically&#44; an object that inherits from <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;texttrackcue&#45;2"></a><code>[TextTrackCue](#texttrackcue)</code> — for example&#44; WebVTT cues use the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;vttcue"></a><code>[VTTCue](https://w3c.github.io/webvtt/#vttcue)</code> interface&#41;&#46; A <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;4"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue)&#39;s in&#45;memory representation can be dynamically changed through this <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;texttrackcue&#45;3"></a><code>[TextTrackCue](#texttrackcue)</code> API&#46; [&#91;WEBVTT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBVTT)

A <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;5"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) is associated with <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;updating&#45;the&#45;text&#45;track&#45;rendering"></a>[rules for updating the text track rendering](#rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering)&#44; as defined by the specification for the specific kind of <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;6"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue)&#46; These rules are used specifically when the object representing the cue is added to a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;texttrack&#45;2"></a><code>[TextTrack](#texttrack)</code> object using the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;texttrack&#45;addcue"></a><code>[addCue&#40;&#41;](#dom-texttrack-addcue)</code> method&#46;

In addition&#44; each <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;7"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) has two pieces of dynamic information&#58;

<strong>The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;active&#45;flag"></a><strong>active flag</strong></strong>

This flag must be initially unset&#46; The flag is used to ensure events are fired appropriately when the cue becomes active or inactive&#44; and to make sure the right cues are rendered&#46;

The user agent must synchronously unset this flag whenever the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;8"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) is removed from its <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;17"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;2"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues)&#59; whenever the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;18"></a>[text track](#text-track) itself is removed from its <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;18"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;3"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks) or has its <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[text track mode](#text-track-mode) changed to <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;disabled&#45;2"></a>[disabled](#text-track-disabled)&#59; and whenever the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;19"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;readystate"></a><code>[readyState](#dom-media-readystate)</code> is changed back to <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;have&#95;nothing"></a><code>[HAVE&#95;NOTHING](#dom-media-have_nothing)</code>&#46; When the flag is unset in this way for one or more cues in <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;19"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) that were <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;showing"></a>[showing](#text-track-showing) prior to the relevant incident&#44; the user agent must&#44; after having unset the flag for all the affected cues&#44; apply the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;updating&#45;the&#45;text&#45;track&#45;rendering&#45;2"></a>[rules for updating the text track rendering](#rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering) of those <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;20"></a>[text tracks](#text-track)&#46; For example&#44; for <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;21"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) based on WebVTT&#44; the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;updating&#45;the&#45;display&#45;of&#45;webvtt&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;2"></a>[rules for updating the display of WebVTT text tracks](https://w3c.github.io/webvtt/#rules-for-updating-the-display-of-webvtt-text-tracks)&#46; [&#91;WEBVTT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBVTT)

<strong>The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;display&#45;state"></a><strong>display state</strong></strong>

This is used as part of the rendering model&#44; to keep cues in a consistent position&#46; It must initially be empty&#46; Whenever the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;active&#45;flag"></a>[text track cue active flag](#text-track-cue-active-flag) is unset&#44; the user agent must empty the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;display&#45;state"></a>[text track cue display state](#text-track-cue-display-state)&#46;

The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;9"></a>[text track cues](#text-track-cue) of a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;20"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;22"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) are ordered relative to each other in the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;order"></a><strong>text track cue order</strong>&#44; which is determined as follows&#58; first group the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;10"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) by their <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;23"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#44; with the groups being sorted in the same order as their <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;24"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) appear in the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;media&#45;element&#45;21"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;4"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks)&#59; then&#44; within each group&#44; <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;11"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) must be sorted by their <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;start&#45;time&#45;2"></a>[start time](#text-track-cue-start-time)&#44; earliest first&#59; then&#44; any <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;12"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) with the same <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;start&#45;time&#45;3"></a>[start time](#text-track-cue-start-time) must be sorted by their <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;end&#45;time&#45;3"></a>[end time](#text-track-cue-end-time)&#44; latest first&#59; and finally&#44; any <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;13"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) with identical <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;end&#45;time&#45;4"></a>[end times](#text-track-cue-end-time) must be sorted in the order they were last added to their respective <a id="text&#45;track&#45;model&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;3"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues)&#44; oldest first &#40;so e&#46;g&#46; for cues from a WebVTT file&#44; that would initially be the order in which the cues were listed in the file&#41;&#46; [&#91;WEBVTT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBVTT)

###### <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;11&#46;2 Sourcing in&#45;band text tracks[](#sourcing-in-band-text-tracks)

A <a id="media&#45;resource&#45;specific&#45;text&#45;track"></a><strong>media&#45;resource&#45;specific text track</strong> is a <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track"></a>[text track](#text-track) that corresponds to data found in the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#46;

Rules for processing and rendering such data are defined by the relevant specifications&#44; e&#46;g&#46; the specification of the video format if the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is a video&#46; Details for some legacy formats can be found in Sourcing In&#45;band Media Resource Tracks from Media Containers into HTML&#46; [&#91;INBAND&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsINBAND)

When a <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;3"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) contains data that the user agent recognizes and supports as being equivalent to a <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;2"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#44; the user agent [runs](#found-a-media-resource-specific-timed-track) the <a id="steps&#45;to&#45;expose&#45;a&#45;media&#45;resource&#45;specific&#45;text&#45;track"></a><strong>steps to expose a media&#45;resource&#45;specific text track</strong> with the relevant data&#44; as follows&#46;

1.  Associate the relevant data with a new <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;3"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#46; The <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;4"></a>[text track](#text-track) is a <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;specific&#45;text&#45;track"></a>[media&#45;resource&#45;specific text track](#media-resource-specific-text-track)&#46;

2.  Set the new <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;5"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;kind"></a>[kind](#text-track-kind)&#44; <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;label"></a>[label](#text-track-label)&#44; <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;language"></a>[language](#text-track-language)&#44; and <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;identifier"></a>[identifier](#text-track-identifier) based on the semantics of the relevant data&#44; as defined by the relevant specification&#46; If there is no label in that data&#44; then the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;label&#45;2"></a>[label](#text-track-label) must be set to the empty string&#46;

    If the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;4"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is in a format that supports <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;fragment&#45;syntax"></a>[media fragment syntax](https://www.w3.org/TR/media-frags/#media-fragment-syntax)&#44; then the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;identifier&#45;2"></a>[identifier](#text-track-identifier) must be the same identifier that would enable the track if used as the name of a track in the track dimension of such a <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;fragment"></a>[fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment)&#46;

3.  Associate the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues) with the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;updating&#45;the&#45;text&#45;track&#45;rendering"></a>[rules for updating the text track rendering](#rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering) appropriate for the format in question&#46;

4.  If the new <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;6"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;2"></a>[kind](#text-track-kind) is <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;dom&#45;texttrack&#45;kind&#45;chapters"></a><code>[chapters](#dom-texttrack-kind-chapters)</code> or <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;dom&#45;texttrack&#45;kind&#45;metadata"></a><code>[metadata](#dom-texttrack-kind-metadata)</code>&#44; then set the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;in&#45;band&#45;metadata&#45;track&#45;dispatch&#45;type"></a>[text track in&#45;band metadata track dispatch type](#text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) as follows&#44; based on the type of the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;5"></a>[media resource](#media-resource)&#58;

    <strong>If the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;6"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is an Ogg file</strong>

    The <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;in&#45;band&#45;metadata&#45;track&#45;dispatch&#45;type&#45;2"></a>[text track in&#45;band metadata track dispatch type](#text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) must be set to the value of the Name header field&#46; [&#91;OGGSKELETONHEADERS&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsOGGSKELETONHEADERS)
    <strong>If the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;7"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is a WebM file</strong>

    The <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;in&#45;band&#45;metadata&#45;track&#45;dispatch&#45;type&#45;3"></a>[text track in&#45;band metadata track dispatch type](#text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) must be set to the value of the <code>CodecID</code> element&#46; [&#91;WEBMCG&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBMCG)
    <strong>If the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;8"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is an MPEG&#45;2 file</strong>

    Let <var>stream type</var> be the value of the &#34;stream&#95;type&#34; field describing the text track&#39;s type in the file&#39;s program map section&#44; interpreted as an 8&#45;bit unsigned integer&#46; Let <var>length</var> be the value of the &#34;ES&#95;info&#95;length&#34; field for the track in the same part of the program map section&#44; interpreted as an integer as defined by Generic coding of moving pictures and associated audio information&#46; Let <var>descriptor bytes</var> be the <var>length</var> bytes following the &#34;ES&#95;info&#95;length&#34; field&#46; The <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;in&#45;band&#45;metadata&#45;track&#45;dispatch&#45;type&#45;4"></a>[text track in&#45;band metadata track dispatch type](#text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) must be set to the concatenation of the <var>stream type</var> byte and the zero or more <var>descriptor bytes</var> bytes&#44; expressed in hexadecimal using <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;uppercase&#45;ascii&#45;hex&#45;digits"></a>[ASCII upper hex digits](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-upper-hex-digit)&#46; [&#91;MPEG2&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsMPEG2)
    <strong>If the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;resource&#45;9"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) is an MPEG&#45;4 file</strong>

    Let <var>stsd box</var> be the first <code>stsd</code> box of the first <code>stbl</code> box of the first <code>minf</code> box of the first <code>mdia</code> box of the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;7"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#39;s <code>trak</code> box in the first <code>moov</code> box of the file&#44; or null if no such <code>stsd</code> box exists&#46; If <var>stsd box</var> is null&#44; or if <var>stsd box</var> has neither a <code>mett</code> box nor a <code>metx</code> box&#44; then the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;in&#45;band&#45;metadata&#45;track&#45;dispatch&#45;type&#45;5"></a>[text track in&#45;band metadata track dispatch type](#text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) must be set to the empty string&#46; Otherwise&#44; if <var>stsd box</var> has a <code>mett</code> box&#44; then the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;in&#45;band&#45;metadata&#45;track&#45;dispatch&#45;type&#45;6"></a>[text track in&#45;band metadata track dispatch type](#text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) must be set to either the concatenation of the string &#34;<code>mett</code>&#34;&#44; a U&#43;0020 SPACE character&#44; and the value of the first <code>mime&#95;format</code> field of the first <code>mett</code> box of <var>stsd box</var>&#44; or the empty string if that field is absent in that box&#46; Otherwise&#44; if <var>stsd box</var> has no <code>mett</code> box but has a <code>metx</code> box&#44; then the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;in&#45;band&#45;metadata&#45;track&#45;dispatch&#45;type&#45;7"></a>[text track in&#45;band metadata track dispatch type](#text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type) must be set to either the concatenation of the string &#34;<code>metx</code>&#34;&#44; a U&#43;0020 SPACE character&#44; and the value of the first <code>namespace</code> field of the first <code>metx</code> box of <var>stsd box</var>&#44; or the empty string if that field is absent in that box&#46; [&#91;MPEG4&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsMPEG4)

5.  Populate the new <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;8"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;2"></a>[list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues) with the cues parsed so far&#44; following the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;guidelines&#45;for&#45;exposing&#45;cues&#45;in&#45;various&#45;formats&#45;as&#45;text&#45;track&#45;cues"></a>[guidelines for exposing cues](#guidelines-for-exposing-cues-in-various-formats-as-text-track-cues)&#44; and begin updating it dynamically as necessary&#46;

6.  Set the new <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;9"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;readiness&#45;state"></a>[readiness state](#text-track-readiness-state) to <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;loaded"></a>[loaded](#text-track-loaded)&#46;

7.  Set the new <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;10"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode"></a>[mode](#text-track-mode) to the mode consistent with the user&#39;s preferences and the requirements of the relevant specification for the data&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    For instance&#44; if there are no other active subtitles&#44; and this is a forced subtitle track &#40;a subtitle track giving subtitles in the audio track&#39;s primary language&#44; but only for audio that is actually in another language&#41;&#44; then those subtitles might be activated here&#46;

8.  Add the new <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;11"></a>[text track](#text-track) to the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks)&#46;

9.  <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;event&#45;media&#45;addtrack"></a><code>[addtrack](#event-media-addtrack)</code> at the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;texttracks"></a><code>[textTracks](#dom-media-texttracks)</code> attribute&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;texttracklist"></a><code>[TextTrackList](#texttracklist)</code> object&#44; using <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;trackevent"></a><code>[TrackEvent](#trackevent)</code>&#44; with the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;dom&#45;trackevent&#45;track"></a><code>[track](#dom-trackevent-track)</code> attribute initialized to the <a id="sourcing&#45;in&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;12"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#46;

###### <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;11&#46;3 Sourcing out&#45;of&#45;band text tracks[](#sourcing-out-of-band-text-tracks)

When a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element is created&#44; it must be associated with a new <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track"></a>[text track](#text-track) &#40;with its value set as defined below&#41;&#46;

The <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;kind"></a>[text track kind](#text-track-kind) is determined from the state of the element&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind"></a><code>[kind](#attr-track-kind)</code> attribute according to the following table&#59; for a state given in a cell of the first column&#44; the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;2"></a>[kind](#text-track-kind) is the string given in the second column&#58;

<table><thead><tr><th>State      </th><th>String    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><a href="#attr-track-kind-subtitles" id="sourcing-out-of-band-text-tracks:attr-track-kind-subtitles">Subtitles</a>      </td><td><code id="sourcing-out-of-band-text-tracks:dom-texttrack-kind-subtitles"><a href="#dom-texttrack-kind-subtitles">subtitles</a></code>     </td></tr><tr><td><a href="#attr-track-kind-captions" id="sourcing-out-of-band-text-tracks:attr-track-kind-captions">Captions</a>      </td><td><code id="sourcing-out-of-band-text-tracks:dom-texttrack-kind-captions"><a href="#dom-texttrack-kind-captions">captions</a></code>     </td></tr><tr><td><a href="#attr-track-kind-descriptions" id="sourcing-out-of-band-text-tracks:attr-track-kind-descriptions">Descriptions</a>      </td><td><code id="sourcing-out-of-band-text-tracks:dom-texttrack-kind-descriptions"><a href="#dom-texttrack-kind-descriptions">descriptions</a></code>     </td></tr><tr><td><a href="#attr-track-kind-chapters" id="sourcing-out-of-band-text-tracks:attr-track-kind-chapters">Chapters metadata</a>      </td><td><code id="sourcing-out-of-band-text-tracks:dom-texttrack-kind-chapters"><a href="#dom-texttrack-kind-chapters">chapters</a></code>     </td></tr><tr><td><a href="#attr-track-kind-metadata" id="sourcing-out-of-band-text-tracks:attr-track-kind-metadata">Metadata</a>      </td><td><code id="sourcing-out-of-band-text-tracks:dom-texttrack-kind-metadata"><a href="#dom-texttrack-kind-metadata">metadata</a></code>   </td></tr></tbody></table>

The <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;label"></a>[text track label](#text-track-label) is the element&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;track&#45;label"></a>[track label](#track-label)&#46;

The <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;language"></a>[text track language](#text-track-language) is the element&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;track&#45;language"></a>[track language](#track-language)&#44; if any&#59; otherwise the empty string&#46;

The <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;identifier"></a>[text track identifier](#text-track-identifier) is the element&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute"></a><code>[id](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-id-attribute)</code> attribute value&#44; if any&#59; otherwise the empty string&#46;

As the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;2"></a><code>[kind](#attr-track-kind)</code>&#44; <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;label"></a><code>[label](#attr-track-label)</code>&#44; <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;srclang"></a><code>[srclang](#attr-track-srclang)</code>&#44; and <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a><code>[id](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-id-attribute)</code> attributes are set&#44; changed&#44; or removed&#44; the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;2"></a>[text track](#text-track) must update accordingly&#44; as per the definitions above&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Changes to the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;track&#45;url"></a>[track URL](#track-url) are handled in the algorithm below&#46;

The <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;readiness&#45;state"></a>[text track readiness state](#text-track-readiness-state) is initially <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;not&#45;loaded"></a>[not loaded](#text-track-not-loaded)&#44; and the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode"></a>[text track mode](#text-track-mode) is initially <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](#text-track-disabled)&#46;

The <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues) is initially empty&#46; It is dynamically modified when the referenced file is parsed&#46; Associated with the list are the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;updating&#45;the&#45;text&#45;track&#45;rendering"></a>[rules for updating the text track rendering](#rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering) appropriate for the format in question&#59; for WebVTT&#44; this is the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;updating&#45;the&#45;display&#45;of&#45;webvtt&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a>[rules for updating the display of WebVTT text tracks](https://w3c.github.io/webvtt/#rules-for-updating-the-display-of-webvtt-text-tracks)&#46; [&#91;WEBVTT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBVTT)

When a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#39;s parent element changes and the new parent is a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; then the user agent must add the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#39;s corresponding <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;3"></a>[text track](#text-track) to the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks)&#44; and then <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;event&#45;media&#45;addtrack"></a><code>[addtrack](#event-media-addtrack)</code> at the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;texttracks"></a><code>[textTracks](#dom-media-texttracks)</code> attribute&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;texttracklist"></a><code>[TextTrackList](#texttracklist)</code> object&#44; using <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;trackevent"></a><code>[TrackEvent](#trackevent)</code>&#44; with the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;dom&#45;trackevent&#45;track"></a><code>[track](#dom-trackevent-track)</code> attribute initialized to the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;4"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#46;

When a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#39;s parent element changes and the old parent was a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; then the user agent must remove the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#39;s corresponding <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;5"></a>[text track](#text-track) from the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;2"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks)&#44; and then <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;event&#45;media&#45;removetrack"></a><code>[removetrack](#event-media-removetrack)</code> at the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;8"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;texttracks&#45;2"></a><code>[textTracks](#dom-media-texttracks)</code> attribute&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;texttracklist&#45;2"></a><code>[TextTrackList](#texttracklist)</code> object&#44; using <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;trackevent&#45;2"></a><code>[TrackEvent](#trackevent)</code>&#44; with the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;dom&#45;trackevent&#45;track&#45;2"></a><code>[track](#dom-trackevent-track)</code> attribute initialized to the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;6"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

When a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;7"></a>[text track](#text-track) corresponding to a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element is added to a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;9"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;3"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks)&#44; the user agent must <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;10"></a>[media element](#media-element) to run the following steps for the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;11"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#58;

1.  If the element&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;blocked&#45;on&#45;parser"></a>[blocked&#45;on&#45;parser](#blocked-on-parser) flag is true&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If the element&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;did&#45;perform&#45;automatic&#45;track&#45;selection"></a>[did&#45;perform&#45;automatic&#45;track&#45;selection](#did-perform-automatic-track-selection) flag is true&#44; then return&#46;

3.  <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;honor&#45;user&#45;preferences&#45;for&#45;automatic&#45;text&#45;track&#45;selection"></a>[Honor user preferences for automatic text track selection](#honor-user-preferences-for-automatic-text-track-selection) for this element&#46;

When the user agent is required to <a id="honor&#45;user&#45;preferences&#45;for&#45;automatic&#45;text&#45;track&#45;selection"></a><strong>honor user preferences for automatic text track selection</strong> for a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;12"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; the user agent must run the following steps&#58;

1.  <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;perform&#45;automatic&#45;text&#45;track&#45;selection"></a>[Perform automatic text track selection](#perform-automatic-text-track-selection) for <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;dom&#45;texttrack&#45;kind&#45;subtitles&#45;2"></a><code>[subtitles](#dom-texttrack-kind-subtitles)</code> and <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;dom&#45;texttrack&#45;kind&#45;captions&#45;2"></a><code>[captions](#dom-texttrack-kind-captions)</code>&#46;

2.  <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;perform&#45;automatic&#45;text&#45;track&#45;selection&#45;2"></a>[Perform automatic text track selection](#perform-automatic-text-track-selection) for <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;dom&#45;texttrack&#45;kind&#45;descriptions&#45;2"></a><code>[descriptions](#dom-texttrack-kind-descriptions)</code>&#46;

3.  If there are any <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;8"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) in the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;13"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;4"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks) whose <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;3"></a>[text track kind](#text-track-kind) is <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;dom&#45;texttrack&#45;kind&#45;metadata&#45;2"></a><code>[chapters](#dom-texttrack-kind-metadata)</code> or <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;dom&#45;texttrack&#45;kind&#45;metadata&#45;3"></a><code>[metadata](#dom-texttrack-kind-metadata)</code> that correspond to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> elements with a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;default"></a><code>[default](#attr-track-default)</code> attribute set whose <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[text track mode](#text-track-mode) is set to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;disabled&#45;2"></a>[disabled](#text-track-disabled)&#44; then set the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[text track mode](#text-track-mode) of all such tracks to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;hidden"></a>[hidden](#text-track-hidden)&#46;

4.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;did&#45;perform&#45;automatic&#45;track&#45;selection&#45;2"></a>[did&#45;perform&#45;automatic&#45;track&#45;selection](#did-perform-automatic-track-selection) flag to true&#46;

When the steps above say to <a id="perform&#45;automatic&#45;text&#45;track&#45;selection"></a><strong>perform automatic text track selection</strong> for one or more <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;4"></a>[text track kinds](#text-track-kind)&#44; it means to run the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>candidates</var> be a list consisting of the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;9"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) in the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;14"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;5"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks) whose <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;5"></a>[text track kind](#text-track-kind) is one of the kinds that were passed to the algorithm&#44; if any&#44; in the order given in the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;6"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks)&#46;

2.  If <var>candidates</var> is empty&#44; then return&#46;

3.  If any of the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;10"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) in <var>candidates</var> have a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[text track mode](#text-track-mode) set to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;showing"></a>[showing](#text-track-showing)&#44; return&#46;

4.  If the user has expressed an interest in having a track from <var>candidates</var> enabled based on its <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;6"></a>[text track kind](#text-track-kind)&#44; <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;language&#45;2"></a>[text track language](#text-track-language)&#44; and <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;label&#45;2"></a>[text track label](#text-track-label)&#44; then set its <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode&#45;5"></a>[text track mode](#text-track-mode) to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;showing&#45;2"></a>[showing](#text-track-showing)&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    For example&#44; the user could have set a browser preference to the effect of &#34;I want French captions whenever possible&#34;&#44; or &#34;If there is a subtitle track with &#39;Commentary&#39; in the title&#44; enable it&#34;&#44; or &#34;If there are audio description tracks available&#44; enable one&#44; ideally in Swiss German&#44; but failing that in Standard Swiss German or Standard German&#34;&#46;
