    Otherwise&#44; if there are any <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;11"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) in <var>candidates</var> that correspond to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> elements with a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;default&#45;2"></a><code>[default](#attr-track-default)</code> attribute set whose <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode&#45;6"></a>[text track mode](#text-track-mode) is set to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;disabled&#45;3"></a>[disabled](#text-track-disabled)&#44; then set the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode&#45;7"></a>[text track mode](#text-track-mode) of the first such track to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;showing&#45;3"></a>[showing](#text-track-showing)&#46;

When a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;12"></a>[text track](#text-track) corresponding to a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element experiences any of the following circumstances&#44; the user agent must <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;start&#45;the&#45;track&#45;processing&#45;model"></a>[start the <code>track</code> processing model](#start-the-track-processing-model) for that <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;13"></a>[text track](#text-track) and its <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#58;

- The <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element is created&#46;
- The <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;14"></a>[text track](#text-track) has its <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode&#45;8"></a>[text track mode](#text-track-mode) changed&#46;
- The <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#39;s parent element changes and the new parent is a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;15"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46;

When a user agent is to <a id="start&#45;the&#45;track&#45;processing&#45;model"></a><strong>start the <code>track</code> processing model</strong> for a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;15"></a>[text track](#text-track) and its <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#44; it must run the following algorithm&#46; This algorithm interacts closely with the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;event&#45;loop"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) mechanism&#59; in particular&#44; it has a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;synchronous&#45;section"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) &#40;which is triggered as part of the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;event&#45;loop&#45;2"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) algorithm&#41;&#46; The steps in that section are marked with ⌛&#46;

1.  If another occurrence of this algorithm is already running for this <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;16"></a>[text track](#text-track) and its <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#44; return&#44; letting that other algorithm take care of this element&#46;

2.  If the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;17"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode&#45;9"></a>[text track mode](#text-track-mode) is not set to one of <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;hidden&#45;2"></a>[hidden](#text-track-hidden) or <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;showing&#45;4"></a>[showing](#text-track-showing)&#44; then return&#46;

3.  If the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;18"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element does not have a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;16"></a>[media element](#media-element) as a parent&#44; return&#46;

4.  Run the remainder of these steps <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;in&#45;parallel"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel)&#44; allowing whatever caused these steps to run to continue&#46;

5.  <em>Top</em>&#58; <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;await&#45;a&#45;stable&#45;state"></a>[Await a stable state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#await-a-stable-state)&#46; The <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;2"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) consists of the following steps&#46; &#40;The steps in the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;3"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section) are marked with ⌛&#46;&#41;

6.  ⌛ Set the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;readiness&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[text track readiness state](#text-track-readiness-state) to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;loading"></a>[loading](#text-track-loading)&#46;

7.  ⌛ Let <var>URL</var> be the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;track&#45;url&#45;2"></a>[track URL](#track-url) of the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#46;

8.  ⌛ If the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#39;s parent is a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;17"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; then let <var>corsAttributeState</var> be the state of the parent <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;18"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;crossorigin"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-media-crossorigin)</code> content attribute&#46; Otherwise&#44; let <var>corsAttributeState</var> be <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;attr&#45;crossorigin&#45;none"></a>[No CORS](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-crossorigin-none)&#46;

9.  End the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;synchronous&#45;section&#45;4"></a>[synchronous section](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#synchronous-section)&#44; continuing the remaining steps <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;in&#45;parallel&#45;2"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel)&#46;

10. If <var>URL</var> is not the empty string&#58;

    1.  Let <var>request</var> be the result of <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;create&#45;a&#45;potential&#45;cors&#45;request"></a>[creating a potential&#45;CORS request](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#create-a-potential-cors-request) given <var>URL</var>&#44; &#34;<code>track</code>&#34;&#44; and <var>corsAttributeState</var>&#44; and with the <em>same&#45;origin fallback flag</em> set&#46;

    2.  Set <var>request</var>&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;client"></a>[client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-client) to the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;relevant&#45;settings&#45;object"></a>[relevant settings object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-settings-object)&#46;

    3.  Set <var>request</var>&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;initiator&#45;type"></a>[initiator type](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-initiator-type) to &#34;<code>track</code>&#34;&#46;

    4.  <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;concept&#45;fetch"></a>[Fetch](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch) <var>request</var>&#46;

    The <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;concept&#45;task"></a>[tasks](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;task"></a>[queued](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-task) by the fetching algorithm on the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;networking&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[networking task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#networking-task-source) to process the data as it is being fetched must determine the type of the resource&#46; If the type of the resource is not a supported text track format&#44; the load will fail&#44; as described below&#46; Otherwise&#44; the resource&#39;s data must be passed to the appropriate parser &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;webvtt&#45;parser"></a>[WebVTT parser](https://w3c.github.io/webvtt/#webvtt-parser)&#41; as it is received&#44; with the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;2"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues) being used for that parser&#39;s output&#46; [&#91;WEBVTT&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsWEBVTT)

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    The appropriate parser will incrementally update the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;3"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues) during these <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;networking&#45;task&#45;source&#45;2"></a>[networking task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#networking-task-source) <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[tasks](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task)&#44; as each such task is run with whatever data has been received from the network&#41;&#46;

    This specification does not currently say whether or how to check the MIME types of text tracks&#44; or whether or how to perform file type sniffing using the actual file data&#46; Implementers differ in their intentions on this matter and it is therefore unclear what the right solution is&#46; In the absence of any requirement here&#44; the HTTP specifications&#39; strict requirement to follow the Content&#45;Type header prevails &#40;&#34;Content&#45;Type specifies the media type of the underlying data&#46;&#34; &#46;&#46;&#46; &#34;If and only if the media type is not given by a Content&#45;Type field&#44; the recipient MAY attempt to guess the media type via inspection of its content and&#47;or the name extension&#40;s&#41; of the URI used to identify the resource&#46;&#34;&#41;&#46;

    If fetching fails for any reason &#40;network error&#44; the server returns an error code&#44; CORS fails&#44; etc&#46;&#41;&#44; or if <var>URL</var> is the empty string&#44; then <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) given the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;media&#45;element&#45;19"></a>[media element](#media-element) to first change the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;readiness&#45;state&#45;3"></a>[text track readiness state](#text-track-readiness-state) to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;failed&#45;to&#45;load"></a>[failed to load](#text-track-failed-to-load) and then <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;3"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;event&#45;track&#45;error"></a><code>[error](#event-track-error)</code> at the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#46;

    If fetching does not fail&#44; but the type of the resource is not a supported text track format&#44; or the file was not successfully processed &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; the format in question is an XML format and the file contained a well&#45;formedness error that XML requires be detected and reported to the application&#41;&#44; then the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that is <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[queued](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;networking&#45;task&#45;source&#45;3"></a>[networking task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#networking-task-source) in which the aforementioned problem is found must change the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;readiness&#45;state&#45;4"></a>[text track readiness state](#text-track-readiness-state) to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;failed&#45;to&#45;load&#45;2"></a>[failed to load](#text-track-failed-to-load) and <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;4"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;event&#45;track&#45;error&#45;2"></a><code>[error](#event-track-error)</code> at the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#46;

    If fetching does not fail&#44; and the file was successfully processed&#44; then the final <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;4"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that is <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[queued](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) by the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;networking&#45;task&#45;source&#45;4"></a>[networking task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#networking-task-source)&#44; after it has finished parsing the data&#44; must change the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;readiness&#45;state&#45;5"></a>[text track readiness state](#text-track-readiness-state) to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;loaded"></a>[loaded](#text-track-loaded)&#44; and <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;5"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;event&#45;track&#45;load"></a><code>[load](#event-track-load)</code> at the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#46;

    If&#44; while fetching is ongoing&#44; either&#58;

    - the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;track&#45;url&#45;3"></a>[track URL](#track-url) changes so that it is no longer equal to <var>URL</var>&#44; while the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode&#45;10"></a>[text track mode](#text-track-mode) is set to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;hidden&#45;3"></a>[hidden](#text-track-hidden) or <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;showing&#45;5"></a>[showing](#text-track-showing)&#59; or
    - the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode&#45;11"></a>[text track mode](#text-track-mode) changes to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;hidden&#45;4"></a>[hidden](#text-track-hidden) or <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;showing&#45;6"></a>[showing](#text-track-showing)&#44; while the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;track&#45;url&#45;4"></a>[track URL](#track-url) is not equal to <var>URL</var>&#44;

    &#46;&#46;&#46;then the user agent must abort <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;concept&#45;fetch&#45;2"></a>[fetching](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch)&#44; discarding any pending <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;5"></a>[tasks](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) generated by that algorithm &#40;and in particular&#44; not adding any cues to the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;4"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues) after the moment the URL changed&#41;&#44; and then <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;4"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source&#45;2"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) given the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;22"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element that first changes the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;readiness&#45;state&#45;6"></a>[text track readiness state](#text-track-readiness-state) to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;failed&#45;to&#45;load&#45;3"></a>[failed to load](#text-track-failed-to-load) and then <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;6"></a>[fires an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;event&#45;track&#45;error&#45;3"></a><code>[error](#event-track-error)</code> at the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;23"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element&#46;

11. Wait until the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;readiness&#45;state&#45;7"></a>[text track readiness state](#text-track-readiness-state) is no longer set to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;loading&#45;2"></a>[loading](#text-track-loading)&#46;

12. Wait until the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;track&#45;url&#45;5"></a>[track URL](#track-url) is no longer equal to <var>URL</var>&#44; at the same time as the <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode&#45;12"></a>[text track mode](#text-track-mode) is set to <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;hidden&#45;5"></a>[hidden](#text-track-hidden) or <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;showing&#45;7"></a>[showing](#text-track-showing)&#46;

13. Jump to the step labeled <em>top</em>&#46;

Whenever a <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;the&#45;track&#45;element&#45;24"></a><code>[track](#the-track-element)</code> element has its <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;attr&#45;track&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-track-src)</code> attribute set&#44; changed&#44; or removed&#44; the user agent must <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;immediately"></a>[immediately](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#immediately) empty the element&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;19"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#39;s <a id="sourcing&#45;out&#45;of&#45;band&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;5"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues)&#46; &#40;This also causes the algorithm above to stop adding cues from the resource being obtained using the previously given URL&#44; if any&#46;&#41;

###### <a id="guidelines&#45;for&#45;exposing&#45;cues&#45;in&#45;various&#45;formats&#45;as&#45;text&#45;track&#45;cues"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;11&#46;4 <strong>Guidelines for exposing cues</strong> in various formats as <a id="guidelines&#45;for&#45;exposing&#45;cues&#45;in&#45;various&#45;formats&#45;as&#45;text&#45;track&#45;cues&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue"></a>[text track cues](#text-track-cue)[](#guidelines-for-exposing-cues-in-various-formats-as-text-track-cues)

How a specific format&#39;s text track cues are to be interpreted for the purposes of processing by an HTML user agent is defined by that format&#46; In the absence of such a specification&#44; this section provides some constraints within which implementations can attempt to consistently expose such formats&#46;

To support the <a id="guidelines&#45;for&#45;exposing&#45;cues&#45;in&#45;various&#45;formats&#45;as&#45;text&#45;track&#45;cues&#58;text&#45;track"></a>[text track](#text-track) model of HTML&#44; each unit of timed data is converted to a <a id="guidelines&#45;for&#45;exposing&#45;cues&#45;in&#45;various&#45;formats&#45;as&#45;text&#45;track&#45;cues&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;2"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue)&#46; Where the mapping of the format&#39;s features to the aspects of a <a id="guidelines&#45;for&#45;exposing&#45;cues&#45;in&#45;various&#45;formats&#45;as&#45;text&#45;track&#45;cues&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;3"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) as defined in this specification are not defined&#44; implementations must ensure that the mapping is consistent with the definitions of the aspects of a <a id="guidelines&#45;for&#45;exposing&#45;cues&#45;in&#45;various&#45;formats&#45;as&#45;text&#45;track&#45;cues&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;4"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) as defined above&#44; as well as with the following constraints&#58;

<strong>The <a id="guidelines&#45;for&#45;exposing&#45;cues&#45;in&#45;various&#45;formats&#45;as&#45;text&#45;track&#45;cues&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;identifier"></a>[text track cue identifier](#text-track-cue-identifier)</strong>

Should be set to the empty string if the format has no obvious analogue to a per&#45;cue identifier&#46;

<strong>The <a id="guidelines&#45;for&#45;exposing&#45;cues&#45;in&#45;various&#45;formats&#45;as&#45;text&#45;track&#45;cues&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;pause&#45;on&#45;exit&#45;flag"></a>[text track cue pause&#45;on&#45;exit flag](#text-track-cue-pause-on-exit-flag)</strong>

Should be set to false&#46;

###### <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;11&#46;5 Text track API[](#text-track-api)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[TextTrackList](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/TextTrackList)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox31&#43;Safari6&#43;Chrome23&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;texttracks"></a><strong><code>textTracks</code></strong> attribute of <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;media&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[media elements](#media-element) must return a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttracklist&#45;2"></a><code>[TextTrackList](#texttracklist)</code> object representing the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;5"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) in the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;media&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;3"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks)&#44; in the same order as in the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;4"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks)&#46;

The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;supported&#45;property&#45;indices"></a>[supported property indices](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-indices) of a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttracklist&#45;5"></a><code>[TextTrackList](#texttracklist)</code> object at any instant are the numbers from zero to the number of <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;7"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) in the list represented by the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttracklist&#45;6"></a><code>[TextTrackList](#texttracklist)</code> object minus one&#44; if any&#46; If there are no <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;8"></a>[text tracks](#text-track) in the list&#44; there are no <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;supported&#45;property&#45;indices&#45;2"></a>[supported property indices](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-indices)&#46;

<a id="dom&#45;texttracklist&#45;item"></a>To <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;determine&#45;the&#45;value&#45;of&#45;an&#45;indexed&#45;property"></a>[determine the value of an indexed property](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-determine-the-value-of-an-indexed-property) of a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttracklist&#45;7"></a><code>[TextTrackList](#texttracklist)</code> object for a given index <var>index</var>&#44; the user agent must return the <var>index</var>th <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;9"></a>[text track](#text-track) in the list represented by the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttracklist&#45;8"></a><code>[TextTrackList](#texttracklist)</code> object&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;texttracklist&#45;gettrackbyid"></a><strong><code>getTrackById&#40;<var>id</var>&#41;</code></strong> method must return the first <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttrack&#45;4"></a><code>[TextTrack](#texttrack)</code> in the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttracklist&#45;9"></a><code>[TextTrackList](#texttracklist)</code> object whose <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;texttrack&#45;id"></a><code>[id](#dom-texttrack-id)</code> IDL attribute would return a value equal to the value of the <var>id</var> argument&#46; When no tracks match the given argument&#44; the method must return null&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;addtexttrack"></a><strong><code>addTextTrack&#40;<var>kind</var>&#44; <var>label</var>&#44; <var>language</var>&#41;</code></strong> method of <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;media&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[media elements](#media-element)&#44; when invoked&#44; must run the following steps&#58;

1.  Create a new <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;11"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#44; and set its <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;2"></a>[text track kind](#text-track-kind) to <var>kind</var>&#44; its <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;label&#45;2"></a>[text track label](#text-track-label) to <var>label</var>&#44; its <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;language&#45;2"></a>[text track language](#text-track-language) to <var>language</var>&#44; its <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;readiness&#45;state"></a>[text track readiness state](#text-track-readiness-state) to the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;loaded"></a>[text track loaded](#text-track-loaded) state&#44; its <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode&#45;2"></a>[text track mode](#text-track-mode) to the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;hidden&#45;2"></a>[text track hidden](#text-track-hidden) mode&#44; and its <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;5"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues) to an empty list&#46;

    Initially&#44; the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;6"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues) is not associated with any <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;updating&#45;the&#45;text&#45;track&#45;rendering"></a>[rules for updating the text track rendering](#rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering)&#46; When a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;2"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) is added to it&#44; the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;7"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues) has its rules permanently set accordingly&#46;

2.  Add the new <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;12"></a>[text track](#text-track) to the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;media&#45;element&#45;8"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;list&#45;of&#45;text&#45;tracks&#45;6"></a>[list of text tracks](#list-of-text-tracks)&#46;

3.  <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;media&#45;element&#45;9"></a>[media element](#media-element) to <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;event&#45;media&#45;addtrack"></a><code>[addtrack](#event-media-addtrack)</code> at the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;media&#45;element&#45;10"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;texttracks&#45;3"></a><code>[textTracks](#dom-media-texttracks)</code> attribute&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttracklist&#45;10"></a><code>[TextTrackList](#texttracklist)</code> object&#44; using <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;trackevent"></a><code>[TrackEvent](#trackevent)</code>&#44; with the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;trackevent&#45;track"></a><code>[track](#dom-trackevent-track)</code> attribute initialized to the new <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;13"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#46;

4.  Return the new <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;14"></a>[text track](#text-track)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;texttrack&#45;kind"></a><strong><code>kind</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;3"></a>[kind](#text-track-kind)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;texttrack&#45;label"></a><strong><code>label</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;label&#45;3"></a>[label](#text-track-label)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;texttrack&#45;language"></a><strong><code>language</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;language&#45;3"></a>[language](#text-track-language)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;texttrack&#45;id"></a><strong><code>id</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;identifier"></a>[identifier](#text-track-identifier)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;texttrack&#45;inbandmetadatatrackdispatchtype"></a><strong><code>inBandMetadataTrackDispatchType</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;in&#45;band&#45;metadata&#45;track&#45;dispatch&#45;type&#45;2"></a>[in&#45;band metadata track dispatch type](#text-track-in-band-metadata-track-dispatch-type)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;texttrack&#45;mode"></a><strong><code>mode</code></strong> getter steps are to return the string switching on <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;this&#45;6"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode&#45;3"></a>[mode](#text-track-mode)&#58;

<strong>The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;disabled&#45;2"></a>[text track disabled](#text-track-disabled) mode</strong>

&#34;<a id="dom&#45;texttrack&#45;disabled"></a><strong><code>disabled</code></strong>&#34;

<strong>The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;hidden&#45;3"></a>[text track hidden](#text-track-hidden) mode</strong>

&#34;<a id="dom&#45;texttrack&#45;hidden"></a><strong><code>hidden</code></strong>&#34;

<strong>The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;showing&#45;2"></a>[text track showing](#text-track-showing) mode</strong>

&#34;<a id="dom&#45;texttrack&#45;showing"></a><strong><code>showing</code></strong>&#34;

The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;texttrack&#45;mode&#45;2"></a><code>[mode](#dom-texttrack-mode)</code> setter steps are to set <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;this&#45;7"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode&#45;4"></a>[mode](#text-track-mode) to the mode switching on the given value&#58;

<strong>&#34;<a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;texttrack&#45;disabled&#45;3"></a><code>[disabled](#dom-texttrack-disabled)</code>&#34;</strong>

The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;disabled&#45;3"></a>[text track disabled](#text-track-disabled) mode&#46;

<strong>&#34;<a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;texttrack&#45;hidden&#45;3"></a><code>[hidden](#dom-texttrack-hidden)</code>&#34;</strong>

The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;hidden&#45;4"></a>[text track hidden](#text-track-hidden) mode&#46;

<strong>&#34;<a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;texttrack&#45;showing&#45;3"></a><code>[showing](#dom-texttrack-showing)</code>&#34;</strong>

The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;showing&#45;3"></a>[text track showing](#text-track-showing) mode&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;texttrack&#45;cues"></a><strong><code>cues</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  If <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;this&#45;8"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode&#45;5"></a>[mode](#text-track-mode) is the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;disabled&#45;4"></a>[text track disabled](#text-track-disabled) mode&#44; then return null&#46;

2.  Return a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;live"></a>[live](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#live) <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttrackcuelist&#45;5"></a><code>[TextTrackCueList](#texttrackcuelist)</code> object that represents the subset of <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;this&#45;9"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;8"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues) whose <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;end&#45;time"></a>[end times](#text-track-cue-end-time) occur at or after the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;earliest&#45;possible&#45;position&#45;when&#45;the&#45;script&#45;started"></a>[earliest possible position when the script started](#earliest-possible-position-when-the-script-started)&#44; in <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;order"></a>[text track cue order](#text-track-cue-order)&#46;

For each <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttrack&#45;6"></a><code>[TextTrack](#texttrack)</code> object&#44; when an object is returned&#44; the same <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttrackcuelist&#45;6"></a><code>[TextTrackCueList](#texttrackcuelist)</code> object must be returned each time&#46;

The <a id="earliest&#45;possible&#45;position&#45;when&#45;the&#45;script&#45;started"></a><strong>earliest possible position when the script started</strong> is whatever the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;earliest&#45;possible&#45;position"></a>[earliest possible position](#earliest-possible-position) was the last time the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;event&#45;loop"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) reached step 1&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;texttrack&#45;activecues"></a><strong><code>activeCues</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  If <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;this&#45;10"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;mode&#45;6"></a>[mode](#text-track-mode) is the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;disabled&#45;5"></a>[text track disabled](#text-track-disabled) mode&#44; then return null&#46;

2.  Return a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;live&#45;2"></a>[live](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#live) <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttrackcuelist&#45;7"></a><code>[TextTrackCueList](#texttrackcuelist)</code> object that represents the subset of <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;this&#45;11"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;9"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues) whose <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;active&#45;flag&#45;was&#45;set&#45;when&#45;the&#45;script&#45;started"></a>[active flag was set when the script started](#active-flag-was-set-when-the-script-started)&#44; in <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;order&#45;2"></a>[text track cue order](#text-track-cue-order)&#46;

For each <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttrack&#45;7"></a><code>[TextTrack](#texttrack)</code> object&#44; when an object is returned&#44; the same <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttrackcuelist&#45;8"></a><code>[TextTrackCueList](#texttrackcuelist)</code> object must be returned each time&#46;

A <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;3"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue)&#39;s <a id="active&#45;flag&#45;was&#45;set&#45;when&#45;the&#45;script&#45;started"></a><strong>active flag was set when the script started</strong> if its <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;active&#45;flag"></a>[text track cue active flag](#text-track-cue-active-flag) was set the last time the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;event&#45;loop&#45;2"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) reached [step 1](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#step1)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;texttrack&#45;addcue"></a><strong><code>addCue&#40;<var>cue</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>list</var> be <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;this&#45;12"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;10"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues)&#46;

2.  If <var>list</var> does not yet have any associated <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;updating&#45;the&#45;text&#45;track&#45;rendering&#45;2"></a>[rules for updating the text track rendering](#rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering)&#44; then associate <var>list</var> with the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;updating&#45;the&#45;text&#45;track&#45;rendering&#45;3"></a>[rules for updating the text track rendering](#rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering) appropriate to <var>cue</var>&#46;

3.  If <var>list</var>&#39;s associated <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;updating&#45;the&#45;text&#45;track&#45;rendering&#45;4"></a>[rules for updating the text track rendering](#rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering) are not the same <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;updating&#45;the&#45;text&#45;track&#45;rendering&#45;5"></a>[rules for updating the text track rendering](#rules-for-updating-the-text-track-rendering) as appropriate for <var>cue</var>&#44; then throw an <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;invalidstateerror"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

4.  If the given <var>cue</var> is in a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;11"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues)&#44; then remove <var>cue</var> from that <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;12"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues)&#46;

5.  Add <var>cue</var> to <var>list</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;texttrack&#45;removecue"></a><strong><code>removeCue&#40;<var>cue</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If the given <var>cue</var> is not in <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;this&#45;13"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;13"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues)&#44; then throw a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;notfounderror"></a>[&#34;<code>NotFoundError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notfounderror) <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  Remove <var>cue</var> from <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;this&#45;14"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;list&#45;of&#45;cues&#45;14"></a>[text track list of cues](#text-track-list-of-cues)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; an <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> element is used to play a specific sound&#45;effect from a sound file containing many sound effects&#46; A cue is used to pause the audio&#44; so that it ends exactly at the end of the clip&#44; even if the browser is busy running some script&#46; If the page had relied on script to pause the audio&#44; then the start of the next clip might be heard if the browser was not able to run the script at the exact time specified&#46;

``` text
var sfx = new Audio('sfx.wav');
var sounds = sfx.addTextTrack('metadata');

// add sounds we care about
function addFX(start, end, name) {
  var cue = new VTTCue(start, end, '');
  cue.id = name;
  cue.pauseOnExit = true;
  sounds.addCue(cue);
}
addFX(12.783, 13.612, 'dog bark');
addFX(13.612, 15.091, 'kitten mew');

function playSound(id) {
  sfx.currentTime = sounds.getCueById(id).startTime;
  sfx.play();
}

// play a bark as soon as we can
sfx.oncanplaythrough = function () {
  playSound('dog bark');
}
// meow when the user tries to leave,
// and have the browser ask them to stay
window.onbeforeunload = function (e) {
  playSound('kitten mew');
  e.preventDefault();
}
```

<a id="texttrackcuelist"></a><a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;texttrackcuelist&#45;length"></a><a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttrackcue&#45;3"></a><a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttrackcue&#45;4"></a><a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;texttrackcuelist&#45;getcuebyid"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface TextTrackCueList {
  readonly attribute unsigned long length;
  getter TextTrackCue (unsigned long index);
  TextTrackCue? getCueById(DOMString id);
};
```

<strong><code><var>cuelist</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;texttrackcuelist&#45;length&#45;dev"></a>[length](#dom-texttrackcuelist-length)</code></strong>

Returns the number of <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;4"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) in the list&#46;

<strong><code><var>cuelist</var>&#91;<var>index</var>&#93;</code></strong>

Returns the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;5"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) with index <var>index</var> in the list&#46; The cues are sorted in <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;order&#45;3"></a>[text track cue order](#text-track-cue-order)&#46;

<strong><code><var>cuelist</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;texttrackcuelist&#45;getcuebyid&#45;dev"></a>[getCueById](#dom-texttrackcuelist-getcuebyid)&#40;<var>id</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Returns the first <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;6"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) &#40;in <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;order&#45;4"></a>[text track cue order](#text-track-cue-order)&#41; with <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;identifier"></a>[text track cue identifier](#text-track-cue-identifier) <var>id</var>&#46;

Returns null if none of the cues have the given identifier or if the argument is the empty string&#46;

A <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttrackcuelist&#45;9"></a><code>[TextTrackCueList](#texttrackcuelist)</code> object represents a dynamically updating list of <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;7"></a>[text track cues](#text-track-cue) in a given order&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;texttrackcuelist&#45;length"></a><strong><code>length</code></strong> attribute must return the number of <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;8"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) in the list represented by the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttrackcuelist&#45;10"></a><code>[TextTrackCueList](#texttrackcuelist)</code> object&#46;

The <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;supported&#45;property&#45;indices&#45;3"></a>[supported property indices](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-indices) of a <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttrackcuelist&#45;11"></a><code>[TextTrackCueList](#texttrackcuelist)</code> object at any instant are the numbers from zero to the number of <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;9"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) in the list represented by the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttrackcuelist&#45;12"></a><code>[TextTrackCueList](#texttrackcuelist)</code> object minus one&#44; if any&#46; If there are no <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;10"></a>[cues](#text-track-cue) in the list&#44; there are no <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;supported&#45;property&#45;indices&#45;4"></a>[supported property indices](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-indices)&#46;

<a id="dom&#45;texttrackcuelist&#45;item"></a>To <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;determine&#45;the&#45;value&#45;of&#45;an&#45;indexed&#45;property&#45;2"></a>[determine the value of an indexed property](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-determine-the-value-of-an-indexed-property) for a given index <var>index</var>&#44; the user agent must return the <var>index</var>th <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;text&#45;track&#45;cue&#45;11"></a>[text track cue](#text-track-cue) in the list represented by the <a id="text&#45;track&#45;api&#58;texttrackcuelist&#45;13"></a><code>[TextTrackCueList](#texttrackcuelist)</code> object&#46;

###### <a id="best&#45;practices&#45;for&#45;metadata&#45;text&#45;tracks"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;11&#46;7 Best practices for metadata text tracks[](#best-practices-for-metadata-text-tracks)

<em>This section is non&#45;normative&#46;</em>

Text tracks can be used for storing data relating to the media data&#44; for interactive or augmented views&#46;

For example&#44; a page showing a sports broadcast could include information about the current score&#46; Suppose a robotics competition was being streamed live&#46; The image could be overlaid with the scores&#44; as follows&#58;



In order to make the score display render correctly whenever the user seeks to an arbitrary point in the video&#44; the metadata text track cues need to be as long as is appropriate for the score&#46; For example&#44; in the frame above&#44; there would be maybe one cue that lasts the length of the match that gives the match number&#44; one cue that lasts until the blue alliance&#39;s score changes&#44; and one cue that lasts until the red alliance&#39;s score changes&#46; If the video is just a stream of the live event&#44; the time in the bottom right would presumably be automatically derived from the current video time&#44; rather than based on a cue&#46; However&#44; if the video was just the highlights&#44; then that might be given in cues also&#46;

The following shows what fragments of this could look like in a WebVTT file&#58;

``` text
WEBVTT

...

05:10:00.000 --> 05:12:15.000
matchtype:qual
matchnumber:37

...

05:11:02.251 --> 05:11:17.198
red:78

05:11:03.672 --> 05:11:54.198
blue:66

05:11:17.198 --> 05:11:25.912
red:80

05:11:25.912 --> 05:11:26.522
red:83

05:11:26.522 --> 05:11:26.982
red:86

05:11:26.982 --> 05:11:27.499
red:89

...
```

The key here is to notice that the information is given in cues that span the length of time to which the relevant event applies&#46; If&#44; instead&#44; the scores were given as zero&#45;length &#40;or very brief&#44; nearly zero&#45;length&#41; cues when the score changes&#44; for example saying &#34;red&#43;2&#34; at 05&#58;11&#58;17&#46;198&#44; &#34;red&#43;3&#34; at 05&#58;11&#58;25&#46;912&#44; etc&#44; problems arise&#58; primarily&#44; seeking is much harder to implement&#44; as the script has to walk the entire list of cues to make sure that no notifications have been missed&#59; but also&#44; if the cues are short it&#39;s possible the script will never see that they are active unless it listens to them specifically&#46;

When using cues in this manner&#44; authors are encouraged to use the <a id="best&#45;practices&#45;for&#45;metadata&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;event&#45;media&#45;cuechange"></a><code>[cuechange](#event-media-cuechange)</code> event to update the current annotations&#46; &#40;In particular&#44; using the <a id="best&#45;practices&#45;for&#45;metadata&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;event&#45;media&#45;timeupdate"></a><code>[timeupdate](#event-media-timeupdate)</code> event would be less appropriate as it would require doing work even when the cues haven&#39;t changed&#44; and&#44; more importantly&#44; would introduce a higher latency between when the metadata cues become active and when the display is updated&#44; since <a id="best&#45;practices&#45;for&#45;metadata&#45;text&#45;tracks&#58;event&#45;media&#45;timeupdate&#45;2"></a><code>[timeupdate](#event-media-timeupdate)</code> events are rate&#45;limited&#46;&#41;

##### <a id="identifying&#45;a&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;through&#45;a&#45;url"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;12 Identifying a track kind through a URL[](#identifying-a-track-kind-through-a-url)

Other specifications or formats that need a <a id="identifying&#45;a&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;through&#45;a&#45;url&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) to identify the return values of the <a id="identifying&#45;a&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;through&#45;a&#45;url&#58;audiotrack"></a><code>[AudioTrack](#audiotrack)</code> <a id="identifying&#45;a&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;through&#45;a&#45;url&#58;dom&#45;audiotrack&#45;kind"></a><code>[kind](#dom-audiotrack-kind)</code> or <a id="identifying&#45;a&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;through&#45;a&#45;url&#58;videotrack"></a><code>[VideoTrack](#videotrack)</code> <a id="identifying&#45;a&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;through&#45;a&#45;url&#58;dom&#45;videotrack&#45;kind"></a><code>[kind](#dom-videotrack-kind)</code> IDL attributes&#44; or identify the <a id="identifying&#45;a&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;through&#45;a&#45;url&#58;text&#45;track&#45;kind"></a>[kind of text track](#text-track-kind)&#44; must use the <a id="identifying&#45;a&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;through&#45;a&#45;url&#58;about&#58;html&#45;kind"></a><code>[about&#58;html&#45;kind](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#about:html-kind)</code> <a id="identifying&#45;a&#45;track&#45;kind&#45;through&#45;a&#45;url&#58;url&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url)&#46;

##### <a id="user&#45;interface"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;13 User interface[](#user-interface)

The <a id="attr&#45;media&#45;controls"></a><strong><code>controls</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46; If present&#44; it indicates that the author has not provided a scripted controller and would like the user agent to provide its own set of controls&#46;

If the attribute is present&#44; or if <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;n&#45;noscript"></a>[scripting is disabled](html-language-dom-parsing--877d6146487f--c076ab7a56b9.md#concept-n-noscript) for the <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; then the user agent should <a id="expose&#45;a&#45;user&#45;interface&#45;to&#45;the&#45;user"></a><strong>expose a user interface to the user</strong>&#46; This user interface should include features to begin playback&#44; pause playback&#44; seek to an arbitrary position in the content &#40;if the content supports arbitrary seeking&#41;&#44; change the volume&#44; change the display of closed captions or embedded sign&#45;language tracks&#44; select different audio tracks or turn on audio descriptions&#44; and show the media content in manners more suitable to the user &#40;e&#46;g&#46; fullscreen video or in an independent resizable window&#41;&#46; Other controls may also be made available&#46;

Even when the attribute is absent&#44; however&#44; user agents may provide controls to affect playback of the media resource &#40;e&#46;g&#46; play&#44; pause&#44; seeking&#44; track selection&#44; and volume controls&#41;&#44; but such features should not interfere with the page&#39;s normal rendering&#46; For example&#44; such features could be exposed in the <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;media&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s context menu&#44; platform media keys&#44; or a remote control&#46; The user agent may implement this simply by <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;expose&#45;a&#45;user&#45;interface&#45;to&#45;the&#45;user"></a>[exposing a user interface to the user](#expose-a-user-interface-to-the-user) as described above &#40;as if the <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;controls"></a><code>[controls](#attr-media-controls)</code> attribute was present&#41;&#46;

If the user agent <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;expose&#45;a&#45;user&#45;interface&#45;to&#45;the&#45;user&#45;2"></a>[exposes a user interface to the user](#expose-a-user-interface-to-the-user) by displaying controls over the <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;media&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; then the user agent should suppress any user interaction events while the user agent is interacting with this interface&#46; &#40;For example&#44; if the user clicks on a video&#39;s playback control&#44; <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;event&#45;mousedown"></a><code>[mousedown](https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#mousedown)</code> events and so forth would not simultaneously be fired at elements on the page&#46;&#41;

Where possible &#40;specifically&#44; for starting&#44; stopping&#44; pausing&#44; and unpausing playback&#44; for seeking&#44; for changing the rate of playback&#44; for fast&#45;forwarding or rewinding&#44; for listing&#44; enabling&#44; and disabling text tracks&#44; and for muting or changing the volume of the audio&#41;&#44; user interface features exposed by the user agent must be implemented in terms of the DOM API described above&#44; so that&#44; e&#46;g&#46;&#44; all the same events fire&#46;

Features such as fast&#45;forward or rewind must be implemented by only changing the <code>playbackRate</code> attribute &#40;and not the <code>defaultPlaybackRate</code> attribute&#41;&#46;

Seeking must be implemented in terms of <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seek"></a>[seeking](#dom-media-seek) to the requested position in the <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;media&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#39;s <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;media&#45;timeline"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline)&#46; For media resources where seeking to an arbitrary position would be slow&#44; user agents are encouraged to use the <em>approximate&#45;for&#45;speed</em> flag when seeking in response to the user manipulating an approximate position interface such as a seek bar&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<strong><code><var>media</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;media&#45;volume&#45;dev"></a>[volume](#dom-media-volume) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLMediaElement&#47;volume](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLMediaElement/volume)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox3&#46;5&#43;Safari3&#46;1&#43;Chrome3&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS🔰 3&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns the current playback volume&#44; as a number in the range 0&#46;0 to 1&#46;0&#44; where 0&#46;0 is the quietest and 1&#46;0 the loudest&#46;

Can be set&#44; to change the volume&#46;

Throws an <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;indexsizeerror"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> if the new value is not in the range 0&#46;0 &#46;&#46; 1&#46;0&#46;

<strong><code><var>media</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;media&#45;muted&#45;dev"></a>[muted](#dom-media-muted) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLMediaElement&#47;muted](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLMediaElement/muted)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox3&#46;5&#43;Safari3&#46;1&#43;Chrome3&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS3&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns true if audio is muted&#44; overriding the <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;volume"></a><code>[volume](#dom-media-volume)</code> attribute&#44; and false if the <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;volume&#45;2"></a><code>[volume](#dom-media-volume)</code> attribute is being honored&#46;

Can be set&#44; to change whether the audio is muted or not&#46;

A <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;media&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[media element](#media-element) has a <a id="concept&#45;media&#45;volume"></a><strong>playback volume</strong>&#44; which is a fraction in the range 0&#46;0 &#40;silent&#41; to 1&#46;0 &#40;loudest&#41;&#46; Initially&#44; the volume should be 1&#46;0&#44; but user agents may remember the last set value across sessions&#44; on a per&#45;site basis or otherwise&#44; so the volume may start at other values&#46;

To <a id="set&#45;the&#45;playback&#45;volume"></a><strong>set the playback volume</strong> of a <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;media&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[media element](#media-element) <var>element</var> to a number <var>value</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;volume"></a>[playback volume](#concept-media-volume) equals <var>value</var>&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;volume&#45;2"></a>[playback volume](#concept-media-volume) to <var>value</var>&#46;

3.  If <var>element</var> is not <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;allowed&#45;to&#45;play"></a>[allowed to play](#allowed-to-play)&#44; then run the <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;internal&#45;pause&#45;steps"></a>[internal pause steps](#internal-pause-steps) for <var>element</var>&#46;

4.  <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given <var>element</var> to <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;event&#45;media&#45;volumechange"></a><code>[volumechange](#event-media-volumechange)</code> at <var>element</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;volume"></a><strong><code>volume</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;volume&#45;3"></a>[playback volume](#concept-media-volume)&#46;

The <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;volume&#45;3"></a><code>[volume](#dom-media-volume)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  If the given value is not in the range 0&#46;0 to 1&#46;0 inclusive&#44; then throw an <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;set&#45;the&#45;playback&#45;volume"></a>[Set the playback volume](#set-the-playback-volume) of <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to the given value&#46;

A <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;media&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[media element](#media-element) is <a id="concept&#45;media&#45;muted"></a><strong>muted</strong> if any of the following are true&#58;

- Its <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;muted&#45;state"></a>[muted state](#concept-media-muted-state) is true&#46;

- Its <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;muted&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[muted state](#concept-media-muted-state) is &#34;<code>default</code>&#34; and it has a <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;muted"></a><code>[muted](#attr-media-muted)</code> content attribute&#46;

- The <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;direction&#45;of&#45;playback"></a>[direction of playback](#direction-of-playback) is backwards&#46;

- Its <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;playbackrate"></a><code>[playbackRate](#dom-media-playbackrate)</code> is so low or so high that the user agent cannot play audio usefully&#46;

Each <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;media&#45;element&#45;8"></a>[media element](#media-element) has a <a id="concept&#45;media&#45;muted&#45;state"></a><strong>muted state</strong>&#44; which is either true&#44; false&#44; or &#34;<code>default</code>&#34;&#59; it is initially &#34;<code>default</code>&#34;&#46; User agents may <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;set&#45;the&#45;muted&#45;state"></a>[set the muted state](#set-the-muted-state) of a <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;media&#45;element&#45;9"></a>[media element](#media-element) to true or false &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; remembering the last set value across sessions&#44; on a per&#45;site basis or otherwise&#41;&#46;

To <a id="set&#45;the&#45;muted&#45;state"></a><strong>set the muted state</strong> of a <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;media&#45;element&#45;10"></a>[media element](#media-element) <var>element</var> to a boolean <var>value</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;muted&#45;state&#45;3"></a>[muted state](#concept-media-muted-state) equals <var>value</var>&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;muted&#45;state&#45;4"></a>[muted state](#concept-media-muted-state) to <var>value</var>&#46;

3.  If <var>element</var> is not <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;allowed&#45;to&#45;play&#45;2"></a>[allowed to play](#allowed-to-play)&#44; then run the <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;internal&#45;pause&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[internal pause steps](#internal-pause-steps) for <var>element</var>&#46;

4.  <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;media&#45;element&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[Queue a media element task](#queue-a-media-element-task) given <var>element</var> to <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;event&#45;media&#45;volumechange&#45;2"></a><code>[volumechange](#event-media-volumechange)</code> at <var>element</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;muted"></a><strong><code>muted</code></strong> getter steps are to return true if <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) is <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;muted"></a>[muted](#concept-media-muted)&#59; otherwise false&#46;

The <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;muted"></a><code>[muted](#dom-media-muted)</code> setter steps are to <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;set&#45;the&#45;muted&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[set the muted state](#set-the-muted-state) of <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to the given value&#46;

A user agent has an associated <a id="volume&#45;locked"></a><strong>volume locked</strong> &#40;a boolean&#41;&#46; Its value is <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;implementation&#45;defined"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined) and determines whether the <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;volume&#45;4"></a>[playback volume](#concept-media-volume) takes effect&#46;

An element&#39;s <a id="effective&#45;media&#45;volume"></a><strong>effective media volume</strong> is determined as follows&#58;

1.  If the user has indicated that the user agent is to override the volume of the element&#44; then return the volume desired by the user&#46;

2.  If the user agent&#39;s <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;volume&#45;locked"></a>[volume locked](#volume-locked) is true&#44; then return the system volume&#46;

3.  If the element is <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;muted&#45;2"></a>[muted](#concept-media-muted)&#44; then return 0&#46;

4.  Let <var>volume</var> be the <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;media&#45;volume&#45;5"></a>[playback volume](#concept-media-volume) of the audio portions of the <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;media&#45;element&#45;11"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#44; in range 0&#46;0 &#40;silent&#41; to 1&#46;0 &#40;loudest&#41;&#46;

5.  Return <var>volume</var>&#44; interpreted relative to the range 0&#46;0 to 1&#46;0&#44; with 0&#46;0 being silent&#44; and 1&#46;0 being the loudest setting&#44; values in between increasing in loudness&#46; The range need not be linear&#46; The loudest setting may be lower than the system&#39;s loudest possible setting&#59; for example the user could have set a maximum volume&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;media&#45;muted"></a><strong><code>muted</code></strong> content attribute on <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;media&#45;element&#45;12"></a>[media elements](#media-element) is a <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;boolean&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute) that gives the default value for muting&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This attribute has no further effect once the <a id="user&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;muted&#45;2"></a><code>[muted](#dom-media-muted)</code> setter has been invoked or the user indicated a preference&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

This video &#40;an advertisement&#41; autoplays&#44; but to avoid annoying users&#44; it does so without sound&#44; and allows the user to turn the sound on&#46; The user agent can pause the video if it&#39;s unmuted without a user interaction&#46;

``` text
<video src="adverts.cgi?kind=video" controls autoplay loop muted></video>
```

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[TimeRanges&#47;start](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/TimeRanges/start)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox4&#43;Safari3&#46;1&#43;Chrome6&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------
