<strong><code><var>time</var> &#61; <var>media</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;timeranges&#45;end&#45;dev"></a>[end](#dom-timeranges-end)&#40;<var>index</var>&#41;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[TimeRanges&#47;end](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/TimeRanges/end)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox4&#43;Safari3&#46;1&#43;Chrome6&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns the time for the end of the range with the given index&#46;

Throws an <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> if the index is out of range&#46;

A <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;2"></a><code>[TimeRanges](#timeranges)</code> object has <a id="timeranges&#45;ranges"></a><strong>ranges</strong>&#44; a <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;list"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list) of zero or more <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range"></a>[time ranges](#timeranges-range)&#46;

A <a id="timeranges&#45;range"></a><strong>time range</strong> is a <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;struct"></a>[struct](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct) with the following <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;struct&#45;item"></a>[items](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item)&#58;

- A <a id="timeranges&#45;range&#45;start"></a><strong>start</strong>&#44; a number&#44; in seconds&#46;

- An <a id="timeranges&#45;range&#45;end"></a><strong>end</strong>&#44; a number&#44; in seconds&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;timeranges&#45;length"></a><strong><code>length</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;ranges"></a>[ranges](#timeranges-ranges)&#39;s <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;list&#45;size"></a>[size](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;timeranges&#45;start"></a><strong><code>start&#40;<var>index</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <var>index</var> is greater than or equal to <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;ranges&#45;2"></a>[ranges](#timeranges-ranges)&#39;s <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;list&#45;size&#45;2"></a>[size](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size)&#44; then throw an <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;3"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;domexception&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  Return <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;ranges&#45;3"></a>[ranges](#timeranges-ranges)&#91;<var>index</var>&#93;&#39;s <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;start"></a>[start](#timeranges-range-start)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;timeranges&#45;end"></a><strong><code>end&#40;<var>index</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <var>index</var> is greater than or equal to <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;ranges&#45;4"></a>[ranges](#timeranges-ranges)&#39;s <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;list&#45;size&#45;3"></a>[size](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size)&#44; then throw an <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;4"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;domexception&#45;4"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  Return <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;ranges&#45;5"></a>[ranges](#timeranges-ranges)&#91;<var>index</var>&#93;&#39;s <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;end"></a>[end](#timeranges-range-end)&#46;

A <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;3"></a><code>[TimeRanges](#timeranges)</code> object is a <a id="normalised&#45;timeranges&#45;object"></a><strong>normalized <code>TimeRanges</code> object</strong> if the following are true for each <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;2"></a>[time range](#timeranges-range) in its <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;ranges&#45;6"></a>[ranges](#timeranges-ranges)&#58;

- Its <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;start&#45;2"></a>[start](#timeranges-range-start) is greater than the <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;end&#45;2"></a>[end](#timeranges-range-end) of all earlier <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;3"></a>[time ranges](#timeranges-range)&#46;

- Its <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;start&#45;3"></a>[start](#timeranges-range-start) is less than or equal to its <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;end&#45;3"></a>[end](#timeranges-range-end)&#46;

In other words&#44; the <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;4"></a>[time ranges](#timeranges-range) in such an object are ordered&#44; don&#39;t overlap&#44; and don&#39;t touch &#40;adjacent ones are folded into one bigger <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;5"></a>[time range](#timeranges-range)&#41;&#46; A <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;6"></a>[time range](#timeranges-range) can be empty &#40;referencing just a single moment in time&#41;&#44; e&#46;g&#46;&#44; to indicate that only one frame is currently buffered in the case that the user agent has discarded the entire <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;media&#45;resource"></a>[media resource](#media-resource) except for the current frame&#44; when a <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[media element](#media-element) is paused&#46;

A <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;7"></a>[time range](#timeranges-range)&#39;s <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;start&#45;4"></a>[start](#timeranges-range-start) and <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;end&#45;4"></a>[end](#timeranges-range-end) are inclusive&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Thus&#44; the <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;end&#45;5"></a>[end](#timeranges-range-end) of a <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;8"></a>[time range](#timeranges-range) would be equal to the <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;start&#45;5"></a>[start](#timeranges-range-start) of a following adjacent &#40;touching but not overlapping&#41; <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;9"></a>[time range](#timeranges-range)&#46; Similarly&#44; a <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;10"></a>[time range](#timeranges-range) covering a whole timeline anchored at zero would have a <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;start&#45;6"></a>[start](#timeranges-range-start) equal to zero and an <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;timeranges&#45;range&#45;end&#45;6"></a>[end](#timeranges-range-end) equal to the duration of the timeline&#46;

The timelines used by the objects returned by the <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;buffered"></a><code>[buffered](#dom-media-buffered)</code>&#44; <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;seekable"></a><code>[seekable](#dom-media-seekable)</code>&#44; and <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;played"></a><code>[played](#dom-media-played)</code> IDL attributes of <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;media&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[media elements](#media-element) must be that element&#39;s <a id="time&#45;ranges&#58;media&#45;timeline"></a>[media timeline](#media-timeline)&#46;

##### <a id="the&#45;trackevent&#45;interface"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;15 The <a id="the&#45;trackevent&#45;interface&#58;trackevent"></a><code>[TrackEvent](#trackevent)</code> interface[](#the-trackevent-interface)

##### <a id="security&#45;and&#45;privacy&#45;considerations"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;17 Security and privacy considerations[](#security-and-privacy-considerations)

The main security and privacy implications of the <a id="security&#45;and&#45;privacy&#45;considerations&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> and <a id="security&#45;and&#45;privacy&#45;considerations&#58;the&#45;audio&#45;element"></a><code>[audio](#the-audio-element)</code> elements come from the ability to embed media cross&#45;origin&#46; There are two directions that threats can flow&#58; from hostile content to a victim page&#44; and from a hostile page to victim content&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

If a victim page embeds hostile content&#44; the threat is that the content might contain scripted code that attempts to interact with the <a id="security&#45;and&#45;privacy&#45;considerations&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> that embeds the content&#46; To avoid this&#44; user agents must ensure that there is no access from the content to the embedding page&#46; In the case of media content that uses DOM concepts&#44; the embedded content must be treated as if it was in its own unrelated <a id="security&#45;and&#45;privacy&#45;considerations&#58;top&#45;level&#45;traversable"></a>[top&#45;level traversable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#top-level-traversable)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For instance&#44; if an SVG animation was embedded in a <a id="security&#45;and&#45;privacy&#45;considerations&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> element&#44; the user agent would not give it access to the DOM of the outer page&#46; From the perspective of scripts in the SVG resource&#44; the SVG file would appear to be in a lone top&#45;level traversable with no parent&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

If a hostile page embeds victim content&#44; the threat is that the embedding page could obtain information from the content that it would not otherwise have access to&#46; The API does expose some information&#58; the existence of the media&#44; its type&#44; its duration&#44; its size&#44; and the performance characteristics of its host&#46; Such information is already potentially problematic&#44; but in practice the same information can more or less be obtained using the <a id="security&#45;and&#45;privacy&#45;considerations&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#44; and so it has been deemed acceptable&#46;

However&#44; significantly more sensitive information could be obtained if the user agent further exposes metadata within the content&#44; such as subtitles&#46; That information is therefore only exposed if the video resource uses CORS&#46; The <a id="security&#45;and&#45;privacy&#45;considerations&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;crossorigin"></a><code>[crossorigin](#attr-media-crossorigin)</code> attribute allows authors to enable CORS&#46; [&#91;FETCH&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsFETCH)

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Without this restriction&#44; an attacker could trick a user running within a corporate network into visiting a site that attempts to load a video from a previously leaked location on the corporation&#39;s intranet&#46; If such a video included confidential plans for a new product&#44; then being able to read the subtitles would present a serious confidentiality breach&#46;

##### <a id="best&#45;practices&#45;for&#45;authors&#45;using&#45;media&#45;elements"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;18 Best practices for authors using media elements[](#best-practices-for-authors-using-media-elements)

<em>This section is non&#45;normative&#46;</em>

Playing audio and video resources on small devices such as set&#45;top boxes or mobile phones is often constrained by limited hardware resources in the device&#46; For example&#44; a device might only support three simultaneous videos&#46; For this reason&#44; it is a good practice to release resources held by <a id="best&#45;practices&#45;for&#45;authors&#45;using&#45;media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[media elements](#media-element) when they are done playing&#44; either by being very careful about removing all references to the element and allowing it to be garbage collected&#44; or&#44; even better&#44; by setting the element&#39;s <a id="best&#45;practices&#45;for&#45;authors&#45;using&#45;media&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;media&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-media-src)</code> attribute to an empty string&#46; In cases where <a id="best&#45;practices&#45;for&#45;authors&#45;using&#45;media&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;srcobject"></a><code>[srcObject](#dom-media-srcobject)</code> was set&#44; instead set the <a id="best&#45;practices&#45;for&#45;authors&#45;using&#45;media&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;srcobject&#45;2"></a><code>[srcObject](#dom-media-srcobject)</code> to null&#46;

Similarly&#44; when the playback rate is not exactly 1&#46;0&#44; hardware&#44; software&#44; or format limitations can cause video frames to be dropped and audio to be choppy or muted&#46;

##### <a id="best&#45;practices&#45;for&#45;implementers&#45;of&#45;media&#45;elements"></a>4&#46;8&#46;11&#46;19 Best practices for implementers of media elements[](#best-practices-for-implementers-of-media-elements)

<em>This section is non&#45;normative&#46;</em>

How accurately various aspects of the <a id="best&#45;practices&#45;for&#45;implementers&#45;of&#45;media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;element"></a>[media element](#media-element) API are implemented is considered a quality&#45;of&#45;implementation issue&#46;

For example&#44; when implementing the <a id="best&#45;practices&#45;for&#45;implementers&#45;of&#45;media&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;buffered"></a><code>[buffered](#dom-media-buffered)</code> attribute&#44; how precise an implementation reports the ranges that have been buffered depends on how carefully the user agent inspects the data&#46; Since the API reports ranges as times&#44; but the data is obtained in byte streams&#44; a user agent receiving a variable&#45;bitrate stream might only be able to determine precise times by actually decoding all of the data&#46; User agents aren&#39;t required to do this&#44; however&#59; they can instead return estimates &#40;e&#46;g&#46; based on the average bitrate seen so far&#41; which get revised as more information becomes available&#46;

As a general rule&#44; user agents are urged to be conservative rather than optimistic&#46; For example&#44; it would be bad to report that everything had been buffered when it had not&#46;

Another quality&#45;of&#45;implementation issue would be playing a video backwards when the codec is designed only for forward playback &#40;e&#46;g&#46; there aren&#39;t many key frames&#44; and they are far apart&#44; and the intervening frames only have deltas from the previous frame&#41;&#46; User agents could do a poor job&#44; e&#46;g&#46; only showing key frames&#59; however&#44; better implementations would do more work and thus do a better job&#44; e&#46;g&#46; actually decoding parts of the video forwards&#44; storing the complete frames&#44; and then playing the frames backwards&#46;

Similarly&#44; while implementations are allowed to drop buffered data at any time &#40;there is no requirement that a user agent keep all the media data obtained for the lifetime of the media element&#41;&#44; it is again a quality of implementation issue&#58; user agents with sufficient resources to keep all the data around are encouraged to do so&#44; as this allows for a better user experience&#46; For example&#44; if the user is watching a live stream&#44; a user agent could allow the user only to view the live video&#59; however&#44; a better user agent would buffer everything and allow the user to seek through the earlier material&#44; pause it&#44; play it forwards and backwards&#44; etc&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

When a <a id="best&#45;practices&#45;for&#45;implementers&#45;of&#45;media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[media element](#media-element) that is paused is <a id="best&#45;practices&#45;for&#45;implementers&#45;of&#45;media&#45;elements&#58;remove&#45;an&#45;element&#45;from&#45;a&#45;document"></a>[removed from a document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#remove-an-element-from-a-document) and not reinserted before the next time the <a id="best&#45;practices&#45;for&#45;implementers&#45;of&#45;media&#45;elements&#58;event&#45;loop"></a>[event loop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-loop) reaches [step 1](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#step1)&#44; implementations that are resource constrained are encouraged to take that opportunity to release all hardware resources &#40;like video planes&#44; networking resources&#44; and data buffers&#41; used by the <a id="best&#45;practices&#45;for&#45;implementers&#45;of&#45;media&#45;elements&#58;media&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[media element](#media-element)&#46; &#40;User agents still have to keep track of the playback position and so forth&#44; though&#44; in case playback is later restarted&#46;&#41;

<strong><a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmlmapelement"></a><a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect"></a><a id="dom&#45;map&#45;name"></a><a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;htmlcollection"></a><a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;map&#45;areas"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLMapElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString name;
  [SameObject] readonly attribute HTMLCollection areas;
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;the&#45;map&#45;element"></a><code>[map](#the-map-element)</code> element&#44; in conjunction with an <a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element and any <a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> element descendants&#44; defines an <a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;image&#45;map&#45;2"></a>[image map](#image-map)&#46; The element <a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) its children&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;map&#45;name"></a><strong><code>name</code></strong> attribute gives the map a name so that it can be <a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;referenced&#45;2"></a>[referenced](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#referenced)&#46; The attribute must be present and must have a non&#45;empty value with no <a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46; The value of the <a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;map&#45;name&#45;2"></a><code>[name](#attr-map-name)</code> attribute must not be equal to the value of the <a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;map&#45;name&#45;3"></a><code>[name](#attr-map-name)</code> attribute of another <a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;the&#45;map&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[map](#the-map-element)</code> element in the same <a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;tree"></a>[tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree)&#46; If the <a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute"></a><code>[id](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-id-attribute)</code> attribute is also specified&#44; both attributes must have the same value&#46;

<strong><code><var>map</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;map&#45;areas&#45;dev"></a>[areas](#dom-map-areas)</code></strong>

Returns an <a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;htmlcollection&#45;2"></a><code>[HTMLCollection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection)</code> of the <a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> elements in the <a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;the&#45;map&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[map](#the-map-element)</code>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;map&#45;areas"></a><strong><code>areas</code></strong> attribute must return an <a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;htmlcollection&#45;3"></a><code>[HTMLCollection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection)</code> rooted at the <a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;the&#45;map&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[map](#the-map-element)</code> element&#44; whose filter matches only <a id="the&#45;map&#45;element&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> elements&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Image maps can be defined in conjunction with other content on the page&#44; to ease maintenance&#46; This example is of a page with an image map at the top of the page and a corresponding set of text links at the bottom&#46;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE HTML>
<HTML LANG="EN">
<TITLE>Babies™: Toys</TITLE>
<HEADER>
 <H1>Toys</H1>
 <IMG SRC="/images/menu.gif"
      ALT="Babies™ navigation menu. Select a department to go to its page."
      USEMAP="#NAV">
</HEADER>
 ...
<FOOTER>
 <MAP NAME="NAV">
  <P>
   <A HREF="/clothes/">Clothes</A>
   <AREA ALT="Clothes" COORDS="0,0,100,50" HREF="/clothes/"> |
   <A HREF="/toys/">Toys</A>
   <AREA ALT="Toys" COORDS="100,0,200,50" HREF="/toys/"> |
   <A HREF="/food/">Food</A>
   <AREA ALT="Food" COORDS="200,0,300,50" HREF="/food/"> |
   <A HREF="/books/">Books</A>
   <AREA ALT="Books" COORDS="300,0,400,50" HREF="/books/">
  </P>
 </MAP>
</FOOTER>
```

<a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;ping"></a><code>[ping](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#ping)</code> — <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;url"></a>[URLs](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) to ping

<a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;rel"></a><code>[rel](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-rel)</code> — Relationship between the location in the document containing the <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;hyperlink&#45;3"></a>[hyperlink](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#hyperlink) and the destination resource

<a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;referrerpolicy"></a><code>[referrerpolicy](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-referrerpolicy)</code> — <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;referrer&#45;policy"></a>[Referrer policy](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy) for <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fetch"></a>[fetches](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch) initiated by the element

<a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;hreflang"></a><code>[hreflang](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-hreflang)</code> — Language of the linked resource

Otherwise&#58; [for authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-area-no-href)&#59; [for implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-area-no-href)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmlareaelement"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect"></a><a id="dom&#45;area&#45;alt"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;2"></a><a id="dom&#45;area&#45;coords"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;3"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;3"></a><a id="dom&#45;area&#45;shape"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;4"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;4"></a><a id="dom&#45;area&#45;download"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;5"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;5"></a><a id="dom&#45;area&#45;ping"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;6"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;6"></a><a id="dom&#45;area&#45;rel"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;domtokenlist&#45;value"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;7"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;rel&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;domtokenlist"></a><a id="dom&#45;area&#45;rellist"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;7"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;area&#45;referrerpolicy"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;htmlareaelement"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;hyperlinkelementutils"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;htmlareaelement&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;htmlhyperlinkelementutils"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLAreaElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString alt;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString coords;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString shape;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString download;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute USVString ping;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString rel;
  [SameObject, PutForwards=value, Reflect="rel"] readonly attribute DOMTokenList relList;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString referrerPolicy;

  // also has obsolete members
};
HTMLAreaElement includes HyperlinkElementUtils;
HTMLAreaElement includes HTMLHyperlinkElementUtils;
```

The <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) either a hyperlink with some text and a corresponding area on an <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;image&#45;map&#45;3"></a>[image map](#image-map)&#44; or a dead area on an image map&#46;

An <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> element with a parent node must have a <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;the&#45;map&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[map](#the-map-element)</code> element ancestor&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> element has an <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;href&#45;4"></a><code>[href](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-href)</code> attribute&#44; then the <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> element represents a <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;hyperlink&#45;4"></a>[hyperlink](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#hyperlink)&#46; In this case&#44; the <a id="attr&#45;area&#45;alt"></a><strong><code>alt</code></strong> attribute must be present&#46; It specifies the text of the hyperlink&#46; Its value must be text that&#44; when presented with the texts specified for the other hyperlinks of the <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;image&#45;map&#45;4"></a>[image map](#image-map)&#44; and with the alternative text of the image&#44; but without the image itself&#44; provides the user with the same kind of choice as the hyperlink would when used without its text but with its shape applied to the image&#46; The <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;alt&#45;2"></a><code>[alt](#attr-area-alt)</code> attribute may be left blank if there is another <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> element in the same <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;image&#45;map&#45;5"></a>[image map](#image-map) that points to the same resource and has a non&#45;blank <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;alt&#45;3"></a><code>[alt](#attr-area-alt)</code> attribute&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> element has no <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;href&#45;5"></a><code>[href](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-href)</code> attribute&#44; then the area represented by the element cannot be selected&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;alt&#45;4"></a><code>[alt](#attr-area-alt)</code> attribute must be omitted&#46;

In both cases&#44; the <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;2"></a><code>[shape](#attr-area-shape)</code> and <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;coords&#45;2"></a><code>[coords](#attr-area-coords)</code> attributes specify the area&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;area&#45;shape"></a><strong><code>shape</code></strong> attribute is an <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;enumerated&#45;attribute"></a>[enumerated attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#enumerated-attribute) with the following keywords and states&#58;

<table class="yesno"><thead><tr><th>Keyword      </th><th>Conforming      </th><th>State      </th><th>Brief description    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><dfn id="attr-area-shape-keyword-circle"><code>circle</code></dfn>      </td><td>      </td><td rowspan="2"><a href="#attr-area-shape-circle" id="the-area-element:attr-area-shape-circle">Circle state</a>      </td><td rowspan="2">Designates a circle&#44; using exactly three integers in the <code id="the-area-element:attr-area-coords-3"><a href="#attr-area-coords">coords</a></code> attribute&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn id="attr-area-shape-keyword-circ"><code>circ</code></dfn>      </td><td class="no">No     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn id="attr-area-shape-keyword-default"><code>default</code></dfn>      </td><td>      </td><td><a href="#attr-area-shape-default" id="the-area-element:attr-area-shape-default">Default state</a>      </td><td>This area is the whole image&#46; &#40;The <code id="the-area-element:attr-area-coords-4"><a href="#attr-area-coords">coords</a></code>      attribute is not used&#46;&#41;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn id="attr-area-shape-keyword-poly"><code>poly</code></dfn>      </td><td>      </td><td rowspan="2"><a href="#attr-area-shape-poly" id="the-area-element:attr-area-shape-poly">Polygon state</a>      </td><td rowspan="2">Designates a polygon&#44; using at&#45;least six integers in the <code id="the-area-element:attr-area-coords-5"><a href="#attr-area-coords">coords</a></code> attribute&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn id="attr-area-shape-keyword-polygon"><code>polygon</code></dfn>      </td><td class="no">No     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn id="attr-area-shape-keyword-rect"><code>rect</code></dfn>      </td><td>      </td><td rowspan="2"><a href="#attr-area-shape-rect" id="the-area-element:attr-area-shape-rect">Rectangle state</a>      </td><td rowspan="2">Designates a rectangle&#44; using exactly four integers in the <code id="the-area-element:attr-area-coords-6"><a href="#attr-area-coords">coords</a></code> attribute&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn id="attr-area-shape-keyword-rectangle"><code>rectangle</code></dfn>      </td><td class="no">No   </td></tr></tbody></table>

The attribute&#39;s <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;missing&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[missing value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#missing-value-default)</em> and <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;invalid&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[invalid value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#invalid-value-default)</em> are both the <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;rect&#45;2"></a>[rectangle](#attr-area-shape-rect) state&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;area&#45;coords"></a><strong><code>coords</code></strong> attribute must&#44; if specified&#44; contain a <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;list&#45;of&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;numbers"></a>[valid list of floating&#45;point numbers](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-list-of-floating-point-numbers)&#46; This attribute gives the coordinates for the shape described by the <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;3"></a><code>[shape](#attr-area-shape)</code> attribute&#46; The processing for this attribute is described as part of the <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;image&#45;map&#45;6"></a>[image map](#image-map) processing model&#46;

In the <a id="attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;circle"></a><strong>circle state</strong>&#44; <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> elements must have a <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;coords&#45;7"></a><code>[coords](#attr-area-coords)</code> attribute present&#44; with three integers&#44; the last of which must be non&#45;negative&#46; The first integer must be the distance in <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;&#39;px&#39;"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px) from the left edge of the image to the center of the circle&#44; the second integer must be the distance in <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;2"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px) from the top edge of the image to the center of the circle&#44; and the third integer must be the radius of the circle&#44; again in <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;3"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46;

In the <a id="attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;default"></a><strong>default state</strong>&#44; <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> elements must not have a <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;coords&#45;8"></a><code>[coords](#attr-area-coords)</code> attribute&#46; &#40;The area is the whole image&#46;&#41;

In the <a id="attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;poly"></a><strong>polygon state</strong>&#44; <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> elements must have a <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;coords&#45;9"></a><code>[coords](#attr-area-coords)</code> attribute with at least six integers&#44; and the number of integers must be even&#46; Each pair of integers must represent a coordinate given as the distances from the left and the top of the image in <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;4"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px) respectively&#44; and all the coordinates together must represent the points of the polygon&#44; in order&#46;

In the <a id="attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;rect"></a><strong>rectangle state</strong>&#44; <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> elements must have a <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;coords&#45;10"></a><code>[coords](#attr-area-coords)</code> attribute with exactly four integers&#44; the first of which must be less than the third&#44; and the second of which must be less than the fourth&#46; The four points must represent&#44; respectively&#44; the distance from the left edge of the image to the left side of the rectangle&#44; the distance from the top edge to the top side&#44; the distance from the left edge to the right side&#44; and the distance from the top edge to the bottom side&#44; all in <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;5"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46;

When user agents allow users to <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;following&#45;hyperlinks&#45;2"></a>[follow hyperlinks](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#following-hyperlinks-2) or <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;downloading&#45;hyperlinks"></a>[download hyperlinks](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#downloading-hyperlinks) created using the <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> element&#44; the <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;href&#45;6"></a><code>[href](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-href)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;target&#45;2"></a><code>[target](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-target)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;download&#45;2"></a><code>[download](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-download)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;ping&#45;2"></a><code>[ping](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#ping)</code> attributes decide how the link is followed&#46; The <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;rel&#45;3"></a><code>[rel](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-rel)</code> attribute may be used to indicate to the user the likely nature of the target resource before the user follows the link&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;target&#45;3"></a><code>[target](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-target)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;download&#45;3"></a><code>[download](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-download)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;ping&#45;3"></a><code>[ping](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#ping)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;rel&#45;4"></a><code>[rel](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-rel)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;referrerpolicy&#45;2"></a><code>[referrerpolicy](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-referrerpolicy)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;hreflang&#45;2"></a><code>[hreflang](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-hreflang)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-type)</code> attributes must be omitted if the <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;href&#45;7"></a><code>[href](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-href)</code> attribute is not present&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;names&#58;&#45;the&#45;itemprop&#45;attribute"></a><code>[itemprop](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#names:-the-itemprop-attribute)</code> attribute is specified on an <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> element&#44; then the <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;href&#45;8"></a><code>[href](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-href)</code> attribute must also be specified&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLAreaElement&#47;referrerPolicy](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLAreaElement/referrerPolicy)

The IDL attribute <a id="dom&#45;area&#45;referrerpolicy"></a><strong><code>referrerPolicy</code></strong> must <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;reflect"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;referrerpolicy&#45;3"></a><code>[referrerpolicy](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-referrerpolicy)</code> content attribute&#44; <a id="the&#45;area&#45;element&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values"></a>[limited to only known values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#limited-to-only-known-values)&#46;

#### <a id="image&#45;maps"></a>4&#46;8&#46;14 Image maps[](#image-maps)

##### <a id="authoring"></a>4&#46;8&#46;14&#46;1 Authoring[](#authoring)

An <a id="image&#45;map"></a><strong>image map</strong> allows geometric areas on an image to be associated with <a id="authoring&#58;hyperlink"></a>[hyperlinks](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#hyperlink)&#46;

An image&#44; in the form of an <a id="authoring&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#44; may be associated with an image map &#40;in the form of a <a id="authoring&#58;the&#45;map&#45;element"></a><code>[map](#the-map-element)</code> element&#41; by specifying a <a id="attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;usemap"></a><strong><code>usemap</code></strong> attribute on the <a id="authoring&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element&#46; The <a id="authoring&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;usemap"></a><code>[usemap](#attr-hyperlink-usemap)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must be a <a id="authoring&#58;valid&#45;hash&#45;name&#45;reference"></a>[valid hash&#45;name reference](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-hash-name-reference) to a <a id="authoring&#58;the&#45;map&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[map](#the-map-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Consider an image that looks as follows&#58;

![A line with four shapes in it&#44; equally spaced&#58; a red hollow box&#44; a green circle&#44; a blue triangle&#44; and a yellow four&#45;pointed star&#46;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/sample-usemap.png)

If we wanted just the colored areas to be clickable&#44; we could do it as follows&#58;

``` text
<p>
 Please select a shape:
 <img src="shapes.png" usemap="#shapes"
      alt="Four shapes are available: a red hollow box, a green circle, a blue triangle, and a yellow four-pointed star.">
 <map name="shapes">
  <area shape=rect coords="50,50,100,100"> <!-- the hole in the red box -->
  <area shape=rect coords="25,25,125,125" href="red.html" alt="Red box.">
  <area shape=circle coords="200,75,50" href="green.html" alt="Green circle.">
  <area shape=poly coords="325,25,262,125,388,125" href="blue.html" alt="Blue triangle.">
  <area shape=poly coords="450,25,435,60,400,75,435,90,450,125,465,90,500,75,465,60"
        href="yellow.html" alt="Yellow star.">
 </map>
</p>
```

##### <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model"></a>4&#46;8&#46;14&#46;2 <a id="processing&#45;model"></a>Processing model[](#image-map-processing-model)

If an <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element has a <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;usemap"></a><code>[usemap](#attr-hyperlink-usemap)</code> attribute specified&#44; user agents must process it as follows&#58;

1.  Parse the attribute&#39;s value using the <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;a&#45;hash&#45;name&#45;reference"></a>[rules for parsing a hash&#45;name reference](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-a-hash-name-reference) to a <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;map&#45;element"></a><code>[map](#the-map-element)</code> element&#44; with the element as the context node&#46; This will return either an element &#40;the <var>map</var>&#41; or null&#46;

2.  If that returned null&#44; then return&#46; The image is not associated with an image map after all&#46;

3.  Otherwise&#44; the user agent must collect all the <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> elements that are descendants of the <var>map</var>&#46; Let <var>areas</var> be that list&#46;

Having obtained the list of <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> elements that form the image map &#40;the <var>areas</var>&#41;&#44; interactive user agents must process the list in one of two ways&#46;

If the user agent intends to show the text that the <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> element represents&#44; then it must use the following steps&#58;

1.  Remove all the <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> elements in <var>areas</var> that have no <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;href"></a><code>[href](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-href)</code> attribute&#46;

2.  Remove all the <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> elements in <var>areas</var> that have no <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;alt"></a><code>[alt](#attr-area-alt)</code> attribute&#44; or whose <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;alt&#45;2"></a><code>[alt](#attr-area-alt)</code> attribute&#39;s value is the empty string&#44; <em>if</em> there is another <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> element in <var>areas</var> with the same value in the <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;hyperlink&#45;href&#45;2"></a><code>[href](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#attr-hyperlink-href)</code> attribute and with a non&#45;empty <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;alt&#45;3"></a><code>[alt](#attr-area-alt)</code> attribute&#46;

3.  Each remaining <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> element in <var>areas</var> represents a <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;hyperlink"></a>[hyperlink](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#hyperlink)&#46; Those hyperlinks should all be made available to the user in a manner associated with the text of the <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code>&#46;

    In this context&#44; user agents may represent <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> and <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> elements with no specified <code>alt</code> attributes&#44; or whose <code>alt</code> attributes are the empty string or some other non&#45;visible text&#44; in an <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;implementation&#45;defined"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined) fashion intended to indicate the lack of suitable author&#45;provided text&#46;

If the user agent intends to show the image and allow interaction with the image to select hyperlinks&#44; then the image must be associated with a set of layered shapes&#44; taken from the <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> elements in <var>areas</var>&#44; in reverse <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order) &#40;so the last specified <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> element in the <var>map</var> is the bottom&#45;most shape&#44; and the first element in the <var>map</var>&#44; in <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;2"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#44; is the top&#45;most shape&#41;&#46;

Each <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> element in <var>areas</var> must be processed as follows to obtain a shape to layer onto the image&#58;

1.  Find the state that the element&#39;s <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape"></a><code>[shape](#attr-area-shape)</code> attribute represents&#46;

2.  Use the <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;numbers"></a>[rules for parsing a list of floating&#45;point numbers](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-a-list-of-floating-point-numbers) to parse the element&#39;s <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;coords"></a><code>[coords](#attr-area-coords)</code> attribute&#44; if it is present&#44; and let the <var>coords</var> list be the result&#46; If the attribute is absent&#44; let the <var>coords</var> list be the empty list&#46;

3.  If the number of items in the <var>coords</var> list is less than the minimum number given for the <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> element&#39;s current state&#44; as per the following table&#44; then the shape is empty&#59; return&#46;

    <table><thead><tr><th>State        </th><th>Minimum number of items      </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><a href="#attr-area-shape-circle" id="image-map-processing-model:attr-area-shape-circle">Circle state</a>        </td><td>3       </td></tr><tr><td><a href="#attr-area-shape-default" id="image-map-processing-model:attr-area-shape-default">Default state</a>        </td><td>0       </td></tr><tr><td><a href="#attr-area-shape-poly" id="image-map-processing-model:attr-area-shape-poly">Polygon state</a>        </td><td>6       </td></tr><tr><td><a href="#attr-area-shape-rect" id="image-map-processing-model:attr-area-shape-rect">Rectangle state</a>        </td><td>4     </td></tr></tbody></table>

4.  Check for excess items in the <var>coords</var> list as per the entry in the following list corresponding to the <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;2"></a><code>[shape](#attr-area-shape)</code> attribute&#39;s state&#58;

    <strong><a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;circle&#45;2"></a>[Circle state](#attr-area-shape-circle)</strong>

    Drop any items in the list beyond the third&#46;
    <strong><a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;default&#45;2"></a>[Default state](#attr-area-shape-default)</strong>

    Drop all items in the list&#46;
    <strong><a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;poly&#45;2"></a>[Polygon state](#attr-area-shape-poly)</strong>

    Drop the last item if there&#39;s an odd number of items&#46;
    <strong><a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;rect&#45;2"></a>[Rectangle state](#attr-area-shape-rect)</strong>

    Drop any items in the list beyond the fourth&#46;

5.  If the <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;3"></a><code>[shape](#attr-area-shape)</code> attribute represents the <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;rect&#45;3"></a>[rectangle state](#attr-area-shape-rect)&#44; and the first number in the list is numerically greater than the third number in the list&#44; then swap those two numbers around&#46;

6.  If the <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;4"></a><code>[shape](#attr-area-shape)</code> attribute represents the <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;rect&#45;4"></a>[rectangle state](#attr-area-shape-rect)&#44; and the second number in the list is numerically greater than the fourth number in the list&#44; then swap those two numbers around&#46;

7.  If the <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;5"></a><code>[shape](#attr-area-shape)</code> attribute represents the <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;circle&#45;3"></a>[circle state](#attr-area-shape-circle)&#44; and the third number in the list is less than or equal to zero&#44; then the shape is empty&#59; return&#46;

8.  Now&#44; the shape represented by the element is the one described for the entry in the list below corresponding to the state of the <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;6"></a><code>[shape](#attr-area-shape)</code> attribute&#58;

    <strong><a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;circle&#45;4"></a>[Circle state](#attr-area-shape-circle)</strong>

    Let <var>x</var> be the first number in <var>coords</var>&#44; <var>y</var> be the second number&#44; and <var>r</var> be the third number&#46;

    The shape is a circle whose center is <var>x</var> <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;&#39;px&#39;"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px) from the left edge of the image and <var>y</var> <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;2"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px) from the top edge of the image&#44; and whose radius is <var>r</var> <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;3"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46;

    <strong><a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;default&#45;3"></a>[Default state](#attr-area-shape-default)</strong>

    The shape is a rectangle that exactly covers the entire image&#46;

    <strong><a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;poly&#45;3"></a>[Polygon state](#attr-area-shape-poly)</strong>

    Let <var>x<sub><var>i</var></sub></var> be the &#40;2<var>i</var>&#41;th entry in <var>coords</var>&#44; and <var>y<sub><var>i</var></sub></var> be the &#40;2<var>i</var>&#43;1&#41;th entry in <var>coords</var> &#40;the first entry in <var>coords</var> being the one with index 0&#41;&#46;

    Let <var>the coordinates</var> be &#40;<var>x<sub><var>i</var></sub></var>&#44; <var>y<sub><var>i</var></sub></var>&#41;&#44; interpreted in <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;4"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px) measured from the top left of the image&#44; for all integer values of <var>i</var> from 0 to &#40;<var>N</var>&#47;2&#41;&#45;1&#44; where <var>N</var> is the number of items in <var>coords</var>&#46;

    The shape is a polygon whose vertices are given by <var>the coordinates</var>&#44; and whose interior is established using the even&#45;odd rule&#46; [&#91;GRAPHICS&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsGRAPHICS)

    <strong><a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;area&#45;shape&#45;rect&#45;5"></a>[Rectangle state](#attr-area-shape-rect)</strong>

    Let <var>x<sub>1</sub></var> be the first number in <var>coords</var>&#44; <var>y<sub>1</sub></var> be the second number&#44; <var>x<sub>2</sub></var> be the third number&#44; and <var>y<sub>2</sub></var> be the fourth number&#46;

    The shape is a rectangle whose top&#45;left corner is given by the coordinate &#40;<var>x<sub>1</sub></var>&#44; <var>y<sub>1</sub></var>&#41; and whose bottom right corner is given by the coordinate &#40;<var>x<sub>2</sub></var>&#44; <var>y<sub>2</sub></var>&#41;&#44; those coordinates being interpreted as <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;5"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px) from the top left corner of the image&#46;

    For historical reasons&#44; the coordinates must be interpreted relative to the <em>displayed</em> image after any stretching caused by the CSS <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;&#39;width&#39;"></a>[&#39;width&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#the-width-property) and <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;&#39;height&#39;"></a>[&#39;height&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#the-height-property) properties &#40;or&#44; for non&#45;CSS browsers&#44; the image element&#39;s <code>width</code> and <code>height</code> attributes — CSS browsers map those attributes to the aforementioned CSS properties&#41;&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    Browser zoom features and transforms applied using CSS or SVG do not affect the coordinates&#46;

Pointing device interaction with an image associated with a set of layered shapes per the above algorithm must result in the relevant user interaction events being first fired to the top&#45;most shape covering the point that the pointing device indicated&#44; if any&#44; or to the image element itself&#44; if there is no shape covering that point&#46; User agents may also allow individual <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> elements representing <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;hyperlink&#45;2"></a>[hyperlinks](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#hyperlink) to be selected and activated &#40;e&#46;g&#46; using a keyboard&#41;&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Because a <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;map&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[map](#the-map-element)</code> element &#40;and its <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> elements&#41; can be associated with multiple <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> elements&#44; it is possible for an <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;area&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[area](#the-area-element)</code> element to correspond to multiple <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;focusable&#45;area"></a><em>[focusable areas](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focusable-area)</em> of the document&#46;

Image maps are <a id="image&#45;map&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;live"></a>[live](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#live)&#59; if the DOM is mutated&#44; then the user agent must act as if it had rerun the algorithms for image maps&#46;

#### <a id="mathml"></a>4&#46;8&#46;15 MathML[](#mathml)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTML&#47;HTML5&#47;HTML5&#95;Parser&#35;Inline&#95;SVG&#95;and&#95;MathML&#95;support](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Guide/HTML/HTML5/HTML5_Parser#Inline_SVG_and_MathML_support)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox4&#43;Safari5&#46;1&#43;Chrome7&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera11&#46;6&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer9&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android5&#43;Safari iOS5&#43;Chrome Android18&#43;WebView Android3&#43;Samsung Internet1&#46;0&#43;Opera Android12&#43;

The <a id="mathml&#58;mathml&#45;math"></a>[MathML <code>math</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#the-top-level-math-element) element falls into the <a id="mathml&#58;embedded&#45;content&#45;category"></a>[embedded content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#embedded-content-category)&#44; <a id="mathml&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[phrasing content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#phrasing-content-2)&#44; <a id="mathml&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[flow content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#flow-content-2)&#44; and <a id="mathml&#58;palpable&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[palpable content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#palpable-content-2) categories for the purposes of the content models in this specification&#46;

When the <a id="mathml&#58;mathml&#45;annotation&#45;xml"></a>[MathML <code>annotation&#45;xml</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#dfn-annotation-xml) element contains elements from the <a id="mathml&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#44; such elements must all be <a id="mathml&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[flow content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#flow-content-2)&#46;

When the MathML token elements &#40;<a id="mathml&#58;mathml&#45;mi"></a><code>[mi](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#the-mi-element)</code>&#44; <a id="mathml&#58;mathml&#45;mo"></a><code>[mo](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#operator-fence-separator-or-accent-mo)</code>&#44; <a id="mathml&#58;mathml&#45;mn"></a><code>[mn](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#number-mn)</code>&#44; <a id="mathml&#58;mathml&#45;ms"></a><code>[ms](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#string-literal-ms)</code>&#44; and <a id="mathml&#58;mathml&#45;mtext"></a><code>[mtext](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#text-mtext)</code>&#41; are descendants of HTML elements&#44; they may contain <a id="mathml&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[phrasing content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#phrasing-content-2) elements from the <a id="mathml&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#46;

User agents must handle text other than <a id="mathml&#58;inter&#45;element&#45;whitespace"></a>[inter&#45;element whitespace](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#inter-element-whitespace) found in MathML elements whose content models do not allow straight text by pretending for the purposes of MathML content models&#44; layout&#44; and rendering that the text is actually wrapped in a <a id="mathml&#58;mathml&#45;mtext&#45;2"></a>[MathML <code>mtext</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#text-mtext) element&#46; &#40;Such text is not&#44; however&#44; conforming&#46;&#41;

User agents must act as if any MathML element whose contents does not match the element&#39;s content model was replaced&#44; for the purposes of MathML layout and rendering&#44; by a <a id="mathml&#58;mathml&#45;merror"></a>[MathML <code>merror</code>](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#error-message-merror) element containing some appropriate error message&#46;

The semantics of MathML elements are defined by MathML and <a id="mathml&#58;other&#45;applicable&#45;specifications"></a>[other applicable specifications](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#other-applicable-specifications)&#46; [&#91;MATHML&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsMATHML)

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Here is an example of the use of MathML in an HTML document&#58;

``` text
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
 <head>
  <title>The quadratic formula</title>
 </head>
 <body>
  <h1>The quadratic formula</h1>
  <p>
   <math>
    <mi>x</mi>
    <mo>=</mo>
    <mfrac>
     <mrow>
      <mo form="prefix">−</mo> <mi>b</mi>
      <mo>±</mo>
      <msqrt>
       <msup> <mi>b</mi> <mn>2</mn> </msup>
       <mo>−</mo>
       <mn>4</mn> <mo>⁢</mo> <mi>a</mi> <mo>⁢</mo> <mi>c</mi>
      </msqrt>
     </mrow>
     <mrow>
      <mn>2</mn> <mo>⁢</mo> <mi>a</mi>
     </mrow>
    </mfrac>
   </math>
  </p>
 </body>
</html>
```

The <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;svg&#45;svg"></a>[SVG <code>svg</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/struct.html#elementdef-svg) element falls into the <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;embedded&#45;content&#45;category"></a>[embedded content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#embedded-content-category)&#44; <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[phrasing content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#phrasing-content-2)&#44; <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[flow content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#flow-content-2)&#44; and <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;palpable&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[palpable content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#palpable-content-2) categories for the purposes of the content models in this specification&#46;

When the <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;svg&#45;foreignobject"></a>[SVG <code>foreignObject</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/embedded.html#elementdef-foreignObject) element contains elements from the <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#44; such elements must all be <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[flow content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#flow-content-2)&#46;

The content model for the <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;svg&#45;title"></a>[SVG <code>title</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/struct.html#elementdef-title) element inside <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;html&#45;documents"></a>[HTML documents](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#html-document) is <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[phrasing content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#phrasing-content-2)&#46; &#40;This further constrains the requirements given in SVG 2&#46;&#41;

The semantics of SVG elements are defined by SVG 2 and <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;other&#45;applicable&#45;specifications"></a>[other applicable specifications](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#other-applicable-specifications)&#46; [&#91;SVG&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsSVG)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<strong><code><var>doc</var> &#61; <var>iframe</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;media&#45;getsvgdocument&#45;dev"></a>[getSVGDocument](#dom-media-getsvgdocument)&#40;&#41;</code></strong>

<strong><code><var>doc</var> &#61; <var>embed</var>&#46;<a id="svg&#45;0&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;getsvgdocument"></a>[getSVGDocument](#dom-media-getsvgdocument)&#40;&#41;</code></strong>

<strong><code><var>doc</var> &#61; <var>object</var>&#46;<a id="svg&#45;0&#58;dom&#45;media&#45;getsvgdocument&#45;2"></a>[getSVGDocument](#dom-media-getsvgdocument)&#40;&#41;</code></strong>

Returns the <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> object&#44; in the case of <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code>&#44; <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element"></a><code>[embed](#the-embed-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> elements being used to embed SVG&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;media&#45;getsvgdocument"></a><strong><code>getSVGDocument&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>document</var> be <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;concept&#45;bcc&#45;content&#45;document"></a>[content document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-bcc-content-document)&#46;

2.  If <var>document</var> is non&#45;null and was created by the <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;read&#45;xml"></a>[page load processing model for XML files](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#read-xml) section because the <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;content&#45;type&#45;sniffing&#45;2"></a>[computed type of the resource](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#computed-mime-type) in the <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;navigate"></a>[navigate](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigate) algorithm was <a id="svg&#45;0&#58;image&#47;svg&#43;xml"></a><code>[image&#47;svg&#43;xml](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image/svg+xml)</code>&#44; then return <var>document</var>&#46;

3.  Return null&#46;

#### <a id="dimension&#45;attributes"></a>4&#46;8&#46;17 <strong>Dimension attributes</strong>[](#dimension-attributes)

<strong>Author requirements</strong>&#58; The <a id="attr&#45;dim&#45;width"></a><strong><code>width</code></strong> and <a id="attr&#45;dim&#45;height"></a><strong><code>height</code></strong> attributes on <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code>&#44; <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code>&#44; <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element"></a><code>[embed](#the-embed-element)</code>&#44; <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code>&#44; <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code>&#44; <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> when the parent is a <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;picture&#45;element"></a><code>[picture](#the-picture-element)</code> element and&#44; when their <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;"></a>[Image Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#image-button-state-(type=image)) state&#44; <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code> elements may be specified to give the dimensions of the visual content of the element &#40;the width and height respectively&#44; relative to the nominal direction of the output medium&#41;&#44; in <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;&#39;px&#39;"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46; The attributes&#44; if specified&#44; must have values that are <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integer"></a>[valid non&#45;negative integers](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-negative-integer)&#46;

The specified dimensions given may differ from the dimensions specified in the resource itself&#44; since the resource may have a resolution that differs from the CSS pixel resolution&#46; &#40;On screens&#44; <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;2"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px) have a resolution of 96ppi&#44; but in general the CSS pixel resolution depends on the reading distance&#46;&#41; If both attributes are specified&#44; then one of the following statements must be true&#58;

- <var>specified width</var> &#45; 0&#46;5 ≤ <var>specified height</var> &#42; <var>target ratio</var> ≤ <var>specified width</var> &#43; 0&#46;5
- <var>specified height</var> &#45; 0&#46;5 ≤ <var>specified width</var> &#47; <var>target ratio</var> ≤ <var>specified height</var> &#43; 0&#46;5
- <var>specified height</var> &#61; <var>specified width</var> &#61; 0

The <var>target ratio</var> is the ratio of the <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;natural&#45;width"></a>[natural width](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-width) to the <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;natural&#45;height"></a>[natural height](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-height) in the resource&#46; The <var>specified width</var> and <var>specified height</var> are the values of the <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;width"></a><code>[width](#attr-dim-width)</code> and <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;height"></a><code>[height](#attr-dim-height)</code> attributes respectively&#46;

The two attributes must be omitted if the resource in question does not have both a <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;natural&#45;width&#45;2"></a>[natural width](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-width) and a <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;natural&#45;height&#45;2"></a>[natural height](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-height)&#46;

If the two attributes are both 0&#44; it indicates that the element is not intended for the user &#40;e&#46;g&#46; it might be a part of a service to count page views&#41;&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The dimension attributes are not intended to be used to stretch the image&#46;

<strong>User agent requirements</strong>&#58; User agents are expected to use these attributes [as hints for the rendering](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dimRendering)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

For <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[iframe](#the-iframe-element)</code>&#44; <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;embed&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[embed](#the-embed-element)</code> and <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[object](#the-object-element)</code> the IDL attributes are <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;domstring"></a><code>[DOMString](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString)</code>&#59; for <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;video&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[video](#the-video-element)</code> and <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;source&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[source](#the-source-element)</code> the IDL attributes are <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;idl&#45;unsigned&#45;long"></a><code>[unsigned long](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long)</code>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The corresponding IDL attributes for <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;dom&#45;img&#45;height"></a><code>[img](#dom-img-height)</code> and <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;height"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#dom-input-height)</code> elements are defined in those respective elements&#39; sections&#44; as they are slightly more specific to those elements&#39; other behaviors&#46; Both are defined in terms of the algorithm below&#46;

To <a id="determine&#45;dimensions"></a><strong>determine the dimensions</strong> of an <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[img](#the-img-element)</code> or <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](html-language-forms-tables-templates--877d6146487f--2dfc6f632608.md#the-input-element)</code> element <var>element</var> given a struct consisting of a width and a height&#44; or null&#44; <var>naturalDimensions</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var> is <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;being&#45;rendered"></a>[being rendered](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#being-rendered)&#44; then return the width and height of <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;content&#45;box"></a>[content box](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-box/#content-box)&#44; in <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;3"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46; [&#91;CSS&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSS)

2.  Let <var>width</var> and <var>height</var> be 0&#46;

3.  If <var>naturalDimensions</var> is not null&#44; then set <var>width</var> to <var>naturalDimensions</var>&#39;s width and <var>height</var> to <var>naturalDimensions</var>&#39;s height&#46;

4.  If <var>element</var> has a <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;width&#45;2"></a><code>[width](#attr-dim-width)</code> attribute&#58;

    1.  Let <var>attributeWidth</var> be the result of <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integers"></a>[parsing that attribute&#39;s value](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-non-negative-integers)&#46;

    2.  If <var>attributeWidth</var> is not an error&#44; then set <var>width</var> to <var>attributeWidth</var>&#46;

5.  If <var>element</var> has a <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;height&#45;2"></a><code>[height](#attr-dim-height)</code> attribute&#58;

    1.  Let <var>attributeHeight</var> be the result of <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integers&#45;2"></a>[parsing that attribute&#39;s value](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-non-negative-integers)&#46;

    2.  If <var>attributeHeight</var> is not an error&#44; then set <var>height</var> to <var>attributeHeight</var>&#46;

6.  Return a width of <var>width</var> and a height of <var>height</var>&#44; in <a id="dimension&#45;attributes&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;4"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46;
